        clear,status:()=>({chain:chain?{kind:chain.kind,target:chain.target,phase:chain.preparing?'prepare':'committed',ready:chain.issued?[...chain.issued.values()].filter(e=>e.ready).length:null,active:chain.active,remaining:chain.issued?[...chain.issued.values()].filter(e=>!e.done).length:chain.queue.length}:null,job:job?{...job}:null})
    };
}

// The player HP receipt and our Polearm swing may arrive in either order.
function createDragonCapeWindow(now,onChange=()=>{}) {
    let until=0,attempt=null,lastSwing=null,lastText=null;
    function recent(){
        if(attempt&&now()>attempt.deadline)attempt=null;
        return attempt;
    }
    function extend(end){
        if(end<=until)return;
        until=end;onChange();
    }
    function confirm(){
        if(!attempt?.hit||attempt.swingAt==null)return;
        extend(attempt.swingAt+5000);
        attempt=null;
    }
    function matchText(){
        if(!lastSwing||!lastText||lastSwing.id!==lastText.id||Math.abs(lastSwing.at-lastText.at)>lastText.windowMs)return;
        extend(lastSwing.at+5000);lastSwing=lastText=null;
    }
    return {
        begin(sid,hp,damage,receiptWindow){
            attempt={sid,hp,damage,deadline:now()+receiptWindow,swingAt:null,hit:false};
        },
        health(sid,hp){
            const a=recent();
            if(!a||a.sid!==sid||!Number.isFinite(hp))return;
            const loss=a.hp-hp;
            if(loss>0&&(Math.abs(loss-a.damage)<=1.1||hp<=0&&a.hp>0&&a.hp<=a.damage+1.1))a.hit=true;
            a.hp=hp;
            confirm();
        },
        swing(id){
            lastSwing={id,at:now()};const a=recent();
            if(id===5&&a){a.swingAt??=lastSwing.at;confirm();}
            matchText();
        },
        playerDamageText(id,windowMs){lastText={id,at:now(),windowMs};matchText();},
        remaining:()=>Math.max(0,until-now()),
        pending:()=>!!recent(),
        reset(){until=0;attempt=lastSwing=lastText=null;}
    };
}

function createMeleeFollowups({self,players,player,weapon,position,damage,now,tick,enabled,onHit}){
    const health=new Map(),drops=new Map();let confirmed=0,late=[];
    const seed=()=>{health.clear();drops.clear();late=[];for(const p of players())health.set(p.sid,p.health);};
    function accept(sample,actor,id){
        const target=player(sample.target);if(!enabled()||!target?.alive||!actor?.alive||target.health<=0||target.health>sample.hp||now()-sample.at>tick()*1.5)return false;
        const expected=damage(actor,target,id);if(!(expected>0)||Math.abs(expected-sample.loss)>1.1)return false;
        confirmed++;onHit({...sample,actor:actor.sid,weapon:id,at:now()});return true;
    }
    seed();
    return {
        health(sid,value){
            const p=player(sid),before=health.get(sid)??p?.maxHealth??100;health.set(sid,value);
            if(!enabled()||sid===self().sid||!p||value<=0||value>=before){drops.delete(sid);return;}
            const a=position(self()),b=position(p);
            if(Math.hypot(a.x-b.x,a.y-b.y)>750)return;
            drops.set(sid,{target:sid,before,hp:value,loss:before-value,at:now()});
        },
        swing(sid,id){
            const samples=[...drops.values()];drops.clear();
            if(!enabled())return;
            const actor=player(sid),w=weapon(id);
            if(!actor?.alive||!actor.visible||!(w?.dmg>0)||w.projectile!=null)return;
            const a=position(actor);
            for(const sample of samples){
                const target=player(sample.target);if(!target?.alive||!target.visible||target.health<=0||target.sid===sid||now()-sample.at>tick()*1.5)continue;
                if(actor.team!=null&&actor.team===target.team)continue;
                const b=position(target);if(Math.hypot(a.x-b.x,a.y-b.y)>(w.range||0)+(target.scale||35)*1.8+8)continue;
                // A remote Bull switch may only arrive in the position packet
                // following this swing. Recheck once at that packet, never poll.
                if(!accept(sample,actor,id))late.push({sample,sid,id});
            }
        },
        pending:sid=>drops.has(sid)||late.some(e=>e.sample.target===sid),
        tick(){const delayed=late;late=[];for(const e of delayed)accept(e.sample,player(e.sid),e.id);drops.clear();for(const p of players())health.set(p.sid,p.health);for(const sid of health.keys())if(!player(sid))health.delete(sid);},
        clear:seed,
        status:()=>({healthSamples:health.size,pending:drops.size,confirmed})
    };
}



function createIncrementalWorld(ctx){
    const size=256,entries=new Map(),cells=new Map(),wide=new Set(),owners=new Map();
    let sequence=0,list=null,revision=0,updates=0,rebuilds=0;
    const physical=o=>o?.active&&!o.fake&&!o.preplace;
    function unlink(e){
        for(const key of e.cells){const set=cells.get(key);set?.delete(e);if(!set?.size)cells.delete(key);}
        wide.delete(e);const owned=owners.get(e.owner);owned?.delete(e);if(!owned?.size)owners.delete(e.owner);
    }
    function remove(sid){const e=entries.get(sid);if(!e)return;unlink(e);entries.delete(sid);list=null;revision++;}
    function upsert(o){
        if(!physical(o)){if(o)remove(o.sid);return;}
        let e=entries.get(o.sid);if(e)unlink(e);else{e={order:sequence++};entries.set(o.sid,e);}
        e.object=o;e.cells=[];e.owner=o.ownerSid;
        if(ctx.data.item(o.id)?.group?.name==='spikes'){let owned=owners.get(e.owner);if(!owned)owners.set(e.owner,owned=new Set());owned.add(e);}
        const radius=Math.max(o.blocker||0,o.getScale?.(.6,o.isItem)??o.scale,o.getScale?.()??o.scale);
        const x0=Math.floor((o.x-radius)/size),x1=Math.floor((o.x+radius)/size),y0=Math.floor((o.y-radius)/size),y1=Math.floor((o.y+radius)/size);
        if(![o.x,o.y,radius].every(Number.isFinite)||radius<0||(x1-x0+1)*(y1-y0+1)>1024)wide.add(e);
        else for(let x=x0;x<=x1;x++)for(let y=y0;y<=y1;y++){const key=x+':'+y;let set=cells.get(key);if(!set)cells.set(key,set=new Set());set.add(e);e.cells.push(key);}
        list=null;revision++;updates++;
    }
    function clear(){entries.clear();cells.clear();wide.clear();owners.clear();list=null;sequence=0;revision++;}
    function rebuild(){clear();for(const o of ctx.objects.all())upsert(o);rebuilds++;}
    function all(){return list||(list=[...entries.values()].map(e=>e.object).filter(physical));}
    const regions=new Map();let regionRevision=-1;
    function query(a,b){
        if(![a.x,a.y,b.x,b.y].every(Number.isFinite))return all();
        const x0=Math.floor(Math.min(a.x,b.x)/size),x1=Math.floor(Math.max(a.x,b.x)/size),y0=Math.floor(Math.min(a.y,b.y)/size),y1=Math.floor(Math.max(a.y,b.y)/size);
        if((x1-x0+1)*(y1-y0+1)>4096)return all();
        if(regionRevision!==revision){regions.clear();regionRevision=revision;}
        const key=x0+':'+y0+':'+x1+':'+y1;
        const saved=regions.get(key);
        if(saved)return saved.filter(physical);
        const found=new Set(wide);
        for(let x=x0;x<=x1;x++)for(let y=y0;y<=y1;y++)for(const e of cells.get(x+':'+y)||[])found.add(e);
        const ordered=[...found].sort((a,b)=>a.order-b.order).map(entry=>entry.object);
        if(regions.size>=64)regions.clear();
        regions.set(key,ordered);
        return ordered.filter(physical);
    }
    rebuild();
    ctx.on('objectsLoad',p=>{const data=p.args?.[0];if(!Array.isArray(data)||data.length%8){rebuild();return;}for(let i=0;i<data.length;i+=8){const sid=data[i],o=ctx.objects.get(sid);if(o)upsert(o);else remove(sid);}});
    ctx.on('objectKilled',p=>remove(p.args?.[0]));
    ctx.on('objectsKilled',p=>{const owner=p.args?.[0];for(const [sid,e]of entries)if(e.owner===owner)remove(sid);});
    for(const event of ['setup','reset','died','disconnect'])ctx.on(event,rebuild);
    return {all,query,get revision(){return revision;},ownedSpikes:sid=>[...(owners.get(sid)||[])].map(e=>e.object).filter(physical),status:()=>({revision,objects:entries.size,cells:cells.size,updates,rebuilds})};
}

function amStructureLimit(group,sandbox){
    if(!group?.place||!(group.limit>0))return Infinity;
    return sandbox?(group.sandboxLimit||Math.max(group.limit*3,99)):group.limit;
}
function amSandbox(ctx,root){return /^sandbox(?:-[a-z0-9]+)?\.moomoo\.io$/i.test(root.location.hostname)||ctx.combat?.sandbox===true;}
function createHatCycles(now,tick){
    const players=new Map(),median=a=>{const b=a.slice().sort((x,y)=>x-y);return b[Math.floor(b.length/2)];};
    function observe(sid,hat,weapon,health){
        if(!Number.isInteger(hat))return;
        const time=now();let s=players.get(sid);
        if(!s||time-s.seen>tick*3){
            if(!s&&players.size>=64)players.delete(players.keys().next().value);
            s={hat,weapon,since:time,seen:time,edges:new Map(),attacks:new Map(),runs:[],health:[],lastHealth:Number.isFinite(health)?health:null};players.set(sid,s);return;
        }
        const previousSeen=s.seen;s.seen=time;s.weapon=weapon;
        if(s.lastHealth==null&&Number.isFinite(health))s.lastHealth=health;
        if(s.hat===hat)return;
        const duration=time-s.since;
        if(duration>=tick*.4&&duration<=6000){
            const edges=s.edges.get(s.hat)||[];edges.push({to:hat,duration});if(edges.length>10)edges.shift();s.edges.set(s.hat,edges);
            s.runs.push({hat:s.hat,start:s.since,last:previousSeen,nextHat:hat});if(s.runs.length>24)s.runs.shift();
        }
        s.hat=hat;s.since=time;
        if(s.pending&&time-s.pending.at<=tick*1.5)link(s,s.pending);
    }
    function health(sid,value){
        const s=players.get(sid);if(!s||!Number.isFinite(value))return;
        if(value<=0){players.delete(sid);return;}
        if(s.lastHealth!=null&&s.lastHealth!==value){
            const time=now();s.health.push({at:time,amount:value-s.lastHealth});
            s.health=s.health.filter(e=>time-e.at<12000).slice(-64);
        }
        s.lastHealth=value;
    }
    function link(s,a){
        if(a.linked)return;
        if((s.hat===40&&a.weapon===10)||(s.hat===7&&a.primary)){s.attacks.set(s.hat,(s.attacks.get(s.hat)||0)+1);a.linked=true;}
    }
    function attack(sid,weapon,primary){
        const s=players.get(sid);if(!s)return;
        s.pending={at:now(),weapon,primary};link(s,s.pending);
    }
    // Glotus-style Bull reset evidence: a short Bull run, five damage, then
    // slow healing. Mere hat changes or one unrelated five-point hit are not
    // sufficient to authorize a future armor opening.
    function bullPulse(s,lead){
        const time=now(),runs=s.runs.filter(r=>r.hat===7&&time-r.start<8000).slice(-5),paired=[];
        for(const r of runs){
            const loss=s.health.find(e=>Math.abs(e.amount+5)<.1&&e.at>=r.start-tick*1.25&&e.at<=r.last+tick);
            const gain=loss&&s.health.find(e=>e.amount>0&&e.at>loss.at+120&&e.at<=loss.at+900);
            if(gain)paired.push({...r,loss});
        }
        if(paired.length<3||paired.length<runs.length*.8)return null;
        const intervals=paired.slice(1).map((r,i)=>r.start-paired[i].start),period=median(intervals);
        const jitter=Math.max(...intervals.map(n=>Math.abs(n-period))),width=median(paired.map(r=>r.last-r.start+tick));
        if(period<600||period>1600||jitter>tick*1.25||width>period*.6||lead>period)return null;
        const anchor=s.hat===7?s.since:paired.at(-1).start;
        if(time-anchor>period+tick*1.5)return null;
        const confidence=Math.min(.96,.72+paired.length*.04)*Math.max(.65,1-jitter/(tick*6));
        if(confidence<.8)return null;
        const center=anchor+(width-tick)/2,phase=((time+lead-center+period/2)%period+period)%period-period/2;
        const edge=width/2-Math.abs(phase);
        if(Math.abs(edge)<=jitter)return {hat:null,confidence:0,source:'bull-heal-boundary'};
        const counts=new Map();for(const r of paired)counts.set(r.nextHat,(counts.get(r.nextHat)||0)+1);
        const [base,count]=[...counts].sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1])[0];
        const inside=edge>0,hat=inside?7:count>=paired.length*.8?base:null;
        const remaining=inside?width/2-phase-jitter:(phase<0?-width/2-phase:period-width/2-phase)-jitter;
        return {hat,confidence,samples:paired.length,period,remaining,verifiedPulse:true,source:'bull-heal-cycle'};
    }
    function forecast(sid,lead){
        const s=players.get(sid),time=now();if(!s||time-s.seen>tick*3||!Number.isFinite(lead)||lead<0)return null;
        const pulse=bullPulse(s,lead);if(pulse)return pulse.hat==null?null:pulse;
        let age=time-s.since+lead,hat=s.hat,confidence=1,samples=Infinity;
        for(let step=0;step<5;step++){
            const edges=s.edges.get(hat)||[],groups=new Map();
            for(const e of edges){const g=groups.get(e.to)||[];g.push(e.duration);groups.set(e.to,g);}
            const best=[...groups.entries()].sort((a,b)=>b[1].length-a[1].length)[0];
            if(!best||best[1].length<2)return null;
            const duration=median(best[1]),jitter=median(best[1].map(v=>Math.abs(v-duration))),ratio=best[1].length/edges.length;
            const tolerance=Math.max(tick*.6,duration*.25),consistent=best[1].filter(v=>Math.abs(v-duration)<=tolerance).length/best[1].length;
            if(ratio<.75||consistent<.75||jitter>tolerance||step===0&&time-s.since>duration+tick)return null;
            confidence=Math.min(confidence,ratio);samples=Math.min(samples,best[1].length);
            if(age<duration)return {hat,confidence,samples,remaining:duration-age,attackLinked:(s.attacks.get(hat)||0)>=2,source:'attack-hat-cycle'};
            age-=duration;hat=best[0];
        }
        return null;
    }
    function window(sid,from,to){
        const a=forecast(sid,Math.max(0,from)),b=forecast(sid,Math.max(0,to));
        if(!a||!b||a.hat!==b.hat||a.remaining<=Math.max(0,to)-Math.max(0,from))return null;
        return {...a,confidence:Math.min(a.confidence,b.confidence),valid:![6,60,61,22].includes(a.hat)&&(![7,40].includes(a.hat)||a.verifiedPulse||a.attackLinked)};
    }
    return {observe,attack,health,forecast,window,remove:sid=>players.delete(sid),clear:()=>players.clear(),size:()=>players.size};
}


function createCombatIndicators(api,root,ctx){
    const rows=new Map(),groups=new Map();let order=0,drawn={markers:[],lines:[]};
    const list=root.document.createElement('div');list.id='am-active-modules';
    list.style.cssText='position:fixed;left:18px;bottom:180px;z-index:31;pointer-events:none;white-space:pre;color:#c3f58d;font:14px/1.4 "Hammersmith One",Arial,sans-serif;text-shadow:0 1px 3px #171b20;display:none';
    function record(group,key,on){const entry=groups.get(group),label=entry?.labels[key];if(!label)return;const id=group+':'+key;if(on&&(entry.armed.has(key)||group==='am-combat'&&(key==='dragonOneTick'||key==='spikeInsta'))){if(!rows.has(id))rows.set(id,{id,key,label,order:++order});}else{rows.delete(id);if(!on)entry.armed.delete(key);}}
    function register(group,settings,labels){groups.set(group,{settings,labels,armed:new Set()});for(const key of Object.keys(labels))record(group,key,!!settings[key]);}
    function entries(){for(const [id,g]of groups)for(const key of Object.keys(g.labels))record(id,key,!!g.settings[key]);return [...rows.values()].sort((a,b)=>b.order-a.order);}
    function update(visible,info){
        if(root.document.body&&!list.isConnected)root.document.body.append(list);
        const seconds=Math.ceil(Math.min(5000,root.MooMooCombatMacros?.dragonBuffMs?.()||0)/1000);
        const active=entries().filter(r=>r.key!=='dragonOneTick'||seconds>0);
        const text=active.map(r=>r.label+': ON'+(r.key==='dragonOneTick'?' ('+seconds+'s)':'')).join('\n');if(list.textContent!==text)list.textContent=text;
        list.style.display=visible&&active.length?'block':'none';
        const offset=info?.style.display!=='none'?(Number.parseFloat(info.style.bottom)||180)+(info.offsetHeight||0)+10:180,bottom=offset+'px';if(list.style.bottom!==bottom)list.style.bottom=bottom;
    }
    function draw(pen,view,me,label){
        const state=root.AntimoocheatCombat?.indicators?.()||{markers:[],lines:[]};drawn={markers:[],lines:[],circles:[]};
        const x1=me.x-view.left,y1=me.y-view.top;
        pen.save();pen.lineWidth=2;const lineRows=new Map(),markerRows=new Map();
        for(const row of state.circles||[]){
            const target=ctx.render.player(row.sid);if(!target?.visible)continue;
            const angle=Math.atan2(target.y-me.y,target.x-me.x),dx=Math.cos(angle)*row.offset,dy=Math.sin(angle)*row.offset;
            const x=row.anchor==='target'?target.x-view.left-dx:x1+dx,y=row.anchor==='target'?target.y-view.top-dy:y1+dy;
            const color='#e25176';pen.strokeStyle=color;pen.lineWidth=2;pen.setLineDash([]);
            pen.beginPath();pen.arc(x,y,row.radius,0,Math.PI*2);pen.stroke();
            drawn.circles.push({...row,x:x+view.left,y:y+view.top});
        }
        for(const row of state.lines){
            const p=ctx.render.player(row.sid);if(!p?.visible)continue;
            const x=p.x-view.left,y=p.y-view.top,color=row.valid?'#b3ee78':'#f3ca70';
            pen.strokeStyle=color;pen.setLineDash([8,6]);pen.beginPath();pen.moveTo(x1,y1);pen.lineTo(x,y);pen.stroke();pen.setLineDash([]);
            pen.beginPath();pen.arc(x,y,(p.scale||35)+12,0,Math.PI*2);pen.stroke();
            const stack=lineRows.get(row.sid)||0;lineRows.set(row.sid,stack+1);
            label(pen,row.label+' '+row.distance.toFixed(1)+' / '+row.range,(x+x1)/2,(y+y1)/2-20-stack*20,color,15);drawn.lines.push(row);
        }
        for(const row of state.markers){
            const p=ctx.render.player(row.sid);if(!p?.visible)continue;const x=p.x-view.left,y=p.y-view.top,r=(p.scale||35)+24;
            pen.strokeStyle=row.kind==='troll'?'#52c7ff':'#ff7c96';pen.beginPath();
            for(let i=0;i<4;i++){const a=i*Math.PI/2;pen.moveTo(x+(r+9)*Math.cos(a)-7*Math.sin(a),y+(r+9)*Math.sin(a)+7*Math.cos(a));pen.lineTo(x+r*Math.cos(a),y+r*Math.sin(a));pen.lineTo(x+(r+9)*Math.cos(a)+7*Math.sin(a),y+(r+9)*Math.sin(a)-7*Math.cos(a));}pen.stroke();
            const stack=markerRows.get(row.sid)||0;markerRows.set(row.sid,stack+1);
            label(pen,row.label,x,y-r-37-stack*20,pen.strokeStyle,15);drawn.markers.push(row);
        }
        pen.restore();
    }
    const service={register,record,arm:(group,key)=>{const entry=groups.get(group);if(entry?.labels[key]){entry.armed.add(key);record(group,key,!!entry.settings[key]);}},update,draw,snapshot:()=>({active:entries().map(r=>({...r})),...drawn})};root.AntimoocheatIndicators=service;
    ctx.onCleanup(()=>{list.remove();rows.clear();groups.clear();if(root.AntimoocheatIndicators===service)delete root.AntimoocheatIndicators;});return service;
}

function createObservedPlayerView(api,ctx,root){
    const teamValue=value=>value===''||value===false||value===0?null:value;
    const sightings=new Map();let sightingTick=0;
    for(const p of api.players.values())if(p.visible&&Number.isFinite(p.x)&&Number.isFinite(p.y))sightings.set(p.sid,{x:p.x2??p.x,y:p.y2??p.y,dir:p.d2??p.dir});
    const normalizeTeam=p=>{if(p)p.team=teamValue(p.team);};
    normalizeTeam(api.self);for(const p of api.players.values())normalizeTeam(p);
    ctx.on('playersUpdate',payload=>{
        normalizeTeam(api.self);
        sightingTick++;
        for(const point of payload.positions||[])if(Number.isFinite(point.x)&&Number.isFinite(point.y)){
            const sample=sightings.get(point.sid);
            if(sample){sample.x=point.x;sample.y=point.y;sample.dir=point.dir;sample.tick=sightingTick;}
            else sightings.set(point.sid,{x:point.x,y:point.y,dir:point.dir,tick:sightingTick});
        }
        for(const attr of payload.attributes||[]){
            normalizeTeam(api.players.get(attr.sid));
            const sample=sightings.get(attr.sid);
            if(sample){
                sample.awaitingTeam=false;
                if(sample.tick!==sightingTick&&!payload.hidden?.includes(attr.sid)){
                    const native=ctx.combat?.Hg?.(attr.sid);
                    if(native){
                        // The SDK's building-hit resolver reads these fields,
                        // which its animation loop sets only on moving actors.
                        native.x2=sample.x;native.y2=sample.y;native.d2=sample.dir;
                        native.skinIndex=attr.skin;native.weaponVariant=attr.variant;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        for(const sid of payload.hidden||[])sightings.delete(sid);
    });
    ctx.on('playerAdd',payload=>{
        normalizeTeam(api.self);
        const data=payload.data,player=api.players.get(data?.[1]);
        normalizeTeam(player);
        if(player&&Number.isFinite(data?.[6]))player.health=data[6];
        if(player&&data[6]>0&&Number.isFinite(data[3])&&Number.isFinite(data[4]))
            sightings.set(data[1],{x:data[3],y:data[4],dir:data[5],awaitingTeam:!payload.isYou&&api.self.team!=null});
        else if(data)sightings.delete(data[1]);
    });
    ctx.on('tribeMembers',payload=>{
        const team=teamValue(api.self.team),members=payload.args?.[0];
        if(team==null||!Array.isArray(members)||members.length%2)return;
        const ids=new Set();
        for(let i=0;i<members.length;i+=2){
            if(!Number.isInteger(members[i])||typeof members[i+1]!=='string')return;
            ids.add(members[i]);
        }
        if(!ids.has(api.self.sid))return;
        for(const player of api.players.values()){
            if(ids.has(player.sid))player.team=team;
            else if(player.team===team)player.team=null;
        }
    });
    ctx.on('tribeSet',payload=>{if(Array.isArray(payload.args))api.self.team=teamValue(payload.args[0]);});
    ctx.on('playerRemove',p=>sightings.delete(p.sid));
    for(const event of ['setup','reset','disconnect','died'])ctx.on(event,()=>sightings.clear());
    let revision=0,seen=-1;const records=new Map(),view=new Map();
    const normalized=new Set(['x2','y2','hat','accessory','health','alive','visible']);
    const relevant=new Set(['playersUpdate','playerAdd','playerRemove','setup','reset','disconnect','died']);
    ctx.on('*',event=>{if(relevant.has(event))revision++;});
    function read(record,key){
        const p=record.player,n=record.native;
        if(key==='visible'||key==='x2'||key==='y2'){
            const sample=sightings.get(p.sid);
            if(key==='visible')return !!sample&&!sample.awaitingTeam;
            if(sample)return key==='x2'?sample.x:sample.y;
        }
        if(key==='team')return teamValue(Object.hasOwn(p,'team')?p.team:n.team);
        if(key==='x2')return p.x2??n.x2??p.x;
        if(key==='y2')return p.y2??n.y2??p.y;
        if(key==='hat')return record.player.sid===api.self.sid?(root?.AntimoocheatEquipment?.current()??p.hat??p.skin??n.skinIndex):p.hat??p.skin??n.skinIndex;
        if(key==='accessory')return p.accessory??p.tail??n.tailIndex;
        if(key==='health')return p.health??n.health;
        if(key==='alive')return p.alive??n.alive??n.Alive??((p.health??n.health??100)>0);
        return Object.hasOwn(p,key)?p[key]:n[key];
    }
    return function observed(){
        if(seen===revision)return view;seen=revision;
        for(const sid of records.keys())if(!api.players.has(sid)){records.delete(sid);view.delete(sid);}
        for(const [sid,p]of api.players){
            let record=records.get(sid);
            if(!record){
                record={player:p,native:{},shadow:{}};
                const keys=()=>[...new Set([...Object.keys(record.native),...Object.keys(record.player),...normalized,...Object.keys(record.shadow)])];
                record.proxy=new Proxy({}, {
                    get:(_,key)=>Object.hasOwn(record.shadow,key)?record.shadow[key]:read(record,key),has:(_,key)=>normalized.has(key)||key in record.player||key in record.native||key in record.shadow,
                    set:(_,key,value)=>{record.shadow[key]=value;return true;},
                    ownKeys:keys,getOwnPropertyDescriptor:(_,key)=>normalized.has(key)||Object.hasOwn(record.native,key)||Object.hasOwn(record.player,key)||Object.hasOwn(record.shadow,key)?{configurable:true,enumerable:true,writable:true,value:read(record,key)}:undefined
                });
                records.set(sid,record);view.set(sid,record.proxy);
            }
            record.player=p;record.native=sid===api.self.sid?api.self:ctx.combat?.Hg?.(sid)||{};record.shadow={};
        }
        return view;
    };
}

function createResourceBalance(ctx,root){
    if(root.AntimoocheatResourceBalance)return root.AntimoocheatResourceBalance;
    const keys=new Set(['food','wood','stone','points']),reported=new Map(),fallback=new Map(),pending=new Map();
    let selected=null;
    function observed(key){
        if(reported.has(key))return reported.get(key);
        const time=root.performance.now(),old=fallback.get(key);
        if(old && time-old.at<16)return old.value;
        const text=root.document.getElementById(key+'Display')?.textContent.trim().replace(/[\s,]/g,'')||'';
        const match=/^(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)([kmb])?$/i.exec(text);
        const native=Number(ctx.self[key]);
        const value=match?Number(match[1])*({k:1000,m:1000000,b:1000000000}[match[2]?.toLowerCase()]||1):Number.isFinite(native)?Math.max(0,native):0;
        fallback.set(key,{value,at:time});return value;
    }
    function reservations(key){
        const list=pending.get(key)||[],time=root.performance.now();
        while(list.length && list[0].until<=time)list.shift();
        return list;
    }
    function amount(key){return Math.max(0,observed(key)-reservations(key).reduce((sum,p)=>sum+p.cost,0));}
    function spend(req){
        const until=root.performance.now()+Math.max(500,2*(ctx.net?.ping||0)+300);
        for(let i=0;i<(req?.length||0);i+=2){
            const key=req[i],cost=Number(req[i+1]);
            if(!keys.has(key)||!(cost>0))continue;
            const list=reservations(key);list.push({cost,until});pending.set(key,list);
        }
    }
    const clear=()=>{reported.clear();fallback.clear();pending.clear();selected=null;};
    ctx.on('playerValue',p=>{
        if(!keys.has(p.key)||!Number.isFinite(p.value))return;
        const previous=reported.get(p.key)??fallback.get(p.key)?.value;
        const list=reservations(p.key);
        let spent=Math.max(0,(previous??p.value)-p.value);
        while(spent>0&&list.length){const used=Math.min(spent,list[0].cost);spent-=used;list[0].cost-=used;if(!list[0].cost)list.shift();}
        reported.set(p.key,Math.max(0,p.value));fallback.delete(p.key);
    });
    ctx.onSent((action,p)=>{
        if(action==='selectItem')selected=p.isWeapon?null:p.index;
        if(action==='mouse'&&p.down&&selected!=null){const item=ctx.data.item(selected);if(item?.heal||item?.group?.place&&!amSandbox(ctx,root))spend(item.req);}
    });
    for(const event of ['setup','reset','disconnect','died'])ctx.on(event,clear);
    ctx.on('playerAdd',p=>{if(p.isYou)clear();});
    const service={amount,status:()=>({reported:[...reported.keys()],fallback:fallback.size})};
    root.AntimoocheatResourceBalance=service;ctx.onCleanup(()=>{clear();if(root.AntimoocheatResourceBalance===service)delete root.AntimoocheatResourceBalance;});return service;
}

function installNavigationPathVisual(ctx,root){
    const proto=root.Object.prototype,prior=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(proto,'line');
    let renderer=null,alphaDescriptor=null,alpha=1,drawing=false,disposed=false,frames=0,lastPath=[];
    // Draw in the native ground pass, after the grid and before world objects.
    // A z-index on the SDK overlay would still put the path above players.
    function paint(pen){
        if(disposed||drawing)return;
        lastPath=[];
        if(!ctx.self.alive)return;
        const path=root.MooMooAutomation?.navigationPath?.();
        if(!path?.length)return;
        const view=ctx.render.view,me=ctx.render.me||ctx.self;
        if(!Number.isFinite(me.x)||!Number.isFinite(me.y))return;
        const points=[{x:me.x,y:me.y},...path];
        drawing=true;pen.save();
        try{
            pen.globalAlpha=.8;pen.strokeStyle='#ffffff';pen.lineWidth=2.5;
            for(let i=1;i<points.length;i++){
                const a=points[i-1],b=points[i];
                pen.line(a.x-view.left,a.y-view.top,b.x-view.left,b.y-view.top);
            }
            lastPath=points;frames++;
        }finally{pen.restore();drawing=false;}
    }
    const alphaGet=()=>alpha;
    const alphaSet=value=>{
        const groundFinished=alpha===.06&&value===1;alpha=value;
        if(groundFinished)paint(renderer);
    };
    function capture(pen){
        if(renderer||!Object.hasOwn(pen,'drawCalls')||typeof pen.drawImage!=='function'||typeof pen.resize!=='function')return;
        const descriptor=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(pen,'globalAlpha');
        if(!descriptor?.configurable||!Object.hasOwn(descriptor,'value'))return;
        renderer=pen;alphaDescriptor=descriptor;alpha=descriptor.value;
        Object.defineProperty(pen,'globalAlpha',{configurable:true,enumerable:descriptor.enumerable,get:alphaGet,set:alphaSet});
        if(Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(proto,'line')?.set===captureLine)delete proto.line;
    }
    function captureLine(value){
        Object.defineProperty(this,'line',{configurable:true,enumerable:true,writable:true,value});
        if(typeof value==='function')capture(this);
    }
    if(!prior)Object.defineProperty(proto,'line',{configurable:true,set:captureLine});
    const service={status:()=>({attached:!!renderer,layer:'after-ground-before-world',color:'#ffffff',opacity:.8,transparency:.2,frames,points:lastPath.map(p=>({...p}))})};
    root.AntimoocheatPathVisual=service;
    ctx.onCleanup(()=>{
        disposed=true;lastPath=[];
        if(Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(proto,'line')?.set===captureLine)delete proto.line;
        if(renderer&&Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(renderer,'globalAlpha')?.get===alphaGet)Object.defineProperty(renderer,'globalAlpha',{...alphaDescriptor,value:alpha});
        if(root.AntimoocheatPathVisual===service)delete root.AntimoocheatPathVisual;
    });
}

function installVisualMotion(ctx,root,settings,menuOpen){
    const proto=root.Object.prototype,tracked=new Set();let zoom=1,disposed=false,allocations=0,lastWheel=null;
    const baseWidth=ctx.combat?.K?.maxScreenWidth||1920,baseHeight=ctx.combat?.K?.maxScreenHeight||1080;
    const stopped=o=>o.group?.name==='spikes'?settings.disableSpikeSpin:o.group?.name==='mill'?settings.disableWindmillSpin:false;
    const prior=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(proto,'turnSpeed');
    const hook=function(value){
        if(typeof this.init!=='function'||typeof this.getScale!=='function'){
            Object.defineProperty(this,'turnSpeed',{value,writable:true,configurable:true,enumerable:true});return;
        }
        const object=this,record={object,value,get:null};record.get=()=>!disposed&&stopped(object)?0:record.value;
        Object.defineProperty(object,'turnSpeed',{get:record.get,set:value=>{record.value=value;},configurable:true,enumerable:true});tracked.add(new root.WeakRef(record));
        if(++allocations%256===0)for(const ref of tracked)if(!ref.deref())tracked.delete(ref);
    };
    if(!prior)Object.defineProperty(proto,'turnSpeed',{configurable:true,set:hook});
    // Resize is closed over by the native renderer. Wrap its registered resize
    // callbacks, using the user's real wheel event when requesting a new scale.
    // Math.max is restored synchronously before returning from each callback.
    const add=root.addEventListener,remove=root.removeEventListener,resizers=[];
    const capture=options=>typeof options==='boolean'?options:!!options?.capture;
    function scaled(callback,event){
        const original=root.Math.max,w=root.innerWidth,h=root.innerHeight;
        const a=w/baseWidth,b=h/(baseHeight*1.15),c=Math.sqrt(w*h/(baseWidth*baseHeight));
        const wrapper=function(x,y,z){if(arguments.length===3&&Math.abs(x-a)<1e-8&&Math.abs(y-b)<1e-8&&Math.abs(z-c)<1e-8)return original(x,y,z)/zoom;return original.apply(this,arguments);};
        if(!disposed&&zoom!==1)root.Math.max=wrapper;
        try{return typeof callback==='function'?callback.call(root,event):callback.handleEvent(event);}
        finally{if(root.Math.max===wrapper)root.Math.max=original;}
    }
    const addWrapped=function(type,callback,options){
        if(this!==root||type!=='resize'||!callback)return add.call(this,type,callback,options);
        let entry=resizers.find(r=>r.callback===callback&&r.capture===capture(options));
        if(!entry){entry={callback,options,capture:capture(options),wrapped:event=>scaled(callback,event)};resizers.push(entry);}
        return add.call(this,type,entry.wrapped,options);
    };
    const removeWrapped=function(type,callback,options){
        const i=this===root&&type==='resize'?resizers.findIndex(r=>r.callback===callback&&r.capture===capture(options)):-1;
        if(i>=0){const [entry]=resizers.splice(i,1);return remove.call(this,type,entry.wrapped,options);}
        return remove.call(this,type,callback,options);
    };
    root.addEventListener=addWrapped;root.removeEventListener=removeWrapped;
    const resize=()=>{if(lastWheel)for(const entry of [...resizers])entry.wrapped(lastWheel);};
    function wheel(event){
        if(disposed||event.ctrlKey||event.metaKey||menuOpen()||ctx.input.isTyping()||!ctx.self.alive||!event.target?.closest?.('#gameCanvas,#touch-controls-fullscreen')||!event.deltaY)return;
        if(!event.isTrusted)return;
        event.preventDefault();const next=Math.max(1,Math.min(3,zoom*(event.deltaY>0?1.05:1/1.05)));
        if(Math.abs(next-zoom)<1e-9)return;zoom=next;
        lastWheel=event;resize();
    }
    root.addEventListener('wheel',wheel,{capture:true,passive:false});
    const offFrame=ctx.render.onFrame(()=>{
        if(zoom===1)return;const view=ctx.render.view;
        view.scale/=zoom;view.width*=zoom;view.height*=zoom;view.left=view.camX-view.width/2;view.top=view.camY-view.height/2;
    });
    const service={status:()=>({zoom,minimum:1,maximum:3,tracked:tracked.size,spikes:!!settings.disableSpikeSpin,windmills:!!settings.disableWindmillSpin}),resetZoom(){zoom=1;resize();}};
    root.AntimoocheatVisualMotion=service;
    ctx.onCleanup(()=>{
        disposed=true;offFrame();root.removeEventListener('wheel',wheel,true);zoom=1;resize();
        if(root.addEventListener===addWrapped)root.addEventListener=add;
        if(root.removeEventListener===removeWrapped)root.removeEventListener=remove;
        for(const r of resizers){remove.call(root,'resize',r.wrapped,r.options);add.call(root,'resize',r.callback,r.options);}resizers.length=0;
        if(Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(proto,'turnSpeed')?.set===hook)delete proto.turnSpeed;
        for(const ref of tracked){const r=ref.deref();if(r&&Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(r.object,'turnSpeed')?.get===r.get)Object.defineProperty(r.object,'turnSpeed',{value:r.value,writable:true,configurable:true,enumerable:true});}
        tracked.clear();lastWheel=null;if(root.AntimoocheatVisualMotion===service)delete root.AntimoocheatVisualMotion;
    });
    return service;
}

    const makeXp = function weaponXpTracker(getSelf,getData,getObject,now=Date.now,weaponVariants) {

        function matchGold() {
            const at=now(),self=getSelf();hits=hits.filter(h=>!h.used&&at-h.at<=250);swings=swings.filter(s=>at-s.at<=250);
            for(const hit of hits)for(const swing of swings) {

                const matches=positions.some(p=>{
                    const dx=hit.object.x-p.x,dy=hit.object.y-p.y,delta=Math.atan2(dy,dx)-hit.angle;
                    return Math.hypot(dx,dy)<=swing.range+hit.object.scale+.01&&Math.abs(Math.atan2(Math.sin(delta),Math.cos(delta)))<=.11;
                });

            }

        function observe(event,payload) {

                }

                }

            } else if(event==='wiggle'&&ready) {
                const [angle,sid]=payload.args||[],object=getObject(sid);
                if(object&&!object.isItem&&object.type>=0&&object.type<=3&&Number.isFinite(angle)) {
                    hits.push({object,angle,at:now(),used:false});if(hits.length>128)hits.shift();matchGold();
                }
            } else if(event==='gatherAnimation'&&ready) {
                const [sid,hit,id]=payload.args||[],weapon=getData()?.weapon(id);
                if(sid===self.sid&&hit&&Number.isFinite(weapon?.range)&&Number.isFinite(weapon?.gather)) {
                    for(const gain of gains)if(now()-gain.at<=250)add(id,gain.amount);gains=[];

                        at:now(),position:{x:self.x2??self.x,y:self.y2??self.y},hits:new Set()});
                    if(swings.length>64)swings.shift();matchGold();
                }
            }
        }
        function current(id=getSelf().weaponIndex) {
            const self=getSelf();if(!getData()?.weapon(id))return null;

                ratio:variant===4?1:clamp((total-thresholds[variant])/(thresholds[next]-thresholds[variant]),0,1)};
        }
        return {observe,current};

                pen.fillText(String(Math.round(Math.abs(entry.value)*100)/100),entry.x-view.left,entry.y-view.top-.18*age);
            }

        },clear,snapshot:()=>({entries:entries.filter(e=>!e.claimed).map(e=>({value:e.value,count:e.count,stacked:e.stacked})),suppressed,connected:!!pool,discovering:!!capturePush})
    };
    ctx.onCleanup(()=>{clear();detach();cachedPool=null;});return service;
}
