    function observeMotion(map,point){
        if(![point.x,point.y].every(Number.isFinite))return;
        const time=now(),old=map.get(point.sid),dt=old?time-old.at:0;
        if(old&&dt<=0){if(point.x!==old.x||point.y!==old.y)map.set(point.sid,{...old,x:point.x,y:point.y,vx:0,vy:0,ax:0,ay:0,confidence:.2,samples:1});return;}
        const moved=old?Math.hypot(point.x-old.x,point.y-old.y):0,continuous=dt>0&&dt<=tick*3&&moved<150;
        const vx=continuous?(point.x-old.x)/dt:0,vy=continuous?(point.y-old.y)/dt:0;
        const samples=continuous?Math.min(8,(old.samples||1)+1):1;
        const ax=continuous?(vx-old.vx)/dt:0,ay=continuous?(vy-old.vy)/dt:0;
        const reversal=continuous&&vx*old.vx+vy*old.vy<-.0025;
        const confidence=continuous?Math.max(.3,Math.min(.95,.45+samples*.08)-Math.min(.3,Math.hypot(ax,ay)*tick)-Number(reversal)*.2):.35;
        map.set(point.sid,{x:point.x,y:point.y,previous:old?{x:old.x,y:old.y}:pos(point),previousAt:old?.at??time,at:time,vx,vy,ax,ay,samples,confidence,discontinuity:!!old&&!continuous});
        if(map.size>256)map.delete(map.keys().next().value);
    }
    let trapSource=null,trapObjects=[];
    function traps(){const objects=world();if(trapSource!==objects){trapSource=objects;trapObjects=objects.filter(o=>o.trap);}return trapObjects;}
    function trapFor(player){
        if(!player||hat(player)?.noTrap)return null;
        const list=traps();if(!list.length)return null;
        const center=pos(player),body=player.scale||35,sid=player.sid,team=player.team;
        for(const o of list){
            if(!o.active||o.ownerSid==null||o.ownerSid===sid)continue;
            const dx=center.x-(o.x2??o.x),dy=center.y-(o.y2??o.y),reach=body+(o.getScale?.()??o.scale)+1e-7;
            if(dx*dx+dy*dy<=reach*reach&&!(team!=null&&api.player(o.ownerSid)?.team===team))return o;
        }
        return null;
    }
    function predict(player,horizon=tick,options={}){
        if(!player)return null;
        const start=pos(player),sample=(options.animal?animalMotion:motion).get(player.sid),age=sample?Math.max(0,now()-sample.at):Infinity;
        const fresh=age<=tick*2,ms=Math.max(0,Math.min(tick*3,Number(horizon)||0));
        const trapped=options.animal?animalTrap(player):trapFor(player);
        let vx=fresh?sample.vx:0,vy=fresh?sample.vy:0;
        const confidence=fresh?sample.confidence*Math.max(.25,1-age/(tick*4)):0;
        const acceleration=options.linear?0:Math.min(ms,tick)*.5*Math.min(.65,confidence),ax=fresh?sample.ax||0:0,ay=fresh?sample.ay||0:0;
        let dx=(vx+ax*acceleration)*ms,dy=(vy+ay*acceleration)*ms;
        const limit=Math.max(Math.hypot(vx,vy)*ms,8)+Math.min(35,ms*.15),length=Math.hypot(dx,dy);
        if(length>limit){dx*=limit/length;dy*=limit/length;}
        if(trapped&&!options.knockback){dx=dy=0;}
        let fraction=1,blockedBy=null;
        if(options.collisions!==false&&dx*dx+dy*dy>1e-10){
            const radius=player.scale||35;
            for(const object of coverCandidates({x:Math.min(start.x,start.x+dx)-radius,y:Math.min(start.y,start.y+dy)-radius},{x:Math.max(start.x,start.x+dx)+radius,y:Math.max(start.y,start.y+dy)+radius})){
                if(object.ignoreCollision)continue;
                const radius=(player.scale||35)+(object.getScale?.()??object.scale),ox=start.x-object.x,oy=start.y-object.y;
                if(Math.abs(ox)>radius+Math.abs(dx)||Math.abs(oy)>radius+Math.abs(dy))continue;
                const a=dx*dx+dy*dy,b=2*(ox*dx+oy*dy),c=ox*ox+oy*oy-radius*radius;
                if(c<=0){if(b<0){fraction=0;blockedBy=object.sid;}continue;}
                const discriminant=b*b-4*a*c;if(discriminant<0)continue;
                const entry=(-b-Math.sqrt(discriminant))/(2*a);
                if(entry>=0&&entry<fraction){fraction=Math.max(0,entry-1e-7);blockedBy=object.sid;}
            }
        }
        return{x:start.x+dx*fraction,y:start.y+dy*fraction,vx,vy,ax,ay,at:now()+ms,horizon:ms,age,fresh,confidence,trapped:trapped?.sid??null,blockedBy,
            uncertainty:Math.min(90,(1-confidence)*(Math.hypot(dx,dy)+ms*.06)),estimated:true};
    }
    function meleeAim(target,animal=false){
        const self=pos(api.self),current=pos(target),direct=Math.atan2(current.y-self.y,current.x-self.x);
        const horizon=tick/2+Math.min(tick/2,Math.max(0,root.MooMooLoader.net?.ping||0)/2);
        const future=predict(target,horizon,{animal,linear:true}),from=predict(api.self,horizon,{linear:true});
        if(!future.fresh||future.confidence<.35||future.trapped!=null)return direct;
        const projected=Math.atan2(future.y-from.y,future.x-from.x);
        const delta=Math.atan2(Math.sin(projected-direct),Math.cos(projected-direct));
        const limit=(root.MooMooLoader.combat.K?.gatherAngle??Math.PI/2.6)*.8;
        return direct+Math.max(-limit,Math.min(limit,delta));
    }
    function enemyState(sid,full=true){
        const player=api.player(sid);if(!player)return null;
        const sample=motion.get(sid),selfSample=motion.get(api.self.sid),p=pos(player),s=pos(api.self),d=Math.hypot(p.x-s.x,p.y-s.y);
        const age=sample?now()-sample.at:Infinity,fresh=age<=tick*2;
        const vx=fresh?sample.vx:0,vy=fresh?sample.vy:0,ownFresh=selfSample&&now()-selfSample.at<=tick*2;
        const rx=vx-(ownFresh?selfSample.vx:0),ry=vy-(ownFresh?selfSample.vy:0),closing=d?-(rx*(p.x-s.x)+ry*(p.y-s.y))/d:0;
        const speed=Math.hypot(vx,vy),classification=!fresh?'uncertain':speed<.015&&Math.hypot(rx,ry)<.02?'stationary':closing>.035?'approaching':closing<-.035?'retreating':'strafing';
        let old=tracking.get(sid);
        if(!old||old.revision!==revision){
            const stable=old?.candidate===classification?(old.stable||0)+1:1;
            old={revision,candidate:classification,stable,classification:!old||!fresh||stable>=2?classification:old.classification};tracking.set(sid,old);
            if(tracking.size>256)tracking.delete(tracking.keys().next().value);
        }
        if(!full)return {distance:d,fresh,age,closingSpeed:closing,hat:player.hat??player.skinIndex,
            confidence:fresh?sample.confidence*Math.max(.25,1-age/(tick*4)):0};
        const prediction=predict(player),trap=trapFor(player),loadout=potentialWeapons(player);
        return{sid,position:p,previous:sample?.previous||p,velocity:{x:vx,y:vy},acceleration:{x:sample?.ax||0,y:sample?.ay||0},speed,direction:speed>.005?Math.atan2(vy,vx):null,
            relativeVelocity:{x:rx,y:ry},distance:d,closingSpeed:closing,classification:old.classification,fresh,age,confidence:prediction.confidence,prediction,
            trap:trap?.sid??null,nearbySpikes:world().filter(o=>data.item(o.id)?.group?.name==='spikes'&&distance(player,o)<(player.scale||35)+(o.getScale?.()??o.scale)+80).map(o=>o.sid).slice(0,16),
            weapons:loadout.map(w=>({...w,reload:reload(sid,w.id)})),turret:turretReload(sid),hat:player.hat??player.skinIndex,visible:!!player.visible,revision,estimated:true};
    }
    function evaluateAttack(player,id,options={},batch=null){
        const weapon=data.weapon(id),self=api.self;if(!weapon||!player)return{feasible:false,reason:'invalid-target'};
        const projectile=weapon.projectile!=null?data.projectiles[weapon.projectile]:null;
        const latency=Math.max(0,Math.min(tick,Number(root.MooMooLoader.net?.ping)||0)/2),horizon=options.horizon??tick+latency;
        const from=batch?(batch.from??=predict(self,horizon)):predict(self,horizon),to=predict(player,horizon,{animal:!!options.animal});
        const reach=projectile?(projectile.range||0)+70+(player.scale||35):(weapon.range||0)+(player.scale||35)*1.8;
        const predictedDistance=Math.hypot(to.x-from.x,to.y-from.y),currentDistance=distance(self,player);
        const reloadState=reload(self.sid,id),loaded=options.ignoreReload||(root.MooMooAutoReload?.ready(id)??reloadState?.ready??true);
        const shield=shielded(player,self),blocked=projectile&&covered(self,player,Math.max(self.zIndex||0,projectile.layer||0));
        const fresh=to.fresh||options.animal&&player.visible||options.trapOpening&&pinnedOpening(player,to.age);
        const feasible=fresh&&loaded&&!blocked&&!shield&&predictedDistance<=reach+(options.tolerance||0)&&(!options.requireCurrent||currentDistance<=reach);
        const damage=projectile?projectileDamage(player,self,projectile.dmg):meleeDamage({...pos(self),hat:options.hat??7,accessory:self.accessory??self.tail??self.tailIndex},player,id,self.weaponVariant);
        return{feasible,reason:!fresh?'stale-position':!loaded?'reload':blocked?'projectile-cover':shield?'shield-facing':predictedDistance>reach?'predicted-out-of-range':options.requireCurrent&&currentDistance>reach?'opening-out-of-range':'ready',
            predictedDistance,currentDistance,reach,horizon,from,to,angle:Math.atan2(to.y-from.y,to.x-from.x),confidence:to.confidence,damage,reload:reloadState,estimated:true};
    }
    function rankTargets(owner,id,options={}){
        const selected=selections.get(owner),result=[],batch={};
        for(const player of api.players.values()){
            if(!player.alive||!player.visible||player.health<=0||friendly(player))continue;
            if(distance(api.self,player)>(options.maxRange||1500))continue;
            const state=enemyState(player.sid,!options.scoreOnly);if(state.distance>(options.maxRange||1500)||!state.fresh&&!(options.trapOpening&&pinnedOpening(player,state.age)))continue;
            const evaluation=evaluateAttack(player,id,options,batch),failure=failures.get(owner+':'+player.sid);
            if(failure&&failure.until>now()&&failure.revision===revision)continue;
            const score=Number(evaluation.feasible)*1000+state.confidence*100+Math.min(100,evaluation.damage||0)-state.distance*.2+Math.max(-30,Math.min(30,state.closingSpeed*50))+(selected===player.sid?25:0)-(state.hat===6?20:0);
            result.push({sid:player.sid,state,evaluation,score});
        }
        result.sort((a,b)=>b.score-a.score||a.sid-b.sid);if(result.length)selections.set(owner,result[0].sid);
        if(selections.size>32)selections.delete(selections.keys().next().value);return result;
    }
    function pinnedOpening(player,age){
        return player.visible&&player.alive&&age<2000&&now()-lastMessage<1000&&!!trapFor(api.self)&&!!trapFor(player);
    }
    function recordFailure(owner,sid,reason){
        failures.set(owner+':'+sid,{revision,until:now()+tick*2,reason});if(failures.size>128)failures.delete(failures.keys().next().value);
        emit('combat','prediction-failed',{owner,sid,reason,revision});
    }
    function knockbackCollisions(targets,incoming=[]){
        const self=api.self,start=pos(self),body=self.scale||35,world=[];
        let nearSpike=false;
        for(const o of coverCandidates({x:start.x-400,y:start.y-400},{x:start.x+400,y:start.y+400})){
            if(!o.active||o.fake||o.preplace||o.ignoreCollision)continue;
            const size=o.getScale?.()??o.scale,dx=start.x-(o.x2??o.x),dy=start.y-(o.y2??o.y);
            if(dx*dx+dy*dy>(400+size)*(400+size))continue;
            world.push({o,radius:body+size});
            if(!nearSpike&&o.ownerSid!=null&&data.item(o.id)?.group?.name==='spikes'&&!root.MooMooLoader.objects.isFriendly(o.ownerSid))nearSpike=true;
        }
        if(!nearSpike)return [];
        const observed=velocity(self),fresh=now()-observed.at<=tick*2,baseX=fresh?observed.vx:0,baseY=fresh?observed.vy:0,decay=Math.pow(root.MooMooLoader.combat?.K?.playerDecel??.993,tick);
        let best=[],bestDamage=0;const projectilePaths=[],horizon=Math.min(500,healingHorizon());
        const readySpikeIds=new Set();
        const paths=[{target:null,attack:null}];
        // Only snapshot's already trajectory/cover-validated, observed shots.
        // Simulate at most four independent paths; never sum alternative pushes.
        for(const projectile of incoming.filter(p=>p.eta>=0&&p.eta<horizon&&p.impact&&Number.isFinite(p.dir)).sort((a,b)=>a.eta-b.eta).slice(0,4))paths.push({target:null,attack:null,projectile});
        for(const target of targets.slice(0,8))for(const attack of target.attacks)paths.push({target,attack});
        for(const {target,attack,projectile} of paths){
            const weapon=attack&&data.weapon(attack.weapon),enemy=target&&api.player(target.sid);
            const turret=attack?.turret===true;
            if(attack&&(!enemy||attack.unknown||attack.ranged||!turret&&(!weapon||!(weapon.dmg>0))))continue;
            if(turret&&(attack.reload?.remaining>0||target.distance>350))continue;
            const p=enemy?pos(enemy):start,dist=Math.hypot(start.x-p.x,start.y-p.y)||1,impulse=turret||weapon ? .3*(self.weightM||1)+(weapon?.knock||0) : 0;
            // Native projectile collision adds .3*weight along its direction,
            // even when a shield suppresses the projectile's HP damage.
            const shotImpulse=projectile ? .3*(self.weightM||1) : 0;
            let x=projectile?.impact.x??start.x,y=projectile?.impact.y??start.y,
                vx=baseX+(start.x-p.x)/dist*impulse+(projectile?Math.cos(projectile.dir)*shotImpulse:0),
                vy=baseY+(start.y-p.y)/dist*impulse+(projectile?Math.sin(projectile.dir)*shotImpulse:0);const hits=new Map();
            const remaining=horizon-(projectile?.eta||0);
            for(let elapsed=0;elapsed<remaining;elapsed+=tick){
                const duration=projectile?Math.min(tick,remaining-elapsed):tick;
                const steps=Math.min(12,Math.max(1,Math.ceil(Math.hypot(vx,vy)*duration/25))),seen=new Set();
                for(let step=0;step<steps;step++){
                    x+=vx*duration/steps;y+=vy*duration/steps;
                    for(const {o,radius} of world){
                        if(seen.has(o.sid))continue;
                        const dx=x-o.x,dy=y-o.y,squared=dx*dx+dy*dy;
                        if(squared>radius*radius)continue;
                        seen.add(o.sid);const d=Math.sqrt(squared),ux=d?dx/d:1,uy=d?dy/d:0;
                        x=o.x+radius*ux;y=o.y+radius*uy;vx*=.75;vy*=.75;
                        const item=data.item(o.id);
                        if(item?.group?.name==='spikes'&&item.dmg>0&&o.ownerSid!=null&&!root.MooMooLoader.objects.isFriendly(o.ownerSid)){
                            hits.set(o.sid,{sid:o.sid,damage:item.dmg*factor(hat(self)?.dmgMult)*factor(tail(self)?.dmgMult),predicted:true,knockback:true,attacker:projectile?.ownerSid??target?.sid??null,
                                ...(projectile?{source:'observed-projectile-knockback',projectileSid:projectile.sid,impactEta:projectile.eta}:{} )});
                            vx+=1.5*(o.weightM||1)*ux;vy+=1.5*(o.weightM||1)*uy;
                        }
                    }
                }
                vx*=decay;vy*=decay;
            }
            const damage=[...hits.values()].reduce((sum,hit)=>sum+hit.damage,0);
            if(attack&&!attack.forecast&&!(attack.reload?.remaining>0))for(const sid of hits.keys())readySpikeIds.add(sid);
            if(turret)continue;
            if(projectile){if(hits.size)projectilePaths.push({projectileSid:projectile.sid,ownerSid:projectile.ownerSid,eta:projectile.eta,source:'observed-projectile-knockback',spikes:[...hits.values()]});}
            else if(damage>bestDamage){bestDamage=damage;best=[...hits.values()];}
        }
        // Keep committed projectile evidence separate from hypothetical melee.
        best.readySpikeIds=[...readySpikeIds];best.projectilePaths=projectilePaths;return best;
    }
    const normalized=a=>Math.atan2(Math.sin(a),Math.cos(a));
    const variantOf=p=>p.sid===api.self.sid?p.weaponVariant??p.variant:p.variant??p.weaponVariant;
    function cancelRefresh(){if(refreshTimer!==null)root.clearTimeout(refreshTimer);refreshTimer=null;refreshAt=Infinity;}
    // Time until a normal heal can be applied: normal wait + a server tick + RTT.
    // This is a future-attack window, never a post-damage AutoQ hold.
    const healingHorizon=()=>125+tick+Math.min(350,Math.max(0,Number(root.MooMooLoader.net?.ping)||0));
    function armRefresh(){
        const time=now();
        if(sessionEnded||!api.isReady()||!api.self.alive){cancelRefresh();return;}
        let next=inputDirty?time+1:Infinity;
        const consider=at=>{if(Number.isFinite(at)&&at>time)next=Math.min(next,at);};
        for(const state of cooldowns.values())if(state.running){consider(state.at+state.remaining-healingHorizon()+.01);consider(state.at+state.remaining-tick+.01);consider(state.at+state.remaining+.01);}
        for(const until of turrets.values()){consider(until-healingHorizon()+.01);consider(until-tick+.01);consider(until+.01);}
        for(const evidence of projectilePushEvidence.values())if(evidence.until!=null)consider(evidence.until+.01);
        for(const point of motion.values()){consider(point.at+tick*2+.01);if(point===motion.get(api.self.sid))consider(point.at+tick*3+.01);}
        for(const until of oneTickPreps.values())consider(until+.01);
        if(poisonState)consider(poisonState.expiresAt+.01);
        if(poisonState||hat(api.self)?.healthRegen<0||cached?.targets.some(t=>t.distance<=350||t.damage>0)||cached?.spikes.length||cached?.animals.some(a=>a.reachable)||shots.size)consider(time+tick);
        const self=pos(api.self),radius=api.self.scale||35;
        for(const shot of shots.values()){
            consider(shot.at+Math.min(3000,shot.range/shot.speed)+.01);
            const owner=shot.ownerSid==null?null:api.player(shot.ownerSid);if(owner&&friendly(owner))continue;
            const dx=self.x-shot.x,dy=self.y-shot.y,along=dx*Math.cos(shot.dir)+dy*Math.sin(shot.dir);
            if(along<0||along>shot.range||Math.abs(dx*Math.sin(shot.dir)-dy*Math.cos(shot.dir))>radius)continue;
            consider(shot.at+Math.max(0,along-radius)/shot.speed-250+.01);
            if(shot.gear)consider(shot.at+Math.max(0,along-radius)/shot.speed-tick*2+.01);
            consider(shot.at+Math.max(0,along-radius)/shot.speed-600+.01);
            consider(shot.at+along/shot.speed+.01);
        }
        if(!Number.isFinite(next)){cancelRefresh();return;}
        const due=Math.max(time+1,next);if(refreshTimer!==null&&refreshAt<=due)return;
        cancelRefresh();refreshAt=due;
        refreshTimer=root.setTimeout(()=>{refreshTimer=null;refreshAt=Infinity;inputDirty=false;cached=null;
            if(sessionEnded||!api.isReady()||!api.self.alive)return;
            snapshot();
            for(const fn of listeners)try{fn();}catch(error){emit('lifecycle','threat-listener-error',{message:String(error)});}armRefresh();
        },due-time);
    }
    function forgetPlayerEvidence(sid){
        for(const map of [weapons,turrets,recentTurret,poisonHits,repeaterShots,motion,tracking,oneTickPreps,spikeComboOpenings])map.delete(sid);
        knownTurrets.delete(sid);
        for(const key of cooldowns.keys())if(key.startsWith(sid+':'))cooldowns.delete(key);
        for(const [owner,target]of selections)if(target===sid)selections.delete(owner);
        for(const key of failures.keys())if(key.endsWith(':'+sid))failures.delete(key);
        cached=null;
    }
    function remember(p,id=p.weaponIndex,variant=variantOf(p)){
        const definition=data.weapon(id);if(!definition)return;
        let slots=weapons.get(p.sid);if(!slots)weapons.set(p.sid,slots=new Map());
        // A return from an upgraded primary to the spawn tool starts a new loadout.
        if(id===0&&slots.get(0)?.id>0){forgetPlayerEvidence(p.sid);slots=new Map();weapons.set(p.sid,slots);}
        const slot=definition.type??(id<9?0:1),old=slots.get(slot);
        slots.set(slot,{id,variant:variants[variant]!=null?variant:old?.id===id?old.variant:null});
    }
    function potentialWeapons(p){
        // Hidden inventory is not transmitted. Preserve evidence separately
        // from this explicit loadout heuristic, and discard it on observation.
        const known=weapons.get(p.sid)||new Map(),primary=known.get(0);
        const entries=[...known].map(([slot,weapon])=>({...weapon,slot,unknown:false,observed:true}));
        if(!known.has(1)&&(primary?.id===5||primary?.id===3&&primary.variant>=2))
            entries.push({id:15,slot:1,variant:0,unknown:true,observed:false,reason:'likely-musket-loadout'});
        return entries;
    }

    function projectileWeapon(index){
        const matches=data.weapons.filter(w=>w.projectile===index);
        return matches.length===1?matches[0].id:null;
    }
    function resolveShotOwner(shot){
        // A launch can precede the snapshot showing the switched weapon/hat.
        // Use the projectile's launch geometry, leaving overlapping owners unknown.
        const owners=[...api.players.values()].filter(p=>p.alive&&p.visible&&
            (shot.gear?turretDistance(p,shot.x,shot.y):Math.hypot(pos(p).x+70*Math.cos(shot.dir)-shot.x,pos(p).y+70*Math.sin(shot.dir)-shot.y))<35);
        if(owners.length!==1)return null;
        const owner=owners[0];shot.ownerSid=owner.sid;
        if(shot.gear){rememberTurret(owner);markTurret(owner.sid,shot.at);}
        else{
            const id=projectileWeapon(shot.index);
            if(id!=null){
                const known=weapons.get(owner.sid)?.get(data.weapon(id).type);
                remember(owner,id,known?.id===id?known.variant:null);markAttack(owner.sid,id);
                const cooldown=cooldowns.get(owner.sid+':'+id);
                if(cooldown)cooldown.remaining=Math.max(0,cooldown.remaining-(now()-shot.at));
            }
        }
        return owner;
    }
    function retireShot(sid){
        const shot=shots.get(sid);if(!shot)return false;
        shots.delete(sid);retiredShots.set(sid,{ownerSid:shot.ownerSid,until:now()+Math.max(350,Math.min(1000,2*(root.MooMooLoader.net?.ping||0)+2*tick))});
        for(const [id,p]of retiredShots)if(p.until<=now())retiredShots.delete(id);
        while(retiredShots.size>128)retiredShots.delete(retiredShots.keys().next().value);
        return true;
    }
    function coverCandidates(a,b){return root.AntimoocheatWorld.query(a,b);}
    function covered(origin,target,layer=0){
        const a=pos(origin),b=pos(target),dx=b.x-a.x,dy=b.y-a.y,length=Math.hypot(dx,dy);
        if(!length)return false;
        const nx=dx/length,ny=dy/length,limit=Math.max(0,length-(target.scale||35));
        for(const o of coverCandidates(a,b)){
            if(!o.active||o.fake||o.preplace||o.ignoreCollision||(o.layer||0)<layer)continue;
            const radius=o.getScale?.()??o.scale;let enter=0,exit=limit;
            const ox=o.x-a.x,oy=o.y-a.y;
            if(Math.abs(nx)<1e-9){if(Math.abs(ox)>radius)continue;}
            else{const x=(ox-radius)/nx,y=(ox+radius)/nx;enter=Math.max(enter,Math.min(x,y));exit=Math.min(exit,Math.max(x,y));if(enter>exit)continue;}
            if(Math.abs(ny)<1e-9){if(Math.abs(oy)>radius)continue;}
            else{const x=(oy-radius)/ny,y=(oy+radius)/ny;enter=Math.max(enter,Math.min(x,y));exit=Math.min(exit,Math.max(x,y));if(enter>exit)continue;}
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }
    function approachingDistance(a,b){
        const x=pos(b).x-pos(a).x,y=pos(b).y-pos(a).y,horizon=tick+Math.min(tick,Math.max(0,root.MooMooLoader.net?.ping||0)/2);
        const fresh=p=>{const m=motion.get(p.sid);return m&&now()-m.at<=tick*2?m:{vx:0,vy:0};},av=fresh(a),bv=fresh(b);
        const dx=(bv.vx-av.vx)*horizon,dy=(bv.vy-av.vy)*horizon,length=dx*dx+dy*dy,u=length?Math.max(0,Math.min(1,-(x*dx+y*dy)/length)):0;
        return Math.hypot(x+dx*u,y+dy*u);
    }
    function reload(sid,id){
        const weapon=data.weapon(id);if(!weapon)return null;
        const selfClock=sid===api.self.sid?root.MooMooAutoReload?.display?.(id):null;
        if(selfClock)return {id,...selfClock,ready:selfClock.remaining<=0,observed:true,status:selfClock.remaining>0?'reloading':'estimated-ready',confirmedReady:false,confidence:.8,estimated:true};
        const state=cooldowns.get(sid+':'+id),duration=state?.duration||weapon.speed;
        const remaining=state?Math.max(0,state.remaining-(state.running?Math.max(0,now()-state.at):0)):0;
        const observed=!!state?.observed,status=!observed?'unknown':remaining>0?'reloading':'estimated-ready';
        return {id,remaining,duration,ratio:Math.max(0,Math.min(1,1-remaining/duration)),ready:remaining<=0,observed,status,confirmedReady:false,confidence:observed?.8:0,estimated:true};
    }
    function reloadBarRatio(sid,slot){
        const id=weapons.get(sid)?.get(slot)?.id;
        if(id==null||!cooldowns.get(sid+':'+id)?.observed)return null;
        return reload(sid,id)?.ratio;
    }
    const ready=(sid,id)=>reload(sid,id)?.ready??true;
    const turretReady=sid=>now()>=(turrets.get(sid)||0);
    function turretReload(sid){
        const duration=data.hat(53)?.turret?.rate||2500,remaining=Math.max(0,(turrets.get(sid)||0)-now());
        const observed=turrets.has(sid);
        return {remaining,duration,ratio:Math.max(0,Math.min(1,1-remaining/duration)),ready:remaining<=0,observed,status:!observed?'unknown':remaining>0?'reloading':'estimated-ready',confirmedReady:false,confidence:observed?.8:0,estimated:true};
    }
    function markTurret(sid,at=now()){turrets.set(sid,at+(data.hat(53)?.turret?.rate||2500));cached=null;armRefresh();}
    function updateReloads(){
        const time=now();
        for(const state of cooldowns.values()){
            const p=api.player(state.sid);
            state.remaining=Math.max(0,state.remaining-(state.running?Math.max(0,time-state.at):0));state.at=time;
            if(!p?.visible){state.remaining=0;state.observed=false;}
            state.running=!!p?.visible&&p.alive&&p.buildIndex<0&&p.weaponIndex===state.id;
        }
    }
    function markAttack(sid,id){
        const p=api.player(sid),weapon=data.weapon(id);if(!weapon)return;
        if(p)remember(p,id,p.weaponIndex===id?variantOf(p):weapons.get(sid)?.get(id<9?0:1)?.variant);
        const duration=weapon.speed*factor(p&&hat(p)?.atkSpd);
        cooldowns.set(sid+':'+id,{sid,id,duration,remaining:duration,at:now(),observed:true,running:!!p?.visible&&p.alive&&p.buildIndex<0&&p.weaponIndex===id});cached=null;armRefresh();
    }
    function shielded(defender,attacker){
        const shield=data.weapon(defender.weaponIndex)?.shield;
        const a=pos(attacker),b=pos(defender);
        const dir=defender.d2??defender.dir;
        return shield&&Number.isFinite(dir)&&Math.abs(normalized(Math.atan2(a.y-b.y,a.x-b.x)-dir))<=Math.PI/3?shield:0;
    }
    function meleeDamage(attacker,defender,id,variant){
        const w=data.weapon(id);if(!w||w.projectile!=null)return 0;
        return Math.max(0,w.dmg||0)*(shielded(defender,attacker)||variants[variant]||1)*
            factor(hat(attacker)?.dmgMultO)*factor(tail(attacker)?.dmgMultO)*
            factor(hat(defender)?.dmgMult)*factor(tail(defender)?.dmgMult);
    }
    const projectileDamage=(defender,origin,damage)=>shielded(defender,origin)?0:
        damage*factor(hat(defender)?.dmgMult)*factor(tail(defender)?.dmgMult)*(defender.accessory===15?.75:1);
    const velocity=p=>motion.get(p.sid)||{vx:0,vy:0};
    let poisonState=null,lastSelfDamage=null,periodicItem=null,cheesePendingUntil=0;
    const poisonHits=new Map(),spikeContacts=new Map(),repeaterShots=new Map();
    function rememberRepeater(x,y,dir,range,speed,index,layer){
        if(data.weapon(13)?.projectile!==index)return;
        const dx=Math.cos(dir),dy=Math.sin(dir),self=pos(api.self),radius=api.self.scale||35;
        const along=(self.x-x)*dx+(self.y-y)*dy,cross=Math.abs((self.x-x)*dy-(self.y-y)*dx);
        if(along<0||along>range+radius||cross>radius+8||covered({x,y},api.self,layer))return;
        const shooters=[...api.players.values()].filter(p=>p.sid!==api.self.sid&&p.alive&&p.visible&&!friendly(p)&&
            weapons.get(p.sid)?.get(1)?.id===13&&Math.hypot(pos(p).x+70*dx-x,pos(p).y+70*dy-y)<35);
        if(shooters.length!==1)return;
        const shooter=shooters[0],impact=now()+Math.max(0,along-radius)/speed;
        repeaterShots.set(shooter.sid,{impact,damage:projectileDamage(api.self,{x,y},data.projectiles[index].dmg),hit:null});
    }
    function matchRepeaterHit(loss,time){
        const tolerance=tick+Math.min(tick,Math.max(0,root.MooMooLoader.net?.ping||0));
        for(const [sid,shot] of repeaterShots){
            if(time>shot.impact+tolerance && (shot.hit==null || time-shot.hit>tick*3)){repeaterShots.delete(sid);continue;}
            if(shot.hit==null && Math.abs(time-shot.impact)<=tolerance && Math.abs(shot.damage-loss)<=1.1)shot.hit=time;
        }
    }
    function boostCanReach(p,reach,forecastDistance){
        if(forecastDistance<=reach)return true;
        const point=pos(p),me=pos(api.self);
        return world().some(pad=>{
            if(!pad.active||!pad.boostSpeed||!Number.isFinite(pad.dir)||distance(p,pad)>(p.scale||35)+(pad.getScale?.()??pad.scale))return false;
            const dx=Math.cos(pad.dir),dy=Math.sin(pad.dir),along=(me.x-point.x)*dx+(me.y-point.y)*dy;
            const travel=Math.min(Math.max(0,along),pad.boostSpeed*tick*2);
            return travel>0&&Math.hypot(me.x-point.x-dx*travel,me.y-point.y-dy*travel)<=reach&&!covered(p,api.self,p.zIndex||0);
        });
    }
    let approachSource=null,boostPads=[],motionStops=[];
    function approachForecast(p,horizon,selfAt){
        const objects=world();
        if(approachSource!==objects){approachSource=objects;boostPads=[];motionStops=[];for(const object of objects){if(object.boostSpeed&&Number.isFinite(object.dir))boostPads.push(object);if(object.trap||object.teleport)motionStops.push(object);}}
        const start=pos(p),me=pos(api.self),sample=motion.get(p.sid),elapsed=sample&&sample.previous?sample.at-(sample.previousAt??sample.at-tick):0;
        let distance=Math.hypot(start.x-me.x,start.y-me.y),pad=null;
        const closest=(a,b)=>{const dx=b.x-a.x,dy=b.y-a.y,len=dx*dx+dy*dy,u=len?Math.max(0,Math.min(1,-(a.x*dx+a.y*dy)/len)):0;return Math.hypot(a.x+u*dx,a.y+u*dy);};
        if(!trapFor(p))for(const object of boostPads){
            const radius=(p.scale||35)+(object.getScale?.()??object.scale),touch=Math.hypot(start.x-object.x,start.y-object.y)<=radius;
            const recent=sample&&now()-sample.at<=tick*2&&elapsed>0&&elapsed<=tick*3&&sample.previous;
            const crossed=recent&&closest({x:sample.previous.x-object.x,y:sample.previous.y-object.y},{x:start.x-object.x,y:start.y-object.y})<=radius;
            if(touch||crossed){pad={object,touch};break;}
        }
        const ms=Math.min(tick*3,Math.max(0,horizon)),steps=Math.ceil(ms/tick),decel=root.MooMooLoader.combat?.K?.playerDecel??.993;
        let previous={x:start.x-me.x,y:start.y-me.y},point={...start},vx=sample?.vx||0,vy=sample?.vy||0;
        if(pad){
            const {object,touch}=pad,dx=Math.cos(object.dir),dy=Math.sin(object.dir),decay=Math.pow(decel,tick);
            if(!touch&&elapsed>0){vx=(start.x-sample.previous.x)/elapsed*decay;vy=(start.y-sample.previous.y)/elapsed*decay;}
            if(touch){const impulse=Math.max(0,object.boostSpeed-(vx*dx+vy*dy));vx+=dx*impulse;vy+=dy*impulse;}
        }
        const triggers=pad?motionStops.filter(o=>o.teleport||!hat(p)?.noTrap&&o.trap&&o.ownerSid!==p.sid&&!(p.team!=null&&api.player(o.ownerSid)?.team===p.team)):[];
        for(let i=1;i<=steps;i++){
            const at=Math.min(ms,i*tick),dt=at-(i-1)*tick,self=selfAt(at);
            let next;
            if(pad){
                next={x:point.x+vx*dt,y:point.y+vy*dt};let fraction=1;
                const dx=next.x-point.x,dy=next.y-point.y,a=dx*dx+dy*dy;
                if(a>0)for(const object of [...coverCandidates({x:Math.min(point.x,next.x)-35,y:Math.min(point.y,next.y)-35},{x:Math.max(point.x,next.x)+35,y:Math.max(point.y,next.y)+35}),...triggers]){
                    if(object.ignoreCollision&&!(object.trap&&object.ownerSid!==p.sid&&!(p.team!=null&&api.player(object.ownerSid)?.team===p.team))&&!object.teleport)continue;
                    const r=(p.scale||35)+(object.getScale?.()??object.scale),ox=point.x-object.x,oy=point.y-object.y,b=2*(ox*dx+oy*dy),c=ox*ox+oy*oy-r*r;
                    if(c<=0){if(b<0)fraction=0;continue;}
                    const disc=b*b-4*a*c;if(disc<0)continue;
                    const hit=(-b-Math.sqrt(disc))/(2*a);if(hit>=0&&hit<fraction)fraction=Math.max(0,hit-1e-6);
                }
                next={x:point.x+dx*fraction,y:point.y+dy*fraction};
                vx*=fraction<1?0:Math.pow(decel,dt);vy*=fraction<1?0:Math.pow(decel,dt);point=next;
            }else next=predict(p,at);
            const relative={x:next.x-self.x,y:next.y-self.y};distance=Math.min(distance,closest(previous,relative));previous=relative;
        }
        return {distance,boosted:!!pad,padSid:pad?.object.sid??null,horizon:ms};
    }
    const damageFactor=()=>factor(hat(api.self)?.dmgMult)*factor(tail(api.self)?.dmgMult);
    const poisonWindow=()=>Math.min(500,tick*2+Math.max(0,root.MooMooLoader.net?.ping||0));
    function startPoison(sample){
        const time=now();
        poisonState={source:sample.source,ownerSid:sample.ownerSid,rawDamage:sample.rawDamage,ticksLeft:sample.seconds,lastTick:null,startedAt:time,expiresAt:time+sample.seconds*1000+tick,estimated:true};
        if(lastSelfDamage)lastSelfDamage.matched=true;
        cached=null;
    }
    function matchPoisonHit(){
        if(!lastSelfDamage||lastSelfDamage.matched||now()-lastSelfDamage.at>poisonWindow())return;
        for(const sample of [...poisonHits.values()].reverse()){
            if(now()-sample.at>poisonWindow()||lastSelfDamage.loss<Math.min(10,sample.hitDamage*.5))continue;
            startPoison(sample);return;
        }
    }
    function observePoisonAttack(sid,id){
        const player=api.player(sid),weapon=data.weapon(id),self=api.self;
        if(!player?.alive||!player.visible||friendly(player)||weapon?.projectile!=null||!(weapon?.dmg>0)||hat(self)?.poisonRes)return;
        const variant=weapons.get(sid)?.get(weapon.type??(id<9?0:1))?.variant??variantOf(player);
        const ruby=(root.MooMooLoader.combat?.K?.weaponVariants||[]).find(v=>v.id===variant)?.poison??[3,4].includes(variant);
        const venom=hat(player)?.poisonDmg;
        if(!ruby&&!venom)return;
        const toward=Math.atan2(pos(self).y-pos(player).y,pos(self).x-pos(player).x),direction=player.d2??player.dir;
        if(distance(player,self)>(weapon.range||0)+(self.scale||35)*1.8||!Number.isFinite(direction)||Math.abs(normalized(toward-direction))>(root.MooMooLoader.combat?.K?.gatherAngle??Math.PI/2.6)+.05)return;
        poisonHits.set(sid,{at:now(),ownerSid:sid,source:ruby?'ruby-hit':'poison-hat-hit',rawDamage:ruby?5:venom,seconds:ruby?5:hat(player)?.poisonTime||1,hitDamage:meleeDamage(player,self,id,variant)});
        if(poisonHits.size>16)poisonHits.delete(poisonHits.keys().next().value);
        matchPoisonHit();
    }
    function observePeriodicHealth(value){
        const loss=selfHealth-value,time=now();
        if(loss>0){
            matchRepeaterHit(loss,time);
            lastSelfDamage={at:time,loss,armor:damageFactor(),matched:false};matchPoisonHit();
            const poison=poisonState;
            const armor=damageFactor(),bullDrain=Math.max(0,-(hat(api.self)?.healthRegen||0))*armor;
            const pulse=poison?.rawDamage*armor;
            if(!lastSelfDamage.matched&&poison&&time<poison.expiresAt&&time-(poison.lastTick??poison.startedAt)>=1000-tick&&
                (Math.abs(loss-pulse)<=.51||bullDrain>0&&Math.abs(loss-pulse-bullDrain)<=.51)){
                poison.lastTick=time;
                if(--poison.ticksLeft===0)poisonState=null;
                else poison.expiresAt=time+poison.ticksLeft*(1000+tick)+tick;
            }
            // Collision separation can leave the next position just outside the
            // spike radius. Preserve a damage-matched contact for two updates,
            // never for arbitrary periodic wounds or a distant object.
            const contacts=world().filter(o=>o.ownerSid!=null&&!root.MooMooLoader.objects.isFriendly(o.ownerSid)&&data.item(o.id)?.group?.name==='spikes'&&
                distance(api.self,o)<=(api.self.scale||35)+(o.getScale?.()??o.scale)+24&&
                Math.abs(loss-data.item(o.id).dmg*damageFactor())<=1.1).sort((a,b)=>distance(api.self,a)-distance(api.self,b));
            if(contacts.length){lastSelfDamage.spikeSid=contacts[0].sid;spikeContacts.set(contacts[0].sid,time);}
            if(!lastSelfDamage.matched&&!hat(api.self)?.poisonRes)for(const object of world()){
                const item=data.item(object.id);
                if(!(item?.pDmg>0)||object.ownerSid==null||root.MooMooLoader.objects.isFriendly(object.ownerSid)||distance(api.self,object)>(api.self.scale||35)+(object.getScale?.()??object.scale)+3||loss<Math.min(10,item.dmg*damageFactor()*.5))continue;
                startPoison({source:'poison-spike-hit',ownerSid:object.ownerSid,rawDamage:item.pDmg,seconds:5});break;
            }
        }else if(loss<0){repeaterShots.clear();if(time<cheesePendingUntil){poisonState=null;cheesePendingUntil=0;}}
        selfHealth=value;
    }
    function periodicThreats(){
        if(sessionEnded||!api.isReady()||!api.self.alive)return [];
        const result=[],defense=damageFactor(),regen=(hat(api.self)?.healthRegen||0)+(tail(api.self)?.healthRegen||0);
        if(regen<0)result.push({source:'bull-drain',damage:-regen*defense,horizonMs:1000,estimated:true});
        if(poisonState&&now()>=poisonState.expiresAt)poisonState=null;
        if(poisonState)result.push({...poisonState,damage:poisonState.rawDamage*defense,horizonMs:Math.min(1000,poisonState.expiresAt-now())});
        return result;
    }

    function animalTrap(animal,definition=data.animal(animal?.index)){
        if(!animal||!definition||definition.noTrap||definition.boss||animal.noTrap||[6,8,10].includes(animal.index))return null;
        return traps().find(o=>o.active&&!o.fake&&!o.preplace&&o.ownerSid!=null&&
            distance(animal,o)<=(animal.scale||definition.scale||35)+(o.getScale?.()??o.scale))||null;
    }
    function animalThreats(){
        if(!api.isReady()||!api.self.alive)return [];
        const defense=factor(hat(api.self)?.dmgMult)*factor(tail(api.self)?.dmgMult);
        return (root.MooMooLoader.combat?.animals||[]).flatMap(animal=>{
            const definition=data.animal(animal.index);
            if(!animal.active||!animal.visible||!(animal.health>0)||!(definition?.dmg>0)||animal.state&&definition.diver)return [];
            const dist=distance(api.self,animal),reach=(definition.hitRange??animal.scale??definition.scale??0)+(api.self.scale||35);
            if(!Number.isFinite(dist))return [];
            const observation=animalMotion.get(animal.sid),fresh=!!observation&&now()-observation.at<=tick*3;
            const attack=animalAttacks.get(animal.sid),prediction=predict(animal,tick,{animal:true}),trap=animalTrap(animal,definition);
            // A new overlap can still be the capture tick. Suppress ordinary contact
            // danger only after a second, stationary observation inside the same trap.
            const recentAttack=attack!=null&&now()-attack<=tick*2;
            let capture=animalCaptures.get(animal.sid);
            if(!trap){animalCaptures.delete(animal.sid);capture=null;}
            else if(capture?.sid!==trap.sid){capture={sid:trap.sid,at:observation?.at??now()};animalCaptures.set(animal.sid,capture);if(animalCaptures.size>256)animalCaptures.delete(animalCaptures.keys().next().value);}
            const settled=trap&&fresh&&observation.at>capture.at&&observation.samples>=2&&observation.previous&&
                Math.hypot(observation.x-observation.previous.x,observation.y-observation.previous.y)<=1&&
                Math.hypot(observation.previous.x-trap.x,observation.previous.y-trap.y)<=(animal.scale||definition.scale||35)+(trap.getScale?.()??trap.scale);
            const trapSuppressed=!!settled&&!definition.hitRange&&!recentAttack;
            return [{sid:animal.sid,index:animal.index,distance:dist,reach,reachable:dist<=reach&&fresh&&!trapSuppressed,damage:definition.dmg*defense,
                trapSid:trap?.sid??null,trapSuppressed,recentAttack,
                category:definition.hostile?'hostile':'contact',fresh,confidence:prediction.confidence,prediction,
                attackObservedAt:attack??null,reload:{status:'unknown',confirmedReady:false},estimated:true}];
        });
    }
    function selfTrap(){
        const self=api.self;if(hat(self)?.noTrap)return null;
        return traps().find(o=>o.active&&!o.fake&&!o.preplace&&o.ownerSid!=null&&
            !root.MooMooLoader.objects.isFriendly(o.ownerSid)&&distance(self,o)<=(self.scale||35)+(o.getScale?.()??o.scale))||null;
    }
    // A loadout or an empty future placement is not an attack commitment.
    // Keep only observed, directed melee openings; the ordinary pot-damage
    // snapshot remains unchanged for healing and HUD consumers.
    const spikeComboOpenings=new Map();
    function matchRecentSpikeContact(){
        const wound=lastSelfDamage;
        if(!wound||wound.spikeSid!=null||now()-wound.at>2*tick)return;
        const contacts=world().filter(o=>o.active&&!o.fake&&!o.preplace&&o.ownerSid!=null&&
            !root.MooMooLoader.objects.isFriendly(o.ownerSid)&&data.item(o.id)?.group?.name==='spikes'&&
            distance(api.self,o)<=(api.self.scale||35)+(o.getScale?.()??o.scale)+24&&
            Math.abs(wound.loss-data.item(o.id).dmg*wound.armor)<=1.1).sort((a,b)=>distance(api.self,a)-distance(api.self,b));
        if(contacts.length){wound.spikeSid=contacts[0].sid;spikeContacts.set(wound.spikeSid,wound.at);}
    }
    function observeSpikeComboOpening(sid,id){
        const enemy=api.player(sid),weapon=data.weapon(id),self=api.self;
        if(!enemy||friendly(enemy)||!enemy.alive||!enemy.visible||!weapon||weapon.projectile!=null)return;
        const a=pos(enemy),b=pos(self),angle=Math.atan2(b.y-a.y,b.x-a.x),facing=enemy.d2??enemy.dir;
        if(!Number.isFinite(facing)||Math.abs(normalized(angle-facing))>Math.PI/2.6||
            distance(enemy,self)>(weapon.range||0)+(self.scale||35)*1.8)return;
        // Record the committed swing before its cooldown or next position update
        // can erase the pending push. Only existing physical objects are eligible.
        const path=knockbackCollisions([{sid,attacks:[{weapon:id}]}]).map(hit=>{
            const object=root.MooMooLoader.objects.get(hit.sid);
            return object?{sid:object.sid,id:object.id,x:object.x,y:object.y}:null;
        }).filter(Boolean);
        spikeComboOpenings.set(sid,{at:now(),weapon:id,position:pos(self),path});
        if(spikeComboOpenings.size>32)spikeComboOpenings.delete(spikeComboOpenings.keys().next().value);
    }
    const projectileKnockbackRiskCache=new WeakMap();
    function projectileKnockbackRisk(value=snapshot()){
        const prior=projectileKnockbackRiskCache.get(value);if(prior)return prior;
        let best={active:false,reason:null};
        // Empty observed-path sets need no player copies or armor evaluation.
        if(!value.projectileKnockback?.length){projectileKnockbackRiskCache.set(value,best);return best;}
        const self=api.self,neutral={...self,hat:0,skin:0,skinIndex:0},soldier={...self,hat:6,skin:6,skinIndex:6};
        if(self.alive&&self.health>0)for(const path of value.projectileKnockback||[]){
            const shot=path.paidProjectile?path.shot:(value.incoming||[]).find(s=>s.sid===path.projectileSid);
            if(!shot||!path.paidProjectile&&!shots.has(shot.sid)||path.eta>=Math.min(500,healingHorizon()))continue;
            const spikes=path.spikes.filter(s=>{const o=root.MooMooLoader.objects.get(s.sid);return o?.active&&!o.fake&&!o.preplace&&!o.ignoreCollision&&o.ownerSid!=null&&!root.MooMooLoader.objects.isFriendly(o.ownerSid)&&data.item(o.id)?.group?.name==='spikes';});
            if(!spikes.length)continue;
            const rawSpike=spikes.reduce((sum,s)=>sum+(data.item(root.MooMooLoader.objects.get(s.sid).id)?.dmg||0),0),tailFactor=factor(tail(self)?.dmgMult);
            let primary=0,soldierPrimary=0,neutralPrimary=0,weapon=null;
            // An unknown shot can still push. It cannot borrow a nearby
            // unrelated player's primary, or an unobserved loadout weapon.
            const enemy=shot.ownerSid==null?null:api.player(shot.ownerSid);
            if(enemy?.alive&&enemy.visible&&enemy.health>0&&!friendly(enemy))for(const w of weapons.get(enemy.sid)?.values()||[]){
                const spec=data.weapon(w.id);if(w.id>=9||!spec?.dmg||spec.projectile!=null||distance(enemy,self)>(spec.range||0)+(self.scale||35)*1.8||(reload(enemy.sid,w.id)?.remaining||0)>healingHorizon())continue;
                const attacker={...enemy,hat:7,skin:7,skinIndex:7},amount=meleeDamage(attacker,self,w.id,w.variant);
                if(amount>primary){primary=amount;soldierPrimary=meleeDamage(attacker,soldier,w.id,w.variant);neutralPrimary=meleeDamage(attacker,neutral,w.id,w.variant);weapon=w.id;}
            }
            const origin={x:shot.xNow,y:shot.yNow},projectileHp=path.paidProjectile?0:shot.rawDamage,
                damage=projectileDamage(self,origin,projectileHp)+rawSpike*tailFactor*factor(hat(self)?.dmgMult)+primary;
            if(damage<self.health||best.active&&damage<=best.damage)continue;
            best={active:true,reason:'lethal-projectile-spike-path',evidence:'observed-projectile-knockback',attacker:shot.ownerSid??null,weapon,projectileSid:shot.sid,damage,
                neutralDamage:projectileDamage(neutral,origin,projectileHp)+rawSpike*tailFactor+neutralPrimary,
                soldierDamage:projectileDamage(soldier,origin,projectileHp)+rawSpike*tailFactor*factor(data.hat(6)?.dmgMult)+soldierPrimary,
                paidProjectile:!!path.paidProjectile,spikeSids:spikes.map(s=>s.sid),estimated:true};
        }
        projectileKnockbackRiskCache.set(value,best);return best;
    }
    function committedSpikePath(value=snapshot(),protectBeforeHit=true){
        const self=api.self,time=now(),window=Math.min(450,2*tick+Math.max(0,root.MooMooLoader.net?.ping||0));
        const inactive={active:false,reason:null};
        if(!self.alive||!(self.health>0))return inactive;
        const physical=sid=>{
            const object=root.MooMooLoader.objects.get(sid);
            return object?.active&&!object.fake&&!object.preplace&&object.ownerSid!=null&&
                object.ownerSid!==self.sid&&!root.MooMooLoader.objects.isFriendly(object.ownerSid)&&
                data.item(object.id)?.group?.name==='spikes'&&data.item(object.id).dmg>0?object:null;
        };
        if(protectBeforeHit&&value.readySpikeIds?.length){
            const ids=value.readySpikeIds.filter(physical);
            if(ids.length)return {active:true,reason:'ready-knockback-to-spike',evidence:'ready-enemy-path',spikeSids:ids};
        }
        const incomingPath=(value.projectileKnockback||[]).find(p=>(p.paidProjectile||shots.has(p.projectileSid)&&(value.incoming||[]).some(s=>s.sid===p.projectileSid))&&p.spikes.some(s=>physical(s.sid)));
        if(incomingPath)return {active:true,reason:'committed-spike-path',evidence:'observed-projectile-knockback',projectileSid:incomingPath.projectileSid,attacker:incomingPath.ownerSid??null,spikeSids:incomingPath.spikes.filter(s=>physical(s.sid)).map(s=>s.sid)};
        const current=(value.spikes||[]).filter(s=>!s.placement&&s.damage>0&&physical(s.sid)&&
            (s.observedMotion||s.observedContact||s.predicted===false||s.knockback&&s.attacker==null));
        if(current.length)return {active:true,reason:'committed-spike-path',evidence:'physical-motion-or-contact',spikeSids:[...new Set(current.map(s=>s.sid))]};
        const point=pos(self);
        for(const [sid,opening]of spikeComboOpenings){
            if(time-opening.at>window){spikeComboOpenings.delete(sid);continue;}
            const enemy=api.player(sid);
            if(!enemy?.alive||!enemy.visible||friendly(enemy)||!opening.position||
                Math.hypot(point.x-opening.position.x,point.y-opening.position.y)>2)continue;
            const paths=(opening.path||[]).filter(p=>{const object=physical(p.sid);return object&&object.id===p.id&&object.x===p.x&&object.y===p.y;});
            if(paths.length)return {active:true,reason:'committed-spike-path',evidence:'observed-directed-melee',attacker:sid,weapon:opening.weapon,spikeSids:paths.map(p=>p.sid)};
        }
        return inactive;
    }
    function lethalSpikeCombo(value=snapshot()){
        const self=api.self,hp=self.health,time=now(),window=Math.min(450,2*tick+Math.max(0,root.MooMooLoader.net?.ping||0));
        const inactive={active:false,reason:null};
        for(const [sid,opening]of spikeComboOpenings)if(time-opening.at>window||!api.player(sid))spikeComboOpenings.delete(sid);
        if(!self.alive||!(hp>0))return inactive;
        const physical=(value.spikes||[]).filter(s=>{
            if(s.placement)return false;
            const object=root.MooMooLoader.objects.get(s.sid);
            return object?.active&&!object.fake&&!object.preplace&&object.ownerSid!=null&&
                !root.MooMooLoader.objects.isFriendly(object.ownerSid)&&data.item(object.id)?.group?.name==='spikes';
        });
        let best=projectileKnockbackRisk(value);
        if(!physical.length)return best;
        const neutral={...self,hat:0,skin:0,skinIndex:0},soldier={...self,hat:6,skin:6,skinIndex:6};
        for(const target of value.targets||[]){
            const enemy=api.player(target.sid);if(!enemy||friendly(enemy)||!enemy.alive||!enemy.visible||!(enemy.health>0))continue;
            const opening=spikeComboOpenings.get(target.sid);
            const contact=physical.some(s=>s.observedContact);
            const airborne=(value.incoming||[]).filter(s=>s.ownerSid===target.sid&&s.eta<=2*tick);
            if(!opening&&!contact&&!airborne.length)continue;
            // Unknown primaries and a merely approaching enemy do not interrupt a combo.
            const known=[...(weapons.get(target.sid)?.values()||[])].filter(w=>w.id<9);
            let melee=0,armoredMelee=0,weapon=null;
            for(const w of known){
                const spec=data.weapon(w.id);
                if(!spec||spec.projectile!=null||!spec.dmg||distance(enemy,self)>(spec.range||0)+(self.scale||35)*1.8||
                    (reload(target.sid,w.id)?.remaining||0)>tick)continue;
                const attacker={...enemy,hat:7,skin:7,skinIndex:7};
                const amount=meleeDamage(attacker,neutral,w.id,w.variant);
                if(amount>melee){melee=amount;armoredMelee=meleeDamage(attacker,soldier,w.id,w.variant);weapon=w.id;}
            }
            if(!(melee>0))continue;
            // A speculative KB trajectory is actionable only for this committed attacker.
            const spikes=physical.filter(s=>!s.knockback||s.observedContact||!s.predicted||s.attacker===target.sid&&!!opening);
            if(!spikes.length)continue;
            // A damage-matched contact is evidence, not another future 45 damage.
            const remaining=spikes.filter(s=>!s.observedContact);
            const rawSpike=remaining.reduce((sum,s)=>sum+(data.item(root.MooMooLoader.objects.get(s.sid).id)?.dmg||0),0);
            const tailFactor=factor(tail(self)?.dmgMult),air=new Map(airborne.map(s=>[s.sid,s]));
            const airDamage=[...air.values()].reduce((sum,s)=>sum+projectileDamage(neutral,{x:s.xNow,y:s.yNow},s.rawDamage),0);
            const soldierAir=[...air.values()].reduce((sum,s)=>sum+projectileDamage(soldier,{x:s.xNow,y:s.yNow},s.rawDamage),0);
            const damage=melee+rawSpike*tailFactor+airDamage;
            if(damage<hp||best.active&&damage<=best.damage)continue;
            best={active:true,reason:'lethal-spike-combo',attacker:target.sid,weapon,damage,
                soldierDamage:armoredMelee+rawSpike*tailFactor*factor(data.hat(6)?.dmgMult)+soldierAir,
                spikeSids:spikes.map(s=>s.sid),evidence:opening?'observed-melee-opening':contact?'confirmed-spike-contact':'incoming-projectile',estimated:true};
        }
        return best;
    }

    function snapshot(){
        // One completed assessment serves synchronous consumers in the same turn.
        // Packet/health/geometry invalidation still clears cached immediately.
        // An overdue timer cannot expire it repeatedly before JS can yield.
        const time=now();if(cached&&(snapshotTurn||time-cacheAt<50&&time<refreshAt))return cached;
        for(const [sid,until] of oneTickPreps)if(until<=time)oneTickPreps.delete(sid);
        const self=api.self,targets=[],incoming=[],spikes=[],projectileKnockback=[],readySpikeIds=[],animals=animalThreats(),periodic=periodicThreats();let damage=0;
        if(!sessionEnded&&api.isReady()&&self.alive){
            const selfPositions=new Map();
            function selfAt(horizon){
                if(!selfPositions.has(horizon))selfPositions.set(horizon,predict(self,horizon));
                return selfPositions.get(horizon);
            }
            damage+=animals.filter(a=>a.reachable).reduce((n,a)=>n+a.damage,0);
            for(const p of api.players.values()){
                if(!p.alive||p.health<=0||!p.visible||friendly(p))continue;
                remember(p);const dist=distance(p,self);if(!Number.isFinite(dist)||dist>1500)continue;
                let total=0;const attacks=[],loadout=potentialWeapons(p);
                // Start evaluating approach danger within 350, while retaining the
                // actual weapon reach, observed loadout, cooldown and collision path.
                const forecastHorizon=dist<=350?Math.min(tick*3,tick*2+Math.max(0,root.MooMooLoader.net?.ping||0)):tick;
                const approach=dist<=350?approachForecast(p,forecastHorizon,selfAt):null;
                const forecastDistance=approach?.distance??dist;
                for(const entry of loadout){
                    const w=data.weapon(entry.id);if(!w)continue;
                    const ranged=w.projectile!=null,projectile=ranged&&data.projectiles[w.projectile];
                    // Beyond 350, count actual incoming projectiles, not an idle loadout.
                    if(ranged&&dist>350)continue;
                    const reach=ranged?(projectile?.range||0)+70+(self.scale||35):(w.range||0)+(self.scale||35)*1.8;
                    if(forecastDistance>reach)continue;
                    if(ranged){const a=pos(p),b=pos(self),dir=Math.atan2(b.y-a.y,b.x-a.x);if(covered({x:a.x+70*Math.cos(dir),y:a.y+70*Math.sin(dir)},self,p.zIndex||0))continue;}
                    const reloadHorizon=Math.max(healingHorizon(),dist>reach?forecastHorizon:0);
                    if((reload(p.sid,w.id)?.remaining||0)>reloadHorizon)continue;

                    const amount=ranged?projectileDamage(self,p,projectile?.dmg||0):
                        (w.dmg||0)*(variants[entry.variant]||1)*(shielded(self,p)||1)*factor(data.hat(7)?.dmgMultO)*
                        factor(hat(self)?.dmgMult)*factor(tail(self)?.dmgMult);
                    total+=amount;attacks.push({weapon:entry.unknown?null:w.id,predictedWeapon:entry.unknown?w.id:null,damage:amount,ranged,unknown:!!entry.unknown,slot:entry.slot,reload:reload(p.sid,w.id),reloadHorizon,forecast:dist>reach,forecastDistance,forecastHorizon,boosted:!!approach?.boosted,estimated:true});
                }
                const equippedGear=hat(p)?.turret,gear=equippedGear||data.hat(53)?.turret;
                if(dist<=350&&gear&&(equippedGear||knownTurrets.has(p.sid)||turrets.has(p.sid))&&turretReload(p.sid).remaining<=Math.max(healingHorizon(),dist>gear.range?forecastHorizon:0)&&forecastDistance<=gear.range&&!hat(self)?.antiTurret&&!covered(p,self,p.zIndex||0)){
                    const amount=projectileDamage(self,p,data.projectiles[gear.proj]?.dmg||25);total+=amount;attacks.push({turret:true,damage:amount,possibleSwitch:!equippedGear,reload:turretReload(p.sid),estimated:true});
                }
                const spear=weapons.get(p.sid)?.get(0)?.id===5;
                const toward=Math.atan2(pos(self).y-pos(p).y,pos(self).x-pos(p).x);
                const facing=Math.abs(normalized(toward-(p.d2??p.dir)))<=Math.PI/2,oneTickDistance=approachingDistance(self,p),oneTickRange=245+(self.scale||35)-35;
                const turretPath=!covered(p,self,p.zIndex||0);
                const airborneGear=[...shots.values()].some(s=>{
                    if(!s.gear||s.ownerSid!==p.sid)return false;
                    const travel=(time-s.at)*s.speed,x=s.x+Math.cos(s.dir)*travel,y=s.y+Math.sin(s.dir)*travel;
                    const dx=pos(self).x-x,dy=pos(self).y-y,along=dx*Math.cos(s.dir)+dy*Math.sin(s.dir),cross=Math.abs(dx*Math.sin(s.dir)-dy*Math.cos(s.dir));
                    return along>=0&&along<=s.range-travel&&cross<=(self.scale||35)&&Math.max(0,along-(self.scale||35))/s.speed<=tick*2&&!covered({x,y},self,s.layer);
                });
                const preparing=turretPath&&spear&&p.weaponIndex===5&&facing&&(reload(p.sid,5)?.remaining||0)<=tick&&
                    (!!equippedGear&&turretReload(p.sid).remaining<=tick&&oneTickDistance<=oneTickRange||airborneGear&&oneTickDistance<=oneTickRange+35);
                if(preparing)oneTickPreps.set(p.sid,time+tick*2);
                // A recognized opener remains dangerous through its existing
                // two-tick impact window. K/reload and facing/weapon receipts
                // can precede the damage receipt; they do not cancel that hit.
                // Do not extend the deadline without another real preparation.
                const oneTick=preparing||turretPath&&spear&&oneTickDistance<=oneTickRange+35&&
                    (oneTickPreps.get(p.sid)||0)>time;
                const opener=repeaterShots.get(p.sid);
                const boostFollowup=opener?.hit!=null && time-opener.hit<=tick*3 && dist<=350 && spear && turretPath &&
                    (airborneGear || !!equippedGear && turretReload(p.sid).remaining<=healingHorizon()) &&
                    (reload(p.sid,5)?.remaining||0)<=healingHorizon() &&
                    boostCanReach(p,(data.weapon(5).range||0)+(self.scale||35)*1.8,forecastDistance);
                const positionAge=Math.max(0,time-(motion.get(p.sid)?.at??-Infinity)),positionFresh=positionAge<=tick*3;
                targets.push({sid:p.sid,distance:dist,forecastDistance,forecastHorizon,damage:total,attacks,oneTick,boostFollowup,position:pos(p),positionAge,positionFresh,confidence:positionFresh?motion.get(p.sid)?.confidence||0:0});damage+=total;
            }
            damage+=periodic.reduce((sum,effect)=>sum+effect.damage,0);


            const current=pos(self),future=predict(self,tick+Math.min(tick,Math.max(0,root.MooMooLoader.net?.ping||0)/2));
            const dx=future.x-current.x,dy=future.y-current.y,length=dx*dx+dy*dy;
            // The index contains full object extents; expand the swept self
            // bounds for body contact plus the existing recent-contact margin.
            // A custom collision hook can nominate a remote object, so retain
            // the complete scan whenever that hook is present.
            const contactPad=(self.scale||35)+24;
            const contactWorld=root.MooMooSafewalk?.collisionThreat&&root.MooMooSafewalk.collisionThreat!==root.MooMooSafewalk.stockContact?root.MooMooLoader.objects?.all()||[]:
                root.AntimoocheatWorld?.query({x:Math.min(current.x,future.x)-contactPad,y:Math.min(current.y,future.y)-contactPad},
                    {x:Math.max(current.x,future.x)+contactPad,y:Math.max(current.y,future.y)+contactPad})||root.MooMooLoader.objects?.all()||[];
            for(const object of contactWorld){
                const item=data.item(object.id);
                if(!object.active||object.fake||object.preplace||object.ownerSid==null||
                    root.MooMooLoader.objects.isFriendly(object.ownerSid)||item?.group?.name!=='spikes'||!(item.dmg>0))continue;
                const u=length?Math.max(0,Math.min(1,((object.x-current.x)*dx+(object.y-current.y)*dy)/length)):0;
                const radius=(self.scale||35)+(object.getScale?.()??object.scale);
                const safe=root.MooMooSafewalk;
                const recent=now()-(spikeContacts.get(object.sid)??-Infinity)<=Math.min(500,tick*2+Math.max(0,root.MooMooLoader.net?.ping||0))&&distance(self,object)<=radius+24;
                if(Math.hypot(object.x-current.x-dx*u,object.y-current.y-dy*u)>radius+.5&&!recent&&!safe?.collisionThreat?.(object.sid))continue;
                const amount=item.dmg*factor(hat(self)?.dmgMult)*factor(tail(self)?.dmgMult);
                spikes.push({sid:object.sid,damage:amount,predicted:!recent&&distance(self,object)>radius,observedContact:recent,observedMotion:true});damage+=amount;
            }
            for(const [key,shot] of shots){
                const latency=Math.min(250,Math.max(0,root.MooMooLoader.net.ping||0)/2),age=Math.max(0,time-shot.at+latency),past=Math.min(tick,age),travel=(age-past)*shot.speed,remaining=shot.range-travel;
                if(remaining<=0||time-shot.at>3000){shots.delete(key);continue;}
                if(shot.ownerSid!=null){const owner=api.player(shot.ownerSid);if(owner&&friendly(owner))continue;}
                const x=shot.x+Math.cos(shot.dir)*travel,y=shot.y+Math.sin(shot.dir)*travel;
                const limit=Math.min(750,650+latency,remaining/shot.speed),future=predict(self,limit),current=pos(self),radius=self.scale||35;
                const rx=current.x-x,ry=current.y-y,vx=(future.x-current.x)/(limit||1)-Math.cos(shot.dir)*shot.speed,vy=(future.y-current.y)/(limit||1)-Math.sin(shot.dir)*shot.speed;
                // Native projectile hits use a swept axis-aligned box, not a circle.
                // A diagonal shot can hit the corners without crossing the body radius.
                let enter=0,exit=limit;
                for(const [offset,velocity]of [[rx,vx],[ry,vy]]){
                    if(Math.abs(velocity)<1e-10){if(Math.abs(offset)>radius){exit=-1;break;}continue;}
                    const a=(-radius-offset)/velocity,b=(radius-offset)/velocity;
                    enter=Math.max(enter,Math.min(a,b));exit=Math.min(exit,Math.max(a,b));
                }
                const eta=enter<=exit?Math.max(0,enter-past):Infinity;
                if(eta<0||eta>limit)continue;
                const impact={x:current.x+(future.x-current.x)*eta/(limit||1),y:current.y+(future.y-current.y)*eta/(limit||1),scale:radius};
                if(shot.gear&&hat(self)?.antiTurret||covered({x,y},impact,shot.layer))continue;
                const amount=projectileDamage(self,{x,y},shot.damage);damage+=amount;
                incoming.push({...shot,sid:key,damage:amount,rawDamage:shot.damage,
                    soldierDamage:projectileDamage({...self,hat:6,skin:6,skinIndex:6},{x,y},shot.damage),
                    xNow:x,yNow:y,turret:shot.gear,ownerSid:shot.ownerSid,eta,impact,confidence:future.confidence,estimated:true});
            }
            const knockback=knockbackCollisions(targets,incoming);readySpikeIds.push(...(knockback.readySpikeIds||[]));
            projectileKnockback.push(...(knockback.projectilePaths||[]));
            for(const path of projectileKnockback){
                const shot=incoming.find(s=>s.sid===path.projectileSid);
                projectilePushEvidence.set(path.projectileSid,{at:time,shot,path,position:pos(self),objects:path.spikes.map(s=>{const o=root.MooMooLoader.objects.get(s.sid);return {sid:s.sid,object:o,x:o?.x,y:o?.y};})});
            }
            for(const [sid,evidence]of projectilePushEvidence){
                if(time-evidence.at>Math.min(500,2*tick+Math.max(100,root.MooMooLoader.net?.ping||0))||evidence.until!=null&&time>=evidence.until){projectilePushEvidence.delete(sid);continue;}
                if(evidence.confirmedAt==null)continue;
                const point=pos(self),dx=point.x-evidence.position.x,dy=point.y-evidence.position.y;
                if(dx*Math.cos(evidence.shot.dir)+dy*Math.sin(evidence.shot.dir)<-2||Math.hypot(dx,dy)>120){projectilePushEvidence.delete(sid);continue;}
                const remaining=evidence.path.spikes.filter(s=>{const record=evidence.objects.find(o=>o.sid===s.sid),object=root.MooMooLoader.objects.get(s.sid);return record&&object===record.object&&object.active&&object.x===record.x&&object.y===record.y&&(spikeContacts.get(s.sid)??-Infinity)<evidence.confirmedAt;});
                if(remaining.length)projectileKnockback.push({...evidence.path,eta:0,confirmedAt:evidence.confirmedAt,paidProjectile:true,shot:evidence.shot,spikes:remaining});
            }
            while(projectilePushEvidence.size>8)projectilePushEvidence.delete(projectilePushEvidence.keys().next().value);
            for(const hit of knockback){
                const existing=spikes.find(s=>s.sid===hit.sid);
                if(existing){existing.knockback=true;existing.attacker=hit.attacker;}else {spikes.push(hit);damage+=hit.damage;}
            }
            for(const point of root.forecastPlacements?.()||[]){
                spikes.push({...point,sid:'placement:'+point.enemy,predicted:true,placement:true});
                damage+=point.damage;
            }
        }
        targets.sort((a,b)=>a.distance-b.distance);
        const defense=factor(hat(self)?.dmgMult)*factor(tail(self)?.dmgMult);
        cached={damage,periodic,periodicDamage:periodic.reduce((sum,effect)=>sum+effect.damage,0),unknownDamage:targets.reduce((n,t)=>n+t.attacks.filter(a=>a.unknown).reduce((v,a)=>v+a.damage,0),0),spikeDamage:spikes.reduce((total,s)=>total+s.damage,0),unarmoredDamage:defense>0?damage/defense:damage,lethal:damage>=self.health&&self.health>0,targets,incoming,spikes,projectileKnockback,readySpikeIds,animals,at:time,revision,worldRevision,estimated:true,
            immediateDamage:incoming.reduce((n,s)=>n+s.damage,0)+spikes.filter(s=>!s.predicted).reduce((n,s)=>n+s.damage,0),futureSpikeDamage:spikes.filter(s=>s.predicted).reduce((n,s)=>n+s.damage,0)};cacheAt=time;
        if(!snapshotTurn){snapshotTurn=true;root.queueMicrotask(()=>{snapshotTurn=false;});}
        armRefresh();return cached;
    }
    const pressureCache=[null,null];
    function pressure(value=snapshot(),airborneOnly=false){
        const slot=Number(airborneOnly),old=pressureCache[slot],self=api.self;
        if(old?.value===value&&old.hp===self.health&&old.hat===self.hat&&old.tail===self.accessory)return old.result;
        const incoming=(value.incoming||[]).reduce((n,p)=>n+p.damage,0);
        const attacks=(value.targets||[]).filter(t=>t.distance<=350).flatMap(t=>t.attacks.filter(a=>!a.possibleSwitch&&(!airborneOnly||!a.ranged&&!a.turret)));
        const attackDamage=attacks.reduce((n,a)=>n+a.damage,0);
        const spikeDamage=(value.spikes||[]).reduce((n,s)=>n+s.damage,0);
        const animalDamage=(value.animals||[]).filter(a=>a.reachable).reduce((n,a)=>n+a.damage,0);
        const periodicDamage=value.periodicDamage||0;
        const damage=incoming+attackDamage+spikeDamage+animalDamage+periodicDamage;
        const defense=factor(hat(api.self)?.dmgMult)*factor(tail(api.self)?.dmgMult);
        const observedDamage=incoming+spikeDamage+animalDamage+periodicDamage+attacks.filter(a=>!a.unknown).reduce((n,a)=>n+a.damage,0);
        const unarmoredDamage=defense>0?observedDamage/defense:observedDamage;
        const incomingTurret=(value.incoming||[]).filter(p=>p.turret).reduce((n,p)=>n+p.damage,0),polearm=attacks.filter(a=>a.weapon===5).reduce((n,a)=>n+a.damage,0);
        const airStack=incomingTurret>0&&polearm>0&&(incomingTurret+polearm)/(defense||1)>=api.self.health;
        const oneTick=(value.targets||[]).some(t=>t.oneTick),urgent=api.self.health>0&&(airStack||unarmoredDamage>=api.self.health);
        const knockbackDanger=new Set((value.spikes||[]).filter(s=>s.damage>0).map(s=>s.sid)).size>=2;
        const result={damage,unarmoredDamage,incomingDamage:incoming/(defense||1),spikeDamage:spikeDamage/(defense||1),periodicDamage,knockbackDanger,animalDanger:animalDamage>0,ongoing:damage>0,oneTick,airStack,urgent};
        pressureCache[slot]={value,hp:self.health,hat:self.hat,tail:self.accessory,result};return result;
    }
    const clear=()=>{pressureCache.fill(null);cancelRefresh();inputDirty=false;weapons.clear();cooldowns.clear();turrets.clear();recentTurret.clear();motion.clear();shots.clear();retiredShots.clear();projectilePushEvidence.clear();oneTickPreps.clear();tracking.clear();selections.clear();failures.clear();animalMotion.clear();animalAttacks.clear();animalCaptures.clear();worldCache=null;coverCache=null;trapSource=null;trapObjects=[];worldRevision++;poisonState=lastSelfDamage=periodicItem=null;cheesePendingUntil=0;poisonHits.clear();repeaterShots.clear();knownTurrets.clear();selfHealth=api.self.health;hatRequests.length=accessoryRequests.length=0;cached=null;};

        }
        if(event==='playersUpdate'){
            updateReloads();

                observeMotion(motion,point);
                received.add(point.sid);
            }

                if(hat(p)?.turret)rememberTurret(p);remember(p);if(!received.has(p.sid))observeMotion(motion,{sid:p.sid,...pos(p)});
            }

        if(event==='animalsUpdate'){
            const values=payload.args?.[0]||[];for(let i=0;i+7<values.length;i+=8)observeMotion(animalMotion,{sid:values[i],x:values[i+2],y:values[i+3]});
            for(const sid of payload.args?.[1]||[])animalMotion.delete(sid);
        }
        if(event==='animalAttack'){const sid=payload.args?.[0];if(animalMotion.has(sid))animalAttacks.set(sid,now());if(animalAttacks.size>256)animalAttacks.delete(animalAttacks.keys().next().value);}
        if(event==='health'&&payload.sid===api.self.sid)observePeriodicHealth(payload.value);

        if(event==='gatherAnimation'){const [sid,,id]=payload.args||[];observePoisonAttack(sid,id);}
        if(event==='projectileAdd'){
            const [x,y,dir,range,speed,index,layer,sid]=payload.args||[],definition=data.projectiles[index];
            if(definition&&[x,y,dir,range,speed].every(Number.isFinite)&&speed>0){
                rememberRepeater(x,y,dir,range,speed,index,layer);
                const key=sid??'shot'+(++serial),shot={x,y,dir,range,speed,index,layer:layer||0,gear:index===1&&speed===1.5,damage:definition.dmg,ownerSid:null,at:now()};

                if(shots.size>128)shots.delete(shots.keys().next().value);
            }
        }
        if(event==='projectileRemove')retireShot(payload.args?.[0]);
        if(event==='playersUpdate')for(const shot of shots.values())if(shot.ownerSid==null&&now()-shot.at<250)resolveShotOwner(shot);

        cached=null;
        for(const fn of listeners)try{fn();}catch(error){emit('lifecycle','threat-listener-error',{message:String(error)});}
        if(!['reset','setup','disconnect','died'].includes(event))armRefresh();
    });

    function uncertainTurretDamage(sid){
        const enemy=api.player(sid),self=api.self,gear=data.hat(53)?.turret;
        if(!gear||!self.alive||!enemy?.alive||!enemy.visible||!(enemy.health>0)||friendly(enemy))return 0;
        // Observed gear and real cooldowns already belong to ordinary threat
        // accounting. Unseen ownership is uncertainty, never confirmed absence.
        if(hat(enemy)?.turret||knownTurrets.has(sid)||turrets.has(sid))return 0;
        if(now()-(motion.get(sid)?.at??-Infinity)>tick*3||distance(enemy,self)>Math.min(350,gear.range)||
            hat(self)?.antiTurret||!turretReady(sid)||covered(enemy,self,enemy.zIndex||0))return 0;
        return projectileDamage(self,enemy,data.projectiles[gear.proj]?.dmg||25);
    }
    const exposureFactor=()=>(api.self.hat??api.self.skinIndex)===6?1/factor(data.hat(6)?.dmgMult):1;
    const healPotentialCache=new WeakMap();
    function healPotential(value=snapshot(),horizon=0,exposed=false){
        let cache=healPotentialCache.get(value);if(!cache)healPotentialCache.set(value,cache=new Map());
        const multiplier=exposed?exposureFactor():1,key=multiplier===1?horizon:"exposed:"+horizon;
        const prior=cache.get(key),time=now();if(prior&&time<prior.until)return prior.result;
        const self=api.self,targets=[];
        for(const p of api.players.values()){
            if(!p.visible||!p.alive||p.health<=0||friendly(p)||distance(p,self)>350)continue;
            let strongest=null,followup=0,readyMeleeDamage=0;
            for(const entry of potentialWeapons(p)){
                const w=data.weapon(entry.id);if(!w?.dmg&&w?.projectile==null)continue;
                const projectile=w.projectile!=null?data.projectiles[w.projectile]:null;
                const reach=projectile?(projectile.range||0)+70+(self.scale||35):(w.range||0)+(self.scale||35)*1.8;
                // Select the strongest loadout weapon before checking reach.
                // A weaker ready secondary must not replace an out-of-range primary on the HUD.
                const reachable=distance(p,self)<=reach&&!(projectile&&covered(p,self,p.zIndex||0));
                const amount=projectile?projectileDamage(self,p,projectile.dmg||0):(w.dmg||0)*(variants[entry.variant]||1)*(shielded(self,p)||1)*factor(data.hat(7)?.dmgMultO)*factor(hat(self)?.dmgMult)*factor(tail(self)?.dmgMult);
                const remaining=reload(p.sid,w.id)?.remaining||0;
                const attack={weapon:w.id,damage:amount*multiplier,remaining,reachable,ranged:!!projectile,unknown:!!entry.unknown};
                if(!strongest||attack.damage>strongest.damage)strongest=attack;
                if(reachable&&!attack.ranged&&!entry.unknown&&remaining<=0)readyMeleeDamage=Math.max(readyMeleeDamage,attack.damage);
                if(reachable&&remaining<=horizon)followup+=attack.damage;
            }
            const turret=(value.targets.find(t=>t.sid===p.sid)?.attacks||[]).find(a=>a.turret);
            if(turret&&(turret.reload?.remaining||0)<=horizon)followup+=turret.damage*multiplier;
            if(strongest)targets.push({sid:p.sid,strongest,readyMeleeDamage,damage:strongest.reachable&&strongest.remaining<=horizon?strongest.damage:0,followup});
        }
        const result={targets,damage:targets.reduce((n,t)=>n+t.damage,0),followupDamage:targets.reduce((n,t)=>n+t.followup,0),
            projectileDamage:(value.incoming||[]).reduce((n,p)=>n+p.damage,0)*multiplier,
            placementDamage:(value.spikes||[]).reduce((n,p)=>n+(p.placement?p.damage:0),0)*multiplier};
        const boundary=targets.flatMap(t=>[t.strongest.remaining,t.strongest.remaining-horizon]).filter(n=>n>0);
        if(cache.size>3)cache.clear();cache.set(key,{result,until:time+Math.min(20,...boundary)});return result;
    }

        matchProjectilePush(sid,loss){
            const evidence=projectilePushEvidence.get(sid),time=now();
            if(!evidence||evidence.confirmedAt!=null||time-evidence.at>Math.min(500,2*tick+Math.max(100,root.MooMooLoader.net?.ping||0))||
                !(loss>0)||Math.abs(projectileDamage(api.self,{x:evidence.shot.xNow,y:evidence.shot.yNow},evidence.shot.rawDamage)-loss)>1.1)return false;
            evidence.confirmedAt=time;evidence.until=time+Math.min(350,2*tick+Math.max(0,root.MooMooLoader.net?.ping||0)/2);
            cached=null;revision++;armRefresh();return true;
        },
        consumeProjectile(sid){if(!retireShot(sid))return false;cached=null;revision++;armRefresh();return true;},
        projectileOwner:sid=>shots.get(sid)?.ownerSid??(retiredShots.get(sid)?.until>now()?retiredShots.get(sid).ownerSid:null)??null,
        onChange(fn){listeners.add(fn);return()=>listeners.delete(fn);},
        potentialWeapons:sid=>api.player(sid)?potentialWeapons(api.player(sid)):[],
        observedWeapons:sid=>[...(weapons.get(sid)?.values()||[])].map(x=>({...x}))};
    root.MooMooThreats=controller;return controller;
