(function installHealObserver(api,root){
    'use strict';if(root.MooMooHealObserver)return;
    const data=root.MooMooLoader.gameData,now=()=>root.performance?.now()??Date.now();
    const freeFood=()=>/^sandbox(?:-[a-z0-9]+)?\.moomoo\.io$/i.test(root.location?.hostname||'')||root.MooMooLoader.combat?.sandbox===true;
    let selected=null,batch=null,timer=null,health=api.self.health,food=api.self.food,regenUntil=0;
    const samples=new Map(),invalidatedBatches=new Map();let sampleSerial=0,batchSerial=0;
    const otherHealing=()=>now()<regenUntil||[data.hat(api.self.hat),data.accessory(api.self.accessory)].some(e=>e?.healthRegen>0||e?.healD>0);
    const reset=()=>{selected=null;batch=null;regenUntil=0;samples.clear();invalidatedBatches.clear();if(timer!==null)root.clearTimeout(timer);timer=null;health=api.self.health;food=api.self.food;};
    function invalidate(b){
        b.invalid=true;invalidatedBatches.set(b.id,b.token);
        // A later unsolicited gain in the same observation window can reveal
        // regeneration. Withdraw only this window's provisional free-food sample.
        if(b.freeSample&&samples.get(b.id)===b.freeSample)samples.delete(b.id);
    }
    function finish(){
        timer=null;const b=batch;batch=null;
        if(!b||b.free||b.invalid||b.spent<=0||b.gain<=0)return;
        const count=b.spent/b.cost,heal=b.gain/count;
        if(!Number.isInteger(count)||count>b.sent||!Number.isFinite(heal)||heal<=0||heal>b.base+.01||b.clipped&&b.gain!==count*b.base)return;
        samples.set(b.id,{heal:Math.min(b.base,heal),base:b.base,at:now(),count,serial:++sampleSerial,batchId:b.token,estimated:true,source:'observed health gain / consumed food'});
    }
    api.onSent((action,p)=>{
        if(action==='selectItem')selected=p.isWeapon?null:p.index;
        if(action!=='mouse'||!p.down)return;
        const item=data.item(selected);if(!item?.heal)return;
        // SDK state changes before listeners run. An earlier listener can send
        // reactive food before our health callback, so account for that receipt
        // before appending the new request. The later callback is idempotent.
        observeHealth(api.self.health);
        // Cheese adds regeneration later; its total gain is not immediate food healing.
        if(selected===2)regenUntil=now()+5500;
        if(batch&&batch.id!==selected){invalidate(batch);return;}
        if(!batch){
            const cost=item.req[item.req.indexOf('food')+1];
            if(!(cost>0))return;
            batch={id:selected,token:++batchSerial,base:item.heal,cost,sent:0,gain:0,spent:0,invalid:otherHealing(),clipped:false,
                free:freeFood(),pending:0,ambiguous:false,freeSample:null};
            timer=root.setTimeout(finish,Math.min(1500,Math.max(350,(root.MooMooLoader.net?.ping||0)*2+222)));
        }
        batch.sent++;batch.pending++;
    });
    // Use an event-specific health listener: SDK event listeners run before '*'.
    // Defense may send the next food from its health listener; reading at '*'
    // would count that later request against the receipt currently being handled.
    function observeHealth(value){
        if(!Number.isFinite(value)||value===health)return;
        // Later damage starts a new wound; it cannot undo an already isolated
        // food receipt with no remaining request. Keep overlapping/regen windows invalid.
        if(value<health&&batch?.free&&batch.pending===0&&batch.freeSample&&!otherHealing()){
            if(timer!==null)root.clearTimeout(timer);finish();
        }
        if(batch){
            const b=batch,gain=value-health;
            if(otherHealing()||!Number.isFinite(gain)||gain<0)invalidate(b);
            else b.gain+=gain;
            const clipped=value>=(api.self.maxHealth||100);if(clipped)b.clipped=true;
            if(b.free&&gain>0){
                if(b.pending!==1){b.ambiguous=true;invalidate(b);}
                // A full base gain remains identifiable at the health cap;
                // smaller capped gains cannot reveal the food's actual healing.
                // This is still an estimate without a per-food acknowledgement.
                if(!b.invalid&&!b.ambiguous&&(!clipped||gain===b.base)&&gain<=b.base+.01){
                    const sample={heal:Math.min(b.base,gain),base:b.base,at:now(),count:1,serial:++sampleSerial,batchId:b.token,estimated:true,
                        source:'single outstanding sandbox food request + '+(clipped?'full base health receipt':'unclipped health receipt')};
                    samples.set(b.id,sample);b.freeSample=sample;
                }
                if(b.pending===1)b.pending=0;
            }
        }
        health=value;
    }
    api.on('health',p=>{if(p.sid===api.self.sid)observeHealth(p.value);});
    api.on('*',(event,p)=>{
        if(['reset','setup','died','disconnect'].includes(event)||event==='playerAdd'&&p.isYou){reset();return;}
        if(batch&&otherHealing())invalidate(batch);
        if(event==='playerValue'&&p.key==='food'){
            if(batch){if(!Number.isFinite(food)||!Number.isFinite(p.value)||p.value>food)invalidate(batch);else batch.spent+=Math.max(0,food-p.value);}
            food=p.value;
        }
    });
    root.MooMooHealObserver={status(id){
        const item=id==null?(api.self.items||[]).map(id=>data.item(id)).find(i=>i?.heal):
            (api.self.items||[]).includes(id)?data.item(id):null;
        const sample=item&&samples.get(item.id),ageMs=sample?Math.max(0,now()-sample.at):null;
        const fresh=!!sample&&ageMs<=5000;
        return {item:item?.id??null,base:item?.heal??null,heal:fresh?sample.heal:null,estimated:true,
            ratio:fresh?sample.heal/sample.base:null,ageMs,sampleCount:fresh?sample.count:0,
            sampleId:sample?.serial??null,batchId:sample?.batchId??null,settled:!!sample&&batch?.token!==sample.batchId,invalidatedBatchId:invalidatedBatches.get(item?.id)??null,
            label:fresh?'~'+Number(sample.heal.toFixed(1))+' heal':'unknown',source:fresh?sample.source:'unknown'};
    }};
})(observedApi,observedRoot);

    function drawMap(at){

        const y=expanded?(root.innerHeight-size)/2:bounds?.width>=8?bounds.top:root.innerHeight-size-18;
        const dpr=Math.min(root.devicePixelRatio||1,2),pixels=Math.round(size*dpr);
        if(mapDirty || terrainKey!==size+':'+pixels+':'+expanded)paintTerrain(size,pixels);
        if(map.width!==pixels){map.width=map.height=pixels;}
        map.style.width=map.style.height=size+'px';
        map.style.left=x+'px';map.style.top=y+'px';map.style.display='block';
        mapPen.setTransform(1,0,0,1,0,0);mapPen.drawImage(terrain,0,0);
        mapPen.setTransform(pixels/size,0,0,pixels/size,0,0);
        const dot=(point,color,radius)=>{mapPen.fillStyle=color;mapPen.strokeStyle='#333';mapPen.lineWidth=.8;mapPen.beginPath();mapPen.arc(point.x/worldScale*size,point.y/worldScale*size,radius,0,Math.PI*2);mapPen.fill();mapPen.stroke();};
        if(settings.mapPlayers){for(const point of clanPoints)dot(point,'#44c4ff',expanded?3:2);for(const p of observed().values())if(p.visible&&p.alive!==false&&p.sid!==api.self.sid)dot(pos(p),friendly(p)?'#44c4ff':'#ed4b52',expanded?3:2);}
        dot(pos(api.self),'#fff',expanded?4:2.5);
        if(settings.lastDeath&&lastDeath){
            const px=lastDeath.x/worldScale*size,py=lastDeath.y/worldScale*size,r=expanded?7:4;
            mapPen.save();mapPen.lineCap='round';mapPen.beginPath();
            mapPen.moveTo(px-r,py-r);mapPen.lineTo(px+r,py+r);mapPen.moveTo(px+r,py-r);mapPen.lineTo(px-r,py+r);
            mapPen.strokeStyle='#3b171b';mapPen.lineWidth=expanded?5:3.8;mapPen.stroke();
            mapPen.strokeStyle='#ff394c';mapPen.lineWidth=expanded?3:2.2;mapPen.stroke();mapPen.restore();
        }
    }
    let diagnosticAt=-Infinity,diagnosticText='',diagnosticState=null;
    let frameStart=0,frameCount=0,frameFps=0;
    function diagnosticFrame(at){
        if(!frameStart){frameStart=at;frameCount=0;}frameCount++;
        if(at-frameStart>=1000){frameFps=frameCount*1000/(at-frameStart);frameStart=at;frameCount=0;}
    }
    function diagnosticInfo(threat){
        const at=now();if(at-diagnosticAt<200)return diagnosticText;diagnosticAt=at;
        const macro=root.MooMooCombatMacros?.status(),automation=root.MooMooAutomation?.status();
        const intent=root.MooMooActionIntent,bus=root.AntimoocheatCore?.bus.status(),placement=root.AntimoocheatBasePlacement?.status();
        const blocked=bus?.lastReason&&at-bus.lastReason.at<1000?bus.lastReason:null,breaker=root.MooMooCombatDefense?.status();
        const names={instakill:'Instakill',bullStrike:'Bull strike','defensive-combat':root.MooMooCombatDefense?.status().spaceHeld?'Space break':'Autobreak'};
        const module=macro?.active||intent?.owner||bus?.transaction;
        const active=names[module]||module||(automation?.insta?'Instakill (armed)':automation?.ownsMovement?'AutoPush':'none');
        const waiting=macro?.active?macro.status:breaker?.target!=null?breaker.reason:automation?.insta?automation.instaWait:blocked?blocked.owner+': '+blocked.reason:'none';
        const danger={melee:threat.targets.some(t=>t.attacks?.some(a=>!a.ranged&&!a.turret&&a.damage>0)),projectile:(threat.incomingDamage||0)>0,spike:threat.spikes.length>0,knockback:threat.spikes.some(s=>s.knockback)};
        const me=pos(api.self),collision=threat.spikes.some(s=>{if(s.placement)return false;const o=ctx.objects.get(s.sid);return o?.active&&Math.hypot(o.x-me.x,o.y-me.y)<=(api.self.scale||35)+(o.getScale?.()??o.scale);});
        const timing=placement?.autoplacer.performance;
        const equipment=root.AntimoocheatEquipment?.status();
        diagnosticState={module:active,waiting:waiting||'none',danger,collision,equipment:equipment&&{hat:equipment.confirmedHat,accessory:equipment.observedAccessory,pendingHat:equipment.pendingHat?.id??null,pendingAccessory:equipment.pendingAccessory?.id??null,unconfirmed:equipment.unconfirmed},places:{active:placement?.activity?.count||0,confirmed:placement?.confirmed||0,pending:placement?.pending||0},performance:{fps:frameFps,placementMs:timing?.lastMs||0,placementMaxMs:timing?.maxMs||0},at};
        diagnosticText='\nModule: '+active+'\nWait: '+diagnosticState.waiting+
            '\nEquip wait: H '+(equipment?.pendingHat?.id??'none')+' / A '+(equipment?.pendingAccessory?.id??'none')+
            '\nDanger: '+danger.melee+', '+danger.projectile+', '+danger.spike+', '+danger.knockback+
            '\nCollideSpike: '+collision+'\nPlaces: '+diagnosticState.places.active+
            '\nPerformance: '+(frameFps?Math.round(frameFps)+' FPS':'sampling')+'\nPlace plan: '+diagnosticState.performance.placementMs.toFixed(2)+' ms / max '+diagnosticState.performance.placementMaxMs.toFixed(2)+' ms';
        return diagnosticText;
    }
    const diagnostics={snapshot:()=>diagnosticState};root.AntimoocheatDiagnostics=diagnostics;
    ctx.onCleanup(()=>{if(root.AntimoocheatDiagnostics===diagnostics)delete root.AntimoocheatDiagnostics;});

    let infoDirty=true;
    ctx.onCleanup(threats.onChange(()=>{infoDirty=true;}));
    function updateHudInfo(visible){
        infoDirty=false;
        if(!visible||!settings.info||!info.isConnected)return;
        const threat=threats.snapshot(),heal=observedRoot.MooMooHealObserver?.status?.();
        const healPotential=threats.healPotential(threat,0,true);
        const placementDamage=healPotential.placementDamage;
        const placementLabel=placementDamage?' (Spike placement '+Math.round(placementDamage)+')':'';
        const incomingArrows=(threat.incoming||[]).filter(s=>[0,2,3].includes(s.index)).reduce((n,s)=>n+s.damage,0);
        const arrowLabel=incomingArrows?' (Incoming arrows '+Number(incomingArrows.toFixed(2))+')':'';
        // Keep the full diagnostic snapshot available without crowding the HUD.
        diagnosticInfo(threat);
        const danger=diagnosticState?.danger||{};
        const text='Autohit: '+autoHit+
            '\nAutoQ: '+!!root.AntimoocheatDefense?.qActive()+
            '\nShame: '+(root.AntimoocheatDefense?.shameStatus().label||'unknown')+
            '\nPot damage: ~'+Math.round(healPotential.damage)+placementLabel+
            '\nBullet pot damage: ~'+Math.round(healPotential.projectileDamage)+
            '\nCollideSpike: '+!!diagnosticState?.collision+
            '\nDanger: '+[danger.melee,danger.projectile,danger.spike,danger.knockback].map(value=>value?'t':'f').join(', ')+
            '\nKILLS: '+kills+'\nDEATHS: '+deaths;
        if(info.textContent!==text)info.textContent=text;
    }
    function updateHud(){
        mount();const visible=live();info.style.display=visible&&settings.info?'block':'none';
        const owned=new Set(api.self.weapons||[]);
        doc.getElementById('actionBar')?.classList.toggle('am-xp-active',visible&&settings.weaponXP&&owned.size>0);
        for(const [id,entry] of xpBars)if(!owned.has(id)||!entry.track.isConnected){entry.track.parentNode?.classList.remove('am-xp-host');entry.track.remove();xpBars.delete(id);}
        for(const id of owned){
            const host=doc.getElementById('actionBarItem'+id),progress=xp.current(id);if(!host||!progress)continue;
            let entry=xpBars.get(id);
            if(!entry){const track=doc.createElement('span'),fill=doc.createElement('span');track.className='am-weapon-xp';track.setAttribute('role','progressbar');track.setAttribute('aria-label',(ctx.data.weapon(id)?.name||'Weapon')+' XP');track.setAttribute('aria-valuemin','0');track.setAttribute('aria-valuemax','100');track.append(fill);host.classList.add('am-xp-host');host.append(track);entry={track,fill,visual:null};xpBars.set(id,entry);}
            entry.track.hidden=!visible||!settings.weaponXP;
            const value=Math.round(progress.ratio*10000)/100,visual=progress.color+':'+progress.nextColor+':'+value;
            if(entry.visual!==visual){entry.track.style.backgroundColor=progress.color;entry.fill.style.backgroundColor=progress.nextColor;entry.fill.style.width=value+'%';entry.track.setAttribute('aria-valuenow',String(value));entry.visual=visual;}
        }
        if(visible&&settings.info){const bounds=doc.getElementById('mapDisplay')?.getBoundingClientRect();info.style.bottom=(bounds?.width>=8?Math.max(180,root.innerHeight-bounds.top+65):210)+'px';}
        updateHudInfo(visible);
        indicators.update(visible,info);
        for(const item of ctx.data.items){
            if(!item.group?.place)continue;const host=doc.getElementById('actionBarItem'+(ctx.data.weapons.length+item.id));if(!host)continue;
            let badge=badges.get(item.id);if(!badge){host.classList.add('am-count-host');badge=doc.createElement('span');badge.className='am-count';badge.style.cssText='position:absolute;right:3px;top:0;color:white;text-shadow:0 1px 2px #000;font:13px "Hammersmith One",sans-serif;pointer-events:none';host.append(badge);badges.set(item.id,badge);}
            badge.hidden=!visible||!settings.counts;const count=Math.max(0,Math.floor(ctx.objects.itemCount(item.group.id)));
            const limit=amStructureLimit(item.group,amSandbox(ctx,root));
            const text=count+'/'+(limit===Infinity?'∞':limit??'?');if(badge.textContent!==text)badge.textContent=text;
        }
    }
    ctx.render.layer('antimoocheat-visuals',draw,{z:65});
    ctx.render.onFrame(()=>{const at=now();diagnosticFrame(at);drawMap(at);if(at-lastHud>=200){lastHud=at;updateHud();}else if(infoDirty)updateHudInfo(live());});
    const keydown=event=>{if(event.repeat||event.ctrlKey||event.altKey||event.metaKey||ctx.input.isTyping()||menuOpen())return;if(event.key.toLowerCase()==='q')qHeld=true;};
    const keyup=event=>{if(event.key.toLowerCase()==='q')qHeld=false;};
    const blur=()=>{qHeld=false;};root.addEventListener('keydown',keydown);root.addEventListener('keyup',keyup);root.addEventListener('blur',blur);
    function dismissWelcome(){
        for(const card of doc.querySelectorAll('.mmj-nt-card')) if(card.querySelector('.mmj-nt-title')?.textContent.trim()==="You're good to go"){
            const button=[...card.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>b.textContent.trim().toLowerCase()==='got it');if(button){button.click();return true;}
        }
        return false;
    }
    let noticeObserver=null;
    const stopNotice=()=>{noticeObserver?.disconnect();noticeObserver=null;};
    if(!dismissWelcome()){noticeObserver=new root.MutationObserver(()=>{if(dismissWelcome())stopNotice();});noticeObserver.observe(doc,{childList:true,subtree:true});}
    const noticeTimer=root.setTimeout(stopNotice,60000);
    const service={settings,specs,set,threats,observedApi,healingStatus:id=>observedRoot.MooMooHealObserver.status(id),weaponProgress:id=>xp.current(id),toggleMap(){if(settings.minimap){expanded=!expanded;lastMap=-Infinity;}},closeMap(){if(!expanded)return false;expanded=false;lastMap=-Infinity;return true;},snapshot:()=>({...lastSnapshot,expanded,lastDeath:lastDeath?{...lastDeath}:null,gearShots:[...observed().keys()].filter(sid=>threats.turretReload(sid).observed).length,numbers:numbers.snapshot()}),gearValue};
    root.AntimoocheatVisuals=service;
    ctx.onCleanup(()=>{disposed=true;threats.dispose();stopNotice();root.clearTimeout(noticeTimer);map.remove();info.remove();badgeStyle.remove();doc.getElementById('actionBar')?.classList.remove('am-xp-active');for(const entry of xpBars.values()){entry.track.parentNode?.classList.remove('am-xp-host');entry.track.remove();}xpBars.clear();for(const badge of badges.values()){badge.parentNode?.classList.remove('am-count-host');badge.remove();}badges.clear();root.removeEventListener('keydown',keydown);root.removeEventListener('keyup',keyup);root.removeEventListener('blur',blur);if(root.AntimoocheatVisuals===service)delete root.AntimoocheatVisuals;});
    return service;
}

function createPlacementThreat(ctx,root,threat,visiblePlayers=()=>ctx.players){
    const pos=p=>({x:p.x2??p.x,y:p.y2??p.y}),dist=(a,b)=>Math.hypot((a.x2??a.x)-(b.x2??b.x),(a.y2??a.y)-(b.y2??b.y)),now=()=>root.performance.now();
    let cached=[],stamp='',at=-Infinity;
    function placementNeighbours(origin,radius){return root.AntimoocheatWorld.query({x:origin.x-radius,y:origin.y-radius},{x:origin.x+radius,y:origin.y+radius});}

    const hammerHits=new Map();
    ctx.on?.('gatherAnimation',p=>{const [sid,,id]=p.args||[];if(id===10){hammerHits.set(sid,now());stamp='';}});
    for(const event of ['setup','died','reset','disconnect'])ctx.on?.(event,()=>{hammerHits.clear();stamp='';});
    if(ctx.combat?.onBuildingDamage)ctx.onCleanup(ctx.combat.onBuildingDamage(o=>{
        if(o?.trap){stamp='';threat.refreshPlacement();}
    }));
    return function(){
        const revision=threat.status?.().worldRevision||0,me=pos(ctx.self);

        const enemies=[...visiblePlayers().values()].filter(p=>p.visible&&p.alive!==false&&p.health>0&&p.sid!==ctx.self.sid&&!(ctx.objects.isFriendly(p.sid))&&!(p.team!=null&&p.team===ctx.self.team)&&dist(p,ctx.self)<230).sort((a,b)=>dist(a,ctx.self)-dist(b,ctx.self)).slice(0,8);
        if(!enemies.length){cached=[];stamp='';return cached;}
        const sandbox=amSandbox(ctx,root);
        for(const [sid,time] of hammerHits)if(now()-time>220+Math.min(350,ctx.net?.ping||0))hammerHits.delete(sid);
        const key=[revision,Math.round(me.x/4),Math.round(me.y/4),ctx.self.hat,ctx.self.accessory,root.MooMooCombatDefense?.status().target,ctx.self.weaponVariant,hammerHits.has(ctx.self.sid),...enemies.flatMap(e=>[e.sid,Math.round(pos(e).x/4),Math.round(pos(e).y/4),e.buildIndex,e.weaponIndex,hammerHits.has(e.sid)])].join(':');
        if(key===stamp&&now()-at<111)return cached;stamp=key;at=now();cached=[];
        const future=threat.predict(ctx.self,111),positions=[me];if(future?.fresh)positions.push(future);
        const breaker=root.MooMooCombatDefense?.status(),ownHammer=ctx.self.weapons?.includes(10)&&ctx.data.weapon(10);
        const ownVariant=ctx.self.weaponIndex===10?ctx.self.weaponVariant:threat.observedWeapons?.(ctx.self.sid)?.find(w=>w.id===10)?.variant;
        const ownDamage=ownHammer?ownHammer.dmg*(ownHammer.sDmg||1)*(ctx.combat.variantVal?.(ownVariant||0)??1)*(ctx.data.hat(40)?.bDmg||1):0;
        const ownCanBreak=o=>ownHammer&&breaker?.target===o.sid&&breaker.weapon===10&&o.trap&&
            (o.health>0||o.health===0&&hammerHits.has(ctx.self.sid))&&o.health<=ownDamage&&
            dist(me,o)<=ownHammer.range+o.scale&&dist(me,o)<=(ctx.self.scale||35)+(o.getScale?.()??o.scale);
        for(const enemy of enemies){
            const known=Array.isArray(enemy.items)&&enemy.items.length?enemy.items.map(id=>ctx.data.item(id)).filter(i=>i?.group?.name==='spikes'):null;
            const held=ctx.data.item(enemy.buildIndex),holdingSpike=held?.group?.name==='spikes';
            if(known&&!known.length&&!holdingSpike)continue;
            const owned=root.AntimoocheatWorld.ownedSpikes(enemy.sid);
            const item=holdingSpike?held:known?.sort((a,b)=>b.dmg-a.dmg)[0]||owned.map(o=>ctx.data.item(o.id)).sort((a,b)=>b.dmg-a.dmg)[0]||ctx.data.item(6);
            if(!item||!sandbox&&owned.length>=item.group.limit)continue;
            const origin=pos(enemy),r=(enemy.scale||35)+item.scale+(item.placeOffset||0),contact=(ctx.self.scale||35)+item.scale;
            const blockers=placementNeighbours(origin,r+item.scale).filter(o=>dist(origin,o)<r+item.scale+(o.blocker||(o.getScale?.(.6,o.isItem)??o.scale)));
            let point=null,replaced=null;
            const seenHammer=enemy.weaponIndex===10||threat.observedWeapons?.(enemy.sid)?.some(w=>w.id===10);
            const hammer=seenHammer&&ctx.data.weapon(10),cooldown=hammer&&threat.reload?.(enemy.sid,10);
            const variant=hammer&&threat.observedWeapons?.(enemy.sid)?.find(w=>w.id===10)?.variant;
            const hammerDamage=hammer?hammer.dmg*(hammer.sDmg||1)*(ctx.combat.variantVal?.(variant||0)??1)*(ctx.data.hat(40)?.bDmg||1):0;
            const canBreak=o=>hammer&&o.trap&&(o.health>0||o.health===0&&hammerHits.has(enemy.sid))&&o.health<=hammerDamage&&dist(origin,o)<=hammer.range+o.scale&&
                dist(origin,me)<=hammer.range+(ctx.self.scale||35)*1.8&&dist(me,o)<=(ctx.self.scale||35)+(o.getScale?.()??o.scale)&&
                (!cooldown||cooldown.remaining<=111||hammerHits.has(enemy.sid));
            const collision=blockers.map(o=>{const b=item.scale+(o.blocker||(o.getScale?.(.6,o.isItem)??o.scale));return {o,b2:b*b,replaceable:ownCanBreak(o)||canBreak(o)};});
            for(const target of positions){
                const d=dist(origin,target);if(d>r+contact||d+contact<r)continue;
                const center=Math.atan2(target.y-origin.y,target.x-origin.x),half=d<1e-6?Math.PI:Math.acos(Math.max(-1,Math.min(1,(r*r+d*d-contact*contact)/(2*r*d))));
                const angles=[center];for(let j=1;j<=6;j++)angles.push(center-half*j/6,center+half*j/6);
                for(const {o,b2} of collision){const od=dist(origin,o);if(!od)continue;const c=(r*r+od*od-b2)/(2*r*od);if(c<=-1||c>=1)continue;const a=Math.atan2(o.y-origin.y,o.x-origin.x),b=Math.acos(c);angles.push(a-b-.0001,a+b+.0001);}
                for(const angle of angles){
                    const p={x:origin.x+r*Math.cos(angle),y:origin.y+r*Math.sin(angle),angle};
                    if(dist(p,target)>contact||p.x<0||p.x>14400||p.y<0||p.y>14400||!sandbox&&Math.abs(p.y-7200)<=362)continue;
                    let unavailable=false,fragile=null;
                    for(const {o,b2,replaceable} of collision){
                        const dx=p.x-o.x,dy=p.y-o.y;if(dx*dx+dy*dy>=b2)continue;
                        if(!replaceable||fragile!=null){unavailable=true;break;}
                        fragile=o.sid;
                    }
                    if(unavailable)continue;
                    if(fragile==null){point=p;replaced=null;break;}
                    if(!point){point=p;replaced=fragile;}
                }
                if(point)break;
            }
            if(point){const amount=item.dmg*(ctx.data.hat(ctx.self.hat)?.dmgMult??1)*(ctx.data.accessory(ctx.self.accessory)?.dmgMult??1);
                cached.push({enemy:enemy.sid,item:item.id,damage:amount,replacingSid:replaced,...point,estimated:true,inventoryKnown:!!known?.length,resourcesKnown:false});}
        }
        return cached;
    };
}

// The SDK ready flag survives a physical socket close; the native menu does not.
const amSessionStates=new WeakMap();
function amSessionState(api,root){
    let state=amSessionStates.get(api);if(state)return state;
    state={packet:root.performance.now(),checked:-Infinity,visible:false,disconnected:false};amSessionStates.set(api,state);
    const received=()=>{state.packet=root.performance.now();};
    api.on('playersUpdate',received);
    api.on('gatherAnimation',p=>{if(p.args?.[0]===api.self.sid)received();});
    for(const event of ['inventory','itemCount','playerValue','storeUpdate'])api.on(event,received);
    api.on('disconnect',()=>{state.disconnected=true;});
    api.on('reset',()=>{state.disconnected=true;});
    api.on('setup',()=>{state.disconnected=false;state.packet=root.performance.now();state.checked=-Infinity;});
    return state;
}
function amSwingDue(ctx,root,weapon){
    const remaining=root.MooMooAutoReload?.remaining(weapon)||0;
    return remaining<=(ctx.net.ping||0)+2*(ctx.SERVER_TICK||1000/9);
}

function amGameLive(api,root){
    if(!api.isReady()||!api.self.alive)return false;
    const state=amSessionState(api,root),time=root.performance.now();
    if(state.disconnected)return false;
    if(time-state.checked>50){const menu=root.document.getElementById('mainMenu');state.visible=!!menu&&!menu.hidden&&root.getComputedStyle(menu).display!=='none';state.checked=time;}
    return !state.visible;
}
function createAmLiveClock(api,root){
    if(root.AntimoocheatLiveClock)return root.AntimoocheatLiveClock;
    const now=()=>root.performance.now(),tasks=new Map();
    let nextId=0,alarm=null,alarmAt=Infinity,draining=false,disposed=false;
    const stats={executed:0,cancelled:0,lateMaxMs:0,lateTotalMs:0};
    function arm(at){
        if(disposed||draining||at===alarmAt)return;
        if(alarm!==null)root.clearTimeout(alarm);
        alarm=null;alarmAt=at;
        if(Number.isFinite(at))alarm=root.setTimeout(()=>{alarm=null;alarmAt=Infinity;drain();},Math.max(0,Math.ceil(at-now())));
    }
    function nextDue(){
        let first=Infinity;
        for(const task of tasks.values())first=Math.min(first,task.at);
        return first;
    }
    function drain(){
        if(disposed||draining)return;
        draining=true;
        try{
            const cutoff=now(),due=[];
            for(const task of tasks.values())if(task.at<=cutoff)due.push(task);
            due.sort((a,b)=>a.at-b.at||a.id-b.id);
            for(const task of due.slice(0,64)){
                if(!tasks.delete(task.id))continue;
                const late=now()-task.at;stats.executed++;
                stats.lateTotalMs+=late;stats.lateMaxMs=Math.max(stats.lateMaxMs,late);
                try{task.fn(...task.args);}catch(error){
                    if(root.reportError)root.reportError(error);else root.console.error(error);
                }
            }
        }finally{draining=false;arm(nextDue());}
    }
    function setTimeout(fn,ms=0,...args){
        const id=++nextId;
        if(disposed)return id;
        const at=now()+Math.max(0,Number(ms)||0);
        tasks.set(id,{id,at,fn,args});
        if(at<alarmAt)arm(at);
        return id;
    }
    function clearTimeout(id){
        const task=tasks.get(id);
        if(!task)return;
        tasks.delete(id);stats.cancelled++;
        if(task.at===alarmAt&&!draining)arm(nextDue());
    }
    const wakeEvents=new Set(['playersUpdate','health','gatherAnimation','objectsLoad','objectKilled','projectileAdd','inventory','storeUpdate']);
    let queued=false;
    const off=api.on('*',event=>{
        if(disposed||queued||now()<alarmAt||!wakeEvents.has(event))return;
        queued=true;root.queueMicrotask(()=>{queued=false;drain();});
    });
    const clock={setTimeout,clearTimeout,status:()=>({pending:tasks.size,...stats}),
        dispose(){disposed=true;off();if(alarm!==null)root.clearTimeout(alarm);alarm=null;alarmAt=Infinity;tasks.clear();
            if(root.AntimoocheatLiveClock===clock)delete root.AntimoocheatLiveClock;}};
    root.AntimoocheatLiveClock=clock;return clock;
}

function createSwingJournal(now){
    let serial=0;const recent=[],counts={sent:0,confirmed:0,unconfirmed:0,cancelled:0,ambiguous:0};
    function send(active,waiting){
        const record={id:++serial,module:active.def.id,phase:active.phase,weapon:waiting.weapon,
            target:active.targetSid,sentAt:waiting.sentAt,status:'sent',evidence:null};
        waiting.receiptRecord=record;recent.push(record);if(recent.length>64)recent.shift();counts.sent++;
    }
    function finish(waiting,status,evidence){
        const record=waiting?.receiptRecord;if(!record||record.status!=='sent')return;
        record.status=status;record.evidence=evidence;record.elapsedMs=now()-record.sentAt;counts[status]++;
    }
    return {send,finish,ambiguous(){counts.ambiguous++;},status:()=>({counts:{...counts},recent:recent.map(r=>({...r}))})};
}

function installConnectionLog(api,root,stage,ctx){
    const key='antimoocheat.connection.v1',now=()=>root.performance.now(),capacity=480,ring=new Array(capacity),buckets=[];
    let start=Date.now(),origin=now();
    const fields={mouse:['down','dir'],aim:['dir'],selectItem:['index','isWeapon'],store:['action','id','isAccessory'],toggle:['which'],move:['dir'],stopMove:[],leaveTribe:[]};
    let cursor=0,size=0,total=0,lastInbound=null,disconnect=null,lastState=null,stateAt=-Infinity;
    const awaitingEquip=[null,null];
    let chatSends=0,chatEchoes=0,lastChatSendMs=null,lastChatEchoMs=null;
    function state(){
        const self=api.self,b=root.MooMooCombatDefense?.status(),c=root.AntimoocheatCombat?.status(),p=root.AntimoocheatBasePlacement?.status(),a=root.MooMooAutomation?.status();
        return {alive:!!self?.alive,health:self?.health,weapon:self?.weaponIndex,hat:self?.hat,combatHat:self?.skinIndex,equipment:root.AntimoocheatEquipment?.status(),
            autobreak:b&&{target:b.target,weapon:b.weapon,reason:b.reason},
            instakill:a&&{armed:a.insta,wait:a.insta?a.instaWait:null},
            movement:a&&{oneTickEnabled:a.oneTick,autoPushEnabled:a.autoPush,ownsPush:a.ownsMovement,reason:a.reason,active:root.MooMooCombatMacros?.status().active},
            combat:c&&{active:!!c.active,auto:!!c.auto,reason:c.reason,phase:c.phase},placement:p&&{last:p.last,pending:p.pending,sent:p.sent},
            healing:root.AntimoocheatDefense?.status().healingDiagnostics,clicks:root.MooMooBaseClicks?.status(),
            itemGate:{placing:!!root.AntimoocheatPlacementHost?.placing(),healPriority:!!root.AntimoocheatDefense?.needsHeal(),live:amGameLive(api,root),food:self?.food,buildIndex:self?.buildIndex,weapons:self?.weapons},
            budgets:stage.net&&{selection:stage.net.tokens('z'),attack:stage.net.tokens('F'),equipment:stage.net.tokens('c'),perSecond:stage.net.perSecond(),refused:stage.net.stats.refused}};
    }
    function observeState(){if(!disconnect&&now()-stateAt>=250){lastState=state();stateAt=now();}}
    const offSent=api.onSent((action,payload,source)=>{
        if(action==='chat'){chatSends++;lastChatSendMs=Math.round(now()-origin);}
        total++;observeState();const second=Math.floor((now()-origin)/1000);
        if(buckets.at(-1)?.second!==second)buckets.push({second,total:0,mouse:0,selection:0,hats:0,accessories:0,purchases:0});
        while(buckets.length&&second-buckets[0].second>=30)buckets.shift();
        const bucket=buckets.at(-1);bucket.total++;if(action==='mouse')bucket.mouse++;if(action==='selectItem')bucket.selection++;if(action==='store'){
            if(payload.action===1 && !payload.isAccessory)bucket.hats++;
            else if(payload.action===1)bucket.accessories++;
            else if(payload.action===0)bucket.purchases++;
        }
        if(!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(fields,action))return;
        const safe={};for(const field of fields[action]){const value=payload[field];if(typeof value==='boolean'||typeof value==='number'&&Number.isFinite(value))safe[field]=value;}
        ring[cursor]={ms:Math.round(now()-origin),action,payload:safe,source:source==='client'?'client':'mod'};
        if(action==='store'&&payload.action===1){
            ring[cursor].owner=root.AntimoocheatEquipment?.sendingOwner?.()??(source==='client'?'client':'unknown');
            ring[cursor].ownedAtSend=root.AntimoocheatEquipment?.owned(payload.id,!!payload.isAccessory)??null;
            ring[cursor].confirmation=null;awaitingEquip[Number(!!payload.isAccessory)]=ring[cursor];
        }
        cursor=(cursor+1)%capacity;size=Math.min(capacity,size+1);
    });
    function snapshot(cause){
        const active=stage.active?.();
        return {version:'2.4.2',startedAt:new Date(start).toISOString(),savedAt:new Date().toISOString(),cause,
            host:root.location.hostname,elapsedMs:Math.round(now()-origin),totalSent:total,
            lastInboundAgeMs:lastInbound==null?null:Math.round(now()-lastInbound),serverDisconnect:disconnect,
            loader:active&&{ready:!!active.ready,failed:!!active.failed,buildId:active.buildId},
            chat:{sent:chatSends,selfEchoes:chatEchoes,lastChatSendMs,lastChatEchoMs},
            ping:stage.net?.ping,state:disconnect?lastState:state(),lastObservedState:lastState,
            seconds:buckets.map(b=>({...b})),actions:Array.from({length:size},(_,i)=>ring[(cursor-size+i+capacity)%capacity]),
            limits:'Observes SDK actions and server disconnect messages; does not observe native WebSocket close codes or infer a ban.'};
    }
    function persist(cause){if(!total&&!disconnect)return;try{root.localStorage.setItem(key,JSON.stringify(snapshot(cause)));}catch(_){}}
    function serverDisconnected(reason){
        if(disconnect)return;lastState=state();stateAt=now();disconnect={ms:Math.round(now()-origin),reason:typeof reason==='string'?reason.slice(0,300):typeof reason==='number'?reason:null};persist('server-disconnect');
    }
    const offRaw=stage.onRaw?.((direction,name,args)=>{if(direction!=='in')return;lastInbound=now();if(name==='B')serverDisconnected(args?.[0]);});
    const offDisconnect=api.on('disconnect',p=>serverDisconnected(p?.reason));
    const offReset=api.on('reset',()=>{persist('connection-reset');start=Date.now();origin=now();cursor=size=total=0;ring.fill(null);awaitingEquip.fill(null);buckets.length=0;chatSends=chatEchoes=0;lastChatSendMs=lastChatEchoMs=null;lastInbound=disconnect=lastState=null;stateAt=-Infinity;});
    const offChat=api.on('chat',p=>{if(p.sid===api.self.sid){chatEchoes++; lastChatEchoMs=Math.round(now()-origin);}});
    function confirmEquip(id,slot,source){
        const request=awaitingEquip[slot];
        if(!request||request.payload.id!==id||disconnect)return;
        request.confirmation={source,delayMs:Math.max(0,Math.round(now()-origin)-request.ms)};awaitingEquip[slot]=null;
    }
    const offEquip=api.on('storeUpdate',p=>{if(p.args?.[0]===1)confirmEquip(p.args[1],Number(!!p.args[2]),'store');});
    const offUpdate=api.on('playersUpdate',p=>{
        if(awaitingEquip[0]||awaitingEquip[1]){
            const self=p?.attributes?.find(a=>a.sid===api.self.sid);
            if(self){confirmEquip(self.skin,0,'player');confirmEquip(self.tail,1,'player');}
        }
        observeState();
    }),pagehide=()=>persist('pagehide');
    function report(){let previous=null;try{previous=JSON.parse(root.localStorage.getItem(key)||'null');}catch(_){}const threats=root.MooMooThreats,seen=new Set((threats?.snapshot()?.targets||[]).map(t=>t.sid));
        const current=root.AntimoocheatVisuals?.observedApi.players??api.players;
        const targets=[...current.values()].filter(p=>p.sid!==api.self.sid).map(p=>({
            sid:p.sid,visible:p.visible,health:p.health,team:p.team,friendly:ctx.objects.isFriendly(p.sid),
            botPeer:!!root.AntimoocheatBots?.isPeer(p.sid),distance:threats?.distance(api.self,p),included:seen.has(p.sid)
        }));
        return {current:snapshot('manual-export'),previous,targets,selfTeam:api.self.team,
            ownsSoldier:ctx.store.ownsHat(6),swing:root.MooMooCombatMacros?.swingDiagnostics?.(),clock:root.AntimoocheatLiveClock?.status()};}
    function download(){
        const url=root.URL.createObjectURL(new root.Blob([JSON.stringify(report(),null,2)],{type:'application/json'}));
        const a=root.document.createElement('a');a.href=url;a.download='antimoocheat-connection-'+Date.now()+'.json';a.click();
        root.setTimeout(()=>root.URL.revokeObjectURL(url),1000);
    }
    const service={report,download};root.AntimoocheatConnectionLog=service;root.addEventListener('pagehide',pagehide);
    ctx.onCleanup(()=>{persist('cleanup');offSent();offRaw?.();offDisconnect?.();offUpdate?.();offEquip?.();offChat?.();offReset?.();root.removeEventListener('pagehide',pagehide);if(root.AntimoocheatConnectionLog===service)delete root.AntimoocheatConnectionLog;});
    return service;
}

function installEquipmentFlow(api,root,net=root.MooMooLoader?.net,store=api.store,sessionLive=()=>true,weaponData=()=>null){
    if(root.AntimoocheatEquipment)return root.AntimoocheatEquipment;
    const now=()=>root.performance.now(),pending=new Map(),attempts=[new Map(),new Map()];
    const recent=[[],[]],lastSent=[-Infinity,-Infinity];
    let visualClown=api.self.hat===45,confirmedHat=Number.isInteger(api.self.hat)&&api.self.hat!==45?api.self.hat:null;
    const clowned=()=>visualClown||api.self.hat===45;
    let confirmedTail = api.self.accessory ?? null;
    const current=(tail=false)=>tail?(confirmedTail ?? api.self.accessory):(confirmedHat ?? (clowned()?null:api.self.hat));
    // Keep the network/rendered skin untouched. Only module calculations use
    // the last server-confirmed equipment while Shame masks its appearance.
    const selfView = new Proxy(api.self, {get(player, key) {
        if (key === 'hat' || key === 'skin' || key === 'skinIndex') return current() ?? player[key];
        if (key === 'accessory' || key === 'tailIndex') return current(true) ?? player[key];
        return Reflect.get(player, key);
    }});
    const owned=(id,tail=false)=>id===0||(tail?store?.ownsTail?.(id):store?.ownsHat?.(id))===true;
    // A local pacing policy, not a claim about a public server's threshold.
    const minimumHatInterval = amHatPacing.min;
    const maximumHatInterval = amHatPacing.max;
    let hatInterval = minimumHatInterval;
    let nextHatInterval = minimumHatInterval;
    const interval = (tail = false) => tail ? Math.max(300, Math.min(600, 2 * (net?.ping || 0))) : hatInterval;
    const timeout=()=>Math.max(500,2*(net?.ping||0)+250);
    let suppressed=0,deferred=0,blocked=0,lastHatAt=-Infinity,manualUntil=0;
    let suspended=!api.self.alive,requestOwner=null,lastDecision=null;
    const manualRequests = new Map();
    let manualTailUntil = 0, tankSwing = null, tankTimer = null;
    const live=()=>!suspended&&api.isReady()&&api.self.alive&&api.self.health>0&&sessionLive();
    const idleDelay=()=>interval(false);
    const manualActive=(tail=false)=>manualRequests.has(tail)||now()<(tail?manualTailUntil:manualUntil);
    const idleAllowed=()=>live()&&!pending.has(false)&&!manualActive()&&now()-lastHatAt>=idleDelay()&&
        !root.MooMooBaseClicks?.status().recovering&&!root.MooMooCombatMacros?.status().recovering&&
        !root.MooMooCombatDefense?.status().soldierPending;
    const settled=(id,tail=false)=>live()&&current(tail)===id&&!pending.has(!!tail);
    function urgent(combat=!!root.MooMooCombatMacros?.status().active){
        if(root.MooMooCombatMacros?.finishingInsta?.())return false;
        if(root.AntimoocheatDefense?.antiOneTickThreat?.()||root.AntimoocheatDefense?.antiBowThreat?.())return true;
        if(root.MooMooThreats?.committedSpikePath().active||root.MooMooThreats?.lethalSpikeCombo().active)return true;
        if(!combat&&root.MooMooCombatDefense?.trapCycleActive?.()){
            const value=root.MooMooThreats.snapshot();
            return !!root.AntimoocheatDefense?.forcedArmor?.(value,false)||(value.incoming||[]).reduce((sum,shot)=>sum+shot.damage,0)>=api.self.health;
        }
        if(combat&&(['instakill','oneTick'].includes(root.MooMooCombatMacros?.status().active)||root.MooMooAutomation?.status().insta))return false;
        const threat=root.MooMooThreats,raw=threat?.snapshot(),value=combat?amAttackThreat(raw):raw,risk=threat?.breakingPressure(value);
        const hp=api.self.health;
        return !!(root.AntimoocheatDefense?.forcedArmor?.(value,combat)||root.MooMooDefenses?.protectingBow?.()||risk?.oneTick||risk?.airStack||
            hp>0&&risk?.incomingDamage>=hp||!combat&&(value?.damage>100||hp>0&&value?.damage>=hp)||risk?.knockbackDanger&&risk?.unarmoredDamage>=hp);
    }
    function clearTankSwing() {
        if (tankTimer !== null) root.clearTimeout(tankTimer);
        tankTimer = null;
        tankSwing = null;
    }
    function recoverTankSwing() {
        if (tankTimer !== null) root.clearTimeout(tankTimer);
        tankTimer = null;
        if (!tankSwing) return;
        if(root.MooMooCombatDefense?.controlsTrapGear?.()||root.MooMooCombatDefense?.keepTank?.()){clearTankSwing();return;}
        if (!live() || !owned(6) || now() >= tankSwing.expires || root.MooMooCombatMacros?.status()?.active || root.MooMooBaseClicks?.heldHat?.()!=null) { clearTankSwing(); return; }
        if (settled(6)) return;
        bridge.request(api.send.store,6,false,'tank-hit-return');
        if (tankSwing && !settled(6))
            tankTimer = root.setTimeout(recoverTankSwing, Math.max(1, Math.ceil(waitMs(6))));
    }
    api.on('gatherAnimation',p=>{
        const [sid,,weapon] = p.args || [];
        if (sid !== api.self.sid || current() !== 40 || !owned(6) || !live() || root.MooMooCombatMacros?.status()?.active) return;
        const clicks = root.MooMooBaseClicks?.status(), breaker = root.MooMooCombatDefense?.status();
        if(root.MooMooCombatDefense?.controlsTrapGear?.()||root.MooMooCombatDefense?.keepTank?.()){clearTankSwing();return;}
        if(root.MooMooBaseClicks?.heldHat?.()!=null){clearTankSwing();return;}
        if (!clicks?.active && !clicks?.recovering && breaker?.target == null && breaker?.trap == null && !root.AntimoocheatDefense?.status()?.breaking) return;
        const speed = weaponData(weapon)?.speed || 0;
        const time=now(),lead=(net?.ping||0)+1000/9;
        const soldierWait=Math.max(0,lastSent[0]+interval()-time);
        const enemyNear=root.MooMooThreats?.snapshot()?.targets?.some(t=>t.distance<=350);
        if(!breaker?.trap&&!enemyNear&&!urgent()&&(breaker?.target!=null||clicks?.active&&speed<soldierWait+maximumHatInterval+(net?.ping||0))){
            clearTankSwing();
            return;
        }
        tankSwing = {rearmAt:time+Math.max(0,speed-lead),expires:time+Math.max(2000,speed+timeout()*2)};
        if(enemyNear&&clicks?.active&&!breaker?.holdingAttack)root.MooMooBaseClicks.pauseTankSwing(weapon);
        recoverTankSwing();
    });
    function waitMs(id,tail=false,owner=requestOwner){
        const slot=Number(tail),time=now(),queued=pending.get(tail),prior=attempts[slot].get(id);
        const reason=decide(id,tail,owner);
        if(!['switch-interval','awaiting-confirmation','already-pending','retry-wait'].includes(reason))return 1000/9;
        return Math.max(1,lastSent[slot]+interval(tail)-time,
            queued?queued.at+timeout()-time:0,prior?prior.retryAt-time:0);
    }
    function decide(id,tail,owner=requestOwner){
        if(!Number.isInteger(id)||id<0)return 'invalid-equipment';
        if(!live())return 'inactive';
        if(!owned(id,tail))return 'unowned-equipment';
        const finishing=root.MooMooCombatMacros?.finishingInsta?.();
        if(finishing&&!tail&&owner!=='combat-macros')return 'combat-priority';
        const bowDefense=!finishing&&owned(tail?15:6,tail)&&root.AntimoocheatDefense?.antiBowThreat?.();
        if(bowDefense&&id!==(tail?15:6))return 'anti-bow';
        const oneTickDefense=!tail&&owned(6)&&root.AntimoocheatDefense?.antiOneTickThreat?.();
        if(!tail&&!oneTickDefense&&!bowDefense&&root.MooMooCombatMacros?.status().active&&['hat-macro','manual-client','manual','combat-input','client'].includes(owner))return 'combat-priority';
        const time=now(),slot=Number(tail),queued=pending.get(tail),prior=attempts[slot].get(id);
        const spikePath=!tail&&owned(6)&&root.MooMooThreats?.committedSpikePath().active;
        const lethal=!finishing&&!tail&&owned(6)&&(oneTickDefense||bowDefense||spikePath||root.MooMooThreats?.lethalSpikeCombo().active);
        if(lethal&&id!==6)return oneTickDefense?'anti-one-tick':spikePath?'committed-spike-path':'lethal-spike-combo';
        const held=tail||lethal||finishing?null:root.MooMooBaseClicks?.heldHat?.();
        const animal=root.MooMooCombatMacros?.animalStealing();
        if(animal&&!lethal&&!bowDefense&&owner!=='combat-macros')return 'combat-priority';
        if(!animal&&held!=null&&id!==held)return 'held-click';
        if(held!=null&&tankSwing)clearTankSwing();
        if(!queued&&current(tail)===id)return 'already-equipped';
        if(!tail && id===40 && tankSwing && time<tankSwing.expires && owner!=='combat-macros' &&
           (!tankSwing.sent || time<tankSwing.rearmAt)) return 'tank-reload';
        if(queued?.id===id&&time-queued.at<timeout())return 'already-pending';
        if(!tail&&clowned()&&prior)return 'masked-unconfirmed';
        if(prior?.count>=2)return 'unconfirmed-equipment';
        if(prior&&time<prior.retryAt)return 'retry-wait';
        if(time-lastSent[slot]<interval(tail))return 'switch-interval';
        const insta=['instakill','oneTick'].includes(root.MooMooCombatMacros?.status().active);
        if(!tail&&!lethal&&insta&&['base-biome','utility-automation','defense','combat-recovery','defensive-combat'].includes(owner))return 'combat-priority';
        const emergency=owned(6)&&urgent(),defensive=!tail&&id===6&&emergency;
        if (!animal && !tail && id !== 6 && held!==id && emergency) return 'defense-priority';
        if (!tail && manualActive() && !defensive && ['base-biome','utility-automation','defense','combat-recovery'].includes(owner))
            return 'manual-priority';
        // A new ordinary request must not replace an unconfirmed request in the
        // same slot. Even an emergency waits for confirmation or timeout.
        if(queued&&queued.id!==id&&time-queued.at<timeout())return 'awaiting-confirmation';
        return 'send';
    }
    function note(reason,id,tail,owner){
        if(reason==='already-equipped'||reason==='already-pending')suppressed++;
        else if(['inactive','invalid-equipment','unowned-equipment'].includes(reason))blocked++;
        else if(reason!=='send')deferred++;
        lastDecision={reason,id,isAccessory:tail,owner,at:now()};
    }
    function clearManualRequest(tail) {
        const job = manualRequests.get(tail);
        if (job) root.clearTimeout(job.timer);
        manualRequests.delete(tail);
    }
    function requestManual(send,id,tail=false,owner='manual',defer=false) {
        tail = !!tail;
        if (!live() || !Number.isInteger(id) || id < 0 || !owned(id,tail)) return false;
        if (!tail) { clearTankSwing(); manualUntil = now()+interval(); } else manualTailUntil = now()+1000;
        if (manualRequests.get(tail)?.id === id) return true;
        clearManualRequest(tail);
        const job = {id,owner,until:now()+Math.max(1500,2*timeout()),timer:null};
        manualRequests.set(tail,job);
        function flush() {
            if (manualRequests.get(tail) !== job) return;
            if(!tail&&root.MooMooCombatMacros?.status().active)job.until=Math.max(job.until,now()+500);
            if (!live() || !owned(id,tail) || now()>=job.until) { clearManualRequest(tail); return; }
            if (bridge.request(send,id,tail,owner)) {
                if (manualRequests.get(tail) === job) clearManualRequest(tail);
                if (!tail) manualUntil = now()+interval();
                return;
            }
            const remaining = lastSent[Number(tail)]+interval(tail)-now();
            const delay = lastDecision?.reason==='switch-interval' && remaining>0 ? Math.ceil(remaining) : 50;
            if (manualRequests.get(tail) === job) job.timer=root.setTimeout(flush,delay);
        }
        if (defer) job.timer=root.setTimeout(flush,0); else flush();
        return true;
    }
    api.onOutgoing('store',(p,info)=>{
        if(p.action!==1)return p;
        const tail=!!p.isAccessory;
        if(info?.source==='client'){clearManualRequest(tail);if(!tail)clearTankSwing();}
        const reason=decide(p.id,tail,requestOwner||info?.source);
        note(reason,p.id,tail,requestOwner||info?.source||'base');
        if(info?.source==='client'&&['awaiting-confirmation','retry-wait','switch-interval','defense-priority','combat-priority'].includes(reason))
            requestManual((...args)=>api.send.store(...args),p.id,tail,'manual-client',true);
        return reason==='send'?p:null;
    });
    api.onSent((action,p,source)=>{
        if(action!=='store'||p.action!==1)return;
        const tail=!!p.isAccessory,slot=Number(tail),time=now(),history=attempts[slot];
        lastSent[slot]=time;
        if(!tail){
            hatInterval = nextHatInterval;
            nextHatInterval = hatInterval===minimumHatInterval?maximumHatInterval:minimumHatInterval;
            if(tankSwing){if(p.id===6)tankSwing.sent=true;else clearTankSwing();}
            lastHatAt=time;if(source==='client')manualUntil=time+interval();
        }
        if(tail&&source==='client')manualTailUntil=time+1000;
        const prior=history.get(p.id),count=(prior?.count||0)+1;
        const retryAt=time+(count<2?timeout():Math.max(5000,timeout()));
        history.set(p.id,{count,retryAt});
        const owner=requestOwner||source||'base';
        pending.set(tail,{id:p.id,at:time,attempts:count,retryAt,owner});
        recent[slot].push({id:p.id,at:time,owner});
        if(recent[slot].length>12)recent[slot].shift();
    });
    function acknowledge(id,tail){
        if(!live()||!Number.isInteger(id))return;
        if(pending.get(tail)?.id===id)pending.delete(tail);
        // Only the latest request's confirmation settles this slot. A stale
        // observation of an older hat must not reopen its retry budget.
        attempts[Number(tail)].delete(id);
    }
    api.on('storeUpdate',p=>{
        const id=p.args?.[1],tail=!!p.args?.[2];
        // A fresh server ownership receipt permits a new attempt. Changing
        // some other hat must not reset a rejected item's retry history.
        if(p.args?.[0]===0&&Number.isInteger(id))attempts[Number(tail)].delete(id);
        if(p.args?.[0]!==1)return;
        if(!live() || !Number.isInteger(id))return;
        if(tail)confirmedTail=id;else if(id!==45)confirmedHat=id;
        acknowledge(id,tail);
        if(!tail&&tankSwing&&!tankSwing.sent)recoverTankSwing();
    });
    api.on('playersUpdate',p=>{
        const self=p.attributes?.find(a=>a.sid===api.self.sid);if(!self)return;
        if(self.skin===45)visualClown=true;
        else if(Number.isInteger(self.skin)){
            if(visualClown)attempts[0].clear();
            visualClown=false;confirmedHat=self.skin;acknowledge(self.skin,false);
        }
        if(Number.isInteger(self.tail))confirmedTail=self.tail;
        acknowledge(self.tail,true);
        if(tankSwing&&!settled(6))recoverTankSwing();
    });
    function reset(active=false){
        suspended=!active;visualClown=false;confirmedHat=active&&api.self.hat!==45?api.self.hat:null;pending.clear();for(const history of attempts)history.clear();
        confirmedTail=active?api.self.accessory:null;
        clearManualRequest(false);clearManualRequest(true);clearTankSwing();manualTailUntil=0;
        for(const trail of recent)trail.length=0;
        lastHatAt=-Infinity;nextHatInterval=minimumHatInterval;manualUntil=0;requestOwner=null;lastDecision=null;
    }
    for(const event of ['setup','reset','died','disconnect'])api.on(event,()=>reset());
    api.on('playerAdd',p=>{if(p.isYou)reset(true);});
    const bridge={current,settled,clowned,selfView,idleAllowed,manualActive,requestManual,owned,waitMs,
        preferManual:()=>{if(live())manualUntil=now()+interval();},releaseManual:(preserveQueued=false)=>{manualUntil=0;if(!preserveQueued)clearManualRequest(false);},sendingOwner:()=>requestOwner,pending:tail=>pending.get(!!tail),
        request(send,id,tail=false,owner='equipment'){
            tail=!!tail;
            const reason=decide(id,tail,owner);
            if(reason!=='send'){
                note(reason,id,tail,owner);
                return reason==='already-equipped'||reason==='already-pending';
            }
            if (net?.wouldAllow?.('c') === false || net?.perSecond?.() >= 120) {
                note('traffic-busy',id,tail,owner);return false;
            }
            const previous=requestOwner;requestOwner=owner;
            try{return send(1,id,tail)===true;}finally{requestOwner=previous;}
        },
        urgent,returningTankHit:()=>!!tankSwing&&now()<tankSwing.expires,returnDelay:0,hatWait:()=>Math.max(0,lastSent[0]+interval()-now()),
        status:()=>({observedHat:current(),visualHat:api.self.hat,clowned:clowned(),confirmedHat,observedAccessory:current(true),pendingHat:pending.get(false)||null,pendingAccessory:pending.get(true)||null,
            suppressed,deferred,blocked,live:live(),idleReady:idleAllowed(),manualRemaining:Math.max(0,manualUntil-now()),manualPending:Array.from(manualRequests,([isAccessory,j])=>({id:j.id,isAccessory,owner:j.owner}))[0]??null,lastDecision,
            minimumInterval:interval(),hatWait:Math.max(0,lastSent[0]+interval()-now()),accessoryWait:Math.max(0,lastSent[1]+interval(true)-now()),
            recentHats:recent[0].map(p=>({...p})),recentAccessories:recent[1].map(p=>({...p})),unconfirmed:attempts.flatMap((history,slot)=>[...history].filter(([,p])=>p.count>=2).map(([id])=>({id,isAccessory:!!slot})))})
    };
    root.AntimoocheatEquipment=bridge;return bridge;
}

// Health packets carry no attacker ID. Match observed projectiles by path, time and
// armored damage; an observed primary swing takes precedence over that estimate.


// Health packets carry no attacker ID. Match observed projectiles by path, time and
// armored damage; an observed primary swing takes precedence over that estimate.
function createHealWoundTracker(now,windowMs,onProjectileReclassified){
    const shots=new Map(),swings=new Map();let wound=null,serial=0;
    const tolerance=()=>Math.max(100,Math.min(400,windowMs()));
    function prune(){
        const time=now(),window=tolerance();
        for(const [id,s]of shots)if(time-s.at>Math.min(3000,s.range/s.speed+window)||s.removedAt!=null&&time-s.removedAt>window)shots.delete(id);
        for(const [id,s]of swings)if(time-s.at>window)swings.delete(id);
    }
    function arrival(shot,self){
        let enter=0,exit=shot.range/shot.speed;const radius=self.scale||35;
        for(const [offset,velocity]of [[self.x-shot.x,Math.cos(shot.dir)*shot.speed],[self.y-shot.y,Math.sin(shot.dir)*shot.speed]]){
            if(Math.abs(velocity)<1e-9){if(Math.abs(offset)>radius)return Infinity;continue;}
            const a=(offset-radius)/velocity,b=(offset+radius)/velocity;
            enter=Math.max(enter,Math.min(a,b));exit=Math.min(exit,Math.max(a,b));
        }
        return enter<=exit?shot.at+enter:Infinity;
    }
    const matches=(s,loss)=>s.damages.some(d=>d>0&&Math.abs(loss-d)<=1.1);
    const primaryPending=()=>wound?.primary===true;
    return {
        reset(){shots.clear();swings.clear();wound=null;},
        projectile(shot){
            if(!(shot.damage>0)||!(shot.speed>0)||!(shot.range>0))return;
            prune();const sid=shot.sid??'projectile'+(++serial);shots.set(sid,{...shot,sid,at:now(),used:false});
            if(shots.size>128)shots.delete(shots.keys().next().value);
        },
        remove(sid){const shot=shots.get(sid);if(shot)shot.removedAt=now();},
        melee(sample){
            prune();const at=Number.isFinite(sample.at)?Math.min(now(),sample.at):now();if(now()-at>tolerance())return;const s={...sample,at,used:false};swings.set(sample.sid,s);
            if(swings.size>32)swings.delete(swings.keys().next().value);
            if(wound&&now()-wound.at<=tolerance()&&matches(s,wound.loss)){
                const projectileSid=wound.projectileSid;
                s.used=true;wound={...wound,kind:'primary',primary:true,bull:!!s.bull,attacker:s.sid,weapon:s.weapon,projectile:null,projectileSid:null,estimated:true};
                if(projectileSid!=null)onProjectileReclassified?.(projectileSid);
            }
        },
        hurt(loss,self,damage){
            prune();const time=now(),primary=false;
            const swing=[...swings.values()].find(s=>!s.used&&matches(s,loss));if(swing)swing.used=true;
            const candidates=[...shots.values()].filter(s=>!s.used&&Math.abs(damage(s)-loss)<=1.1&&Math.abs(time-arrival(s,self))<=tolerance());
            candidates.sort((a,b)=>Math.abs(time-arrival(a,self))-Math.abs(time-arrival(b,self)));
            const shot=!swing&&candidates[0];if(shot)shot.used=true;
            const arrow=shot&&[0,2,3].includes(shot.index);
            wound={kind:swing?'primary':primary?'mixed':arrow?'arrow':shot?'projectile':'unknown',primary:primary||!!swing,loss,at:time,
                bull:!!swing?.bull,attacker:swing?.sid??shot?.owner??null,weapon:swing?.weapon??null,projectile:shot?.index??null,projectileSid:shot?.sid??null,estimated:true};
            return {...wound};
        },
        healed(full){if(full)wound=null;},
        consumed:sid=>shots.get(sid)?.used===true,
        status:()=>wound?{...wound}:null,
        tracked(){prune();return {projectiles:shots.size,swings:swings.size};}
    };
}

function createSplitMeleeHeal(now,windowMs){
    let swing=null,pending=null;
    function reset(){swing=pending=null;}
    function remaining(){
        if(pending&&now()>=pending.until)pending=null;
        return pending;
    }
    return {reset,remaining,
        swing(expected){
            reset();
            if(Number.isFinite(expected)&&expected>10)swing={expected,at:now()};
        },
        hurt(loss,otherSource){
            const half=remaining(),sample=swing;
            reset();
            if(otherSource)return false;
            if(half)return Math.abs(half.missing-loss)<=1.1;
            if(!sample||now()-sample.at>windowMs()||Math.abs(sample.expected/2-loss)>2.6)return false;
            pending={missing:sample.expected-loss,until:now()+125};
            return false;
        }
    };
}

function createReducedHealRecovery(){
    const foods=new Map();let currentItem=null;
    const status=()=>{const s=foods.get(currentItem),evidence=s?.provisional||s?.confirmed;
        return {active:!!evidence,confirmed:!!s?.confirmed,item:currentItem,
            reason:evidence?'reduced-food':s?.reason||'normal',evidence:evidence||null};};
    return {
        reset(){foods.clear();currentItem=null;},
        observe(sample){
            if(sample?.item==null)return status();
            currentItem=sample.item;
            let s=foods.get(currentItem);
            if(!s||s.base!==sample.base){s={base:sample.base,confirmed:null,provisional:null,reason:'normal'};foods.set(currentItem,s);}
            if(s.provisional&&sample.invalidatedBatchId===s.provisional.batchId){
                s.provisional=null;s.reason='observation-withdrawn';
            }
            const eligible=Number.isInteger(sample.sampleId)&&sample.sampleId>0&&
                Number.isFinite(sample.ageMs)&&sample.ageMs<=5000&&sample.base>0&&
                sample.heal>0&&sample.heal<=sample.base&&sample.item!=null;
            if(eligible){
                const evidence={item:sample.item,sampleId:sample.sampleId,batchId:sample.batchId,
                    heal:sample.heal,base:sample.base};
                if(sample.heal<sample.base-.01){
                    if(sample.settled){s.confirmed=evidence;s.provisional=null;}
                    else s.provisional=evidence;
                }else if(sample.heal===sample.base&&sample.settled&&
                    sample.sampleId>Math.max(s.confirmed?.sampleId||0,s.provisional?.sampleId||0)){
                    s.confirmed=s.provisional=null;s.reason='base-restored';
                }
            }
            // Expired/unknown observations and a local Shame zero prove no recovery.
            return status();
        },status
    };
}

function createShameRecovery(now,ackWindow,freeFood){
    let points=0,reported=false,clown=false,lastFood=null,wound=null,woundSource=null,use=null,observedServerCount=null;const clownObservations=[];
    let idleFrom=null,receiptAfterChange=false;
    function decay(){
        if(idleFrom===null)return;
        const steps=Math.floor((now()-idleFrom)/5000);
        if(steps<1)return;
        idleFrom+=steps*5000;
        if(!clown&&points>0){points=Math.max(0,points-steps);reported=false;}
    }
    function reset(){idleFrom=null;receiptAfterChange=false;points=0;reported=clown=false;lastFood=wound=woundSource=use=observedServerCount=null;clownObservations.length=0;}
    function confirm(){
        if(!use||use.gainAt===null||(!use.paid&&!freeFood())||now()-use.at>ackWindow())return;
        decay();
        points=use.gainAt-wound<=120?points+1:use.playerDamage?Math.max(0,points-2):points;
        reported=false;receiptAfterChange=false;use=wound=null;
    }
    function attempt(cost,foodBefore){
        if(clown||wound===null||!(cost>0))return;
        if(lastFood===null&&Number.isFinite(foodBefore))lastFood=foodBefore;
        const time=now();
        if(use&&time-use.at<=ackWindow())return;
        use={at:time,cost,paid:false,gainAt:null};
    }
    function balance(value){
        if(!Number.isFinite(value))return;
        if(use&&lastFood!==null&&lastFood-value>=use.cost)use.paid=true;
        lastFood=value;confirm();
    }
    function serverCount(value){
        if(!Number.isInteger(value)||value<0)return;
        idleFrom??=now();decay();
        if(receiptAfterChange&&observedServerCount?.value===value)return;
        receiptAfterChange=true;points=value;reported=true;observedServerCount={value,at:now()};wound=woundSource=use=null;
    }
    function setClown(value){
        if(clown===value)return;
        if(value){clownObservations.push({at:now(),pointsBefore:points,estimated:!reported});if(clownObservations.length>8)clownObservations.shift();}
        idleFrom=now();receiptAfterChange=false;clown=value;points=0;reported=false;wound=use=null;
    }
    function waitUntil(){
        // Local estimates and reduced food gains do not establish a server cooldown.
        // The healer owns its 120–125ms normal due time and observed equipment gates.
        return 0;
    }
    return {reset,attempt,balance,serverCount,setClown,waitUntil,
        hurt(source=null){decay();receiptAfterChange=false;idleFrom=wound=now();woundSource=source;use=null;},
        gain(source=null){if(use){if(use.gainAt===null){use.gainAt=now();use.playerDamage=!woundSource?.nonPlayer&&!!source&&['primary','arrow','projectile'].includes(source.kind)&&Number.isInteger(source.attacker)&&source.attacker>=0&&source.at>=wound;}confirm();}},
        status(){decay();return {points,estimated:!reported,counterSource:reported?'server-value':'local-receipt-estimate',observedServerCount:observedServerCount&&{...observedServerCount},resetVerified:false,clown,maxKnown:false,clownObservations:clownObservations.map(p=>({...p})),label:(clown?'Clown':reported?String(points):'~'+points)+' ('+(clown||points>=13?'run':points<6?'safe':'in danger')+')'};}
    };
}


// Offensive modules do not yield their combo to spike danger. Keep the
// original snapshot intact for healing, movement and placement geometry.
function amAttackThreat(value){
    if(!value)return value;
    const spike=Math.max(value.spikeDamage||0,(value.spikes||[]).reduce((n,s)=>n+(s.damage||0),0))+(value.placementSpikeDamage||0);
    if(!spike)return value;
    const cache=amAttackThreat.cache??=new WeakMap();if(cache.has(value))return cache.get(value);
    const damage=Math.max(0,(value.damage||0)-spike),ratio=value.damage>0?(value.unarmoredDamage??value.damage)/value.damage:1;
    const result={...value,spikes:[],spikeDamage:0,placementSpikeDamage:0,futureSpikeDamage:0,damage,unarmoredDamage:damage*ratio,
        immediateDamage:Math.max(0,(value.immediateDamage||0)-(value.spikes||[]).filter(s=>!s.predicted).reduce((n,s)=>n+(s.damage||0),0))};
    cache.set(value,result);return result;
}
function installDefense(api,root,visuals,host){
    const clock=createAmLiveClock(api,root);
    'use strict';
    const id='am-defense',settings=[
        {key:'autoheal',label:'Autoheal',default:true},{key:'autoQ',label:'AutoQ',default:true},

        let timer=null,due=Infinity,disposed=false,executing=false,healing=false,manual=false,held=false,auto=false,selected=null,wireItem=null,wireWeapon=null,wireDown=false;

        const state={last:'idle',reason:'idle',damage:0,incomingDamage:0,qheal:false,heals:0,placements:0,breaking:null,blocked:null};

        function observedTrap(){const p=pos(ctx.self),r=ctx.self.scale||35;const nearby=root.AntimoocheatWorld?.query({x:p.x-r,y:p.y-r},{x:p.x+r,y:p.y+r})||objects();return nearby.find(o=>o.trap&&o.ownerSid!=null&&!own(o.ownerSid)&&dist(ctx.self,o)<=(ctx.self.scale||35)+(o.getScale?.()??o.scale))||null;}
        function risk(force=false){

            state.damage=original.damage;state.incomingDamage=incomingDamage;return riskCache;
        }

        // Decision functions below come from the last original antimoocheat healer.
        const tick=Math.max(16,Number(ctx.SERVER_TICK)||1000/9);
        const projectileEmergency=()=>hp>0&&risk().incomingDamage*visuals.threats.exposureFactor()>=hp&&risk().incoming.length>0;
        // Only trajectory-validated incoming Hunting Bow arrows authorize this response.
        // Retain their identity briefly for the matching HP receipt after retirement.
        function antiBowThreat(r){
            if(!ctx.settings.antiBow||!live()||!(hp>0))return false;
            r??=risk();
            const time=now(),index=ctx.data.weapon(9)?.projectile;
            for(const [sid,entry]of bowIncoming)if(time>entry.until)bowIncoming.delete(sid);
            let active=false;
            for(const shot of r.incoming||[]){
                if(shot.index!==index||!(shot.damage>0)||!(shot.speed>0)||!Number.isFinite(shot.eta))continue;
                active=true;
                if(shot.sid!=null){
                    bowIncoming.set(shot.sid,{until:time+Math.min(3000,Math.max(0,shot.eta))+Math.max(100,Math.min(400,2*tick+(ctx.net.ping||0)))});
                    if(bowIncoming.size>16)bowIncoming.delete(bowIncoming.keys().next().value);
                }
            }
            return active;
        }
        function antiBowHealing(){
            if(antiBowThreat())return true;
            if(!ctx.settings.antiBow||!live()||!(hp>0&&hp<Math.min(100,Number(ctx.self.maxHealth)||100)))return false;
            const wound=healWounds.status(),entry=wound?.projectileSid!=null?bowIncoming.get(wound.projectileSid):null;
            return !!entry&&now()<=entry.until&&wound.primary===false&&wound.projectile===ctx.data.weapon(9)?.projectile&&
                wound.loss>0&&now()-wound.at<=Math.max(100,Math.min(400,2*tick+(ctx.net.ping||0)));
        }
        function trapSyncDamage(potential=visuals.threats.snapshot()){
            const trap=visuals.threats.selfTrap();if(!trap)return 0;
            const attacks=(potential.targets||[]).reduce((n,t)=>n+t.damage,0)+(potential.incoming||[]).reduce((n,s)=>n+s.damage,0);
            return (potential.spikes||[]).reduce((max,s)=>s.placement&&s.replacingSid===trap.sid&&s.damage>0?Math.max(max,attacks+s.damage):max,0);
        }
        function healRisk(){
            const potential=visuals.threats.snapshot(),pressure=visuals.threats.pressure(potential);
            const policy=visuals.threats.healPotential(potential,125+Math.max(0,ctx.net.ping||0)/2,true);
            const animalDamage=(potential.animals||[]).reduce((n,a)=>n+(a.reachable?a.damage:0),0);
            const multiplier=visuals.threats.exposureFactor();
            const spikeDamage=(potential.spikeDamage||0)*multiplier,spikeCount=new Set(potential.spikes.filter(s=>s.damage>0).map(s=>s.sid)).size;
            const periodicDamage=potential.periodicDamage||0,playerDamage=policy.followupDamage+policy.projectileDamage;
            const totalDamage=playerDamage+spikeDamage+animalDamage+periodicDamage;
            const wound=healWounds.status(),fresh=!!wound&&now()-wound.at<=Math.max(350,2*tick+(ctx.net.ping||0));
            const strongHit=fresh&&!!wound.primary&&wound.weapon<9;
            const physical=potential.spikes.filter(s=>!s.placement&&s.damage>0&&(s.observedContact||s.predicted===false));
            const trappedSpikeContact=physical.length>0&&!!visuals.threats.selfTrap();
            const actualCombo=visuals.threats.lethalSpikeCombo(potential).active;
            const projectileKnockbackEmergency=visuals.threats.projectileKnockbackRisk(potential).active;
            const recentSpike=!!visuals.threats.recentSpikeContact();
            // Mere nearby damage potential does not promote a weak hit to Q heal.
            // A confirmed strongest hit still uses slow healing when reloads
            // leave enough time and the remaining follow-up cannot kill us.
            const openingOwner=wound?.projectileSid!=null?healProjectileOwner:wound?.attacker;
            const sameAttacker=policy.targets.find(t=>t.sid===openingOwner);
            const secondaryOpening=fresh&&(wound.projectile!=null||wound.weapon>=9)&&sameAttacker&&
                sameAttacker.followup+policy.projectileDamage+spikeDamage>=hp;
            // Only a confirmed strongest melee wound can use this conservative
            // upper follow-up bound. It never changes HUD pot or incoming shots.
            const uncertainTurretDamage=strongHit&&sameAttacker?visuals.threats.uncertainTurretDamage(wound.attacker)*multiplier:0;
            const uncertainPrimaryEmergency=uncertainTurretDamage>0&&
                sameAttacker.followup+policy.projectileDamage+uncertainTurretDamage>=hp;
            // Recovery pacing must yield to a real weak melee hit whose same
            // attacker can finish us. Nearby unrelated potential is not enough.
            const actualMelee=shameMeleeWounds.status();
            const meleeFresh=actualMelee?.kind==='primary'&&actualMelee.primary===true&&
                Number.isInteger(actualMelee.attacker)&&Number.isInteger(actualMelee.weapon)&&actualMelee.weapon>=0&&actualMelee.weapon<9&&
                now()-actualMelee.at<=Math.max(350,2*tick+(ctx.net.ping||0));
            const meleeAttacker=meleeFresh&&policy.targets.find(t=>t.sid===actualMelee.attacker);
            const otherMeleeEmergency=meleeFresh&&hp>0&&policy.targets.reduce((sum,t)=>sum+(t.sid===actualMelee.attacker?0:t.readyMeleeDamage),0)>=hp;
            const bullOpeningEmergency=meleeFresh&&actualMelee.bull&&hp>0&&!!meleeAttacker&&
                meleeAttacker.followup+policy.projectileDamage+spikeDamage>=hp;
            const wearingBull=ctx.self.hat===7||root.AntimoocheatEquipment?.pending(false)?.id===7;
            const bullSwitchEmergency=wearingBull&&hp>0&&hp<(ctx.self.maxHealth||100)&&
                policy.targets.reduce((sum,t)=>sum+t.readyMeleeDamage,0)+policy.projectileDamage+(physical.length||actualCombo?spikeDamage:0)>=hp;
            const reducedMeleeEmergency=recoveryStatus().active&&!!meleeAttacker&&
                meleeAttacker.followup+policy.projectileDamage+spikeDamage>=hp;
            // A confirmed melee wound may already have pushed us toward a real
            // spike. This remaining collision must not wait for that primary's
            // reload, even when a stronger secondary made the wound look weak.
            const projectedPhysical=potential.spikes.filter(s=>{
                if(!s.predicted||s.placement||!(s.damage>0)||s.attacker!=null&&s.attacker!==actualMelee?.attacker)return false;
                const object=ctx.objects.get(s.sid);
                return object?.active&&!object.fake&&!object.preplace&&object.ownerSid!=null&&!own(object.ownerSid)&&
                    ctx.data.item(object.id)?.group?.name==='spikes';
            });
            const projectedSpikeDamage=projectedPhysical.reduce((sum,s)=>sum+s.damage,0)*multiplier;
            const knockbackMeleeEmergency=!!meleeAttacker&&projectedPhysical.length>0&&
                meleeAttacker.followup+policy.projectileDamage+projectedSpikeDamage>=hp;
            const environmentalLethal=hp>0&&animalDamage+periodicDamage>=hp;
            const emergency=bullOpeningEmergency||bullSwitchEmergency||otherMeleeEmergency||environmentalLethal||projectileEmergency()||actualCombo||trappedSpikeContact||reducedMeleeEmergency||knockbackMeleeEmergency||uncertainPrimaryEmergency||
                physical.length>0&&totalDamage>=hp||recentSpike&&playerDamage>=hp||strongHit&&totalDamage>=hp||secondaryOpening;
            const bullDrain=(potential.periodic||[]).filter(e=>e.source==='bull-drain').reduce((n,e)=>n+Math.max(0,e.damage||0),0);
            const noOtherThreat=!emergency&&playerDamage<=0&&spikeDamage<=0&&Math.max(0,periodicDamage-bullDrain)<=0;
            const animalOnly=(animalDamage>0||animalWound)&&noOtherThreat;
            return {pressure,actualCombo,bullOpeningEmergency,bullSwitchEmergency,emergency:!!emergency,otherMeleeEmergency,strongHit,projectileKnockbackEmergency,uncertainTurretDamage,uncertainPrimaryEmergency,reducedMeleeEmergency:!!reducedMeleeEmergency,knockbackMeleeEmergency:!!knockbackMeleeEmergency,secondaryOpening:!!secondaryOpening,wound,boostFollowup:false,trappedSpikeContact,animalOnly,currentAnimalOnly:animalDamage>0&&noOtherThreat,
                spikeLimited:spikeDamage>0&&!emergency,totalDamage,playerDamage,spikeDamage,spikeCount,periodicDamage,potDamage:policy.damage,projectileDamage:policy.projectileDamage};
        }
        const healRecovery=createReducedHealRecovery();
        const recoveryStatus=()=>healRecovery.observe(visuals.healingStatus?.(item('food')?.id));
        const splitMelee=createSplitMeleeHeal(now,()=>Math.min(240,Math.max(80,tick+(ctx.net.ping||0))));
        function lethalHealing(r){
            if(!(hp>0&&hp<Math.min(100,Number(ctx.self.maxHealth)||100)))return false;
            const remaining=splitMelee.remaining()?.missing||0;
            return r.bullOpeningEmergency||r.bullSwitchEmergency||projectileEmergency()||r.actualCombo||r.projectileKnockbackEmergency||
                r.emergency&&(r.totalDamage>=hp||r.uncertainPrimaryEmergency||r.reducedMeleeEmergency||r.knockbackMeleeEmergency)||
                remaining>0&&(remaining+(r.projectileDamage||0)>=hp);
        }
        const fastHealAllowed=()=>shame.status().points<13;
        const urgentHealing=r=>{
            const enabled=manual||ctx.settings.autoheal&&ctx.settings.autoQ;
            if(!fastHealAllowed())return lethalHealing(r)&&(enabled||projectileEmergency()||antiBowHealing());
            return projectileEmergency()||antiBowHealing()||enabled&&(r.emergency||splitMelee.remaining()&&lethalHealing(r));
        };
        const fastHealing=r=>urgentHealing(r)||fastHealAllowed()&&manual&&!recoveryStatus().active;
        function wantsHeal(risk){
            if(!(manual||ctx.settings.autoheal||projectileEmergency()||antiBowHealing())||!(hp>0&&hp<Math.min(100,Number(ctx.self.maxHealth)||100)))return false;
            risk??=healRisk();

        }

        let healProjectileOwner=null;
        const healWounds=createHealWoundTracker(now,()=>2*tick+Math.max(0,ctx.net.ping||0),sid=>visuals.threats.rejectProjectilePush(sid));
        const shameMeleeWounds=createHealWoundTracker(now,()=>2*tick+Math.max(0,ctx.net.ping||0));
        ctx.on('gatherAnimation',p=>{
            const [sid,,id]=p.args||[],enemy=api.player(sid),weapon=ctx.data.weapon(id);
            if(!enemy?.alive||!enemy.visible||own(sid)||weapon?.projectile!=null||!(weapon?.dmg>0))return;

            if(dist(ctx.self,enemy)>(weapon.range||0)+(ctx.self.scale||35)*1.8||!Number.isFinite(facing)||Math.abs(delta(direction,facing))>(ctx.combat.K?.gatherAngle??Math.PI/2.6)+.05)return;

        });
        ctx.on('projectileRemove',p=>healWounds.remove(p.args?.[0]));
        const pendingStrongSwings=new Map();
        const strongFacing=(enemy)=>{
            const dir=Math.atan2(pos(ctx.self).y-pos(enemy).y,pos(ctx.self).x-pos(enemy).x),facing=enemy.d2??enemy.dir;
            return Number.isFinite(facing)&&Math.abs(delta(dir,facing))<=(ctx.combat.K?.gatherAngle??Math.PI/2.6)+.05;
        };
        ctx.on('gatherAnimation',p=>{
            const [sid,,id]=p.args||[],enemy=api.player(sid),weapon=ctx.data.weapon(id);
            pendingStrongSwings.delete(sid);
            if(!enemy?.alive||!enemy.visible||own(sid)||weapon?.projectile!=null||!(weapon?.dmg>0))return;
            // Loadout ranking retains unreachable weapons; observed melee still needs its own reach gate.
            if(dist(ctx.self,enemy)>(weapon.range||0)+(ctx.self.scale||35)*1.8)return;
            const target=visuals.threats.healPotential().targets.find(t=>t.sid===sid);
            if(!target||id<9&&(target.strongest.weapon!==id||target.strongest.unknown))return;
            const variant=visuals.threats.observedWeapons(sid).find(w=>w.id===id)?.variant??enemy.variant??0;
            const damages=id<9?[target.strongest.damage]:[visuals.threats.meleeDamage(enemy,ctx.self,id,variant),weapon.dmg*(ctx.combat.variantVal(variant)||1)*factor(ctx.data.hat(ctx.self.hat)?.dmgMult)*factor(ctx.data.accessory(ctx.self.accessory)?.dmgMult)];
            const sample={sid,weapon:id,damages,at:now()};
            if(!strongFacing(enemy)){
                // K can precede the position packet carrying this swing's facing.
                // Keep only this real swing for the next observed position sample.
                pendingStrongSwings.set(sid,{sample,enemy,self:ctx.self,hat:ctx.self.hat,tail:ctx.self.accessory,woundAt:healWounds.status()?.at??null});
                if(pendingStrongSwings.size>32)pendingStrongSwings.delete(pendingStrongSwings.keys().next().value);
                return;
            }
            healWounds.melee(sample);pulse();
        });
        ctx.on('playersUpdate',p=>{
            const updated=new Set((p.positions||[]).map(v=>v.sid));
            for(const [sid,entry]of pendingStrongSwings){
                const {sample,enemy}=entry,age=now()-sample.at;
                if(age>Math.min(250,tick+Math.max(0,ctx.net.ping||0))){pendingStrongSwings.delete(sid);continue;}
                if(!updated.has(sid))continue;
                pendingStrongSwings.delete(sid);
                if(entry.self!==ctx.self||!ctx.self.alive||api.player(sid)!==enemy||!enemy.alive||!enemy.visible||own(sid)||
                    entry.hat!==ctx.self.hat||entry.tail!==ctx.self.accessory||
                    entry.woundAt!=null&&healWounds.status()?.at!==entry.woundAt)continue;
                const weapon=ctx.data.weapon(sample.weapon),target=visuals.threats.healPotential().targets.find(t=>t.sid===sid);
                if(!target||sample.weapon<9&&(target.strongest.weapon!==sample.weapon||target.strongest.unknown)||
