                    !weapon||weapon.projectile!=null||dist(ctx.self,enemy)>(weapon.range||0)+(ctx.self.scale||35)*1.8||!strongFacing(enemy))continue;
                // Original K time/damage and original wound time survive the retry.
                healWounds.melee(sample);pulse();
            }
        });
        for(const event of ['reset','setup','disconnect','died'])ctx.on(event,()=>pendingStrongSwings.clear());
        ctx.on('playerAdd',p=>pendingStrongSwings.delete(p.data?.[1]));
        ctx.on('playerRemove',p=>pendingStrongSwings.delete(p.sid));
        const primaryHits=new Map();let primaryWound=null,primaryResponse=null;
        function trappedPrimaryResponse(){
            if(!primaryResponse)return false;
            const trap=visuals.threats.selfTrap();
            if(!trap||trap.sid!==primaryResponse.trap||now()>primaryResponse.until||
                now()-primaryResponse.at>=tick&&hp>=Math.min(100,Number(ctx.self.maxHealth)||100)&&(ctx.self.hat===6||!ctx.store.ownsHat(6))){primaryResponse=null;return false;}
            return true;
        }
        function matchPrimaryWound(){
            const trap=visuals.threats.selfTrap(),window=Math.min(500,tick*2+Math.max(0,ctx.net.ping||0));
            if(!trap||!primaryWound||primaryWound.used||now()-primaryWound.at>window)return;
            for(const sample of primaryHits.values())if(now()-sample.at<=window&&Math.abs(primaryWound.loss-sample.damage)<=1.1){
                primaryWound.used=true;primaryResponse={at:now(),until:now()+Math.max(350,window*2),trap:trap.sid,attacker:sample.sid,damage:primaryWound.loss};pulse();break;
            }
        }
        ctx.on('gatherAnimation',p=>{
            const [sid,,id]=p.args||[],enemy=api.player(sid),weapon=ctx.data.weapon(id);
            if(!visuals.threats.selfTrap()||!enemy?.visible||!enemy.alive||own(sid)||weapon?.type!==0||weapon.projectile!=null||!(weapon.dmg>0))return;
            const toward=Math.atan2(pos(ctx.self).y-pos(enemy).y,pos(ctx.self).x-pos(enemy).x),direction=enemy.d2??enemy.dir;
            if(dist(ctx.self,enemy)>(weapon.range||0)+(ctx.self.scale||35)*1.8||!Number.isFinite(direction)||Math.abs(delta(toward,direction))>(ctx.combat.K?.gatherAngle??Math.PI/2.6)+.05)return;
            const variant=visuals.threats.observedWeapons(sid).find(w=>w.id===id)?.variant??enemy.variant??0;
            const damage=visuals.threats.meleeDamage({...enemy,hat:7},ctx.self,id,variant);
            if(!(damage>10))return;
            primaryHits.set(sid,{sid,at:now(),damage});if(primaryHits.size>16)primaryHits.delete(primaryHits.keys().next().value);matchPrimaryWound();
        });
        const qActive=risk=>{
            if(splitMelee.remaining()&&!lethalHealing(risk??healRisk()))return false;
            if(!fastHealAllowed())return hp>0&&hp<100&&urgentHealing(risk??healRisk());
            // Keep reduced-food observations current even when no risk calculation is needed.
            const recovering=recoveryStatus().active;
            if(projectileEmergency()||antiBowHealing()||manual&&!recovering)return true;
            if(!manual&&!(ctx.settings.autoheal&&ctx.settings.autoQ))return false;
            return urgentHealing(risk??healRisk());
        };
        let healBatch=null,healRetry=0,unansweredHeals=0,animalHealAt=Infinity,normalHealAt=Infinity,healWound=0,lastHealWound=0;
        // Sample once per wound, never on every poll. Variation only adds time
        // within the requested 120–125ms local window; urgent Q heal remains immediate.
        const normalHealDelay=()=>120+Math.floor(Math.random()*6);
        const shame=createShameRecovery(now,()=>Math.max(350,2*(ctx.net.ping||0)+tick),()=>amSandbox(ctx,root));
        function recoveryAt(){
            const ratio=visuals.healingStatus?.(item('food')?.id)?.ratio;
            return shame.waitUntil(normalHealAt,tick,ctx.net.ping,ratio>0&&ratio<1);
        }
        ctx.on('playerValue',p=>{if(p.key==='food')shame.balance(p.value);else if(p.key==='shameCount')shame.serverCount(p.value);});
        function resetHealing(){splitMelee.reset();bowIncoming.clear();healRecovery.reset();shame.reset();healWounds.reset();shameMeleeWounds.reset();healWound=lastHealWound=0;normalHealAt=animalHealAt=Infinity;healBatch=null;healRetry=0;unansweredHeals=0;primaryHits.clear();primaryWound=primaryResponse=null;}
        function observeCurrentHealth(value=Number(ctx.self.health)){
            if(!Number.isFinite(value)||value===hp)return;
            const previous=hp;hp=value;riskCache=null;
            if(value<previous){
                lastDamage=now();
                const tail=ctx.data.accessory(ctx.self.accessory),bull=-((ctx.data.hat(7)?.healthRegen||0)+(tail?.healthRegen||0))*factor(ctx.data.hat(7)?.dmgMult)*factor(tail?.dmgMult);
                const nonPlayer=ctx.self.hat===7&&bull>0&&Math.abs(previous-value-bull)<.55||!!visuals.threats.recentSpikeContact();
                shame.hurt({nonPlayer});
                shameMeleeWounds.hurt(previous-value,pos(ctx.self),shot=>shot.damage);
                const source=healWounds.hurt(previous-value,pos(ctx.self),shot=>visuals.threats.projectileDamage(ctx.self,shot,shot.damage));
                healProjectileOwner=source.projectileSid!=null?visuals.threats.projectileOwner(source.projectileSid):null;
                if(source.projectileSid!=null){
                    visuals.threats.matchProjectilePush(source.projectileSid,previous-value);
                    visuals.threats.consumeProjectile(source.projectileSid);
                }
                // Periodic Ruby/Bull losses must not repeatedly bypass cadence.
                if(previous-value>10)healWound++;
                const secondHalf=splitMelee.hurt(previous-value,nonPlayer||source.projectileSid!=null||source.primary);
                if(!Number.isFinite(normalHealAt)||!fastHealAllowed()&&!secondHalf)normalHealAt=lastDamage+normalHealDelay();
                primaryWound={at:now(),loss:previous-value,used:false};matchPrimaryWound();
                animalWound=healRisk().animalOnly;
            }else{
                const melee=shameMeleeWounds.status(),wound=melee?.primary?melee:healWounds.status();
                if(wound?.projectileSid!=null)wound.attacker=healProjectileOwner!=null&&!own(healProjectileOwner)?healProjectileOwner:null;
                splitMelee.reset();
                // Read late melee/projectile attribution before full health clears it.
                shame.gain(wound);
                shameMeleeWounds.healed(value>=Math.min(100,Number(ctx.self.maxHealth)||100));
                healWounds.healed(value>=Math.min(100,Number(ctx.self.maxHealth)||100));
                if(healBatch){
                    // A positive health receipt acknowledges a food use, not
                    // the advertised HP. Nerfed food must not leave phantom HP
                    // reserved until the network timeout expires.
                    const regen=[ctx.data.hat(ctx.self.hat),ctx.data.accessory(ctx.self.accessory)].some(e=>e?.healthRegen>0||e?.healD>0)||item('food')?.id===2;
                    if(!regen&&healBatch.uses?.length){
                        healBatch.uses.shift();
                        healBatch.expected=healBatch.uses.reduce((sum,hp)=>sum+hp,0);
                    }else healBatch.expected=Math.max(0,healBatch.expected-(value-previous));
                }
                if(value>=Math.min(100,Number(ctx.self.maxHealth)||100)||!healBatch?.expected){healBatch=null;pendingHeal=null;}
                healRetry=0;unansweredHeals=0;
                if(value>=Math.min(100,Number(ctx.self.maxHealth)||100)){animalWound=false;normalHealAt=animalHealAt=Infinity;}
            }
        }
        function foodHealing(food=item('food')){
            const sample=food&&visuals.healingStatus?.(food.id),base=Number(food?.heal)||0;
            const measured=sample?.item===food?.id&&Number.isFinite(sample?.heal)&&sample.heal>0&&sample.heal<=base&&sample.ageMs<=5000;
            return {item:food?.id??null,base,heal:measured?sample.heal:base,measured,ratio:measured?sample.heal/base:null,source:measured?'observed':'definition'};
        }
        function heal(){
            if(!live()||healing||host.placing()){state.healReason=!live()?'session-inactive':healing?'food-transaction-active':'placement-transaction-active';return false;}
            observeCurrentHealth();
            const p=ctx.self,max=Math.min(100,Number(p.maxHealth)||100);
            state.healReason='healthy';
            if(hp>=max){normalHealAt=animalHealAt=Infinity;state.qheal=qActive();return false;}
            const r=healRisk(),time=now();
            state.qheal=qActive(r);
            if(!r.animalOnly||hp>80||hp<=0)animalHealAt=Infinity;
            else if(!Number.isFinite(animalHealAt))animalHealAt=Number.isFinite(normalHealAt)?normalHealAt:lastDamage+normalHealDelay();
            if(!wantsHeal(r)){normalHealAt=animalHealAt=Infinity;return false;}
            const partial=splitMelee.remaining();
            if(partial&&!lethalHealing(r)){
                state.qheal=false;state.healReason='waiting-for-melee-remainder';schedule(Math.max(1,partial.until-time));return false;
            }
            if(!Number.isFinite(normalHealAt))normalHealAt=now()+normalHealDelay();
            const pendingHat=gear.get(false),requested=pendingHat&&time-pendingHat.at<Math.max(500,2*(ctx.net.ping||0)+tick)?pendingHat.id:null;
            if(root.AntimoocheatEquipment?.clowned()||p.hat===45||requested===45||ctx.data.hat(p.hat)?.noEat||ctx.data.hat(requested)?.noEat){state.healReason='equipment-prevents-eating';return false;}
            const food=item('food');if(!food){state.healReason='food-unavailable';return false;}
            if(!p.weapons?.includes(p.weaponIndex)){
                state.healReason='waiting-for-owned-weapon';
                const use=p.weapons?.find(id=>Number.isInteger(id)&&ctx.data.weapon(id));
                if(use!=null&&time-(state.weaponRepairAt??-Infinity)>=Math.max(250,2*(ctx.net.ping||0))&&budget(['z'])){
                    if(send('selectItem',use,true))state.weaponRepairAt=time;
                }
                schedule(50);return false;
            }
            const effective=foodHealing(food);if(!(effective.heal>0)){state.healReason='food-unavailable';return false;}
            if(healBatch?.until<=time){healBatch=null;pendingHeal=null;}
            const reserved=healBatch?.expected||0,missing=Math.max(0,max-hp-reserved);
            if(missing<=0){state.healReason='awaiting-heal';schedule(Math.max(1,healBatch.until-time));return false;}
            const recovering=recoveryStatus().active&&!urgentHealing(r);
            // One request in flight keeps a later 40 HP receipt attributable.
            if(recovering&&healBatch){state.healReason='reduced-food-awaiting-heal';schedule(Math.max(1,healBatch.until-time));return false;}
            let count=recovering?1:Math.ceil(missing/effective.heal);
            for(let i=0;i<(food.req||[]).length;i+=2){const cost=Number(food.req[i+1]);if(cost>0)count=Math.min(count,Math.floor(resources.amount(food.req[i])/cost));}
            if(count<1){state.healReason='insufficient-food';return false;}
            const fast=fastHealing(r,time),fresh=fast&&healWound!==lastHealWound;
            const recoveryWait=fast?0:recoveryAt()-time;
            const wait=Math.max(recoveryWait,fresh?0:lastHeal+tick-time,fast?0:(healBatch?.until||0)-time,fast?0:(r.animalOnly?animalHealAt:normalHealAt)-time);
            if(wait>0){state.healReason=recovering?'reduced-food-recovery':recoveryWait>0?'shame-recovery':'legacy-cadence';schedule(wait);return false;}
            let used=0;healing=true;
            try{
                while(used<count&&budget(['z','F','z',...(held||breakState?['F']:[])])){
                    const dir=Number.isFinite(ctx.self.dir)?ctx.self.dir:0;
                    if(!root.AntimoocheatCombat?.useItem(food.id,dir)){state.healReason='food-sequence-incomplete';break;}
                    used++;
                }
            }finally{healing=false;}
            if(used){
                lastHeal=now();if(!recovering)normalHealAt=animalHealAt=Infinity;state.heals+=used;state.last=fastHealing(r,time)?'Qheal':'Autoheal';state.healReason='sent';
                lastHealWound=healWound;
                const uses=healBatch?.uses?.slice()||(reserved>0?[reserved]:[]);
                for(let i=0;i<used;i++)uses.push(Math.min(effective.heal,Math.max(0,missing-i*effective.heal)));
                healBatch={uses,expected:uses.reduce((sum,hp)=>sum+hp,0),until:now()+Math.max(350,2*(ctx.net.ping||0)+tick)};
                pendingHeal={hp,until:healBatch.until};resume();schedule(tick);return true;
            }
            state.healReason='shared-packet-budget';schedule(50);return false;
        }

        function needsItemPriority(){
            if(!live()||!wantsHeal()||healBatch||now()-lastHeal<25||root.AntimoocheatEquipment?.clowned())return false;
            const food=item('food');if(!food||!ctx.self.weapons?.includes(ctx.self.weaponIndex)||ctx.data.hat(ctx.self.hat)?.noEat)return false;
            for(let i=0;i<(food.req||[]).length;i+=2)if(resources.amount(food.req[i])<Number(food.req[i+1]))return false;
            const r=healRisk();return fastHealing(r)||Number.isFinite(normalHealAt)&&now()>=Math.max(normalHealAt,recoveryAt());
        }
        function requestGear(value,accessory=false){
            if(value!==0&&!(accessory?ctx.store.ownsTail(value):ctx.store.ownsHat(value)))return false;
            const equipment=root.AntimoocheatEquipment;
            if(equipment?.settled(value,accessory)&&!equipment.pending(accessory)){gear.delete(accessory);return true;}
            if(equipment?.pending(accessory)?.id===value && now()-equipment.pending(accessory).at<Math.max(500,2*(ctx.net.ping||0)+250))return true;
            if(!budget(['c']))return false;
            const accepted=equipment?equipment.request((...a)=>send('store',...a),value,accessory,'defense'):send('store',1,value,accessory);
            if(accepted){const queued=equipment?.pending(accessory);if(queued)gear.set(accessory,{...queued});else gear.delete(accessory);}
            return accepted;
        }
        let trapBurstUntil=0,trapAttacker=null;
        function opportunityDanger(r=risk()){
            r=amAttackThreat(r);
            if(trappedPrimaryResponse())return true;
            const pressure=visuals.threats.breakingPressure(r),bull=(ctx.data.hat(7)?.dmgMult??1)*(ctx.data.accessory(ctx.self.accessory)?.dmgMult??1);
            if(pressure.oneTick||pressure.airStack||pressure.knockbackDanger||pressure.unarmoredDamage*bull>=ctx.self.health&&ctx.self.health>0)return true;
            return false;
        }
        function antiOneTickThreat(r){
            return !!(ctx.settings.antiOneTick&&((r||visuals.threats.snapshot()).targets||[]).some(t=>t.oneTick));
        }
        function forcedArmor(r=risk(),combat=!!root.MooMooCombatMacros?.status().active){
            if(visuals.threats.committedSpikePath(r).active||visuals.threats.lethalSpikeCombo(r).active)return true;
            if(ctx.settings.antiOneTick&&visuals.threats.pressure(r).oneTick)return true;
            if(antiBowThreat(r))return true;
            if(!combat&&root.MooMooCombatDefense?.trapCycleActive?.())return (r.incomingDamage||0)>=hp;
            if(combat)r=amAttackThreat(r);
            if(trappedPrimaryResponse())return true;
            if(ctx.settings.antiBow&&now()<bowUntil)return true;
            if(ctx.settings.antiOneTick&&(r.targets||[]).some(t=>t.oneTick))return true;
            if(combat){
                const pressure=visuals.threats.breakingPressure(r),hp=ctx.self.health;
                if(pressure.oneTick||pressure.airStack||hp>0&&(pressure.incomingDamage>=hp||pressure.knockbackDanger&&pressure.unarmoredDamage>=hp))return true;
            }
            if(!combat&&ctx.settings.antiOneTick&&ctx.self.health>0&&((r.targets||[]).some(t=>t.damage>0)||r.incomingDamage>0)){
                const exposed=Math.max(r.damage||0,r.unarmoredDamage||0);
                if(exposed>=Math.min(100,ctx.self.health))return true;
            }
            if(!ctx.settings.antiSpikeTick)return false;
            const spike=(r.spikeDamage||0)+(r.placementSpikeDamage||0);if(!(spike>0))return false;
            const melee=(r.targets||[]).reduce((sum,t)=>sum+Math.max(0,...t.attacks.filter(a=>!a.ranged&&!a.turret&&!a.unknown).map(a=>a.damage)),0);
            const air=(r.incoming||[]).filter(p=>p.eta<=(ctx.SERVER_TICK||111)).reduce((sum,p)=>sum+p.damage,0);
            const protection=factor(ctx.data.hat(ctx.self.hat)?.dmgMult)*factor(ctx.data.accessory(ctx.self.accessory)?.dmgMult)||1;
            const attackHat=Math.max(factor(ctx.data.hat(7)?.dmgMult),factor(ctx.data.hat(40)?.dmgMult));
            return (spike+melee+air)/protection*attackHat>=ctx.self.health&&ctx.self.health>0;
        }
        function armor(r){
            if(root.MooMooCombatMacros?.finishingInsta?.())return;
            const time=now();if(ctx.settings.antiBow)bowVolley(r);
            if(!antiBowThreat(r)&&!antiOneTickThreat(r)&&!visuals.threats.committedSpikePath(r).active&&!visuals.threats.lethalSpikeCombo(r).active&&(root.MooMooCombatMacros?.status().active==='oneTick'||root.MooMooAutomation?.oneTickPreparing()))return;
            if(ctx.settings.antiBow&&time<bowUntil){root.MooMooCombatDefense?.release?.();finishBreak(false);}
            const one=ctx.settings.antiOneTick&&(r.targets||[]).some(t=>t.oneTick);
            const urgent=forcedArmor(r);
            let hat=null;
            if(urgent){root.AntimoocheatCombat?.cancel(visuals.threats.lethalSpikeCombo(r).active?'lethal-spike-combo':'defense-priority');hat=6;}
            else if(root.MooMooOpportunities?.finisherPreparing()||combatBusy()||root.AntimoocheatCombat?.manualEquipmentActive?.()||!breakState&&root.AntimoocheatEquipment.manualActive())return;
            else if(breakState){hat=breakHat(r);}
            else if(time<bowUntil&&ctx.settings.antiBow)hat=6;
            else if((ctx.settings.soldier||ctx.settings.biome)&&(enemies().some(e=>dist(e,ctx.self)<=350)||(r.animals||[]).some(a=>a.distance<=350)||r.spikeDamage>0))hat=6;
            else if(ctx.settings.biome&&!held&&!auto&&root.AntimoocheatEquipment.idleAllowed()){const y=pos(ctx.self).y;hat=Math.abs(y-7200)<=362&&!ctx.self.zIndex?31:y<=2400?15:12;}
            else if(gearOwned)hat=6;
            if(hat===6&&!ctx.store.ownsHat(6))hat=ctx.self.hat??0;
            if(hat!=null&&requestGear(hat))gearOwned=!!(breakState||urgent);
            else if(urgent&&hat===6&&ctx.store.ownsHat(6))schedule(Math.max(5,root.AntimoocheatEquipment.waitMs(6)+1));
            if(time<bowUntil&&ctx.settings.antiBow){if(tailRestore==null)tailRestore=ctx.self.accessory||0;requestGear(15,true);}
            else if(tailRestore!=null&&(ctx.settings.distanceAccessory||requestGear(tailRestore,true)))tailRestore=null;
        }
        function weaponFor(o){
            const [primary,secondary]=ctx.self.weapons||[],distance=dist(ctx.self,o),hammer=secondary===10;
            const range=id=>(ctx.data.weapon(id)?.range||0)+o.scale;
            if(hammer&&distance<=range(10))return 10;
            const spike=ctx.data.item(o.id)?.group?.name==='spikes';
            if(primary===8||!(ctx.data.weapon(primary)?.dmg>0)||distance>range(primary))return null;
            if(hammer)return spike&&primary===4&&lastTrap!=null?primary:null;
            const retained=breakState?.sid===o.sid&&distance<=(breakState.engagementDistance??0)+3;
            if(spike&&primary!==0&&primary!==4&&!retained&&safeBlocked!==o.sid&&distance>(ctx.self.scale||35)+(o.getScale?.()??o.scale)+38)return null;
            return primary;
        }
        function breakRemaining(){return root.AntimoocheatCombat?.status().reloads.find(r=>r.id===breakState?.weapon)?.remaining??visuals.threats.reload(ctx.self.sid,breakState?.weapon)?.remaining??0;}
        function breakingPressure(r=risk()){
            // The old smart Tank rule excludes hypothetical weapon switches and uses current HP.
            const value=visuals.threats.breakingPressure(r),tank=(ctx.data.hat(40)?.dmgMult??1)*(ctx.data.accessory(ctx.self.accessory)?.dmgMult??1);
            return {...value,tankDamage:value.unarmoredDamage*tank};
        }
        function breakDanger(r=risk()){return breakingPressure(r).tankDamage>=Math.min(100,ctx.self.health)&&ctx.self.health>0;}
        function breakHat(r=risk()){
            if(forcedArmor(r)||opportunityDanger(r)||breakDanger(r))return ctx.store.ownsHat(6)?6:(ctx.self.hat??0);
            return ctx.store.ownsHat(40)?40:ctx.store.ownsHat(6)?6:(ctx.self.hat??0);
        }
        function breakMayStrike(){
            if(breakState&&(wireWeapon??ctx.self.weaponIndex)!==breakState.weapon){
                if(!budget(['z'])||!send('selectItem',breakState.weapon,true))return false;
            }
            const hat=breakHat(),pending=gear.get(false);
            return breakRemaining()<=1&&now()>=(breakState?.nextAttackAt||0)&&
                (pending?.id===hat||!pending&&ctx.self.hat===hat);
        }
        ctx.on('gatherAnimation',p=>{
            if(p.args?.[0]!==ctx.self.sid||!breakState||p.args?.[2]!==breakState.weapon)return;
            breakState.shot=true;breakState.nextAttackAt=now()+2*(ctx.SERVER_TICK||1000/9);breakResume=true;
            schedule();
        });
        function finishBreak(restore=true){
            const old=breakState;breakState=null;state.breaking=null;breakResume=false;if(!old||!restore||!live())return;
            const weapon=ctx.self.weapons?.includes(selected)?selected:old.original;
            root.AntimoocheatCombat?.restoreAfterBreak(weapon,old.autoResume||auto);
        }
        function resume(){
            held=root.AntimoocheatCombat?.manualInput().held??held;
            if(root.MooMooCombatMacros)return;
            if(!live()||healing||host.placing()||root.AntimoocheatCombat?.restoreItemWeapon()===false)return;
            if(root.AntimoocheatCombat?.active()){root.AntimoocheatCombat.resume();return;}
            if(breakState){
                const target=ctx.objects.get(breakState.sid);if(!target?.active)return;
                const direction=breakState.direction;
                if(auto){if(!budget(['K'])||!send('toggle',1))return;breakState.autoResume=true;}
                if(!breakMayStrike()){if(wireDown&&budget(['F']))send('mouse',false);breakResume=true;return;}
                if(!budget([...(ctx.self.weaponIndex!==breakState.weapon?['z']:[]),'D','F']))return;
                if(ctx.self.weaponIndex!==breakState.weapon&&!send('selectItem',breakState.weapon,true))return;
                send('aim',direction);send('mouse',true,direction);breakState.direction=direction;breakResume=false;
            }else if(held&&budget(['F']))send('mouse',true,ctx.input.aimAngle());
        }

        function breaking(){
            if(root.MooMooCombatDefense)return;
            if(!ctx.settings.autobreak||combatBusy()){finishBreak();return;}
            const prison=visuals.threats.selfTrap()?.sid;
            const hazards=objects().filter(o=>o.ownerSid!=null&&!own(o.ownerSid)&&(!o.trap||prison==null||o.sid===prison)&&['trap','spikes','booster','teleporter'].includes(ctx.data.item(o.id)?.group.name));
            const m=motion.get(ctx.self.sid),speed=now()-(m?.at??0)<350?Math.hypot(m.vx,m.vy):0;
            const safety=Math.max(38,speed*(180+Math.min(150,(ctx.net.ping||0)/2))+18),half=(ctx.combat?.K?.gatherAngle??Math.PI/2.6)-.015;
            let best=null;
            const hammer=ctx.self.weapons?.[1]===10&&ctx.data.weapon(10);
            const hammerTargets=hammer&&hazards.some(o=>dist(ctx.self,o)<=hammer.range+(o.getScale?.()??o.scale));
            for(const weapon of ctx.self.weapons||[]){
                // A longer primary must not win the spike count score over the breaking Hammer.
                if(hammer&&weapon!==10&&weapon!==4)continue;
                const w=ctx.data.weapon(weapon);if(!w||!(w.dmg>0)||w.projectile!=null||w.shield||weapon===8)continue;
                const targets=hazards.filter(o=>weaponFor(o)===weapon);
                const angles=targets.map(o=>Math.atan2(o.y-pos(ctx.self).y,o.x-pos(ctx.self).x));
                const candidates=angles.flatMap(a=>[a,a-half+.00001,a+half-.00001]);
                for(const direction of candidates){
                    const hits=targets.filter((o,i)=>Math.abs(delta(angles[i],direction))<=half);
                    const spikes=hits.filter(o=>ctx.data.item(o.id)?.group.name==='spikes'),containing=hits.find(o=>o.sid===lastTrap);
                    const target=(lastTrap!=null&&spikes[0])||containing||hits.sort((a,b)=>dist(ctx.self,a)-dist(ctx.self,b))[0];if(!target)continue;
                    const priority=lastTrap!=null?spikes.length*1000000+(containing?100000:0):0;
                    const score=priority+hits.length*1000+w.dmg*(w.sDmg||1)/w.speed*100+(weapon===ctx.self.weaponIndex?2:0)-dist(ctx.self,target)*.001;
                    if(!best||score>best.score)best={target,weapon,direction,hits:hits.map(o=>o.sid),score};
                }
            }
            if(!best){finishBreak();return;}
            const {target,weapon,direction,hits}=best;
            if(!breakState||breakState.sid!==target.sid||breakState.weapon!==weapon){const original=breakState?.original??selected??ctx.self.weaponIndex;breakState={sid:target.sid,weapon,original,direction,engagementDistance:dist(ctx.self,target),autoResume:breakState?.autoResume??auto,shot:false};breakResume=true;}
            const changed=Math.abs(delta(direction,breakState.direction))>.025;breakState.direction=direction;breakState.targets=hits;
            if(auto){if(budget(['K'])&&send('toggle',1))breakState.autoResume=true;}
            state.breaking=target.sid;state.reason=lastTrap!=null?'breaking-trap':'breaking-hazard';
            if(!healing&&!host.placing()&&!forcedArmor(undefined,true)&&root.AntimoocheatCombat?.claimBreakOpportunity?.())return;
            armor(risk());
            if(healing||host.placing())return;
            if(!breakMayStrike()){if(wireDown&&budget(['F']))send('mouse',false);breakResume=true;return;}
            if(breakResume||ctx.self.weaponIndex!==weapon||!wireDown&&!auto){resume();return;}
            if(changed&&budget(['D']))send('aim',direction);
        }
        function walkBreakReach(o){
            if(!ctx.settings.autobreak||o.ownerSid==null||!['spikes','booster'].includes(ctx.data.item(o.id)?.group?.name))return 0;
            let reach=0;
            for(const id of ctx.self.weapons||[]){
                const w=ctx.data.weapon(id);
                if(id!==8&&w?.dmg>0&&w.projectile==null)reach=Math.max(reach,w.range+o.scale-1.5);
            }
            return reach;
        }
        function hazard(dir){
            if(!Number.isFinite(dir))return null;
            const me=pos(ctx.self),v=motion.get(ctx.self.sid),speed=now()-(v?.at??0)<350?Math.hypot(v.vx,v.vy):0;
            const reach=Math.max(38,speed*(180+Math.min(150,(ctx.net.ping||0)/2))+18),end={x:me.x+Math.cos(dir)*reach,y:me.y+Math.sin(dir)*reach};
            for(const o of objects()){
                const cactus=!o.isItem&&o.type===1&&o.y>=12000,harm=cactus||o.ownerSid!=null&&!own(o.ownerSid)&&['spikes','booster','teleporter'].includes(ctx.data.item(o.id)?.group.name);
                if(!harm||(o.x-me.x)*Math.cos(dir)+(o.y-me.y)*Math.sin(dir)<=0)continue;
                const collision=(ctx.self.scale||35)+(o.getScale?.()??o.scale)+2;
                // Once a forward hazard is in breaking reach, stay stopped
                // through the reload; decaying velocity must not restart walking.
                const breakReach=walkBreakReach(o),breaking=breakReach>0&&dist(ctx.self,o)<=breakReach;
                const forward={x:me.x+Math.cos(dir)*dist(ctx.self,o),y:me.y+Math.sin(dir)*dist(ctx.self,o)};
                if(breaking&&segment(me,forward,o)<=collision||segment(me,end,o)<=collision)return o.sid;
            }
            return null;
        }
        let walkStop=null;
        function walkingHazard(dir){
            if(!Number.isFinite(dir)){walkStop=null;return null;}
            const prior=walkStop,me=pos(ctx.self);
            if(prior&&prior.dir===dir){
                const o=ctx.objects.get(prior.sid),dx=o?.x-me.x,dy=o?.y-me.y;
                const forward=dx*Math.cos(dir)+dy*Math.sin(dir),side=Math.abs(dx*Math.sin(dir)-dy*Math.cos(dir));
                if(o===prior.object&&o.active&&!o.fake&&!o.preplace&&(o.ownerSid==null||!own(o.ownerSid))&&
                    forward>0&&forward<=prior.forward+1&&side<=(ctx.self.scale||35)+(o.getScale?.()??o.scale)+2)return o.sid;
            }
            const sid=hazard(dir),object=sid==null?null:ctx.objects.get(sid);
            walkStop=object?{sid,object,dir,forward:(object.x-me.x)*Math.cos(dir)+(object.y-me.y)*Math.sin(dir)}:null;
            return sid;
        }
        function stepIntoBreakRange(dir,sid){
            const stop=walkStop,o=stop?.object;
            if(!o||stop.sid!==sid||stop.dir!==dir)return null;
            const reach=walkBreakReach(o),me=pos(ctx.self),time=now(),tick=ctx.SERVER_TICK||1000/9;
            if(!reach||dist(ctx.self,o)<=reach)return null;
            if(time<stop.stepUntil){schedule(stop.stepUntil-time);return stop.stepDir;}
            if(actualMove!=null||time<stop.observeAt)return null;
            const v=motion.get(ctx.self.sid);
            const speed=v&&time-v.at<2*tick?Math.hypot(v.vx,v.vy):0;
            if(speed>.025)return null;
            // A held key may need one movement update after braking early.
            // Bound input duration locally and allow velocity to settle before re-evaluating.
            const decay=Math.pow(ctx.combat?.K?.playerDecel??.993,tick);
            const factor=(ctx.data.weapon(ctx.self.weaponIndex)?.spdMult||1)*(ctx.data.hat(ctx.self.hat)?.spdMult||1)*(ctx.data.accessory(ctx.self.accessory)?.spdMult||1);
            const travel=(speed+(ctx.combat?.K?.playerSpeed??.0016)*factor*tick)*tick/(1-decay);
            const nearby=objects().filter(obj=>obj.active&&!obj.fake&&!obj.preplace&&
                dist(ctx.self,obj)<=travel+(ctx.self.scale||35)+(obj.getScale?.()??obj.scale)+6);
            const step=[0,Math.PI/8,-Math.PI/8,Math.PI/4,-Math.PI/4,3*Math.PI/8,-3*Math.PI/8].map(a=>a+dir).find(a=>{
                const end={x:me.x+Math.cos(a)*travel,y:me.y+Math.sin(a)*travel};
                if(Math.hypot(end.x-o.x,end.y-o.y)>=dist(ctx.self,o)-2)return false;
                return !nearby.some(obj=>(!obj.ignoreCollision||obj.boostSpeed||obj.teleport||obj.trap)&&
                    segment(me,end,obj)<=(ctx.self.scale||35)+(obj.getScale?.()??obj.scale)+5);
            });
            if(step==null)return null;
            stop.stepDir=step;stop.stepUntil=time+tick*.55;stop.observeAt=time+3*tick+(ctx.net.ping||0);
            schedule(stop.stepUntil-time);return step;
        }
        function movement(){
            if(!ctx.settings.safewalk||!Number.isFinite(requestedMove))return;
            const blocked=walkingHazard(requestedMove),next=blocked==null?requestedMove:stepIntoBreakRange(requestedMove,blocked);safeBlocked=blocked;state.blocked=blocked;
            if(next!==actualMove&&budget(['9']))send('move',next);
        }
        function blocksBowRay(x,y,dir,along,object) {
            let enter=0,exit=Math.max(0,along-(ctx.self.scale||35));
            const radius=object.getScale?.()??object.scale;
            for(const [d,offset]of [[Math.cos(dir),object.x-x],[Math.sin(dir),object.y-y]]){
                if(Math.abs(d)<1e-9){if(Math.abs(offset)>radius)return false;continue;}
                const a=(offset-radius)/d,b=(offset+radius)/d;enter=Math.max(enter,Math.min(a,b));exit=Math.min(exit,Math.max(a,b));if(enter>exit)return false;
            }
            return true;
        }
        function bowVolley(r=risk()) {
            const time=now(),me=pos(ctx.self),volley=[];
            for(const hit of r.incoming||[]) {
                const shot=hit;if(!(hit.damage>0)||!Number.isFinite(shot.speed))continue;
                const travel=(time-shot.at+Math.min(250,Math.max(0,ctx.net.ping||0)/2))*shot.speed;
                const x=shot.x+Math.cos(shot.dir)*travel,y=shot.y+Math.sin(shot.dir)*travel;
                const along=(me.x-x)*Math.cos(shot.dir)+(me.y-y)*Math.sin(shot.dir);
                const cross=Math.abs((me.x-x)*Math.sin(shot.dir)-(me.y-y)*Math.cos(shot.dir));
                const mill=item('mill'),radius=(ctx.self.scale||35)+(mill?.scale||45)+(mill?.placeOffset||0);
                const t=Math.max(0,along-Math.sqrt(Math.max(0,radius*radius-cross*cross)));
                const angle=Math.atan2(y+Math.sin(shot.dir)*t-me.y,x+Math.cos(shot.dir)*t-me.x);
                volley.push({...shot,sid:hit.sid,eta:hit.eta,angle,estimatedDamage:hit.damage,soldierDamage:hit.soldierDamage});
            }
            state.bowDamage=volley.reduce((n,s)=>n+s.estimatedDamage,0);
            state.bowSoldierDamage=volley.reduce((n,s)=>n+s.soldierDamage,0);
            state.bowProjectiles=volley.length;
            // Re-evaluate against current HP and actual incoming shots. A past
            // lethal volley must not authorize mills after healing or impact.
            const lethal=volley.length>0&&ctx.self.health>0&&Math.max(state.bowDamage,state.bowSoldierDamage)>=ctx.self.health;
            const hunting=ctx.self.health>0?volley.filter(s=>s.index===ctx.data.weapon(9)?.projectile):[];
            const blocking=lethal?volley:hunting;
            state.bowPredict=hunting.length>0;
            if(!blocking.length){bowUntil=0;return [];}
            bowUntil=time+Math.max(...blocking.map(s=>s.eta))+(ctx.SERVER_TICK||1000/9)+Math.max(0,ctx.net.ping||0);
            return blocking;
        }
        function crossedBoost(player,point,previous,world,time) {
            if(player.sid===ctx.self.sid||own(player.sid)||!previous||time-previous.at>350)return null;
            const me=pos(ctx.self),dx=point.x-previous.x,dy=point.y-previous.y;
            const length=Math.hypot(dx,dy);
            if(length<1||length>500||dx*(me.x-point.x)+dy*(me.y-point.y)<=0)return null;
            let found=null,best=Infinity;
            for(const pad of world){
                if(!pad.boostSpeed||!Number.isFinite(pad.dir))continue;
                const radius=(player.scale||35)+(pad.getScale?.()??pad.scale);
                // Swept contact catches a boost crossed entirely between snapshots.
                if(segment(previous,point,pad)>radius)continue;
                if(Math.cos(pad.dir)*(me.x-point.x)+Math.sin(pad.dir)*(me.y-point.y)<=0)continue;
                const d=Math.hypot(point.x-pad.x,point.y-pad.y);
                if(d<best){best=d;found={sid:pad.sid,ownerSid:pad.ownerSid,x:pad.x,y:pad.y,scale:pad.scale,dir:pad.dir,at:time};}
            }
            return found;
        }
        function boostPathBlocked(enemy,me,velocity){
            const start=pos(enemy),length=Math.hypot(velocity.dx,velocity.dy);
            if(length<1)return true;
            const ux=velocity.dx/length,uy=velocity.dy/length;
            const target=(me.x-start.x)*ux+(me.y-start.y)*uy;
            const contact=Math.max(0,target-(enemy.scale||35)-(ctx.self.scale||35));
            for(const o of objects()){
                if(o.ignoreCollision)continue;
                const radius=(enemy.scale||35)+(o.getScale?.()??o.scale),dx=o.x-start.x,dy=o.y-start.y;
                const along=dx*ux+dy*uy,cross=Math.abs(dx*uy-dy*ux);
                if(along<=0||cross>=radius)continue;
                const entry=along-Math.sqrt(Math.max(0,radius*radius-cross*cross));
                if(entry<contact)return true;
            }
            return false;
        }
        function refreshBoostObjects(){
            if(!ctx.settings.antiBoost||!live())return;
            const time=now(),world=objects().filter(o=>o.boostSpeed);
            if(!world.length)return;
            for(const enemy of enemies()){
                const m=motion.get(enemy.sid);if(!m||time-m.at>350)continue;
                const previous={x:m.x-m.dx,y:m.y-m.dy,at:m.at};
                const boost=crossedBoost(enemy,m,previous,world,time);
                if(boost){m.boost=boost;m.boostUntil=time+350;}
            }
            if(placementActive())root.AntimoocheatPlacementHost?.wake();
        }

        function antiBoostPlan(getItem) {
            const me=pos(ctx.self),spike=getItem('spikes');if(!spike)return null;
            const near=enemies().sort((a,b)=>dist(a,ctx.self)-dist(b,ctx.self));
            for(const enemy of near) {
                const m=motion.get(enemy.sid),e=pos(enemy),boost=m?.boost;
                if(!m||now()-m.at>350||Math.hypot(m.dx,m.dy)<1||m.dx*(me.x-e.x)+m.dy*(me.y-e.y)<=0)continue;
                if(!boost||now()-boost.at>350||Math.cos(boost.dir)*(me.x-e.x)+Math.sin(boost.dir)*(me.y-e.y)<=0)continue;
                if(boostPathBlocked(enemy,me,m))continue;
                const length=Math.hypot(m.dx,m.dy),vx=m.dx/length,vy=m.dy/length,body=enemy.scale||35;
                const speed=m.elapsed>=16&&m.elapsed<=350?length/m.elapsed:0;
                const travelLimit=Math.max(boost.scale+body,Math.min(400,speed*600));
                const placer=root.AntimoocheatBasePlacement,radius=(ctx.self.scale||35)+spike.scale+(spike.placeOffset||0);
                // Two non-overlapping spikes straddle the approach. Both must
                // intersect the incoming body; an arbitrary rotated single side
                // would leave the player outside the intended pair.
                const dir=Math.atan2(e.y-me.y,e.x-me.x),reach=spike.scale+body;
                const contact=round=>round.length===2&&round.every(p=>{
                    const dx=p.x-e.x,dy=p.y-e.y,along=dx*vx+dy*vy,cross=Math.abs(dx*vy-dy*vx);
                    return along>=-body&&cross<reach-2&&Math.max(0,along-Math.sqrt(Math.max(0,reach*reach-cross*cross)))<=travelLimit;
                })&&((round[0].x-e.x)*vy-(round[0].y-e.y)*vx)*((round[1].x-e.x)*vy-(round[1].y-e.y)*vx)<0;
                let plans=null;
                for(const halfGap of [spike.scale+6,spike.scale+12,spike.scale+18]){
                    if(halfGap>=Math.min(radius,reach-2))continue;
                    const spread=Math.asin(halfGap/radius);
                    plans=placer?.pattern(spike,[dir-spread,dir+spread],[0],contact);
                    if(plans)break;
                }
                if(plans){const batch=plans.map(p=>({...p,mode:'anti-boost',defense:true,enemy:enemy.sid}));return {...batch[0],batch};}
            }
            return null;
        }


        function placementActive(){return live()&&(ctx.settings.antiBow&&now()<bowUntil||ctx.settings.antiTrap&&lastTrap!=null||ctx.settings.antiBoost&&[...motion.values()].some(v=>v.boostUntil>now()));}
        function placement(search,getItem,ringSearch=search,contactPlacement=null){
            if(!live())return null;const me=pos(ctx.self),r=risk();
            if(ctx.settings.antiBow)for(const s of bowVolley(r)){
                const mill=getItem('mill');if(!mill||(s.layer||0)>(mill.group.layer||0))continue;
                const travel=(now()-s.at+Math.min(250,Math.max(0,ctx.net.ping||0)/2))*s.speed;
                const x=s.x+Math.cos(s.dir)*travel,y=s.y+Math.sin(s.dir)*travel;
                const along=(me.x-x)*Math.cos(s.dir)+(me.y-y)*Math.sin(s.dir);
                const delay=Math.min(250,Math.max(0,ctx.net.ping||0)/2)+5;
                for(let n=0;n<=24;n++){
                    const offset=n===0?0:Math.ceil(n/2)*(n%2?1:-1)*Math.PI/36;
                    const p=search(mill,s.angle+offset,0,p=>blocksBowRay(x+Math.cos(s.dir)*s.speed*delay,y+Math.sin(s.dir)*s.speed*delay,s.dir,along-s.speed*delay,{...p,scale:mill.scale}));
                    if(p)return {...p,mode:'anti-bow',defense:true};
                }
            }
            if(ctx.settings.antiTrap&&lastTrap!=null){
                const trap=observedTrap()?.sid;
                if(trap!=null){
                    const contact=contactPlacement?.();
                    if(contact)return {...contact,defense:true,trap};
                    const use=getItem('booster')?getItem('spikes'):getItem('trap')||getItem('spikes');
                    // Search the complete placement ring, independent of enemy/cursor direction.
                    // World and pending placements reserve occupied arcs until confirmed or expired.
                    const p=ringSearch(use,0,Math.PI,()=>true,{mode:'anti-trap'});
                    if(p)return {...p,mode:'anti-trap',defense:true,trap};
                }
            }
            if(ctx.settings.antiBoost)return antiBoostPlan(getItem);
            return null;
        }
        let accessoryActivityUntil=0,buildingAccessory=false;
        const enemyNearAccessory=()=>enemies().some(p=>dist(p,ctx.self)<=350);
        const animalNearAccessory=()=>(ctx.combat.animals||[]).some(a=>a.active&&a.visible&&a.health>0&&
            !(a.state&&ctx.data.animal(a.index)?.diver)&&dist(a,ctx.self)<=350);
        function profileAccessory(key,fallback){
            const value=Number(ctx.settings[key]);
            return Number.isInteger(value)&&value>=0?(value===0||ctx.store.ownsTail(value)?value:0):fallback;
        }
        function attackAccessory(forBreak=false,targetKind=null){
            if(root.MooMooCombatMacros?.needsDragonCape()&&!(ctx.settings.antiBow&&now()<bowUntil&&ctx.store.ownsTail(15)))return 2;
            if(!ctx.settings.distanceAccessory)return ctx.self.accessory??0;
            if(ctx.settings.antiBow&&now()<bowUntil&&ctx.store.ownsTail(15))return 15;
            const committed=targetKind==null&&root.MooMooCombatMacros?.animalAttackAccessory?.();
            if(Number.isInteger(committed))return committed;
            const actionProfile=targetKind?null:root.MooMooBaseClicks?.accessoryContext?.();
            if(actionProfile&&Number(ctx.settings[actionProfile])>=0)return profileAccessory(actionProfile,0);
            const enemyGear=()=>profileAccessory('enemyAccessory',ctx.store.ownsTail(15)?15:ctx.store.ownsTail(19)?19:0);
            const animalGear=()=>profileAccessory('animalAccessory',ctx.store.ownsTail(19)?19:0);
            if(targetKind==='animal'||actionProfile==='leftAnimalAccessory')return animalGear();
            if(targetKind==='enemy'||actionProfile==='leftEnemyAccessory'||enemyNearAccessory())return enemyGear();
            if(forBreak||actionProfile==='leftBuildingAccessory'||actionProfile==='rightBuildingAccessory')return ctx.self.accessory??0;
            if(animalNearAccessory())return animalGear();
            return ctx.self.accessory??0;
        }
        function prepareAttackAccessory(forBreak=false){
            if(!ctx.settings.distanceAccessory)return true;
            buildingAccessory=!!(forBreak||breakState||root.MooMooCombatDefense?.status().target!=null||root.MooMooBaseClicks?.heldHat?.()===40);
            accessoryActivityUntil=now()+300;
            const accessory=attackAccessory(forBreak);
            if(!requestGear(accessory,true))return false;
            // A queued equip is not a confirmed equip. In particular, do not
            // let a melee swing use Monkey Tail while its removal is pending.
            return root.AntimoocheatEquipment?.settled(accessory,true)??ctx.self.accessory===accessory;
        }
        function pushTravelAccessory(){
            if(!root.MooMooAutomation?.ownsPushMovement?.()||!ctx.store.ownsTail(11))return null;
            const target=api.player(root.MooMooAutomation.status().pushTarget);
            if(!target||target.alive===false||target.visible===false)return null;
            // Keep travel Tail through the push until this session has a
            // matched spike HP receipt and confirmed physical contact.
            if(root.MooMooAutomation.pushSpikeContact?.()?.sid===target.sid)return null;
            if(root.AntimoocheatEquipment.manualActive(true)||host.combo()||host.placing()||
                root.AntimoocheatCombat?.weaponAttackActive()||root.MooMooBaseClicks?.status().active||
                breakState||root.MooMooCombatDefense?.status().target!=null||root.MooMooActionIntent||
                root.MooMooPlacers?.status().held.length||now()<accessoryActivityUntil||forcedArmor()||
                ctx.settings.antiBow&&now()<bowUntil)return null;
            return 11;
        }
        function updateAccessory(){
            if(!ctx.settings.distanceAccessory||root.AntimoocheatEquipment.manualActive(true))return;
            if(root.MooMooCombatMacros?.animalStealing())return;
            const pushing=pushTravelAccessory();
            if(pushing!=null){requestGear(pushing,true);return;}
            const fighting=host.combo()||root.AntimoocheatCombat?.weaponAttackActive()||breakState||
                root.MooMooActionIntent||root.MooMooAutomation?.ownsMovement?.()||now()<accessoryActivityUntil;
            if(fighting){requestGear(attackAccessory(),true);return;}
            if(ctx.settings.antiBow&&now()<bowUntil||root.AntimoocheatEquipment.manualActive(true))return;
            requestGear(animalNearAccessory()||enemyNearAccessory()?attackAccessory():profileAccessory('idleAccessory',ctx.store.ownsTail(11)?11:0),true);
        }
        function run(){
            if(!live())return;lastRun=now();riskCache=null;
            const trap=observedTrap()?.sid??null;if(lastTrap!=null&&trap!==lastTrap)exitUntil=now()+1000;lastTrap=trap;
            held=root.AntimoocheatCombat?.manualInput().held??held;
            const r=risk();armor(r);heal();breaking();movement();state.qheal=qActive();
            updateAccessory();
            if(placementActive())root.AntimoocheatPlacementHost?.wake();
            if(breakState||wantsHeal()||qActive()||shots.size||healBatch||ctx.settings.safewalk&&Number.isFinite(requestedMove))schedule(50);
        }
        ctx.on('playersUpdate',()=>{
            const time=now(),world=ctx.settings.antiBoost?objects():[];
            shame.setClown(!!root.AntimoocheatEquipment?.clowned()||ctx.self.hat===45);
            for(const p of visuals.observedApi.players.values()){
                if(!p.visible&&p.sid!==ctx.self.sid)continue;const at=pos(p),old=motion.get(p.sid),dt=old?time-old.at:0;
                const dx=old?at.x-old.x:0,dy=old?at.y-old.y:0,me=pos(ctx.self);
                const boost=crossedBoost(p,at,old,world,time)||old?.boost;
                motion.set(p.sid,{...at,at:time,dx,dy,elapsed:dt,vx:dt>5&&dt<500?dx/dt:old?.vx||0,vy:dt>5&&dt<500?dy/dt:old?.vy||0,boost,boostUntil:(boost?.at||0)+350});
            }
            for(const [sid,m]of motion)if(time-m.at>1500){motion.delete(sid);boostCounts.delete(sid);}
            riskCache=null;pulse();
        });
        ctx.on('objectsLoad',refreshBoostObjects);
        ctx.on('projectileAdd',p=>{
            const [x,y,dir,range,speed,index,layer,sid]=p.args||[],data=ctx.data.projectiles[index];if(!data?.dmg||![x,y,dir,range,speed].every(Number.isFinite)||speed<=0)return;
            const gearShot=index===1&&speed===1.5,source={x:x-(gearShot?0:70)*Math.cos(dir),y:y-(gearShot?0:70)*Math.sin(dir)};
            const owners=[...visuals.observedApi.players.values()].filter(p=>p.visible&&dist(p,source)<40),owner=owners.length===1?owners[0].sid:null;
            if(owner!=null&&own(owner))return;shots.set(sid??'shot'+(++serial),{x,y,dir,range,speed,index,layer:layer||0,gear:gearShot,damage:data.dmg,owner,at:now()});if(shots.size>128)shots.delete(shots.keys().next().value);riskCache=null;pulse();
        });
        ctx.on('projectileRemove',p=>{shots.delete(p.args?.[0]);riskCache=null;pulse();});
        ctx.on('health',p=>{if(p.sid!==ctx.self.sid)return;observeCurrentHealth(p.value);heal();pulse();});
        ctx.onSent((action,p,source)=>{
            if(action==='selectItem'){wireItem=p.isWeapon?null:p.index;if(p.isWeapon)wireWeapon=p.index;if(source==='client'&&p.isWeapon){selected=p.index;if(breakState)breakState.original=p.index;}if(p.isWeapon&&breakState)breakResume=true;}
            if(action==='mouse'&&p.down&&wireItem!=null&&hp>0&&hp<(ctx.self.maxHealth||100)){
                const food=ctx.data.item(wireItem),index=food?.heal?food.req?.indexOf('food'):-1;
                if(index>=0)shame.attempt(food.req[index+1],ctx.self.food);
            }
            if(action==='mouse'){if(!p.down||wireItem==null)wireDown=!!p.down;if(source==='client')held=root.AntimoocheatCombat?.manualInput().held??!!p.down;if(p.down&&wireItem!=null&&breakState)breakResume=true;}
            if(action==='toggle'&&p.which===1)auto=!auto;
            if(action==='move')actualMove=p.dir;if(action==='stopMove')actualMove=null;
            if(action==='store'&&p.action===1){
                if(!executing)gear.set(!!p.isAccessory,{id:p.id,at:now(),tries:1});
                if(!p.isAccessory&&p.id===7&&hp>0&&hp<(ctx.self.maxHealth||100)){riskCache=null;pulse();}
            }
        });
        ctx.onOutgoing('store',p=>{
            if(p.action!==1||!live()||!ctx.settings.antiBow||now()>=bowUntil)return p;
            const id=p.isAccessory?15:ctx.store.ownsHat(6)?6:(ctx.self.hat??0);
            const owned=id===0||(p.isAccessory?ctx.store.ownsTail(id):ctx.store.ownsHat(id));
            return owned&&p.id!==id?null:p;
        });
        ctx.onOutgoing('aim',p=>live()&&breakState?{...p,dir:breakState.direction}:p);
        ctx.onOutgoing('mouse',p=>live()&&breakState&&p.down&&wireItem==null&&!host.placing()?{...p,dir:breakState.direction}:p);
        ctx.onOutgoing('move',(p,meta)=>{if(meta?.source!=='client')return p;requestedMove=p.dir;if(!live()||!ctx.settings.safewalk)return p;safeBlocked=walkingHazard(p.dir);return safeBlocked==null?p:actualMove==null?null:{...p,dir:null};});
        ctx.onOutgoing('stopMove',(p,meta)=>{if(meta?.source==='client'){requestedMove=null;walkStop=null;}return p;});
        for(const event of ['objectsLoad','objectKilled','objectsKilled','inventory','storeUpdate','animalsUpdate','animalAttack','gatherAnimation'])ctx.on(event,()=>{riskCache=null;pulse();});
        function clear(){
            resetHealing();trapBurstUntil=0;trapAttacker=null;if(timer!==null)clock.clearTimeout(timer);timer=null;due=Infinity;finishBreak(false);held=auto=manual=wireDown=false;selected=wireItem=wireWeapon=null;bowUntil=exitUntil=0;bowThreatAt=-Infinity;lastTrap=null;pendingHeal=null;lastDamage=lastHeal=-Infinity;foodWindow=[];animalWound=false;gearOwned=false;tailRestore=null;requestedMove=actualMove=null;safeBlocked=walkStop=null;riskCache=null;hp=Number(ctx.self.health)||100;for(const m of [shots,motion,gear,boostCounts])m.clear();Object.assign(state,{last:'idle',reason:'idle',damage:0,incomingDamage:0,qheal:false,breaking:null,blocked:null});
        }
        for(const event of ['reset','setup','died','disconnect'])ctx.on(event,clear);
        ctx.on('playerAdd',p=>{if(p.isYou){healRecovery.reset();hp=Number(ctx.self.health)||100;schedule();}});
        const keydown=e=>{if(!ctx.settings.manualQ||host.typing()||e.ctrlKey||e.metaKey||e.altKey||e.key.toLowerCase()!==ctx.settings.healKey.toLowerCase())return;manual=true;e.preventDefault();e.stopImmediatePropagation();heal();schedule();};
        const keyup=e=>{if(e.key.toLowerCase()===ctx.settings.healKey.toLowerCase()){manual=false;schedule();}};
        const blur=()=>{held=manual=false;requestedMove=walkStop=null;if(live()&&!breakState&&wireDown&&!auto&&budget(['F']))send('mouse',false);schedule();},focus=()=>schedule(),visibility=()=>{if(root.document.hidden)blur();pulse();};
        root.addEventListener('keydown',keydown,true);root.addEventListener('keyup',keyup,true);root.addEventListener('blur',blur);root.addEventListener('focus',focus);root.document.addEventListener?.('visibilitychange',visibility);
        ctx.onSettingChange(()=>{if(!ctx.settings.manualQ)manual=false;if(!ctx.settings.antiBow){bowUntil=0;bowThreatAt=-Infinity;bowIncoming.clear();}if(!ctx.settings.autobreak)finishBreak();if(!ctx.settings.safewalk&&safeBlocked!=null){if(live()&&Number.isFinite(requestedMove)&&budget(['9']))send('move',requestedMove);safeBlocked=state.blocked=walkStop=null;}schedule();});
        service={settings:ctx.settings,attackAccessory,prepareAttackAccessory,qActive,heal,risk,trapSyncDamage,shameStatus:()=>({...shame.status(),automaticReset:false}),needsHeal:needsItemPriority,placementActive,placement,placementUrgent:()=>ctx.settings.antiBow&&now()<bowUntil,
            placed:p=>{state.placements++;state.last=p.mode;if(p.mode==='anti-boost')boostCounts.set(p.enemy,(boostCounts.get(p.enemy)||0)+1);},
            beginCombat:()=>{const original=breakState?.original??selected;finishBreak(false);gearOwned=false;gear.clear();return original;},endCombat:()=>schedule(),
            afterItem:angle=>{if(root.AntimoocheatCombat?.active()){root.AntimoocheatCombat.resume();schedule();return;}if(breakState)breakResume=true;else if(live()&&!held&&Number.isFinite(angle)){const aim=ctx.input.aimAngle();if(Number.isFinite(aim)&&Math.abs(delta(angle,aim))>.001&&budget(['D']))send('aim',aim);}resume();schedule();},busy:()=>healing,forcedArmor,antiOneTickThreat,antiBowThreat,opportunityDanger,hazard,blockedHazard:()=>ctx.settings.safewalk&&Number.isFinite(requestedMove)&&walkStop?.sid===safeBlocked?safeBlocked:null,status:()=>({...state,breaking:root.MooMooCombatDefense?.status().target??state.breaking,forcedArmor:forcedArmor(),primaryResponse:trappedPrimaryResponse()?{...primaryResponse}:null,qheal:qActive(),autoheal:ctx.settings.autoheal,trap:lastTrap,held,auto,autoIntent:breakState?.autoResume??auto,shots:shots.size,motion:motion.size,pendingHeal:!!healBatch,healingDiagnostics:{shame:shame.status(),recovery:recoveryStatus(),policy:'source-and-ready-followup',normalWaitMs:Math.max(0,normalHealAt-now()),clowned:!!root.AntimoocheatEquipment?.clowned(),risk:healRisk(),holdRemaining:0,food:foodHealing(),pending:healBatch&&{...healBatch},reason:state.healReason},breakTargets:root.MooMooCombatDefense?.status().targets||breakState?.targets||[],hatRequests:gear.size,bowProtecting:ctx.settings.antiBow&&now()<bowUntil})};
        const offHealThreat=visuals.threats.onChange(()=>{riskCache=null;pulse();});
        root.AntimoocheatDefense=service;
        ctx.onCleanup(()=>{offHealThreat();finishBreak();disposed=true;clear();root.removeEventListener('keydown',keydown,true);root.removeEventListener('keyup',keyup,true);root.removeEventListener('blur',blur);root.removeEventListener('focus',focus);root.document.removeEventListener?.('visibilitychange',visibility);if(root.AntimoocheatDefense===service)delete root.AntimoocheatDefense;});schedule();
    });
    return service;
}

// Observe accepted SDK actions. This never wraps the socket or changes the
// protocol: only idempotent requests made by our own modules can be omitted.
function createAmActionFlow(sdk,now,ping=()=>0){
    const root=typeof unsafeWindow!=='undefined'?unsafeWindow:window;
    const core=root.AntimoocheatCore;
    return {
        send(send,action,args){return send[action](...args);},
        status(){const state=core.model.status();return {selection:state.selected,down:state.attack,direction:state.direction,skipped:{shared:core.bus.status().counts.suppressed}};},
        dispose(){}
    };
}


function installAmPacketBudget(net,root){
    if(root.AntimoocheatPacketBudget)return root.AntimoocheatPacketBudget;
    const allow=net.allow.bind(net),would=net.wouldAllow.bind(net),tokens=net.tokens.bind(net),now=()=>root.performance.now();
    const counts={total:0,type:0},protocol=new Set(['T','M']),sharedActions=new Set(['z','F']);let last=null;
    // Both SDK-injected and native client packets pass through this one gate.
    // Two slots keep the protocol heartbeat/spawn available during a busy burst.
    const limit=type=>protocol.has(type)?120:118;
    const note=(reason,type)=>{counts[reason]++;last={reason,type,at:now()};return false;};
    net.allow=type=>{
        if(net.perSecond()>=limit(type))return note('total',type);
        // SDK's 18/s selection refill starves legal item bursts long before
        // the shared rolling limit. Selection/use share that limit directly.
        if(sharedActions.has(type))return true;
        const ok=allow(type);if(!ok)note('type',type);return ok;
    };
    net.wouldAllow=type=>net.perSecond()<limit(type)&&(sharedActions.has(type)||would(type));
    net.tokens=type=>Math.min(sharedActions.has(type)?Infinity:tokens(type),Math.max(0,limit(type)-net.perSecond()));
    const batch=types=>{
        if(net.perSecond()+types.length>118)return note('total','batch');
        const needed={};for(const type of types)needed[type]=(needed[type]||0)+1;
        for(const [type,count]of Object.entries(needed))if(!net.wouldAllow(type)||net.tokens(type)<count)return note('type',type);
        return true;
    };
    const names={z:'selection',F:'attack',c:'equipment',D:'aim',9:'movement'};
    const status=()=>({used:net.perSecond(),limit:120,actionLimit:118,sharedTypes:[...sharedActions],blocked:{...counts},waiting:last&&now()-last.at<300?(last.reason==='total'?'total':names[last.type]||last.type):'none'});
    return root.AntimoocheatPacketBudget={batch,status};
}

function installCombat(sdk,win,visuals,host){
    'use strict';
    let loader;sdk&&win.dispatchEvent(new win.CustomEvent('moomoo.js:api',{detail:{resolve:(_api,native)=>{loader=native;}}}));
    if(!loader)throw Error('Combat requires the base SDK');
    const packetBudget=installAmPacketBudget(loader.net,win);
    const api=Object.create(sdk),miscApi=api,contexts=new Map(),schemas=new Map();
    const now=()=>win.performance.now(),available=()=>amGameLive(sdk,win),miscThreats=visuals.threats;
    const reloadPriority=(weapons,trap)=>trap&&weapons?.[1]===10?10:weapons?.[0];
    const input=Object.create(loader.input),stage={config:{isOpen:()=>false,isCapturingKey:()=>false}},clock=createAmLiveClock(sdk,win);
    let syncLegacy=()=>{},signalKey=()=>{},combatHatOwned=false;
    const automationTyping=()=>amChatOpen(win)||loader.input.isTyping()&&!win.document.activeElement?.closest?.('.mml-gui');
    input.isTyping=automationTyping;
    input.onKeyDown=fn=>loader.input.onKeyDown((event,keys)=>{if(automationTyping()||win.AntimoocheatPlacementHost?.capturingKey())return;try{return fn(event,[...new Set(keys)]);}finally{syncLegacy();signalKey(event,keys);}});
    input.onKeyUp=fn=>loader.input.onKeyUp((event,keys)=>{try{return fn(event,[...new Set(keys)]);}finally{syncLegacy();}});
    const net=Object.create(loader.net);
    net.wouldAllowBatch=types=>available()&&packetBudget.batch(types);
    let selected=null,buildItem=null,wireDown=false,itemPressUnreleased=false,wireAuto=false,transaction=0,releaseUntil=0,pendingItemWeapon=null,sendDepth=0;
    const hats=new Map(),oldRoot=win.MooMooPrivateBackground;
    const actionFlow=createAmActionFlow(sdk,now,()=>net.ping);
    win.AntimoocheatActionFlow={status:actionFlow.status};
    const nativeLoader={...loader,input,net,config:stage.config,gameData:loader.gameData,combat:loader.combat,objects:loader.objects};
    const root=new Proxy(win,{get(target,key){
        if(key==='MooMooLoader')return nativeLoader;
        if(key==='MooMooPrivateBackground')return {allowed:available,timers:clock};
        if(key==='setTimeout')return clock.setTimeout;
        if(key==='clearTimeout')return clock.clearTimeout;
        const value=Reflect.get(target,key,target);
        return ['setTimeout','clearTimeout','setInterval','clearInterval','addEventListener','removeEventListener','queueMicrotask','requestAnimationFrame','cancelAnimationFrame'].includes(key)&&typeof value==='function'?value.bind(target):value;
    }});
    Object.defineProperties(api,{self:{get:()=>win.AntimoocheatEquipment.selfView},players:{get:()=>visuals.observedApi.players},player:{value:sid=>visuals.observedApi.player(sid)},isReady:{value:available}});
    sdk.onSent((action,p,source)=>{
        if(action==='selectItem'){
            if(p.isWeapon){selected=p.index;pendingItemWeapon=null;}
            buildItem=p.isWeapon?null:p.index;
            if(source==='client'){deferredMouse=null;deferredAuto=false;}
        }
        if(action==='mouse'&&p.down&&weaponSelected())noteWeaponPress();
        if(action==='mouse'){itemPressUnreleased=!!p.down&&buildItem!=null;if(wireDown&&!p.down&&buildItem==null)releaseUntil=Math.max(releaseUntil,now()+1000/9+(net.ping||0));if(!p.down||buildItem==null)wireDown=!!p.down;}
        if(action==='toggle'&&p.which===1){wireAuto=!wireAuto;if(!wireAuto)releaseUntil=Math.max(releaseUntil,now()+1000/9+(net.ping||0));}
        if(action==='store'&&p.action===1){hats.set(!!p.isAccessory,{id:p.id,at:now()});if(!p.isAccessory)combatHatOwned=source!=='client'&&sendDepth>0&&[7,40,53].includes(p.id);}
    });
    api.onSent=fn=>sdk.onSent((action,p,source)=>fn(action,action==='mouse'&&p.down&&buildItem!=null?{...p,itemUse:true}:p,source));
    function nativePlacementCheck(ctx,id,angle,planned=[],replacingSid=null){
        const planner=win.AntimoocheatBasePlacement;if(!planner)return false;
        return planner.combatSearch(id,angle,0,()=>true,planned,replacingSid);
    }
    function physical(){const s=root.MooMooBaseClicks?.status();return {left:!!s?.primaryHeld,right:!!s?.secondaryHeld,held:!!s?.active};}
    const macro=()=>root.MooMooCombatMacros?.status(),breaking=()=>root.MooMooCombatDefense?.status();
    let accessoryHoldUntil=0, deferredMouse=null, deferredAuto=false;
    const weaponSelected=()=>buildItem==null && !transaction;
    const prepareAccessory=()=>win.AntimoocheatDefense?.prepareAttackAccessory()!==false;
    function noteWeaponPress(){accessoryHoldUntil=now()+(loader.SERVER_TICK||1000/9)+(net.ping||0);}
    const attackOwned=()=>!!(macro()?.active||breaking()?.holdingAttack||root.MooMooActionIntent||root.MooMooAutoGrind?.status().active);
    const busy=()=>!!(macro()?.active||breaking()?.holdingAttack||root.MooMooActionIntent);
    function restoreItemWeapon() {
        if (pendingItemWeapon == null) return true;
        if (!available() || !net.wouldAllowBatch(['z'])) return false;
        const weapon = sdk.self.weapons?.includes(pendingItemWeapon) ? pendingItemWeapon : sdk.self.weapons?.[0];
        if (!Number.isInteger(weapon)) return false;
        if (itemPressUnreleased && !physical().held && !wireAuto && sdk.send.mouse(false,loader.input.aimAngle())!==true) return false;
        if (sdk.send.selectItem(weapon,true)!==true) return false;
        pendingItemWeapon = null;
        if ((win.AntimoocheatBasePlacement?.burstPaused() || !physical().held && !attackOwned() && !wireAuto) && wireDown)
            actionFlow.send(sdk.send,'mouse',[false,loader.input.aimAngle()]);
        return true;
    }
    function selectForUse(id,weapon){
        const item=loader.gameData.item(id);
        if(!item||!sdk.self.items?.includes(id))return false;
        if(item.group?.place&&!amSandbox(loader,win)){
            for(let i=0;i<(item.req?.length||0);i+=2){
                if((win.AntimoocheatResourceBalance?.amount(item.req[i])??0)<item.req[i+1])return false;
            }
        }
        if(buildItem===id){
            pendingItemWeapon??=weapon;
            if(!restoreItemWeapon())return false;
        }
        return sdk.send.selectItem(id,false)===true;
    }
    function useItems(plans,onPlaced=null,nextPlan=null,reserve=false) {
        return win.AntimoocheatCore.transaction('item',()=>{
            if(win.MooMooCombatMacros?.animalStealing()||transaction||!available()||!plans?.length||!restoreItemWeapon())return 0;
            const breaker=win.MooMooCombatDefense?.itemHandoff?.();
            const weapon=breaker?.weapon??(sdk.self.weapons?.includes(selected)?selected:sdk.self.weaponIndex);
            if(!sdk.self.weapons?.includes(weapon))return 0;
            const groupUses=new Map(),list=plans.slice(0,32),planUntil=win.performance.now()+3;let count=0,suspended=false;
            transaction++;
            try{
                for(let i=0;i<list.length;i++){
                    const p=list[i],id=p.item?.id??p.id,dir=p.angle;
                    if(!Number.isFinite(dir)||!sdk.self.items?.includes(id)||!available())break;
                    if(win.AntimoocheatBasePlacement?.allowAutoPlacement?.(p)===false)continue;
                    const group=loader.gameData.item(id)?.group;
                    if(group?.place&&loader.objects.itemCount(group.id)+(groupUses.get(group.id)||0)>=amStructureLimit(group,amSandbox(loader,win)))continue;
                    const wires=[...(breaker&&!suspended?['F']:[]),...(buildItem===id?['F','z']:[]),'z','F','z','F',...(breaker?['D','F']:[])];
                    // Leave a food transaction available when placement uses the shared pool.
                    const foodNeeded=reserve&&sdk.self.health<(sdk.self.maxHealth||100);
                    const required=foodNeeded?[...wires,'z','z','F']:wires;
                    if(!net.wouldAllowBatch(required))break;
                    if(breaker&&!suspended){suspended=breaker.suspend();if(!suspended)break;}
                    if(!selectForUse(id,weapon))break;
                    pendingItemWeapon=weapon;
                    if(sdk.send.mouse(true,dir)!==true)break;
                    count++;if(group?.place)groupUses.set(group.id,(groupUses.get(group.id)||0)+1);onPlaced?.(p);
                    if(nextPlan&&i===list.length-1&&list.length<4&&win.performance.now()<planUntil){const next=nextPlan(p);if(next)list.push(next);}
                }
            }finally{
                try{if((pendingItemWeapon==null||restoreItemWeapon())&&suspended)breaker.resume();}
                finally{transaction--;}
            }
            return count;
        });
    }

    function useItem(id,dir,restore=null) { return win.AntimoocheatCore.transaction("item",()=>useItemSequence(id,dir,restore)); }
    function useItemSequence(id,dir,restore=null) {
        if (win.MooMooCombatMacros?.animalStealing() || transaction || !available() || !Number.isFinite(dir) || !sdk.self.items?.includes(id)) return false;
        if (!restoreItemWeapon()) return false;
        const group=loader.gameData.item(id)?.group;
        if(group?.place&&loader.objects.itemCount(group.id)>=amStructureLimit(group,amSandbox(loader,win)))return false;
        const breaker=win.MooMooCombatDefense?.itemHandoff?.();
        const weapon = breaker?.weapon??(sdk.self.weapons?.includes(restore)?restore:sdk.self.weapons?.includes(selected)?selected:sdk.self.weaponIndex);
        if (!sdk.self.weapons?.includes(weapon) || !net.wouldAllowBatch([...(buildItem===id?['F','z']:[]),...(breaker?['F','z','F','F','D','z','F']:['z','F','F','z'])])) return false;
        let suspended=false;transaction++;
        try {
            if(breaker){suspended=breaker.suspend();if(!suspended)return false;}
            if (!selectForUse(id,weapon)) return false;
            pendingItemWeapon = weapon;
            return sdk.send.mouse(true,dir) === true;
        } finally {
            try {
                if((pendingItemWeapon==null||restoreItemWeapon())&&suspended)breaker.resume();
            } finally { transaction--; }
        }
    }
    api.register=(definition,setup)=>{
        schemas.set(definition.id,definition.settings||[]);
        return sdk.register({...definition,menu:false},native=>{
            const ctx={...native,input,net,player:api.player,onSent:fn=>{const off=api.onSent(fn);native.onCleanup(off);return off;}};
            Object.defineProperties(ctx,{self:{get:()=>api.self},players:{get:()=>api.players}});
            const send=native.send;ctx.send=Object.create(send);
            for(const action of Object.keys(send))ctx.send[action]=(...args)=>{
                if(action==='mouse'&&args[0]&&weaponSelected()&&!prepareAccessory())return false;
                if(action==='store'&&args[0]===1){
                    if(!win.AntimoocheatEquipment.owned(args[1],!!args[2]))return false;
                    if(!args[2]&&['combat-macros','base-clicks'].includes(definition.id)&&!win.AntimoocheatEquipment.pending(false))win.AntimoocheatEquipment.releaseManual(definition.id==='combat-macros');
                    sendDepth++;try{return win.AntimoocheatEquipment.request((...a)=>send.store(...a),args[1],!!args[2],definition.id);}finally{sendDepth--;}
                }
                // An idle reload change must not consume a native swing queued before F-up.
                if(definition.id==='auto-reload'&&action==='selectItem'&&args[1]&&now()<releaseUntil)return false;
                sendDepth++;try{return actionFlow.send(send,action,args);}finally{sendDepth--;}
            };
            ctx.place=(id,angle,restore,replacingSid=null)=>{const plan=nativePlacementCheck(ctx,id,angle,[],replacingSid);if(!plan)return false;const sent=useItem(id,angle,restore);if(sent)win.AntimoocheatBasePlacement.attempted({...plan,mode:'combat'});return sent;};
            contexts.set(definition.id,ctx);
            const result=setup(ctx);return result;
        });
    };
    const misc={spikeThreats:{snapshot:()=>miscThreats.snapshot()},manualGearUntil:0,busy:(ownAttack=false)=>!!(win.AntimoocheatDefense?.busy()||host.placing()||host.heldPlacers()||!ownAttack&&now()<releaseUntil||automationTyping())};
    root.MooMooMisc=misc;root.MooMooThreats=miscThreats;
    root.MooMooHealing={status:()=>({active:!!win.AntimoocheatDefense?.busy()}),refreshSpikes:()=>{}};
    root.MooMooDefenses={protectingBow:()=>!!win.AntimoocheatDefense?.placementUrgent()};
    root.MooMooSafewalk={status:()=>({enabled:!!win.AntimoocheatDefense?.settings.safewalk}),hazard:dir=>win.AntimoocheatDefense?.hazard(dir)??null,
        breakThreat:sid=>{const o=loader.objects.get(sid);return !!o&&o.active&&(win.AntimoocheatDefense?.blockedHazard?.()===sid||miscThreats.distance(sdk.self,o)<=(sdk.self.scale||35)+(o.getScale?.()??o.scale)+38);},collisionThreat:function stockContact(sid){const o=loader.objects.get(sid);return !!o&&miscThreats.distance(sdk.self,o)<=(sdk.self.scale||35)+(o.getScale?.()??o.scale)+.5;}};
    win.MooMooSafewalk.stockContact=win.MooMooSafewalk.collisionThreat;
    root.MooMooPlacers={
        status:()=>({held:win.AntimoocheatBasePlacement?.burstPaused()?[]:host.heldPlacers()||win.AntimoocheatBasePlacement?.boostSpikeHeld()?['manual']:[],manualPausedBy:win.AntimoocheatBasePlacement?.burstPaused()?'boost-surround':null}),
        attempts:()=>[],angles:(_id,angle,_options={})=>{const out=[angle];for(let n=1;n<=32;n++){const delta=n*Math.PI/32;out.push(angle+delta,angle-delta);}return out;},
        defend:(id,angles,count=1,_manual,_name,options={})=>{
            const plans=[];for(const angle of angles){const p=win.AntimoocheatBasePlacement?.combatSearch(id,angle,0,()=>true,plans);if(p)plans.push(p);if(plans.length>=count)break;}
            if(options.dryRun)return plans.length;
            if(options.keepBatch&&count>=2&&count<=3)return plans.length===count?(win.AntimoocheatPlacementHost?.commitCombatPair(plans)??0):0;
            let done=0;for(const p of plans)if(win.AntimoocheatPlacementHost?.commitCombat(p))done++;return done;
        },pause:()=>{},resume:()=>{},clear:()=>{}
    };
        (function installFacing(api,root){
    'use strict';
    if(root.MooMooFacing)return root.MooMooFacing;
    let locked=false,angle=null,nativeAngle=null,seenModules=false;
    const reset=()=>{locked=false;angle=null;nativeAngle=null;};
    const pointer=()=>root.MooMooLoader?.input?.aimAngle?.();
    const offSent=api.onSent((action,payload,source)=>{
        if(source!=='client'||!api.self.alive)return;
        if(action==='toggle'&&payload.which===0){
            locked=!locked;
            if(locked){
                const current=pointer();
                angle=Number.isFinite(current)?Number(current.toFixed(2)):nativeAngle??api.self.dir;
            }else angle=null;
        }
        if((action==='aim'||action==='mouse')&&Number.isFinite(payload.dir)){
            nativeAngle=payload.dir;

            if(locked)angle=nativeAngle;
        }
    });
    const offs=['reset','setup','disconnect','died'].map(event=>api.on(event,reset));
    offs.push(api.on('playerAdd',payload=>{if(payload.isYou)reset();}));
    const controller={get locked(){return locked;},direction(input){
        if(locked&&Number.isFinite(angle))return angle;
        return input?.aimAngle?.()??pointer();
    }};
    root.MooMooFacing=controller;
    const offMods=api.onModsChanged(mods=>{
        if(mods.some(mod=>mod.id==='placers'||mod.id==='healing'||mod.id==='visuals')){seenModules=true;return;}
        if(!seenModules)return;
        offSent();for(const off of offs)off();offMods();
        if(root.MooMooFacing===controller)delete root.MooMooFacing;
    });
    return controller;
})(miscApi,root);

    (function installAutomaticFacing(api,root){
    'use strict';
    if(root.MooMooAutomaticFacing)return;
    const render=root.MooMooLoader?.render;
    if(!render?.onFrame)return;
    const proto=root.Object.prototype,candidates=new Set();
    let disposed=false,owned=false,owner=null,lastAngle=null,native=null,surface=null,seenModules=false,waitingForSelf=true;
    let pointerX=0,pointerY=0,nativeBase=0,hook=null,hookTimer=null;
    const normalize=a=>Math.atan2(Math.sin(a),Math.cos(a));
    let attackFacing=null,lastWeapon=null,wireItem=null,wireAim=null,wirePress=null;
    function attackOwner(){
        const combo=root.MooMooCombatMacros?.facing?.();
        if(Number.isFinite(combo?.angle))return combo;
        const intent=root.MooMooActionIntent;
        if(Number.isFinite(intent?.direction))return {owner:intent.owner,angle:intent.direction};
        const angle=root.MooMooManualAutoaim?.facing();
        return Number.isFinite(angle)?{owner:'manual-autoaim',angle}:null;
    }
    function resolve(){
        if(disposed||!api.isReady()||!api.self.alive||!attackFacing||root.performance.now()>=attackFacing.until)return null;
        return attackFacing;
    }
    // Observe the same trusted desktop coordinates as the native handler.
    // Never dispatch input, stop propagation or alter event trust checks.
    function pointerMove(event){
        if(event.isTrusted){pointerX=event.clientX;pointerY=event.clientY;}
    }
    function bindSurface(){
        const next=root.document.getElementById('touch-controls-fullscreen');
        if(next===surface)return;
        surface?.removeEventListener('mousemove',pointerMove);
        surface=next;surface?.addEventListener('mousemove',pointerMove);
    }
    function release(){
        if(native)native.offset=0;
        owned=false;owner=null;lastAngle=null;
    }
    function disarm(){
        if(hook&&Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(proto,'animate')?.set===hook)delete proto.animate;
        hook=null;if(hookTimer!==null)root.clearTimeout(hookTimer);hookTimer=null;
    }
    function detach(){
        release();if(!native)return;
        const n=native;
        if(n.player.animate===n.wrapper)Object.defineProperty(n.player,'animate',n.animationDescriptor);
        if(Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(n.player,'dirPlus')?.get===n.getSwing)
            Object.defineProperty(n.player,'dirPlus',{value:n.swing,writable:true,enumerable:true,configurable:true});
        native=null;
    }
    function attach(player){
        if(native?.player===player)return;
        const animationDescriptor=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(player,'animate');
        const swingDescriptor=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(player,'dirPlus');
        if(typeof animationDescriptor?.value!=='function'||animationDescriptor.configurable===false||swingDescriptor?.configurable===false)return;
        detach();
        const n={player,animationDescriptor,swing:Number.isFinite(player.dirPlus)?player.dirPlus:0,offset:0};
        n.getSwing=()=>n.swing+n.offset;
        Object.defineProperty(player,'dirPlus',{configurable:true,enumerable:true,get:n.getSwing,set(value){n.swing=value;n.offset=0;}});
        n.wrapper=function(...args){
            // The actual native animation runs against its original swing.
            // Only the subsequent draw reads the extra facing rotation.
            n.offset=0;
            const result=animationDescriptor.value.apply(this,args);
            if(this!==player||native!==n||disposed)return result;
            if(api.self.alive&&player.sid===api.self.sid&&player.visible){candidates.clear();disarm();}
            if(!player.lockDir)nativeBase=Number(Math.atan2(pointerY-root.innerHeight/2,pointerX-root.innerWidth/2).toFixed(2));
            const lock=resolve();
            if(lock&&player.sid===api.self.sid&&player.visible){
                n.offset=normalize(lock.angle-nativeBase);owned=true;owner=lock.owner;lastAngle=lock.angle;
            }else release();
            return result;
        };
        Object.defineProperty(player,'animate',{...animationDescriptor,value:n.wrapper});
        native=n;
    }
    function findSelf(){
        if(waitingForSelf||api.self.sid==null||!api.self.alive)return;
        // Respawn may reuse the old native player or construct another with
        // the same SID. Prefer the most recently constructed matching object.
        for(const player of [...candidates].reverse())if(player.sid===api.self.sid){attach(player);break;}
    }
    function arm(){
        if(disposed||native||hook||Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(proto,'animate'))return;
        // Player construction does not expose a renderer API. Observe only its
        // initial animate assignment, then remove this temporary setter. All
        // assignments still create the same ordinary own data property.
        hook=function(value){
            Object.defineProperty(this,'animate',{value,writable:true,enumerable:true,configurable:true});
            if(this.isPlayer===true&&typeof this.spawn==='function'&&typeof this.setData==='function'&&typeof this.getData==='function'&&typeof value==='function'){
                candidates.add(this);findSelf();
            }
        };
        Object.defineProperty(proto,'animate',{configurable:true,set:hook});
        hookTimer=root.setTimeout(disarm,15000);
    }
    function refresh(){
        if(disposed)return;
        if(!native){bindSurface();findSelf();}if(owned&&!resolve())release();
    }
    const offs=[render.onFrame(refresh),api.onSent((action,payload,source)=>{
        if(action==='spawn'&&source==='client')arm();
        if(action==='selectItem'){wireItem=payload.isWeapon?null:payload.index;if(payload.isWeapon)lastWeapon=payload.index;}
        if((action==='aim'||action==='mouse')&&Number.isFinite(payload.dir))wireAim=payload.dir;
        if(action==='mouse'&&payload.down&&!payload.itemUse&&wireItem==null&&Number.isFinite(wireAim)){
            const owner=attackOwner();
            wirePress=owner?{weapon:lastWeapon??api.self.weaponIndex,angle:wireAim,owner:owner.owner,at:root.performance.now()}:null;
        }
    })];
    offs.push(api.on('gatherAnimation',p=>{
        if(p.args?.[0]!==api.self.sid)return;
        const weapon=p.args[2],time=root.performance.now(),press=wirePress?.weapon===weapon&&time-wirePress.at<1500?wirePress:null;
        // Consume each click once. Repeated AutoHit swings must use the current
        // aim rather than replaying the first click's direction for 1.5 seconds.
        wirePress=null;
        const owner=press??attackOwner();
        const angle=press?.angle??wireAim??owner?.angle;
