        if(!owner||!Number.isFinite(angle))return;
        attackFacing={owner:owner.owner,angle,until:time+Math.min(180,(root.MooMooLoader.gameData.weapon(weapon)?.speed||400)*.35)};
    }));
    for(const event of ['setup','reset','died','disconnect'])offs.push(api.on(event,()=>{attackFacing=wirePress=null;wireItem=lastWeapon=wireAim=null;}));
    offs.push(api.on('setup',()=>{const player=native?.player;detach();if(player)candidates.add(player);waitingForSelf=true;arm();}));
    // Defer until the native playerAdd listener has completed construction.
    // A respawn can replace the player with another object bearing the same SID.
    offs.push(api.on('playerAdd',p=>{if(p.isYou)root.queueMicrotask(()=>{if(disposed)return;waitingForSelf=false;findSelf();});}));
    for(const event of ['reset','disconnect'])offs.push(api.on(event,()=>{detach();waitingForSelf=true;candidates.clear();disarm();}));
    offs.push(api.on('died',()=>{const player=native?.player;detach();waitingForSelf=true;candidates.clear();if(player)candidates.add(player);disarm();}));
    const bridge={refresh,status:()=>({active:owned,owner,angle:lastAngle,rendererAttached:!!native,mode:'confirmed-swing-only',swing:native?.swing??null})};
    root.MooMooAutomaticFacing=bridge;bindSurface();arm();
    const offMods=api.onModsChanged(mods=>{
        if(mods.some(m=>m.id==='combat-macros')){seenModules=true;return;}
        if(!seenModules)return;
        detach();disposed=true;disarm();candidates.clear();for(const off of offs)off();offMods();
        surface?.removeEventListener('mousemove',pointerMove);
        if(root.MooMooAutomaticFacing===bridge)delete root.MooMooAutomaticFacing;
    });
})(miscApi,root);


    (function installAutoReload(api,root){ return installCoreReload(api,root); })(miscApi,root);

    (function installUtilityAutomation(api,root){

    const background=()=>root.MooMooPrivateBackground?.allowed()===true;

            if(root.AntimoocheatEquipment?.settled(hat)&&!root.AntimoocheatEquipment.pending(false))return true;
            return ctx.net.wouldAllowBatch(['c'])&&send('store',1,hat,false);
        }
        const variant=id=>variants.get(id)||0;
        function grindDirection(targets,avoid,p){
            const half=ctx.combat.K?.gatherAngle??Math.PI/2.6;
            const angles=targets.map(o=>Math.atan2(o.y-p.y,o.x-p.x)),candidates=[...angles];
            for(let a=0;a<angles.length;a++)for(let b=a+1;b<angles.length;b++)candidates.push(angles[a]+Math.atan2(Math.sin(angles[b]-angles[a]),Math.cos(angles[b]-angles[a]))/2);
            const avoided=avoid.map(o=>Math.atan2(o.y-p.y,o.x-p.x));
            const delta=(a,b)=>Math.abs(Math.atan2(Math.sin(a-b),Math.cos(a-b)));
            let best=null,count=0;
            for(const dir of candidates){
                if(avoided.some(a=>delta(a,dir)<=half+.001))continue;
                const hits=angles.filter(a=>delta(a,dir)<=half).length;
                if(hits>count){count=hits;best=dir;}
            }
            return best;
        }
        function grind(moving){
            const primary=ctx.self.weapons?.[0],hammer=ctx.self.weapons?.[1]===10;
            const itemId=(ctx.self.items||[]).find(id=>id===17||id===22),item=ctx.data.item(itemId);
            const weapon=hammer&&(itemId===17||variant(primary)>=2)?10:primary,w=ctx.data.weapon(weapon);
            const key=[ctx.self.sid,primary,weapon,itemId].join(':');if(context!==key){release();context=key;pendingUntil=0;}
            if(!ctx.settings.grind||!live()||busy()||automationTyping()||heldMouse()||auto||heldMove()||moving||
                root.MooMooPlacers?.status().held.length||now()<pauseUntil||nearby(400)||!item||ctx.data.weapon(primary)?.projectile!=null||!w?.dmg||
                variant(primary)>=2&&(!hammer||variant(10)>=1)){release();return;}
            if(attacking){if(now()>attackUntil){release();pauseUntil=now()+tick;}return;}
            const p=pos(),objects=ctx.objects.all().filter(o=>o.active&&!o.fake&&!o.preplace&&o.ownerSid===ctx.self.sid&&o.id===itemId&&o.health>0&&Math.hypot(o.x-p.x,o.y-p.y)<=w.range+o.scale);
            if(!objects.length){
                if(now()<pendingUntil)return;
                if(root.AntimoocheatDefense?.placementUrgent())return;
                const radius=(ctx.self.scale||35)+item.scale+(item.placeOffset||0);
                if(radius>w.range+item.scale)return;
                const offset=Math.PI/4;
                const max=amSandbox(ctx,root)?3:2;
                executing=true;
                try{
                    for(let size=max;size>=1;size--)for(let i=0;i<36;i++){
                        const angle=(itemId===17?0:aim())+i*Math.PI/18;
                        const triple=itemId===17?73*Math.PI/180:2*Math.asin(Math.min(1,(item.scale+2)/radius));
                        const angles=itemId===17?(size===3?[angle,angle-triple,angle+triple]:size===2?[angle,angle-triple]:[angle]):
                            size===3?[angle-triple,angle,angle+triple]:size===2?[angle-offset,angle+offset]:[angle];
                        const options={offsets:[0],keepBatch:true,acceptRound:round=>round.length===size};
                        if(root.MooMooPlacers.defend(itemId,angles,size,false,null,{...options,dryRun:true})!==size)continue;
                        claim(weapon,aim());
                        const placed=root.MooMooPlacers.defend(itemId,angles,size,false,null,options);
                        if(placed)pendingUntil=now()+tick*4+Math.min(500,ctx.net.ping||0);
                        return;
                    }
                }finally{executing=false;}
                release();return;
            }
            pendingUntil=0;let use=weapon,targets=objects,avoid=[];
            if(weapon===10&&variant(primary)<2){
                const damage=w.dmg*(w.sDmg||1)*ctx.combat.variantVal(variant(10))*(ctx.store.ownsHat(40)?ctx.data.hat(40).bDmg:1);
                const healthy=objects.filter(o=>o.health>damage);
                if(healthy.length){targets=healthy;avoid=objects.filter(o=>o.health<=damage);}
                else {const reachable=objects.filter(o=>Math.hypot(o.x-p.x,o.y-p.y)<=ctx.data.weapon(primary).range+o.scale);if(!reachable.length){release();return;}targets=reachable;use=primary;}
            }
            let dir=grindDirection(targets,avoid,p);
            // A weak neighboring turret must not be killed by Hammer's cone
            // while its resource XP is still intended for Primary.
            if(dir==null&&avoid.length){
                use=primary;targets=objects.filter(o=>Math.hypot(o.x-p.x,o.y-p.y)<=ctx.data.weapon(primary).range+o.scale);
                dir=grindDirection(targets,[],p);
            }
            if(dir==null){release();return;}
            if(!ctx.net.wouldAllowBatch(['F','D','z','c','F']))return;
            executing=true;
            try{
                claim(use,dir);
                if(current()!==use&&(!send('mouse',false,dir)||!send('selectItem',use,true)))return;
                const ready=root.MooMooAutoReload?.ready(use)??miscThreats.ready(ctx.self.sid,use);
                if(!ready)return;
                if(!equip(40)||!send('aim',dir)||!send('mouse',true,dir))return;
                attacking=true;attackUntil=now()+tick*3+Math.min(500,ctx.net.ping||0);
            }finally{executing=false;}
        }
        function biome(){
            if(!ctx.settings.biome&&!ctx.settings.soldier){combatNearby=false;return;}
            const retained=now()<spikeDangerUntil;
            const me=pos(),pad=(ctx.self.scale||35)+(retained?120:80),safe=root.MooMooSafewalk;
            const indexed=!safe?.collisionThreat||safe.collisionThreat===safe.stockContact;
            const local=indexed?root.AntimoocheatWorld?.query({x:me.x-pad,y:me.y-pad},{x:me.x+pad,y:me.y+pad}):null;
            const spikeNearby=(local??ctx.objects?.all()??[]).some(o=>o.active&&!o.fake&&!o.preplace&&o.ownerSid!=null&&!ctx.objects.isFriendly(o.ownerSid)&&ctx.data.item(o.id)?.group?.name==='spikes'&&(miscThreats.distance(ctx.self,o)<=(ctx.self.scale||35)+(o.getScale?.()??o.scale)+(retained?120:80)||root.MooMooSafewalk?.collisionThreat(o.sid)));
            if(spikeNearby)spikeDangerUntil=now()+750;
            combatNearby=nearby(350)||(miscThreats.animalThreats?.()||[]).some(a=>a.distance<=350||a.reachable)||now()<spikeDangerUntil;
            if(!live()||automationTyping()||now()<misc.manualGearUntil||active||root.MooMooLiteVisualState?.status().active||
                root.MooMooCombatMacros?.status().active||root.MooMooCombatDefense?.status().target!=null||root.MooMooCombatDefense?.status().antiOneTick||
                root.MooMooActionIntent||root.MooMooCombatMacros?.status().manualAttackHat!=null)return;
            if(combatNearby){
                if(ctx.settings.soldier){executing=true;try{equip(6);}finally{executing=false;}}
                return;
            }
            if(!ctx.settings.biome||!root.AntimoocheatEquipment.idleAllowed()||root.MooMooCombatMacros?.status().rightClickTankHeld)return;
            const p=pos(),config=ctx.combat.K||{},water=Math.abs(p.y-(config.mapScale??14400)/2)<=(config.riverWidth??724)/2&&!ctx.self.zIndex;
            const hat=water?31:p.y<=(config.snowBiomeTop??2400)?15:12;
            executing=true;try{equip(hat);}finally{executing=false;}
        }
        function emergency(){
            if(!live()||!ctx.settings.soldier)return false;
            const risk=miscThreats.breakingPressure();if(!risk.urgent&&!risk.oneTick)return false;
            if(root.MooMooLiteVisualState?.status().active||root.MooMooCombatMacros?.status().active||root.MooMooCombatMacros?.status().manualAttackHat!=null)return false;
            release(false);executing=true;try{equip(6,true);}finally{executing=false;}return true;
        }
        function run(){timer=null;if(restoreRespawn()||emergency())return;const p=pos(),moving=lastPosition&&Math.hypot(p.x-lastPosition.x,p.y-lastPosition.y)>5;lastPosition=p;grind(moving);biome();}
        ctx.on('playersUpdate',payload=>{
            for(const attr of payload.attributes||[])if(attr.sid===ctx.self.sid&&Number.isInteger(attr.variant))variants.set(attr.weaponIndex,attr.variant);
            if(timer==null)timer=(root.MooMooPrivateBackground?.timers||root).setTimeout(run,1);
        });
        for(const event of ['storeUpdate','health','projectileAdd','projectileRemove','animalsUpdate','inventory','playerValue','objectsLoad','objectKilled','objectsKilled'])ctx.on(event,schedule);
        ctx.on('gatherAnimation',payload=>{
            if(!attacking||payload.args?.[0]!==ctx.self.sid||payload.args[2]!==root.MooMooActionIntent?.weapon)return;
            executing=true;try{send('mouse',false,root.MooMooActionIntent.direction);attacking=false;}finally{executing=false;}schedule();
        });

        const off=api.onSent((action,p,source)=>{
            if(!executing&&['move','stopMove','mouse','toggle','selectItem','store'].includes(action)){
                pauseUntil=now()+tick*2;
                root.queueMicrotask(()=>{if(!active)return;if(heldMouse()||root.MooMooLiteVisualState?.status().active)attacking=false;release(false);});
            }
            if(action==='selectItem'&&p.isWeapon)selected=p.index;
            if(source==='client'){
                if(action==='mouse')down=!!p.down;
                if(action==='toggle'&&p.which===1)auto=!auto;
                if(action==='move'||action==='stopMove')move=action==='move'&&Number.isFinite(p.dir)?p.dir:null;
            }
        });
        const reset=()=>{spikeDangerUntil=0;active=attacking=combatNearby=false;release(false);if(timer!=null)(root.MooMooPrivateBackground?.timers||root).clearTimeout(timer);timer=null;variants.clear();selected=original=move=lastPosition=null;down=auto=false;buttons.clear();mouseObserved=keyboardObserved=false;pendingUntil=pauseUntil=0;context='';};
        for(const event of ['reset','setup','died','disconnect'])ctx.on(event,reset);
        const blur=()=>{if(background()){release(false);down=false;}else{release();down=auto=false;}blurred=true;move=null;buttons.clear();schedule();},focus=()=>{blurred=false;schedule();};
        const visibility=()=>{if(root.document.hidden)blur();else focus();};root.document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',visibility);
        const mouseDown=e=>{if([0,2].includes(e.button)){yieldForInput();mouseObserved=true;buttons.add(e.button);}},mouseUp=e=>{if([0,2].includes(e.button)){mouseObserved=true;buttons.delete(e.button);schedule();}};
        const key=(e)=>{if(!e.repeat&&!ctx.input.isTyping()&&!stage.config?.isOpen())yieldForInput();if(movementKeys().includes(e.keyCode)){keyboardObserved=true;schedule();}};
        const offDown=ctx.input.onKeyDown(key),offUp=ctx.input.onKeyUp(key);
        root.addEventListener('mousedown',mouseDown,true);root.addEventListener('mouseup',mouseUp,true);
        root.addEventListener('blur',blur);root.addEventListener('focus',focus);
        ctx.onSettingChange(()=>{if(!ctx.settings.grind)release();schedule();});
        function yieldForInput(){if(!executing){release(false);pauseUntil=now()+tick*2;}}
        root.MooMooAutoGrind={release,yieldForInput,status:()=>({enabled:!!ctx.settings.grind,active,attacking,executing,pending:now()<pendingUntil})};
        const offThreat=miscThreats.onChange(schedule);
        const offReload=root.MooMooAutoReload?.onReady(()=>{if(ctx.settings.grind)schedule();});
        ctx.onCleanup(()=>{release();reset();off();offDown();offUp();offThreat();offReload?.();root.removeEventListener('mousedown',mouseDown,true);root.removeEventListener('mouseup',mouseUp,true);root.removeEventListener('blur',blur);root.removeEventListener('focus',focus);root.document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange',visibility);delete root.MooMooAutoGrind;});
    });
})(miscApi,root);


    const combatLoader={gameData:loader.gameData,combat:loader.combat,objects:loader.objects,input,net,get config(){return stage.config;}};
    function combatPlace(ctx,id,angle,restore,replacingSid){
        return ctx.place(id,angle,restore,replacingSid)&&restoreItemWeapon();
    }
    root.MooMooThreats=miscThreats;
    root.MooMooNativeCombat={active:true,version:'1.6'};
function createOpportunityDefense(ctx,root){
    const threat=root.MooMooThreats,tick=ctx.SERVER_TICK||1000/9;
    let trapBurstUntil=0,attacker=null,reason=null;
    const now=()=>root.performance.now();
    const hostile=p=>p&&p.sid!==ctx.self.sid&&p.alive&&p.visible&&p.health>0&&!(ctx.objects.isFriendly(p.sid));
    const spikeExitRemaining=()=>0;
    function danger(){
        reason=null;
        if(!ctx.self.alive)return false;
        if(root.AntimoocheatEquipment.urgent(true)){reason='incoming-burst';return true;}
        return false;
    }
    const reset=()=>{trapBurstUntil=0;attacker=null;reason=null;};
    for(const event of ['setup','reset','died','disconnect'])ctx.on(event,reset);
    return {danger,spikeExitRemaining,status:()=>({reason,attacker,remaining:Math.max(0,trapBurstUntil-now()),spikeExitRemaining:spikeExitRemaining()})};
}

function installPerfectBoostTick(api, root, bridge) {
    'use strict';
    const id = 'perfect-boost-tick';
    if (api.getMods().some(m => m.id === id)) {root.MooMooPerfectBoostTick?.rebind?.(bridge);return;}
    return api.register({id, name: 'Perfect BoostTick', version: '1.0.3', defaultEnabled: true, liveSettings: true,
        settings: [{key: 'key', type: 'key', default: '', label: 'Perfect BoostTick — Polearm + Bow / Crossbow / Repeater',
            hint: 'Bow or Repeater recommended. Hold: aim for 347; ignore decimals and accept 346.xx or 347.xx after settling with Tank + Wooden Wall. Then Turret + ranged shot + Boost, and Bull + Polearm. Restarts the approach if stuck.'}]
    }, ctx => {
        const clock = root.MooMooPrivateBackground?.timers || root;
        const now = () => root.performance.now(), threat = root.MooMooThreats;
        const tick = Math.max(16, ctx.SERVER_TICK || 1000 / 9), minRange = 346, maxRange = 347, targetRange = 347, tolerance = 1;
        let held = false, heldKey = '', timer = null, wakeAt = Infinity, disposed = false, running = false;
        let phase = 'idle', targetSid = null, selected = null, weaponSelected = true, move = null, wireAuto = false;
        let hat = null, hatAt = -Infinity, phaseAt = 0, lastUpdate = now(), lastStep = -Infinity, aimAt = -Infinity, aimed = null;
        let rangedWeapon = null, repeaterSeen = false, repeaterStopped = false, turretSeen = false, primarySeen = false, launch = null, launchRange = null;
        let volleyAt = 0, shotAt = 0, shots = [], completed = 0, lastReason = 'idle', retryAt = 0;
        let stationaryAt = null, stationaryPoint = null, stationarySamples = 0;
        let precision = false, rangeWatch = null, recovery = null, recoveries = 0, rangePulse = null, moveAt = -Infinity;
        const latency = () => Math.min(500,Math.max(0,ctx.net.ping||0));
        const pos = p => threat.position(p), angle = p => Math.atan2(pos(p).y-pos(ctx.self).y,pos(p).x-pos(ctx.self).x);
        const distance = p => Math.hypot(pos(p).x-pos(ctx.self).x,pos(p).y-pos(ctx.self).y);
        let nearestAt=-Infinity,nearestRevision=-1,nearestPlayer=null;
        function nearest(){
            const revision=threat.status().worldRevision;
            if(nearestAt===lastUpdate&&nearestRevision===revision&&nearestPlayer?.alive&&nearestPlayer.visible&&nearestPlayer.health>0&&!ctx.objects.isFriendly(nearestPlayer.sid))return api.player(nearestPlayer.sid)||nearestPlayer;
            const candidates=[...ctx.players.values()].filter(p=>p.alive&&p.health>0&&p.visible&&p.sid!==ctx.self.sid&&!(ctx.objects.isFriendly(p.sid)))
                .map(p=>({player:p,distance:distance(p)})).filter(p=>Number.isFinite(p.distance)).sort((a,b)=>a.distance-b.distance||a.player.sid-b.player.sid);
            nearestAt=lastUpdate;nearestRevision=revision;
            nearestPlayer=candidates.find(p=>bridge.clearPath(p.player)&&bridge.projectileBlock(p.player.sid)==null)?.player||candidates[0]?.player;
            return nearestPlayer;
        }
        const live = () => !disposed && (bridge.enabled?.()??true) && api.isReady() && ctx.self.alive && !root.document.hidden &&
            !automationTyping() && now()-lastUpdate < 1500;
        const ready = w => (root.MooMooAutoReload?.remaining(w) || 0) <= 0 && threat.ready(ctx.self.sid,w);
        const effectiveHat = () => root.AntimoocheatEquipment?.pending(false)?null:ctx.self.hat;
        const setPhase = value => { if (phase !== value) {phase=value;phaseAt=now();} lastReason=value; };
        function send(name,...args) {
            return bridge.atomic(() => ctx.send[name](...args) === true);
        }
        function equip(value) {
            if (value===6&&!ctx.store.ownsHat(6)) value=ctx.self.hat??0;
            if (value!==0&&!ctx.store.ownsHat(value)) return false;
            return effectiveHat() === value || ctx.net.wouldAllowBatch(['c']) && send('store',1,value,false);
        }
        function select(value,isWeapon) {
            return selected === value && weaponSelected === isWeapon || ctx.net.wouldAllowBatch(['z']) && send('selectItem',value,isWeapon);
        }
        function steer(dir) {
            if (dir == null) {
                if (move == null) return true;
                return ctx.net.wouldAllowBatch(['e']) && send('stopMove');
            }
            if (move != null && Math.abs(Math.atan2(Math.sin(move-dir),Math.cos(move-dir))) < .015) return true;
            return ctx.net.wouldAllowBatch(['9']) && send('move',dir);
        }
        function danger() {
            const value=amAttackThreat(threat.snapshot()), risk=threat.breakingPressure(value);
            const factor=(ctx.data.hat(40)?.dmgMult??1)*(ctx.data.accessory(ctx.self.accessory)?.dmgMult??1);
            return ctx.self.hat===45 || threat.selfTrap() || root.AntimoocheatEquipment.urgent(true) ||
                (risk.incomingDamage+risk.spikeDamage)*factor >= ctx.self.health ||
                root.MooMooDefenses?.lethalProjectileThreat?.() === true;
        }
        function release(reason, clearHeld=false) {
            if (clearHeld) {held=false;heldKey='';}
            if (bridge.owns()) bridge.release(reason);
            move=null;setPhase(reason);shots=[];launch=null;repeaterSeen=turretSeen=primarySeen=false;precision=false;rangeWatch=null;recovery=null;
            stationaryAt=null;stationaryPoint=null;stationarySamples=0;rangePulse=null;
        }
        function wake(delay=25) {
            if(disposed||!held)return;
            const due=now()+delay;if(timer!==null&&wakeAt<=due)return;
            if(timer!==null)clock.clearTimeout(timer);wakeAt=due;
            timer=clock.setTimeout(()=>{timer=null;wakeAt=Infinity;run();},delay);
        }
        function blockedPath(enemy) {
            if (!launch) return !bridge.clearPath(enemy) || bridge.projectileBlock(enemy.sid) != null;
            const a=pos(ctx.self),b=pos(enemy),dx=b.x-a.x,dy=b.y-a.y,d=Math.hypot(dx,dy);
            const obstruction=ctx.objects.all().some(o=>{
                if(!o.active||o.fake||o.preplace||o.ignoreCollision&&!o.teleport&&!o.trap&&!o.boostSpeed)return false;

                if(o.id===16&&o.ownerSid===ctx.self.sid&&Math.hypot(o.x-launch.x,o.y-launch.y)<120)return false;
                const along=((o.x-a.x)*dx+(o.y-a.y)*dy)/(d||1);if(along<0)return false;
                const t=Math.min(Math.max(0,d-(ctx.self.scale||35)-(enemy.scale||35)),along);
                return Math.hypot(a.x+dx*t/(d||1)-o.x,a.y+dy*t/(d||1)-o.y)<(ctx.self.scale||35)+(o.getScale?.()??o.scale);
            });
            return obstruction || bridge.projectileBlock(enemy.sid) != null;
        }
        function watchRange(error, observedUpdate, inRange) {
            if (!observedUpdate) return false;
            const at=now(),integerRange=Math.floor(error+targetRange),gap=Math.max(0,minRange-integerRange,integerRange-maxRange),sign=Math.sign(integerRange-targetRange),point=pos(ctx.self);
            if (inRange) return false;
            if (!rangeWatch || rangeWatch.sid!==targetSid || gap>40) {
                rangeWatch={sid:targetSid,at,best:gap,progressAt:at,sign,turns:0,point:{...point},error};return false;
            }
            if (sign && rangeWatch.sign && sign!==rangeWatch.sign) rangeWatch.turns++;
            if (sign) rangeWatch.sign=sign;
            if (gap<rangeWatch.best-.4) {rangeWatch.best=gap;rangeWatch.progressAt=at;}
            rangeWatch.point={...point};rangeWatch.error=error;
            return rangeWatch.turns>=3 || at-rangeWatch.progressAt>1500;
        }
        function recoverRange(enemy,dir,coast,observedUpdate) {
            const at=now();setPhase('range-recovery');
            const fastest=ctx.self.weapons.reduce((a,b)=>(ctx.data.weapon(b)?.spdMult??1)>(ctx.data.weapon(a)?.spdMult??1)?b:a);
            if (!equip(6) || !select(fastest,true)) return;
            const away=dir+Math.PI;
            if (recovery.stage==='step') {
                if (root.MooMooSafewalk?.hazard(away)!=null) {steer(null);lastReason='recovery-blocked';return;}
                if (observedUpdate && ctx.self.hat===(ctx.store.ownsHat(6)?6:(ctx.self.hat??0)) && ctx.self.buildIndex<0) recovery.samples++;
                if (recovery.samples>=1+recoveries%2 || distance(enemy)>=maxRange+20 || at-recovery.at>tick*5) {
                    if (!steer(null)) return;recovery.stage='settle';recovery.samples=0;recovery.point=null;
                } else steer(away);
                return;
            }
            if (!steer(null)) return;
            if (observedUpdate) {
                const point=pos(ctx.self);
                recovery.samples=recovery.point&&Math.hypot(point.x-recovery.point.x,point.y-recovery.point.y)<=.5?recovery.samples+1:0;
                recovery.point={...point};
            }
            if (Math.abs(coast)<.75 && recovery.samples>=2) {
                recovery=null;rangeWatch=null;precision=distance(enemy)<=maxRange+40;lastStep=-Infinity;setPhase('range');
            } else if (at-recovery.at>2000) {release('range-retry');retryAt=at+tick;}
        }
        function reconcileShots() {
            if (!launch) return;
            const points=[launch,pos(ctx.self)];
            for (const s of shots) {
                const gear=s.index===ctx.data.hat(53)?.turret?.proj && s.speed===1.5;
                const offset=gear?0:70;
                if (!gear && s.index!==ctx.data.weapon(rangedWeapon).projectile) continue;
                if (Math.abs(Math.atan2(Math.sin(s.dir-launch.dir),Math.cos(s.dir-launch.dir)))>.35) continue;
                if (!points.some(p=>Math.hypot(s.x-p.x-offset*Math.cos(s.dir),s.y-p.y-offset*Math.sin(s.dir))<55)) continue;
                const other=[...ctx.players.values()].some(p=>p.sid!==ctx.self.sid&&p.alive&&p.visible&&
                    (gear?ctx.data.hat(p.hat)?.turret:ctx.data.weapon(p.weaponIndex)?.projectile===s.index)&&
                    Math.hypot(s.x-pos(p).x-offset*Math.cos(s.dir),s.y-pos(p).y-offset*Math.sin(s.dir))<55);
                if (other) continue;
                if (gear) turretSeen=true; else repeaterSeen=true;
            }
        }
        function run(observedUpdate=false) {
            if (running || disposed || !held) return;
            running=true;
            try {
                if (!live()) {release('inactive',true);return;}
                if (ctx.self.weapons?.[0]!==5 || ![9,12,13].includes(ctx.self.weapons?.[1])) {release('requires-polearm-bow-crossbow-repeater');return;}
                if (!ctx.self.items?.includes(3) || !ctx.self.items?.includes(16)) {release('requires-wooden-wall-boost');return;}
                if (![6,7,40,53].every(h=>ctx.store.ownsHat(h))) {release('requires-owned-gear');return;}
                if (danger()) {release('defense');return;}
                if (now()<retryAt) return;
                const firing=['volley','primary','settle'].includes(phase),secondary=ctx.self.weapons[1];
                if(!firing&&threat.selfTrap()){release('waiting-for-trap-exit');return;}
                if(firing&&secondary!==rangedWeapon){release('loadout-changed');return;}
                const enemy=firing?api.player(targetSid):nearest();
                if (!enemy?.alive || !enemy.visible || enemy.health<=0 || (ctx.objects.isFriendly(enemy.sid))) {release('no-target');return;}
                if (!bridge.claim(enemy.sid)) {setPhase('other-combat');return;}
                if (targetSid!==enemy.sid) {if(move!=null&&!steer(null))return;precision=false;rangeWatch=null;recovery=null;rangePulse=null;stationaryAt=null;stationaryPoint=null;stationarySamples=0;aimed=null;lastStep=-Infinity;}
                targetSid=enemy.sid;bridge.target(targetSid);
                if (!bridge.controls()) {
                    if (!ctx.net.wouldAllowBatch(['e','F',...(wireAuto?['K']:[])])) return;
                    if (!send('stopMove') || !send('mouse',false,angle(enemy)) || wireAuto&&!send('toggle',1)) {release('send-failed');return;}
                    bridge.controlled();
                }
                if (!firing) {
                    if (blockedPath(enemy)) {steer(null);rangeWatch=null;recovery=null;setPhase('blocked-path');return;}
                    const aimDirection=angle(enemy);
                    if((aimed==null||Math.abs(Math.atan2(Math.sin(aimDirection-aimed),Math.cos(aimDirection-aimed)))>.015)&&now()-aimAt>=tick&&ctx.net.wouldAllowBatch(['D'])&&send('aim',aimDirection)){aimed=aimDirection;aimAt=now();}
                    const d=distance(enemy),dir=angle(enemy),sample=threat.velocity(ctx.self);
                    const v=now()-sample.at<=tick*2?sample:{vx:0,vy:0};
                    const decay=Math.pow(ctx.combat?.K?.playerDecel??.993,tick);
                    const coast=(v.vx*Math.cos(dir)+v.vy*Math.sin(dir))*tick*decay/(1-decay);
                    const error=d-targetRange,stoppedError=error-coast,integerRange=Math.floor(d),inRange=integerRange>=minRange&&integerRange<=maxRange;
                    if(!recovery&&d<=maxRange+20&&watchRange(error,observedUpdate,inRange)){
                        stationaryAt=null;stationaryPoint=null;stationarySamples=0;rangePulse=null;
                        recovery={stage:'step',at:now(),samples:0,point:null};recoveries++;rangeWatch=null;
                        recoverRange(enemy,dir,coast,false);return;
                    }
                    if(rangePulse){
                        if(now()<rangePulse.until)return;
                        if(!rangePulse.stopped){if(!steer(null))return;rangePulse.stopped=true;rangePulse.until=now()+latency()+tick;return;}
                        if(now()-moveAt<latency()+tick*2)return;
                        rangePulse=null;
                    }
                    if (recovery && !inRange) {recoverRange(enemy,dir,coast,observedUpdate);return;}
                    if (inRange) {if(recovery){recovery=null;rangeWatch=null;}precision=true;}
                    if (d>maxRange+20) {precision=false;rangeWatch=null;}else precision=true;
                    if (integerRange<=maxRange) precision=true;
                    if (!precision && integerRange>maxRange) {
                        stationaryAt=null;stationaryPoint=null;stationarySamples=0;
                        setPhase('approach');
                        const fastest=ctx.self.weapons.reduce((a,b)=>(ctx.data.weapon(b)?.spdMult??1)>(ctx.data.weapon(a)?.spdMult??1)?b:a);
                        if (!equip(6) || !select(fastest,true)) return;
                        if (now()-lastStep<tick*.85) return;
                        lastStep=now();
                        const projectedCoast=coast+Math.max(0,v.vx*Math.cos(dir)+v.vy*Math.sin(dir))*latency();
                        const direction=Math.floor(d-projectedCoast)>maxRange+20&&root.MooMooSafewalk?.hazard(dir)==null?dir:null;
                        steer(direction);return;
                    }
                    const unloaded=[5,secondary].find(w=>!ready(w));
                    if (unloaded!=null) {steer(null);equip(40);select(unloaded,true);setPhase('reload');return;}
                    const stoppedInRange=inRange&&Math.abs(coast)<2;
                    if (!equip(40) || !select(stoppedInRange?secondary:3,stoppedInRange)) return;
                    setPhase('range');
                    if (inRange) {
                        if (!steer(null)) return;
                        if (Math.abs(coast)>=2 || now()-moveAt<latency()+tick*2) {stationaryAt=null;stationaryPoint=null;stationarySamples=0;return;}
                        if (ctx.self.hat!==40 || !threat.turretReady(ctx.self.sid)) return;
                        if (observedUpdate && stationaryAt!==lastUpdate) {
                            const point=pos(ctx.self);
                            stationarySamples=stationaryPoint?.sid===targetSid&&Math.hypot(point.x-stationaryPoint.x,point.y-stationaryPoint.y)<=2?stationarySamples+1:1;
                            stationaryPoint={...point,sid:targetSid};stationaryAt=lastUpdate;
                        }
                        if (stationarySamples<2) return;
                        const boost=ctx.data.item(16),arrow=ctx.data.weapon(secondary),costs=new Map();
                        for (const req of [boost.req,arrow.req]) for(let i=0;i<(req||[]).length;i+=2) costs.set(req[i],(costs.get(req[i])||0)+req[i+1]);
                        if ([...costs].some(([name,cost])=>ctx.self[name]<cost)) {lastReason='resources';return;}
                        if (!root.MooMooPlacers?.defend(16,[dir],1,false,null,{dryRun:true,interruptManual:true,offsets:[0]})) {lastReason='boost-space';return;}
                        if (!ctx.net.wouldAllowBatch(['D','c','z','F','z','z','F','F','9','F','z','c'])) return;
                        if (!equip(53)) return;
                        rangedWeapon=secondary;launch={...pos(ctx.self),dir};launchRange=d;repeaterSeen=repeaterStopped=turretSeen=primarySeen=false;shots=[];volleyAt=now();
                        setPhase('volley');
                        const ok=bridge.atomic(()=>send('aim',dir)&&ctx.place(16,dir)&&select(rangedWeapon,true)&&send('mouse',true,dir)&&send('mouse',false,dir)&&steer(dir));
                        if (!ok) {retryAt=now()+500;release('send-failed');return;}
                        root.MooMooAutomation?.moduleNotice?.('Perfect BoostTick');
                        return;
                    }
                    stationaryAt=null;stationaryPoint=null;stationarySamples=0;
                    if (now()-lastStep<tick*.85) return;
                    lastStep=now();

                    if(ctx.self.hat!==40||ctx.self.buildIndex!==3){steer(null);return;}
                    if(move!=null){steer(null);return;}
                    if(now()-moveAt<latency()+tick||Math.abs(coast)>.75)return;
                    const correction=d-targetRange;
                    const radial=Math.min(1,Math.max(.12,Math.abs(correction)/6));
                    const offset=Math.abs(correction)<6?Math.acos(radial):0;
                    const base=dir+(correction<0?Math.PI:0);
                    const direction=[base+offset,base-offset].find(a=>root.MooMooSafewalk?.hazard(a)==null);
                    if(direction==null){lastReason='range-blocked';return;}
                    if(steer(direction))rangePulse={until:now()+tick,stopped:false};
                    return;
                }
                reconcileShots();
                const dir=angle(enemy);
                if (phase==='volley') {
                    if (now()-volleyAt>1000) {retryAt=now()+500;release('volley-unconfirmed');return;}
                    if (repeaterSeen&&!repeaterStopped) {if(!send('mouse',false,dir)||!select(5,true))return;repeaterStopped=true;}
                    else if (!repeaterSeen&&(selected!==rangedWeapon || !weaponSelected)) select(rangedWeapon,true);
                    if (blockedPath(enemy)) {release('blocked-path');return;}
                    const pad=ctx.objects.all().find(o=>o.active&&o.id===16&&o.ownerSid===ctx.self.sid&&Math.hypot(o.x-launch.x,o.y-launch.y)<120&&
                        Math.hypot(o.x-pos(ctx.self).x,o.y-pos(ctx.self).y)<(ctx.self.scale||35)+(o.getScale?.()??o.scale));
                    const nextEnemy=threat.predict(enemy,tick),selfPoint=pos(ctx.self),boostTravel=(ctx.data.item(16).boostSpeed||0)*tick;
                    const boosted=pad&&Math.abs(Math.atan2(Math.sin(pad.dir-dir),Math.cos(pad.dir-dir)))<.15&&
                        Math.hypot(nextEnemy.x-selfPoint.x-Math.cos(dir)*boostTravel,nextEnemy.y-selfPoint.y-Math.sin(dir)*boostTravel)<=ctx.data.weapon(5).range+(enemy.scale||35)*1.8;
                    if (repeaterSeen && turretSeen && (distance(enemy)<=ctx.data.weapon(5).range+(enemy.scale||35)||boosted)) {
                        if (!ready(5)||!ctx.net.wouldAllowBatch(['c','z','D','F','F']))return;
                        if (!equip(7)) return;
                        if (!select(5,true)||!send('aim',dir)||!send('mouse',true,dir)||!send('mouse',false,dir)) {release('send-failed');return;}
                        shotAt=now();setPhase('primary');return;
                    }
                    steer(dir);return;
                }
                if (phase==='primary') {
                    if (primarySeen) {
                        if(!send('mouse',false,dir)||!steer(null))return;
                        completed++;setPhase('settle');return;
                    }
                    if (now()-shotAt>Math.max(700,tick*4+(ctx.net.ping||0))) {release('primary-unconfirmed');return;}
                    if (selected!==5 || !weaponSelected) select(5,true);
                    return;
                }
                if (phase==='settle') {
                    if(equip(6)&&now()-phaseAt>=tick*2){release('complete');retryAt=now()+tick;}
                    else if(now()-phaseAt>Math.max(1000,latency()*3+tick*3)){release('defense-return-timeout');retryAt=now()+tick;}
                }
            } finally {running=false;wake();}
        }
        const offSent=api.onSent((name,p)=>{
            if(name==='toggle'&&p.which===1)wireAuto=!wireAuto;
            if(name==='selectItem'){selected=p.index;weaponSelected=!!p.isWeapon;}
            if(name==='store'&&p.action===1&&!p.isAccessory){hat=p.id;hatAt=now();}
            if(name==='move'){move=p.dir;moveAt=now();}
            if(name==='stopMove'){move=null;moveAt=now();}
        });
        const offDown=ctx.input.onKeyDown((event,aliases)=>{
            const key=ctx.input.normKey(ctx.settings.key);
            if(!key||!aliases.includes(key)||event.defaultPrevented||event.repeat||event.ctrlKey||event.altKey||event.metaKey||event.isComposing||!live())return;
            event.preventDefault();event.stopImmediatePropagation();held=true;heldKey=key;lastStep=-Infinity;recoveries=0;run();
        });
        const offUp=ctx.input.onKeyUp((event,aliases)=>{
            if(!heldKey||!aliases.includes(heldKey))return;
            event.preventDefault();event.stopImmediatePropagation();release('cancelled',true);
        });
        ctx.on('playersUpdate',()=>{lastUpdate=now();run(true);});
        ctx.on('projectileAdd',p=>{
            if(!held||phase!=='volley')return;
            const [x,y,dir,,speed,index]=p.args||[];shots.push({x,y,dir,speed,index});if(shots.length>24)shots.shift();wake(1);
        });
        ctx.on('gatherAnimation',p=>{if(phase==='primary'&&p.args?.[0]===ctx.self.sid&&p.args[2]===5){primarySeen=true;wake(1);}});
        const offThreat=threat.onChange(()=>wake(1));
        const reset=()=>{release('reset',true);selected=null;weaponSelected=true;wireAuto=false;hat=null;hatAt=-Infinity;lastUpdate=now();retryAt=0;};
        for(const event of ['setup','reset','disconnect','died'])ctx.on(event,reset);
        const blur=()=>release('inactive',true),hidden=()=>{if(root.document.hidden)blur();};
        root.addEventListener('blur',blur);root.document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',hidden);
        ctx.onSettingChange(()=>release('cancelled',true));
        const controller={run,rebind:value=>{release('cancelled',true);bridge=value;},status:()=>({held,phase,reason:lastReason,targetSid,minRange,maxRange,targetRange,tolerance,recoveries,launchRange,rangedWeapon,rangedSeen:repeaterSeen,repeaterSeen,turretSeen,completed}),stop:()=>release('cancelled',true)};
        root.MooMooPerfectBoostTick=controller;
        ctx.onCleanup(()=>{disposed=true;release('disabled',true);if(timer!==null)clock.clearTimeout(timer);offSent();offDown();offUp();offThreat();root.removeEventListener('blur',blur);root.document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange',hidden);if(root.MooMooPerfectBoostTick===controller)delete root.MooMooPerfectBoostTick;});
    });
}

    (function installBaseClicks(api,root){
    const id='base-clicks';if(api.getMods().some(m=>m.id===id))return;
    api.register({id,name:'Held click equipment',version:'1.2.0',menu:false,defaultEnabled:true},ctx=>{
        const order=[];let hat=null,lastSent=null,disposed=false,engaged=false,lastScan=-Infinity,pendingItem=null,itemUse=false,resumePending=false,resumeQueued=false,lastAim=null,wireAuto=false,itemResumes=0;
        const returnClock=root.MooMooPrivateBackground?.timers||root;
        let returnTimer=null,returnUntil=0,ranged=null;
        let tankPause=null,press=null,releasedSwing=null,heldHat=null,heldRanged=null,accessoryIntent=null;
        function clearReturn(){if(returnTimer!=null)returnClock.clearTimeout(returnTimer);returnTimer=null;returnUntil=0;}
        function wakeReturn(delay){if(returnTimer!=null)returnClock.clearTimeout(returnTimer);returnTimer=returnClock.setTimeout(()=>{returnTimer=null;if(order.length)refreshHeld();else apply();},Math.max(1,delay));}
        function beginReturn(){
            if(tankPause&&!order.length)resumeItemUse();
            if(!engaged&&!press)return;
            const time=now();returnUntil=time+Math.max(2500,4*(ctx.net.ping||0));
            apply();
        }
        const now=()=>root.performance?.now()??Date.now(),pos=p=>root.MooMooThreats?.position(p)||p;
        const busy=()=>root.MooMooCombatMacros?.status().active||root.MooMooCombatDefense?.status().target!=null||root.MooMooActionIntent||root.MooMooPlacers?.status().held.length;
        const item=()=>pendingItem||{index:ctx.self.buildIndex>=0?ctx.self.buildIndex:ctx.self.weaponIndex,isWeapon:!(ctx.self.buildIndex>=0)};
        const heldWeapon=()=>order.includes(2)?(ctx.self.weapons?.[1]??ctx.self.weapons?.[0]):heldRanged!=null&&ctx.self.weapons?.includes(heldRanged)?heldRanged:ctx.self.weapons?.[0];
        function holdWeapon(){
            if(!order.length||root.MooMooCombatMacros?.status().active||root.MooMooCombatDefense?.status().target!=null||root.MooMooActionIntent||!api.isReady()||!ctx.self.alive||ctx.input.isTyping()||stage.config?.isOpen())return;
            const right=order.includes(2),current=item();
            if(!right&&!current.isWeapon)return;
            const id=heldWeapon();
            if(!Number.isInteger(id)||current.isWeapon&&current.index===id)return;
            if(ctx.net.wouldAllowBatch(right?['z']:['D','z'])){
                if(!right){const dir=root.MooMooManualAutoaim?.directionForWeapon?.(id)??root.MooMooFacing?.direction(ctx.input)??ctx.input.aimAngle();if(Number.isFinite(dir)&&ctx.send.aim(dir)!==true)return;}
                ctx.send.selectItem(id,true);
            }
        }
        function rangedTarget(weapon){
            const w=ctx.data.weapon(weapon),shot=w?.projectile==null?null:ctx.data.projectiles[w.projectile];
            if(!shot)return null;
            const me=pos(ctx.self);let best=null;
            for(const p of ctx.players.values()){
                if(p.sid===ctx.self.sid||!p.visible||!p.alive||p.health<=0||ctx.objects.isFriendly(p.sid)||p.team!=null&&p.team===ctx.self.team)continue;
                const q=pos(p),dx=q.x-me.x,dy=q.y-me.y,distance=Math.hypot(dx,dy);
                if(distance>(shot.range||w.range||0)+70+(p.scale||35)||best&&distance>=best.distance)continue;
                // Lead the observed motion by projectile flight time, without a turn/wait stage.
                const v=root.MooMooThreats?.velocity(p)||{},speed=shot.speed||1,flight=Math.max(0,distance-70)/speed;
                const lead=Math.min(700,flight+(ctx.net.ping||0)/2);
                best={sid:p.sid,distance,antiTurret:!!ctx.data.hat(p.hat??p.skinIndex)?.antiTurret,dir:Math.atan2(dy+(v.vy||0)*lead,dx+(v.vx||0)*lead)};
            }
            return best;
        }
        function rangedDirection(){
            if(busy()||!api.isReady()||!ctx.self.alive||ctx.input.isTyping()||stage.config?.isOpen()||(root.document.hidden&&!root.AntimoocheatBots?.background()))return null;
            if(!order.includes(2)&&!(ranged&&press&&!press.sent&&now()<press.until))return null;
            const weapon=order.includes(2)?ctx.self.weapons?.[1]:ranged?.weapon;
            return rangedTarget(weapon)?.dir??null;
        }
        function rangedHat(weapon){
            const target=rangedTarget(weapon);
            if(!target){if(!ranged)return null;ranged.phase='samurai';ranged.target=null;return ctx.store.ownsHat(20)?20:ctx.store.ownsHat(6)?6:0;}
            const ready=root.MooMooThreats?.turretReady(ctx.self.sid)??true;
            const wanted=!target.antiTurret&&target.distance<=(ctx.data.hat(53)?.turret?.range||700)&&ready&&ctx.store.ownsHat(53)?53:ctx.store.ownsHat(20)?20:ctx.store.ownsHat(6)?6:0;
            ranged={weapon,target:target.sid,phase:wanted===53?'turret':'samurai',until:now()+Math.max(800,(ctx.net.ping||0)*2+500)};
            return wanted;
        }
        function rangedReturn(){
            if(!ranged)return false;
            if(busy()||root.AntimoocheatEquipment.urgent()||now()>=ranged.until){ranged=null;return false;}
            // A released short click may still be waiting for equipment / its actual shot.
            if(press&&!press.sent&&now()<press.until){wakeReturn(25);return true;}
            const target=rangedTarget(ranged.weapon),ready=root.MooMooThreats?.turretReady(ctx.self.sid)??true;
            if(ranged.phase==='turret'&&ready&&target&&!target.antiTurret&&target.distance<=(ctx.data.hat(53)?.turret?.range||700)){
                if(equip(53))hat=53;wakeReturn(25);return true;
            }
            if(ctx.store.ownsHat(20)){
                hat=20;if(!root.AntimoocheatEquipment.settled(20)){equip(20);wakeReturn(25);return true;}
            }
            ranged=null;engaged=false;hat=null;clearReturn();return true;
        }
        function pauseTankSwing(weapon){
            if(tankPause||!order.length||busy()||choose()!==40||item().index!==weapon)return;
            if(!ctx.net.wouldAllowBatch(wireAuto?['F','K']:['F']))return;
            const auto=wireAuto;
            if(ctx.send.mouse(false,ctx.input.aimAngle())!==true)return;
            tankPause={auto:auto&&ctx.send.toggle(1)===true};resumePending=true;
        }
        function finishTankPause(){
            if(tankPause?.auto&&!wireAuto&&api.isReady()&&ctx.self.alive&&ctx.send.toggle(1)!==true)return false;
            tankPause=null;return true;
        }
        function resumeItemUse(){
            if(tankPause){
                if(disposed||!api.isReady()||!ctx.self.alive){tankPause=null;return;}
                if(!order.length){if(finishTankPause())resumePending=false;return;}
                if(busy()||!item().isWeapon)return;
                const equipment=root.AntimoocheatEquipment,preferred=choose();
                if(preferred!==null){
                    const wanted=root.MooMooCombatDefense?.manualHat(preferred)??preferred;
                    if(wanted===40&&equipment.returningTankHit()||equipment.owned(wanted)&&!equipment.settled(wanted))return;
                }
                if(!finishTankPause())return;
            }
            if(!resumePending||disposed)return;
            if(!order.length||!api.isReady()||!ctx.self.alive||(root.document.hidden&&!root.AntimoocheatBots?.background())||ctx.input.isTyping()||stage.config?.isOpen()){resumePending=false;return;}
            if(root.MooMooCombatMacros?.status().active||root.MooMooCombatDefense?.status().target!=null||root.MooMooActionIntent)return;
            if(!item().isWeapon)return;
            const right=order.includes(2),weapon=heldWeapon();
            if(!Number.isInteger(weapon))return;
            if(item().index!==weapon){if(!ctx.net.wouldAllowBatch(['z'])||ctx.send.selectItem(weapon,true)!==true)return;}
            const dir=right?(rangedDirection()??ctx.input.aimAngle()):(root.MooMooManualAutoaim?.directionForClick?.(true,true)??ctx.input.aimAngle());
            if(!Number.isFinite(dir))return;
            // A previous sent press does not confirm the server still holds it after item use.
            // resumePending is set once for a completed item batch, and physical release cancels it.
            if(!wireAuto){
                if(!ctx.net.wouldAllowBatch(['F'])||ctx.send.mouse(true,dir)!==true)return;
                itemResumes++;
            }else if(lastAim==null||Math.abs(Math.atan2(Math.sin(dir-lastAim),Math.cos(dir-lastAim)))>.002){
                if(!ctx.net.wouldAllowBatch(['D'])||ctx.send.aim(dir)!==true)return;
            }
            resumePending=false;
        }
        function queueResume(){if(resumeQueued)return;resumeQueued=true;root.queueMicrotask(()=>{resumeQueued=false;resumeItemUse();});}
        function accessoryContext(){
            const config=root.AntimoocheatDefense?.settings;
            if(!config?.distanceAccessory||!["rightBuildingAccessory","leftEnemyAccessory","leftBuildingAccessory","leftAnimalAccessory"].some(key=>Number(config[key])>=0))return null;
            if(busy()||!item().isWeapon||!api.isReady()||!ctx.self.alive||ctx.input.isTyping()||stage.config?.isOpen())return null;
            if(!order.length)return accessoryIntent&&item().index===accessoryIntent.weapon&&now()<accessoryIntent.until?accessoryIntent.key:null;
            const right=order.includes(2),weapon=heldWeapon(),w=ctx.data.weapon(weapon);
            if(!w||w.projectile!=null||w.steal||!w.dmg){accessoryIntent=null;return null;}
            const me=pos(ctx.self),dir=right?ctx.input.aimAngle():(root.MooMooManualAutoaim?.directionForClick?.(true)??ctx.input.aimAngle());
            const reachable=(p,building=false)=>{const at=pos(p),dx=at.x-me.x,dy=at.y-me.y;
                return Math.hypot(dx,dy)<=(w.range||0)+(p.scale||35)*(building?1:1.8)&&Math.abs(Math.atan2(Math.sin(Math.atan2(dy,dx)-dir),Math.cos(Math.atan2(dy,dx)-dir)))<=(ctx.combat?.K?.gatherAngle??Math.PI/2.6);
            };
            let key=null;
            if(!right&&[...ctx.players.values()].some(p=>p.sid!==ctx.self.sid&&p.visible&&p.alive&&p.health>0&&!ctx.objects.isFriendly(p.sid)&&!(p.team!=null&&p.team===ctx.self.team)&&reachable(p)))key='leftEnemyAccessory';
            else if(!right&&(ctx.combat.animals||[]).some(p=>p.active&&p.visible&&p.health>0&&!(p.state&&ctx.data.animal(p.index)?.diver)&&reachable(p)))key='leftAnimalAccessory';
            else if((!right||weapon===10)&&ctx.objects.all().some(p=>p.active&&p.isItem&&!p.fake&&!p.preplace&&!p.dontGather&&p.ownerSid!=null&&reachable(p,true)))key=right?'rightBuildingAccessory':'leftBuildingAccessory';
            accessoryIntent=key?{key,weapon,until:now()+Math.max(600,2*(ctx.net.ping||0)+400)}:null;
            return key;
        }
        function choose(right=order.includes(2),pointer=ctx.input.aimAngle(),weapon=item().index){
            if(busy()||!item().isWeapon||stage.config?.isOpen()||ctx.input.isTyping())return null;
            if(right&&ctx.data.weapon(weapon)?.projectile!=null&&weapon===ctx.self.weapons?.[1])return rangedHat(weapon);
            if(order.length&&heldHat!=null)return heldHat;
            const w=ctx.data.weapon(weapon),self=pos(ctx.self);
            if(!w||w.shield||(!w.dmg&&!w.steal&&w.projectile==null))return null;
            const projectile=w.projectile==null?null:ctx.data.projectiles[w.projectile];
            const enemies=[...ctx.players.values()].filter(p=>p.sid!==ctx.self.sid&&p.visible&&p.alive&&p.health>0&&!(ctx.objects.isFriendly(p.sid))&&!(p.team!=null&&p.team===ctx.self.team));
            const targeting=root.MooMooManualAutoaim;
            const dir=right?pointer:(targeting?.directionForClick?.(order.includes(0)||targeting.status().autohit)??pointer);
            const reachable=(p,building=false)=>{const q=pos(p),dx=q.x-self.x,dy=q.y-self.y,d=Math.hypot(dx,dy),radius=p.scale||35;
                const range=projectile?(projectile.range||w.range||0)+70+radius:(w.range||0)+radius*(building?1:1.8);
                const spread=projectile?Math.asin(Math.min(1,radius/Math.max(1,d))):(ctx.combat?.K?.gatherAngle??Math.PI/2.6);
                return d<=range&&Math.abs(Math.atan2(Math.sin(Math.atan2(dy,dx)-dir),Math.cos(Math.atan2(dy,dx)-dir)))<=spread;
            };
            let choice=null;
            if(!right&&!projectile&&(enemies.some(p=>reachable(p))||!w.steal&&(ctx.combat.animals||[]).some(p=>p.active&&p.visible&&p.health>0&&!(p.state&&ctx.data.animal(p.index)?.diver)&&reachable(p))))choice=7;
            else if(!projectile&&!w.steal&&(ctx.objects.all()||[]).some(o=>o.active&&o.isItem&&!o.fake&&!o.preplace&&!o.dontGather&&o.ownerSid!=null&&reachable(o,true)))choice=40;
            if(order.length&&choice!=null&&ctx.store.ownsHat(choice))heldHat=choice;
            return choice;
        }
        const equip=id=>{
            if(id===6&&!ctx.store.ownsHat(6))id=0;
            const current=root.AntimoocheatEquipment?.pending(false)?null:ctx.self.hat??ctx.self.skinIndex??0;
            if(current===id)return true;
            if(!api.isReady()||!ctx.self.alive||id!==0&&!ctx.store.ownsHat(id))return false;
            return !!ctx.net.wouldAllowBatch(['c'])&&ctx.send.store(1,id,false)===true;
        };
        function armPress(dir){
            if(!order.length||busy()||!item().isWeapon)return null;
            const right=order.includes(2),weapon=heldWeapon();
            const wanted=choose(right,dir,weapon);
            if(wanted==null||!root.AntimoocheatEquipment.owned(wanted))return null;
            press={wanted,weapon,sent:false,until:now()+Math.max(550,2*(ctx.net.ping||0)+400)};
            return press;
        }
        function preparePress(p){
            if(!p)return true;
            if(p!==press||now()>=p.until||busy()||!item().isWeapon||(root.document.hidden&&!root.AntimoocheatBots?.background())||!ctx.self.alive)return false;
            const current=ranged?.weapon===p.weapon?(rangedHat(p.weapon)??(ctx.store.ownsHat(20)?20:p.wanted)):p.wanted;
            const wanted=root.MooMooCombatDefense?.manualHat(current)??current;
            hat=wanted;engaged=true;
            if(!root.AntimoocheatEquipment.settled(wanted)){equip(wanted);return false;}
            return item().index===p.weapon||ctx.net.wouldAllowBatch(['z'])&&ctx.send.selectItem(p.weapon,true)===true;
        }
        function confirmPress(p){
            if(p&&p===press){p.sent=true;p.until=now()+Math.max(350,2*(ctx.net.ping||0)+2*(ctx.SERVER_TICK||111));}
        }
        const apply=()=>{if(!order.length){
            if(rangedReturn())return;
            const until=Math.max(press?.until||0,releasedSwing?.until||0);
            if(now()<until&&!busy()&&!root.AntimoocheatEquipment.urgent()){wakeReturn(Math.min(80,until-now()));return;}
            press=releasedSwing=null;
            if(!engaged)return;
            if(disposed||!api.isReady()||!ctx.self.alive||now()>=returnUntil||root.AntimoocheatEquipment?.manualActive()){
                engaged=false;hat=null;clearReturn();return;
            }
            if(busy()){wakeReturn(100);return;}
            const soldier=ctx.store.ownsHat(6)?6:0;
            if(root.AntimoocheatEquipment?.settled(soldier)){engaged=false;hat=null;clearReturn();return;}
            equip(soldier);wakeReturn(root.AntimoocheatEquipment?.waitMs(soldier,false,'base-clicks')??100);return;
        }if(busy())return;
            const preferred=choose();if(preferred==null)return;
            const value=root.MooMooCombatDefense?.manualHat?.(preferred)??preferred;
            if(value!==0&&!ctx.store.ownsHat(value))return;if(equip(value)){hat=value;engaged=true;}};
        const down=e=>{
            if(e.isTrusted===false||![0,2].includes(e.button)||!e.target?.closest?.('#gameCanvas,#touch-controls-fullscreen')||
                !api.isReady()||!ctx.self.alive||ctx.input.isTyping()||stage.config?.isOpen()||order.includes(e.button))return;
            clearReturn();
            releasedSwing=null;
            if(e.button===0){const selected=item();heldRanged=selected.isWeapon&&ctx.data.weapon(selected.index)?.projectile!=null?selected.index:null;}
            if(e.button===2){hat=null;heldHat=null;ranged=null;}
            order.push(e.button);
            if(e.button===0&&!order.includes(2))root.MooMooCombatDefense?.yieldToLeft();
            lastScan=-Infinity;refreshHeld();
        };
        const up=e=>{
            const i=order.indexOf(e.button);if(i<0)return;
            order.splice(i,1);
            if(e.button===0)heldRanged=null;
            if(!order.length||e.button===2)heldHat=null;
            const weapon=item().index;
            if(!order.length&&engaged&&(hat===7||hat===40)&&item().isWeapon&&amSwingDue(ctx,root,weapon)){
                releasedSwing={weapon,until:now()+(ctx.SERVER_TICK||111)+(ctx.net.ping||0)};
            }
            if(e.button===2&&order.length){hat=null;root.MooMooCombatDefense?.yieldToLeft();}
            holdWeapon();if(order.length)apply();else beginReturn();
        };
        const release=()=>{ranged=null;accessoryIntent=null;press=releasedSwing=heldHat=heldRanged=null;if(!order.length)return;order.length=0;beginReturn();};
        const hidden=()=>{if((root.document.hidden&&!root.AntimoocheatBots?.background()))release();};
        const off=api.onSent((action,p,source)=>{
            if((action==='aim'||action==='mouse')&&Number.isFinite(p.dir))lastAim=p.dir;
            if(action==='toggle'&&p.which===1)wireAuto=!wireAuto;
            if(action==='mouse'&&source==='mod'&&p.down&&pendingItem&&!pendingItem.isWeapon)itemUse=true;
            if(action==='selectItem'){
                pendingItem={index:p.index,isWeapon:!!p.isWeapon,at:now()};
                if(p.isWeapon&&itemUse){itemUse=false;resumePending=order.length>0;queueResume();}
            }
            if(action==='store'&&p.action===1&&!p.isAccessory)lastSent={id:p.id,at:now()};
        });
        ctx.onOutgoing('toggle',(p,info)=>{
            if(tankPause&&info?.source==='client'&&p.which===1){tankPause.auto=!tankPause.auto;return null;}
            return p;
        });
        const reset=()=>{ranged=null;accessoryIntent=null;clearReturn();order.length=0;hat=null;lastSent=null;engaged=false;lastScan=-Infinity;pendingItem=tankPause=press=releasedSwing=heldHat=heldRanged=null;itemUse=resumePending=wireAuto=false;lastAim=null;itemResumes=0;};
        ctx.on('gatherAnimation',p=>{
            if(p.args?.[0]===ctx.self.sid){
                if(!order.length&&accessoryIntent?.weapon===p.args[2])accessoryIntent=null;
                if(press?.sent&&p.args[2]===press.weapon)press=null;
                if(releasedSwing&&p.args[2]===releasedSwing.weapon)releasedSwing=null;
                if(!order.length&&engaged)apply();
            }
        });
        function refreshHeld(){
            if(!order.length||disposed||(root.document.hidden&&!root.AntimoocheatBots?.background())||!api.isReady()||!ctx.self.alive)return;
            const tick=ctx.SERVER_TICK||1000/9;
            if(now()-lastScan>=tick*.9){
                lastScan=now();holdWeapon();apply();resumeItemUse();
                const dir=rangedDirection();
                if(dir!=null&&(lastAim==null||Math.abs(Math.atan2(Math.sin(dir-lastAim),Math.cos(dir-lastAim)))>.002)&&ctx.net.wouldAllowBatch(['D']))ctx.send.aim(dir);
            }
            if(returnTimer==null)wakeReturn(tick);
        }
        ctx.onOutgoing('aim',(p,meta)=>{
            if(meta?.source!=='client'||!order.includes(2))return p;
            const dir=rangedDirection();return dir==null?p:{...p,dir};
        });
        ctx.on('projectileAdd',p=>{
            if(!ranged||p.args?.[5]!==1||p.args?.[4]!==1.5)return;
            root.queueMicrotask(()=>{if(ranged){lastScan=-Infinity;if(order.length)refreshHeld();else apply();}});
        });
        ctx.on('playersUpdate',payload=>{
            const observed=payload.attributes?.find(p=>p.sid===ctx.self.sid);
            if(pendingItem&&observed&&(pendingItem.isWeapon?observed.buildIndex<0&&observed.weaponIndex===pendingItem.index:observed.buildIndex===pendingItem.index))pendingItem=null;
            if(order.length)refreshHeld();else if(engaged)apply();
        });
        for(const event of ['reset','setup','died','disconnect'])ctx.on(event,reset);
        const reconcileButtons=e=>{
            if(!e.isTrusted||!order.length||root.AntimoocheatBots?.child||e.pointerType!=='mouse')return;
            if(order.includes(0)&&!(e.buttons&1))up({button:0});
            if(order.includes(2)&&!(e.buttons&2))up({button:2});
        };
        root.addEventListener('pointermove',reconcileButtons,true);
        root.addEventListener('pointercancel',release,true);
        root.addEventListener('mousedown',down,true);root.addEventListener('mouseup',up,true);root.addEventListener('blur',release);
        root.document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',hidden);
        const bridge={ownsEquipment:()=>order.length>0&&hat!=null&&!busy(),resumeHeld:()=>{resumePending=order.length>0;resumeItemUse();},status:()=>({active:order.length>0,recovering:engaged&&!order.length,returnWaitMs:engaged&&!order.length?root.AntimoocheatEquipment.hatWait():0,button:order.at(-1)??null,secondaryHeld:order.includes(2),primaryHeld:order.includes(0)&&!order.includes(2),hat,observedHat:ctx.self.hat,pendingHat:root.AntimoocheatEquipment?.pending(false)?.id??null,accessory:null,itemResumes,resumePending,ranged:ranged?{weapon:ranged.weapon,target:ranged.target,phase:ranged.phase}:null})};root.MooMooBaseClicks=bridge;
        bridge.rangedDirection=rangedDirection;bridge.accessoryContext=accessoryContext;bridge.armPress=armPress;bridge.preparePress=preparePress;bridge.confirmPress=confirmPress;
        
        bridge.holdingPress=()=>((!!ranged&&now()<ranged.until)||now()<Math.max(press?.until||0,releasedSwing?.until||0))&&!busy();
        bridge.pauseTankSwing=pauseTankSwing;
        bridge.heldHat=()=>order.length?heldHat:null;
        bridge.setRemote=(left,right)=>{
            if(!root.AntimoocheatBots?.child)return;
            for(const button of [0,2]){
                const wanted=button===0?left:right;
                if(wanted&&!order.includes(button))down({button,target:root.document.getElementById('gameCanvas')});
                else if(!wanted&&order.includes(button))up({button});
            }
        };

bridge.primaryHeld=()=>order.includes(0)&&!order.includes(2);
        ctx.onCleanup(()=>{if(disposed)return;release();finishTankPause();disposed=true;off();reset();root.removeEventListener('pointermove',reconcileButtons,true);root.removeEventListener('pointercancel',release,true);root.removeEventListener('mousedown',down,true);root.removeEventListener('mouseup',up,true);
            root.removeEventListener('blur',release);root.document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange',hidden);if(root.MooMooBaseClicks===bridge)delete root.MooMooBaseClicks;});
    });
    if(!api.isModEnabled(id))api.enable(id);
})(miscApi,root);


    (function installManualAutoaim(api,root){
    const id='manual-autoaim';if(api.getMods().some(m=>m.id===id))return;
    api.register({id,name:'Autoaim',version:'1.1.0',defaultEnabled:true,liveSettings:true,settings:[
        {key:'enabled',type:'boolean',default:true,label:'Autoaim',hint:'Left click and E Autohit aim at enemies and animals within weapon reach. Ranged secondary right click aims at the nearest enemy and cycles Turret / Samurai.'}
    ]},ctx=>{
        const buttons=new Set(),background=()=>root.MooMooPrivateBackground?.allowed()===true;
        const now=()=>root.performance?.now()??Date.now(),position=p=>root.MooMooThreats?.position(p)||p;
        let auto=false,item=null,selected=null,blurred=false,owned=false,lastDir=null,targetSid=null,targetType=null,cached=null,cachedAnimals=false,cachedWeapon=null,dirty=true,disposed=false;
        let scans=0,aimSends=0,aimQueued=false;
        const delta=(a,b)=>Math.abs(Math.atan2(Math.sin(a-b),Math.cos(a-b)));
        const live=()=>api.isReady()&&ctx.self.alive&&(!blurred||background())&&(!root.document.hidden||background())&&
            !automationTyping();
        let trappedClick=null,trapPress=null;
        const trapLeft=()=>root.MooMooBaseClicks?.primaryHeld()&&(trappedClick??=!!root.MooMooThreats?.selfTrap());
        const busy=(ownClick=false)=>item!=null||misc.busy(ownClick)||root.MooMooFacing?.locked||root.MooMooCombatMacros?.status().active||
            root.MooMooCombatDefense?.status().target!=null||root.MooMooActionIntent||root.MooMooAutoGrind?.status().active||
            root.MooMooPlacers?.status().held.length;
        const friendly=p=>p.sid===ctx.self.sid||(ctx.objects.isFriendly(p.sid))||(p.team!=null&&p.team===ctx.self.team);
        const animalValid=p=>p?.active&&p.visible&&p.health>0&&!(p.state&&ctx.data.animal(p.index)?.diver);
        const playerValid=p=>p?.visible&&p.alive&&p.health>0&&!friendly(p);
        const currentWeapon=()=>ctx.self.weapons?.includes(selected)?selected:ctx.self.weaponIndex;
        function select(animals,weaponId=currentWeapon()){
            if(!dirty&&cachedAnimals===animals&&cachedWeapon===weaponId){
                if(!cached)return null;
                if(cached.type==='animal'?animalValid(cached.entity):playerValid(api.player(cached.sid)))return cached;
            }
            dirty=false;cached=null;cachedAnimals=animals;cachedWeapon=weaponId;scans++;
            const weapon=ctx.data.weapon(weaponId);
            if(!weapon||weapon.shield||(!weapon.dmg&&!weapon.steal&&weapon.projectile==null))return null;
            const projectile=weapon.projectile==null?null:ctx.data.projectiles[weapon.projectile];
            if(weapon.projectile!=null&&!projectile)return null;
            const self=position(ctx.self);let distance=Infinity;
            const consider=(p,type)=>{const q=position(p),dx=q.x-self.x,dy=q.y-self.y,d=dx*dx+dy*dy;
                const radius=p.scale||35,reach=projectile?(projectile.range||weapon.range||0)+70+radius:(weapon.range||0)+radius*1.8;
                if(Number.isFinite(d)&&reach>0&&d<=reach*reach&&d<distance){distance=d;cached={sid:p.sid,type,entity:p,dir:Math.atan2(dy,dx)};}};
            for(const p of ctx.players.values())if(playerValid(p))consider(p,'player');
            if(animals)for(const p of ctx.combat.animals||[])if(animalValid(p))consider(p,'animal');
            if(cached&&!projectile)cached.dir=root.MooMooThreats.meleeAim(cached.entity,cached.type==='animal');
            return cached;
        }
        function aim(){
            targetSid=null;targetType=null;
            if(trapPress&&!buttons.has(0)){
                const target=api.player(trapPress.sid);
                if(now()<trapPress.until&&live()&&!buttons.has(2)&&!busy(true)&&playerValid(target)){
                    const self=position(ctx.self),p=position(target);targetSid=trapPress.sid;targetType='player';return root.MooMooThreats.meleeAim(target);
                }
                trapPress=null;
            }
            const trapped=trapLeft();
            if(!(ctx.settings.enabled||trapped)||!live()||buttons.has(2)||(!buttons.has(0)&&!auto)||busy(trapped||buttons.has(0)))return null;
            const best=select(!trapped&&(buttons.has(0)||auto));targetSid=best?.sid??null;targetType=best?.type??null;return best?.dir??null;
        }
        function sendAim(dir){
            if(!Number.isFinite(dir)||lastDir!=null&&delta(dir,lastDir)<.002||!ctx.net.wouldAllowBatch(['D']))return false;
            if(ctx.send.aim(dir)===true){aimSends++;return true;}return false;
        }
        function restore(){
            if(!owned)return;
            if(!live()||busy()){owned=false;return;}
            const dir=ctx.input.aimAngle();
            if(lastDir!=null&&Number.isFinite(dir)&&delta(dir,lastDir)<.002||sendAim(dir))owned=false;
        }
        function update(){
            if(disposed)return;const dir=aim();
            if(dir==null){restore();return;}
            if(sendAim(dir))owned=true;
        }
        function refreshAim(){
            dirty=true;trappedClick=null;
            if(disposed||aimQueued||!owned&&!buttons.size&&!auto&&!trapPress)return;
            aimQueued=true;root.queueMicrotask(()=>{aimQueued=false;update();});
        }
        const surface=e=>!!e.target?.closest?.('#gameCanvas,#touch-controls-fullscreen');
        const down=e=>{if(e.isTrusted===false||![0,2].includes(e.button)||!surface(e)||!live())return;buttons.add(e.button);trapPress=null;refreshAim();};
        const up=e=>{buttons.delete(e.button);refreshAim();};
        const blur=()=>{blurred=true;buttons.clear();dirty=true;targetSid=null;targetType=null;trapPress=null;owned=false;};
        const focus=()=>{blurred=false;dirty=true;};
        const visibility=()=>{if(root.document.hidden)blur();else focus();};
        root.addEventListener('mousedown',down,true);root.addEventListener('mouseup',up,true);
        root.addEventListener('blur',blur);root.addEventListener('focus',focus);root.document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',visibility);
        for(const action of ['mouse','aim'])ctx.onOutgoing(action,(payload,info)=>{
            if(info?.source!=='client'||action==='mouse'&&!payload.down&&!trapPress)return payload;
            const dir=aim();if(dir==null)return payload;owned=true;return {...payload,dir};
        });
        const off=api.onSent((action,payload,source)=>{
            if(action==='mouse'&&source==='client'&&payload.down&&trapLeft()&&targetType==='player'&&Number.isFinite(payload.dir)){
                trapPress={sid:targetSid,dir:payload.dir,weapon:currentWeapon(),until:now()+(ctx.net.ping||0)+2*(ctx.SERVER_TICK||1000/9)};
            }
            if(action==='toggle'&&payload.which===1){auto=!auto;refreshAim();}
            if(action==='selectItem'){item=payload.isWeapon?null:payload.index;if(payload.isWeapon)selected=payload.index;dirty=true;}
            if((action==='aim'||action==='mouse')&&Number.isFinite(payload.dir)){
                lastDir=payload.dir;
                if(source==='client'&&action==='mouse'&&!payload.down&&!auto)owned=false;
            }
        });
        ctx.on('playersUpdate',refreshAim);ctx.on('animalsUpdate',refreshAim);
        for(const event of ['objectsLoad','objectKilled','objectsKilled','reset','setup','died','disconnect'])ctx.on(event,()=>{trappedClick=null;});
        for(const event of ['playerAdd','playerRemove','health','team','alliance','tribeSet','tribeMembers'])ctx.on(event,()=>{dirty=true;});
        ctx.on('gatherAnimation',p=>{const [sid,,weapon]=p.args||[];if(sid===ctx.self.sid&&trapPress?.weapon===weapon)trapPress=null;});
        const reset=()=>{buttons.clear();auto=false;item=null;selected=null;cachedWeapon=null;owned=false;lastDir=null;targetSid=null;targetType=null;cached=null;trapPress=null;dirty=true;};
        for(const event of ['reset','setup','died','disconnect'])ctx.on(event,reset);
        ctx.onSettingChange(()=>{dirty=true;if(!ctx.settings.enabled){targetSid=null;targetType=null;restore();}});
        const bridge={facing:aim,directionForWeapon(weapon){
            const trapped=trapLeft();
            if(!(ctx.settings.enabled||trapped)||!live()||buttons.has(2)||busy(true))return null;
            dirty=true;return select(!trapped,weapon)?.dir??null;
        },prepareClick(dir){
            const chosen=aim();if(!Number.isFinite(chosen))return dir;
            if(trapLeft()&&targetType==='player')trapPress={sid:targetSid,weapon:currentWeapon(),until:now()+Math.max(550,2*(ctx.net.ping||0)+400)};
            return chosen;
        },directionForClick:(animals,afterItem=false)=>{const trapped=trapLeft();if(!(ctx.settings.enabled||trapped)||!live()||buttons.has(2)||(!afterItem&&busy(trapped||root.MooMooBaseClicks?.primaryHeld()))||
            afterItem&&(item!=null||root.MooMooFacing?.locked||root.MooMooCombatMacros?.status().active||root.MooMooCombatDefense?.status().target!=null||root.MooMooActionIntent))return null;
            dirty=true;return select(!trapped&&!!animals)?.dir??null;},
            status:()=>({enabled:!!ctx.settings.enabled,held:buttons.size>0,autohit:auto,target:targetSid,targetType,scans,aimSends})};
        bridge.setRemote=(left,right)=>{if(!root.AntimoocheatBots?.child)return;const changed=buttons.has(0)!==left||buttons.has(2)!==right;left?buttons.add(0):buttons.delete(0);right?buttons.add(2):buttons.delete(2);if(changed){blurred=false;dirty=true;refreshAim();}};

root.MooMooManualAutoaim=bridge;
        
        ctx.onCleanup(()=>{restore();disposed=true;reset();off();root.removeEventListener('mousedown',down,true);root.removeEventListener('mouseup',up,true);
            root.removeEventListener('blur',blur);root.removeEventListener('focus',focus);root.document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange',visibility);
            if(root.MooMooManualAutoaim===bridge)delete root.MooMooManualAutoaim;});
    });
})(miscApi,root);


    (function installCombatMacros(api, root) {
    'use strict';
    const background=()=>root.MooMooPrivateBackground?.allowed()===true;
    if (api.getMods().some(m => m.id === 'combat-macros')) return;
    const catalogue = combatLoader?.gameData || root.MooMooGameData;
    if (!catalogue) throw new Error('Combat macros requires the game catalogue');
    const now = () => root.performance?.now() ?? Date.now();
    const menus = ['mainMenu', 'gameSettings', 'chatHolder', 'gameModsBody'];
    const blocked = (ctx,armOnly=false) => !api.isReady() || !ctx.self.alive || root.document.hidden&&!background() || automationTyping() || !armOnly&&!['instakill','oneTick','animalSteal'].includes(state.active?.def.id)&&!root.MooMooAutomation?.status().insta&&root.MooMooDefenses?.protectingBow?.() ||
        menus.some(id => {
            const el=root.document.getElementById(id);return el && !el.hidden && el.getClientRects().length;
        });
    const matches = (ctx,event,aliases,key,armOnly=false) => !event.repeat && !event.defaultPrevented && !event.isComposing &&
        !event.ctrlKey && !event.altKey && !event.metaKey && !blocked(ctx,armOnly) && key && aliases.includes(ctx.input.normKey(key));
    const consume = event => {event.preventDefault();event.stopImmediatePropagation();};
    const state = {weapon:null,move:null,keyboardMove:false,down:false,auto:false,tick:0,order:[],offer:{points:0,age:0},active:null,last:'idle',message:'',armed:{reverse:false,age1Insta:false,katanaInsta:false,boostTick:false}};
    function armVariant(id,value,notify=true){if(state.armed[id]===value)return;state.armed[id]=value;if(notify)root.MooMooAutomation?.moduleNotice?.(({reverse:'Reverse Insta',age1Insta:'Age1 Insta',katanaInsta:'Katana Insta',boostTick:'BoostTick'})[id]+': '+value);}
