    const pendingBuys = new Map();
    let executing=false,comboContext=null,installed=false,rightHeld=false,manualAttackHat=null,manualAimPending=false,manualHeld=false,soldierTimer=null,soldierUntil=0;
    let showNotice=message=>{if(message)root.MooMooAutomation?.moduleNotice?.(message);};
    function reject(reason,message) {state.last=reason;state.message=message;showNotice(message);}
    function owns(ctx,id,tail=false) {return id===0 || (tail?ctx.store?.ownsTail(id):ctx.store?.ownsHat(id));}
    const defenseHat=ctx=>owns(ctx,6)?6:0;
    function gearReady(ctx,ids,tail=false) {
        const missing=[...new Set(ids)].filter(id=>!owns(ctx,id,tail));
        if(!missing.length)return 'ready';
        if(!amSandbox(ctx,root))return 'unowned-gear';
        let points=Number(ctx.self.points)||0;
        for(const request of pendingBuys.values()) if(request.until>now()) points-=request.price;
        for(const id of missing) {
            const key=(tail?'tail:':'hat:')+id,entry=tail?ctx.data.accessory(id):ctx.data.hat(id);
            if(pendingBuys.get(key)?.until>now())continue;
            if(!entry || entry.dontSell || entry.price>points)return 'unowned-gear';
            if(!ctx.net.wouldAllowBatch(['c']) || !ctx.send.store(0,id,tail))return 'budget';
            points-=entry.price||0;
        }
        return 'waiting-for-gear';
    }
    function weapon(ctx) {
        const owned=ctx.self.weapons||[];
        return owned.includes(state.weapon)?state.weapon:owned.includes(ctx.self.weaponIndex)?ctx.self.weaponIndex:owned[0];
    }
    const pointer=ctx=>root.MooMooFacing?.direction(ctx.input)??ctx.input.aimAngle();
    const swingJournal=createSwingJournal(now);
    const targetOf=active=>active?.targetAnimal?(combatLoader.combat?.animals||[]).find(a=>a.sid===active.targetSid):api.player(active?.targetSid);
    const angle=(ctx,weaponId)=>{
        const target=state.active?.targetSid!=null&&targetOf(state.active);
        if(target&&(target.alive||target.isAI&&target.active&&target.health>0)&&target.visible){
            if(state.active.def.id==='spikeSyncHammer'){
                const swing=state.active.waitingSwing;
                if(swing?.sent&&!swing.observed)return swing.dir;
                if(state.active.phase===0&&Number.isFinite(state.active.syncAim))return state.active.syncAim;
            }
            if(state.active.def.id==='spikeContact')return root.MooMooOpportunities?.contactPlan(target.sid)?.angle??state.active.contactDirection;
            if(['bullStrike','animalSteal','autoBullSpam'].includes(state.active.def.id))return root.MooMooThreats.meleeAim(target,!!state.active.targetAnimal);
            const p=root.MooMooThreats?.position(target)||target,self=root.MooMooThreats?.position(ctx.self)||ctx.self;
            if(['instakill','spikeStrike','reverse','age1Insta','katanaInsta'].includes(state.active?.def.id)){
                if(state.active.contactAim&&now()<state.active.contactAim.until)return state.active.contactAim.dir;
                const tick=ctx.SERVER_TICK||1000/9,decay=Math.pow(ctx.combat?.K?.playerDecel??.993,tick);
                const lead=(actor,mult)=>{
                    const q=root.MooMooThreats.predict(actor,tick*mult),p=root.MooMooThreats.position(actor);
                    return {x:q.x-p.x,y:q.y-p.y};
                };
                const a=lead(ctx.self,decay),b=lead(target,1);
                const direct=Math.atan2(p.y-self.y,p.x-self.x),predicted=Math.atan2(p.y+b.y-self.y-a.y,p.x+b.x-self.x-a.x);
                const selected=weaponId??state.active.waitingSwing?.weapon??ctx.self.weapons?.[state.active.stages[state.active.phase]?.slot??0];
                const delta=Math.abs(Math.atan2(Math.sin(predicted-direct),Math.cos(predicted-direct)));
                return ctx.data.weapon(selected)?.projectile==null&&delta>(ctx.combat?.K?.gatherAngle??1.2083)/2?direct:predicted;
            }
            return Math.atan2(p.y-self.y,p.x-self.x);
        }
        return state.active?.dashDirection??pointer(ctx);
    };
    function clearSoldier(){
        if(soldierTimer!=null)(root.MooMooPrivateBackground?.timers||root).clearTimeout(soldierTimer);
        soldierTimer=null;soldierUntil=0;
    }
    function armSoldier(duration){
        const time=now();
        soldierUntil=Math.max(soldierUntil,time+(duration??Math.min(5000,Math.max(2500,(comboContext?.net.ping||0)*2+750))));
        finishSoldier();
    }
    function finishSoldier(){
        const timers=root.MooMooPrivateBackground?.timers||root;
        if(soldierTimer!=null)timers.clearTimeout(soldierTimer);
        soldierTimer=null;const ctx=comboContext,time=now();
        if(!ctx||!api.isReady()||!ctx.self.alive||rightHeld||root.AntimoocheatEquipment.manualActive()||time>=soldierUntil||state.active&&!state.active.finishing){clearSoldier();return;}
        if((!state.active||state.active.finishing)&&root.MooMooBaseClicks?.status().active&&!root.AntimoocheatDefense?.forcedArmor?.()&&!root.MooMooDefenses?.protectingBow?.()){clearSoldier();return;}
        const hat=defenseHat(ctx);
        if(root.AntimoocheatEquipment?.settled(hat)&&!root.AntimoocheatEquipment.pending(false)){clearSoldier();return;}
        if(ctx.net.wouldAllowBatch(['c'])){
            const prior=executing;executing=true;
            try{ctx.send.store(1,hat,false);}finally{executing=prior;}
        }
        const delay=root.AntimoocheatEquipment.waitMs(hat);
        soldierTimer=timers.setTimeout(finishSoldier,Math.max(1,Math.min(delay,soldierUntil-now())));
    }
    let weaponRecovery=null,weaponRecoveryTimer=null;
    function clearWeaponRecovery(){
        if(weaponRecoveryTimer!=null)(root.MooMooPrivateBackground?.timers||root).clearTimeout(weaponRecoveryTimer);
        weaponRecoveryTimer=null;weaponRecovery=null;
    }
    function weaponRecoverySuperseded(){
        return !!(state.active||rightHeld||manualHeld||state.down||root.MooMooBaseClicks?.status().active||
            root.MooMooActionIntent||root.MooMooCombatDefense?.status().target!=null||
            root.MooMooAutoReload?.status().weapon!=null||root.MooMooAutoGrind?.status().active||root.MooMooRangedAutoSync?.status().active);
    }
    function retryWeaponRecovery(){
        weaponRecoveryTimer=null;const job=weaponRecovery,ctx=comboContext;
        if(!job)return;
        if(!ctx||!api.isReady()||!ctx.self.alive||ctx.self.health<=0||now()>=job.until||
            !ctx.self.weapons?.includes(job.weapon)||weaponRecoverySuperseded()){clearWeaponRecovery();return;}
        const selection=root.AntimoocheatActionFlow?.status().selection;
        if(selection&&(!selection.weapon||selection.id!==job.selected&&selection.id!==job.weapon)){clearWeaponRecovery();return;}
        if(ctx.net.wouldAllowBatch(['F','z'])){
            const prior=executing;executing=true;
            try{
                if(ctx.send.mouse(false,job.dir)===true&&ctx.send.selectItem(job.weapon,true)===true){clearWeaponRecovery();return;}
            }finally{executing=prior;}
        }
        if(weaponRecovery===job)weaponRecoveryTimer=(root.MooMooPrivateBackground?.timers||root).setTimeout(retryWeaponRecovery,25);
    }
    function recoverWeapon(weapon,dir){
        clearWeaponRecovery();const ctx=comboContext;
        if(!ctx?.self.weapons?.includes(weapon)||weaponRecoverySuperseded())return;
        const selection=root.AntimoocheatActionFlow?.status().selection;
        weaponRecovery={weapon,dir,selected:selection?.weapon?selection.id:null,until:now()+Math.min(2000,Math.max(500,2*(ctx.net.ping||0)+250))};
        weaponRecoveryTimer=(root.MooMooPrivateBackground?.timers||root).setTimeout(retryWeaponRecovery,25);
    }
    function clearPriority(ctx) {if(ctx)delete ctx.net[Symbol.for('moomoojs.comboPriority')];}
    function clearPhaseTimer(active){
        if(active?.phaseTimer!=null)(root.MooMooPrivateBackground?.timers||root).clearTimeout(active.phaseTimer);
        if(active)active.phaseTimer=null;
    }
    function phaseTimeout(active,reason,ms){
        clearPhaseTimer(active);
        active.phaseTimer=(root.MooMooPrivateBackground?.timers||root).setTimeout(()=>{
            if(state.active===active)cancel(reason);
        },ms);
    }
    function cancel(reason,restore=true) {
        clearWeaponRecovery();
        const ending=state.active,waiting=ending?.waitingSwing;
        if(waiting?.sent&&!waiting.observed)swingJournal.finish(waiting,reason==='primary-unconfirmed'?'unconfirmed':'cancelled',reason);
        if(ending&&root.AntimoocheatCombat?.manualInput)state.down=!!root.AntimoocheatCombat.manualInput().held;
        const resumeBreaker=!!ending&&!['replaced','reset','setup','died','disconnect','manual-override','hat-macro','right-click-tank'].includes(reason)&&root.MooMooCombatDefense?.canResume();
        if(resumeBreaker&&waiting?.observed&&!state.down&&!state.auto)ending.original=waiting.weapon;
        if(reason==='complete'&&restore&&waiting?.observed&&!state.down&&!state.auto&&!root.MooMooBaseClicks?.status().active&&
            root.MooMooAutoReload?.status().enabled&&waiting.weapon===comboContext?.self.weapons?.[0]&&root.MooMooAutoReload.remaining(waiting.weapon)>0)
            ending.original=waiting.weapon;
        // Owned attacks are paired press/release pulses. Once the server reports
        // the swing, no held attack remains to drain before restoring the weapon.
        const active=state.active;state.active=null;state.last=reason;clearPriority(comboContext);
        const retryOpening=active?.lastAttackAt==null&&(
            active?.automatic&&reason==='finisher-priority'||
            (active?.trappedStart||active?.automatic&&active.def.id==='instakill')&&['opening-unavailable','target-lost','defense-priority','defensive-priority','blocked-projectile','shield-facing','spike-path-lost'].includes(reason)||
            active?.def.id==='instakill'&&active.openingWeapon===10&&['opening-unavailable','spike-path-lost'].includes(reason));
        if(active?.automatic&&active.targetSid!=null&&!['complete','cancelled','replaced','reset','setup','died','disconnect'].includes(reason))root.MooMooThreats?.recordFailure(active.def.id,active.targetSid,reason);
        if(active?.automatic&&Object.hasOwn(state.armed,active.def.id)&&active.sent&&!retryOpening&&reason!=='replaced')armVariant(active.def.id,false);
        if(active?.timeout!=null)(root.MooMooPrivateBackground?.timers||root).clearTimeout(active.timeout);
        clearPhaseTimer(active);
        if(active?.swingWake!=null)(root.MooMooPrivateBackground?.timers||root).clearTimeout(active.swingWake);
        if(active?.tickWake!=null)(root.MooMooPrivateBackground?.timers||root).clearTimeout(active.tickWake);
        if(active?.selectionWake!=null)(root.MooMooPrivateBackground?.timers||root).clearTimeout(active.selectionWake);
        if(active?.breakWake!=null)(root.MooMooPrivateBackground?.timers||root).clearTimeout(active.breakWake);
        if(active?.equipmentWake!=null)(root.MooMooPrivateBackground?.timers||root).clearTimeout(active.equipmentWake);
        if(active?.progressWake!=null)(root.MooMooPrivateBackground?.timers||root).clearTimeout(active.progressWake);
        clearSoldier();
        if(active?.def.id!=='dragonPrime'&&!active?.transferToTurret&&(active?.sent||active?.requestedHat||active?.preparedEquipment)&&!(active.transferToBreak&&resumeBreaker)&&comboContext&&api.isReady()&&comboContext.self.alive&&
            !['reset','setup','died','disconnect','manual-override','hat-macro','right-click-tank','replaced'].includes(reason)){
            armSoldier();
        }
        if(active?.targetSid!=null&&!restore&&reason==='complete'&&comboContext&&api.isReady()&&comboContext.self.alive){
            const dir=angle(comboContext);comboContext.send.aim(dir);if(state.down)comboContext.send.mouse(true,dir);
        }


        if(active?.waitingSwing&&!active.waitingSwing.observed&&reason==='manual-override'&&comboContext&&api.isReady()&&comboContext.self.alive){
            executing=true;
            try{if(comboContext.send.mouse(state.down,angle(comboContext))!==true)state.last='cleanup-failed';}
            catch(_){state.last='cleanup-failed';}finally{executing=false;}
        }
        if(active && restore && comboContext && api.isReady() && comboContext.self.alive && (active.sent||active.preparedSelection)) {
            const ctx=comboContext,dir=angle(ctx),owned=ctx.self.weapons||[];
            executing=true;
            try {
                const stopped=ctx.send.mouse(false,dir);
                if(active.targetSid!=null)ctx.send.aim(dir);
                const restored=owned.includes(active.original)?ctx.send.selectItem(active.original,true):false;
                if(stopped && restored && state.down)ctx.send.mouse(true,dir);
                else if((!stopped||!restored)&&owned.includes(active.original))recoverWeapon(active.original,dir);
            } catch (_) {state.last='cleanup-failed';} finally {executing=false;}
        }
        if(active?.def.id==='instakill'&&reason!=='replaced'&&!retryOpening&&!(active.automatic&&reason==='no-stack-contact'))root.MooMooAutomation?.completeInsta(reason,active.hammerSpike);
        if(active?.controls&&comboContext&&api.isReady()&&comboContext.self.alive&&
            !['reset','setup','died','disconnect','replaced'].includes(reason)){
            const resume=['lethal-spike-combo','complete','target-lost','disabled','cancelled','no-stack-contact','spike-path-lost','stick-unavailable'].includes(reason)||active.def.id==='oneTick';
            const input=comboContext.input,pressed=(a,b)=>input.isDown(a)||input.isDown(b);
            const x=Number(pressed('d','arrowright'))-Number(pressed('a','arrowleft')),y=Number(pressed('s','arrowdown'))-Number(pressed('w','arrowup'));
            const safe=root.MooMooSafewalk,dir=resume?(state.keyboardMove?(x||y?Math.atan2(y,x):null):state.move):null;
            if(!active.preserveMovement){
                if(Number.isFinite(dir)&&!(safe?.status().enabled&&safe.hazard(dir)!=null))comboContext.send.move(dir);
                else comboContext.send.stopMove();
            }
            if(resume&&!!state.wireAuto!==!!state.auto){executing=true;try{comboContext.send.toggle(1);}finally{executing=false;}}
        }
        if(resumeBreaker)root.MooMooCombatDefense.resumeAfterCombo();
    }
    const offSent=api.onSent((action,payload,source)=>{
        if(action==='store'&&payload.action===0){
            const tail=!!payload.isAccessory,key=(tail?'tail:':'hat:')+payload.id;
            const entry=tail?catalogue.accessory(payload.id):catalogue.hat(payload.id);
            const delay=Math.min(30000,(pendingBuys.get(key)?.delay||750)*2);
            if(entry)pendingBuys.set(key,{price:entry.price,until:now()+delay,delay});
        }
        if(action==='store'&&payload.action===1&&!payload.isAccessory&&payload.id!==(comboContext?defenseHat(comboContext):0)&&soldierUntil>0)clearSoldier();
        if(action==='toggle'&&payload.which===1)state.wireAuto=!state.wireAuto;
        if(executing)return;
        if(weaponRecovery&&['selectItem','mouse','toggle'].includes(action))clearWeaponRecovery();
        if(action==='aim'&&source==='mod'&&state.active?.targetSid!=null){
            const owner=state.active;root.queueMicrotask(()=>{if(state.active!==owner||!comboContext)return;executing=true;try{comboContext.send.aim(angle(comboContext));}finally{executing=false;}});
        }
        if(action==='mouse' && source!=='mod')state.down=!!payload.down;
        if(source==='client'&&(action==='move'||action==='stopMove'))state.move=action==='move'&&Number.isFinite(payload.dir)?payload.dir:null;
        if(action==='selectItem' && payload.isWeapon)state.weapon=payload.index;
        if(action==='toggle'&&payload.which===1&&source==='client')state.auto=!state.auto;

        if(source!=='mod' && state.active && (action==='selectItem'||action==='store'))cancel('manual-override',false);
    });
    const offState=api.on('*',(event,payload)=>{
        if(['reset','setup','died','disconnect'].includes(event)) {
            for(const id of Object.keys(state.armed))armVariant(id,false,false);
            primaryReloadReservation=null;cancel(event,false);pendingBuys.clear();state.weapon=null;state.move=null;state.keyboardMove=false;state.down=false;state.auto=false;state.wireAuto=false;state.order=[];state.offer={points:0,age:0};
        }
        if(event==='upgrades')state.offer={points:payload.points,age:payload.age};
        if(event==='storeUpdate'&&payload.args?.[0]===0)pendingBuys.delete((payload.args[2]?'tail:':'hat:')+payload.args[1]);
    });
    const offRemoved=api.onModsChanged(mods=>{
        if(!installed)return;
        if(mods.some(m=>m.id==='combat-macros'))return;
        cancel('removed');offSent();offState();offRemoved();pendingBuys.clear();delete root.MooMooCombatMacros;
    });

    const tailKeys=[];
    api.register({id:'combat-input',name:'Combat Input',version:'0.1.0',defaultEnabled:true,
        description:'Manual shop and key selections share the equipment queue and keep the latest choice for each slot. Only Sandbox buys affordable missing gear, then equips it after ownership confirmation.',
        settings:[
            /* Equipment bindings remain in the existing gear-keybinds module. */]
    },ctx=>{
        let pending=null;
        const shopOrder=[
            ['Monkey Tail',true],['Soldier Helmet'],['Flipper Hat'],['Winter Cap'],['Booster Hat'],
            ['Tank Gear'],['Bull Helmet'],['Turret Gear'],['Blockades',true],['Shadow Wings',true],
            ['Corrupt X Wings',true],['Spike Gear'],['Blood Wings',true]
        ].map(([name,tail=false])=>({item:tail?catalogue.accessoryByName(name):catalogue.hatByName(name),tail}));
        function autoShop(){
            if(!root.AntimoocheatCombat?.settings.autoShop||!amSandbox(ctx,win)||!available())return;
            const next=shopOrder.find(({item,tail})=>item&&!owns(ctx,item.id,tail));
            if(next)gearReady(ctx,[next.item.id],next.tail);
        }
        ctx.every(250,autoShop);
        const queueManual=(id,tail)=>{
            if(blocked(ctx)||state.active||rightHeld)return;
            if(!tail)clearSoldier();
            root.AntimoocheatEquipment.requestManual(ctx.send.store,id,tail,'combat-input');
        };
        const mouseButtons=new Set();
        const gameSurface=event=>!event.target||!!event.target.closest?.('#gameCanvas,#touch-controls-fullscreen');
        const mouseDown=event=>{
            if(event.isTrusted===false||![0,2].includes(event.button)||event.defaultPrevented||!gameSurface(event)||blocked(ctx))return;
            mouseButtons.add(event.button);manualHeld=mouseButtons.size>0;
        };
        const mouseUp=event=>{mouseButtons.delete(event.button);manualHeld=mouseButtons.size>0;};
        const blur=()=>{mouseButtons.clear();manualHeld=false;manualAimPending=false;};
        const hidden=()=>{if(root.document.hidden)blur();};
        root.addEventListener('mousedown',mouseDown,true);root.addEventListener('mouseup',mouseUp,true);
        root.addEventListener('blur',blur);root.document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',hidden);
        const attempt=()=>{
            if(!pending)return;
            if(blocked(ctx)||now()>pending.until){pending=null;return;}
            const {id,tail}=pending;
            if(gearReady(ctx,[id],tail)!=='ready')return;
            pending=null;queueManual(id,tail);
        };
        const off=ctx.input.onKeyDown((event,aliases)=>{
            if(state.active)return;
            for(const tail of [true])for(const entry of tailKeys) {
                if(!matches(ctx,event,aliases,ctx.settings[(tail?'tail':'hat')+entry.id]))continue;
                consume(event);cancel('hat-macro');pending={id:entry.id,tail,until:now()+1500};attempt();return;
            }
        });
        ctx.on('storeUpdate',attempt);ctx.on('playersUpdate',attempt);
        for(const event of ['reset','setup','died','disconnect'])ctx.on(event,()=>{pending=null;blur();});
        ctx.onCleanup(()=>{pending=null;blur();off();root.removeEventListener('mousedown',mouseDown,true);root.removeEventListener('mouseup',mouseUp,true);
            root.removeEventListener('blur',blur);root.document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange',hidden);});
    });

    const attack=(hat,slot,place)=>({hat,slot,attack:true,place});
    const definitions=[
        {id:'instakill',name:'Instakill',key:'r',hats:[7,53],slots:[0,1],stages:[attack(7,0),attack(53,1),{slot:0}]},

        {id:'oneTick',name:'OneTick',hats:[53,7],slots:[0],stages:[{hat:53},attack(7,0)]},

After the observed swing: Turret, then owned Soldier. Waits for weapon reload; uses affordable spike capacity and native placement rules.'},

Bull hit, upgrade + Bull + optional contact spike, then Turret. Pot damage does not block this combo.'},

Bull hit, upgrade + Bull + optional contact spike, then Turret. Pot damage does not block this combo.'},
