    const findItem=(ctx,group)=>(ctx.self.items||[]).map(id=>ctx.data.item(id)).find(item=>item?.group?.name===group);
    function canUse(ctx,item,count=1) {
        if(!item)return false;
        const limit=ctx.combat?.sandbox?item.group.sandboxLimit||Math.max(item.group.limit*3,99):item.group.limit;
        if(limit && (ctx.objects?.itemCount(item.group.id)??ctx.self.itemCounts?.[item.group.id]??0)+count>limit)return false;
        if(ctx.combat?.sandbox)return true;
        for(let i=0;i<item.req.length;i+=2)if((ctx.self[item.req[i]]||0)<item.req[i+1]*count)return false;
        return true;
    }
    function dashWeapon(ctx){
        const item=findItem(ctx,'booster');if(!item||!canUse(ctx,item)||!owns(ctx,40))return null;
        const known=root.MooMooThreats?.observedWeapons(ctx.self.sid)||[];
        const inventory=ctx.self.weapons||[],candidates=[10,inventory[0]].filter((id,i,list)=>inventory.includes(id)&&list.indexOf(id)===i);
        return candidates.find(id=>{
            const w=ctx.data.weapon(id);if(!(w?.dmg>0)||w.projectile!=null)return false;
            const observed=ctx.self.weaponIndex===id?(ctx.self.weaponVariant??ctx.self.variant):known.find(w=>w.id===id)?.variant;
            const xp=(ctx.combat.K?.weaponVariants||[]).filter(v=>(ctx.self.weaponXP?.[id]||0)>=v.xp).at(-1)?.id||0;
            const variant=Math.max(observed??0,xp),damage=w.dmg*(w.sDmg||1)*([1,1.1,1.18,1.18,1.18][variant]||1)*(ctx.data.hat(40)?.bDmg||1);
            return damage>=(item.health||Infinity);
        })??null;
    }
    function upgradeEligible(ctx,id) {
        const data=ctx.data.weapon(id),owned=ctx.self.weapons||[];
        return data && state.offer.points>0 && state.offer.age===data.age && !owned.includes(id) &&
            (data.pre==null || owned.includes(data.pre));
    }
    function upgradeInstaRange(ctx,target){
        const first=ctx.data.weapon(ctx.self.weapons?.[0]),spike=findItem(ctx,'spikes')||ctx.data.item(6),threat=root.MooMooThreats;
        if(!first||!spike||!target)return false;
        const body=target.scale||35,placement=(ctx.self.scale||35)+spike.scale+(spike.placeOffset||0);
        const contact=placement+spike.scale+body-2,knockback=(.3*(target.weightM||1)+(first.knock||0))*(ctx.SERVER_TICK||1000/9);
        const limit=Math.min(first.range+body*1.8,contact-knockback);
        const from=threat.position(ctx.self),to=threat.position(target),future=threat.predict(target,ctx.SERVER_TICK||1000/9);
        return Math.max(Math.hypot(to.x-from.x,to.y-from.y),Math.hypot(future.x-from.x,future.y-from.y))<=limit;
    }
    function boostDirection(ctx,target){
        const a=root.MooMooThreats.position(ctx.self),b=root.MooMooThreats.position(target);
        return Math.atan2(b.y-a.y,b.x-a.x);
    }
    function boostClear(ctx,target){
        if(!target)return false;const threat=root.MooMooThreats,a=threat.position(ctx.self),b=threat.position(target),dx=b.x-a.x,dy=b.y-a.y,d=Math.hypot(dx,dy);
        if(!d)return false;const length=Math.max(0,d-(ctx.self.scale||35)-(target.scale||35)),ux=dx/d,uy=dy/d;
        return !(ctx.objects?.all()||[]).some(o=>{
            if(!o.active||o.fake||o.preplace||o.ignoreCollision&&!o.teleport&&!o.trap&&!o.boostSpeed)return false;
            const along=(o.x-a.x)*ux+(o.y-a.y)*uy;if(along<0)return false;
            const t=Math.min(length,along),radius=(ctx.self.scale||35)+(o.getScale?.()??o.scale);
            return Math.hypot(a.x+ux*t-o.x,a.y+uy*t-o.y)<radius;
        });
    }
    function trapped(ctx,target) {
        if(!target||ctx.data.hat(target.hat??target.skinIndex)?.noTrap)return null;
        const p=root.MooMooThreats?.position(target)||target;
        return (ctx.objects?.all()||[]).find(o=>o.active&&!o.fake&&!o.preplace&&o.trap&&o.ownerSid!=null&&o.ownerSid!==target.sid&&
            !(target.team!=null&&api.player(o.ownerSid)?.team===target.team)&&Math.hypot(o.x-p.x,o.y-p.y)<=(target.scale||35)+(o.getScale?.()??o.scale)+1e-7)||null;
    }
    const hammerInstaProtected=(hat,spike)=>hat===61||!spike&&(hat===6||hat===60);
    function instaBlocked(ctx,targetSid,ignoreSecondary=false,committed=false,hammerSpike=false) {
        const target=api.player(targetSid);if(!target?.alive||!target.visible)return 'target-lost';
        const hat=target.hat??target.skinIndex;
        if(!committed&&!ignoreSecondary&&ctx.self.weapons?.[1]===10&&hammerInstaProtected(hat,hammerSpike))return 'waiting-for-unarmored-target';
        const self=root.MooMooThreats?.position(ctx.self)||ctx.self,p=root.MooMooThreats?.position(target)||target;
        const dir=Math.atan2(p.y-self.y,p.x-self.x),toward=Math.atan2(self.y-p.y,self.x-p.x);
        const facing=target.d2??target.dir;
        if(ctx.data.weapon(target.weaponIndex)?.shield&&Number.isFinite(facing)&&Math.abs(Math.atan2(Math.sin(toward-facing),Math.cos(toward-facing)))<=(ctx.combat.K?.shieldAngle??Math.PI/3))return 'shield-facing';
        const secondary=ctx.data.weapon(ctx.self.weapons?.[1]);if(ignoreSecondary||secondary?.projectile==null)return null;
        const shot=ctx.data.projectiles[secondary.projectile],dx=Math.cos(dir),dy=Math.sin(dir),muzzle=2*(ctx.self.scale||35);
        const start={x:self.x+muzzle*dx,y:self.y+muzzle*dy},mult=ctx.data.hat(53)?.aMlt||1;
        const range=shot.range*mult,step=shot.speed*mult*(ctx.SERVER_TICK||1000/9);
        const entry=(point,radius)=>{
            let low=0,high=range;
            for(const axis of ['x','y']){
                const delta=axis==='x'?dx:dy,offset=point[axis]-start[axis];
                if(Math.abs(delta)<1e-9){if(Math.abs(offset)>radius)return Infinity;continue;}
                const a=(offset-radius)/delta,b=(offset+radius)/delta;
                low=Math.max(low,Math.min(a,b));high=Math.min(high,Math.max(a,b));
                if(low>high)return Infinity;
            }
            return low;
        };
        const targetEntry=entry(p,target.scale||35);
        if(!Number.isFinite(targetEntry))return 'blocked-projectile';
        const slice=d=>Math.max(0,Math.ceil(d/step)-1),targetSlice=slice(targetEntry),targetDistance=Math.hypot(p.x-start.x,p.y-start.y);
        const layer=ctx.self.zIndex||shot.layer||0;
        for(const o of ctx.objects?.all()||[]){
            if(!o.active||o.fake||o.preplace||o.ignoreCollision||(o.layer||0)<layer)continue;
            const hit=entry(o,o.getScale?.()??o.scale);
            if(!Number.isFinite(hit))continue;
            const obstacleSlice=slice(hit);
            if(obstacleSlice<targetSlice||obstacleSlice===targetSlice&&Math.hypot(o.x-start.x,o.y-start.y)<targetDistance)return 'blocked-projectile';
        }
        return null;
    }
    function freeSpikeAngle(ctx,item,dir,target=null,choose=null,forward=false,ignoreSid=null,trapSync=false) {
        const p=root.MooMooThreats?.position(ctx.self)||ctx.self,radius=(ctx.self.scale||35)+item.scale+(item.placeOffset||0);
        const nearby=root.AntimoocheatBasePlacement?.nearby?.(item.id)||(ctx.objects?.all()||[]).filter(o=>o.active&&!o.fake&&!o.preplace&&Math.hypot(o.x-p.x,o.y-p.y)<=radius+item.scale+(o.blocker||(o.getScale?.(.6,o.isItem)??o.scale)));
        const clearance=trapSync?1:0;
        const world=nearby.filter(o=>o.sid!==ignoreSid).map(o=>({x:o.x,y:o.y,r2:Math.pow(clearance+item.scale+(o.blocker||(o.getScale?.(.6,o.isItem)??o.scale)),2)})),pending=root.MooMooPlacers?.attempts()||[];
        const tp=target&&(root.MooMooThreats?.position(target)||target);
        const contact=tp&&!choose?{x:tp.x,y:tp.y,radius:item.scale+(target.scale||35)-2}:null;
        const planner=root.AntimoocheatBasePlacement;
        const ring=trapSync?planner?.combatAngles(item,dir,ignoreSid,contact):null;
        const angles=(ring??root.MooMooPlacers?.angles(item.id,dir,{ignoreSid,contact})??[]).map(a=>a-dir);
        if(choose)angles.push(0,...Array.from({length:36},(_,i)=>[(i+1)*Math.PI/36,-(i+1)*Math.PI/36]).flat());
        if(tp){
            const d=Math.hypot(tp.x-p.x,tp.y-p.y),reach=item.scale+(target.scale||35)-1;
            if(d>0&&d<=radius+reach&&d+reach>=radius){
                const center=Math.atan2(tp.y-p.y,tp.x-p.x)-dir,half=Math.acos(Math.max(-1,Math.min(1,(radius*radius+d*d-reach*reach)/(2*radius*d))));
                angles.push(center,center-half+.002,center+half-.002,center-half/2,center+half/2);
            }
        }
        const choices=[],seen=new Set();
        for(const offset of angles){
            const key=Math.round(Math.atan2(Math.sin(offset),Math.cos(offset))*1e8);if(seen.has(key))continue;seen.add(key);
            if(forward&&!target&&Math.abs(Math.atan2(Math.sin(offset),Math.cos(offset)))>Math.PI/4)continue;
            const angle=dir+offset,x=p.x+Math.cos(angle)*radius,y=p.y+Math.sin(angle)*radius;
            if(tp&&!choose&&Math.hypot(x-tp.x,y-tp.y)>item.scale+(target.scale||35)-2)continue;
            if(!Number.isFinite(x)||!Number.isFinite(y)||x<0||x>14400||y<0||y>14400||!ctx.combat?.sandbox&&Math.abs(y-7200)<=362)continue;
            if(world.some(o=>{const dx=o.x-x,dy=o.y-y;return dx*dx+dy*dy<o.r2;}))continue;
            if(pending.some(o=>Math.hypot(o.x-x,o.y-y)<item.scale+(ctx.data.item(o.itemId)?.scale||item.scale)))continue;
            if(!choose)return angle;
            choices.push({angle,x,y});
        }
        return choose?choose(choices):null;
    }
    function hammerFollowupReady(ctx,targetSid,needsSpike,replacingSid=null,pairedSpike=false){
                const target=api.player(targetSid),item=needsSpike&&findItem(ctx,'spikes'),primary=ctx.data.weapon(ctx.self.weapons?.[0]);if(!target||!primary||needsSpike&&(!item||!canUse(ctx,item)))return false;
                const threat=root.MooMooThreats,p=threat.position(ctx.self),e=threat.position(target),dir=Math.atan2(e.y-p.y,e.x-p.x),tick=ctx.SERVER_TICK||1000/9;
                const selfTrapped=!!trapped(ctx,ctx.self),enemyTrapped=!!trapped(ctx,target);
                const sync=replacingSid!=null,v=threat.velocity(target),fresh=now()-v.at<=tick*2,turret=!sync&&owns(ctx,53)&&threat.turretReady(ctx.self.sid)!==false?0.3:0;
                const impulse=.3*(target.weightM||1)+(ctx.data.weapon(10).knock||0),decay=Math.pow(ctx.combat?.K?.playerDecel??.993,tick),sv=threat.velocity(ctx.self);
                const vx=!enemyTrapped&&fresh?v.vx*decay:0,vy=!enemyTrapped&&fresh?v.vy*decay:0,sx=!selfTrapped&&now()-sv.at<=tick*2?sv.vx*decay:0,sy=!selfTrapped&&now()-sv.at<=tick*2?sv.vy*decay:0;
                const ownOrder=state.order.indexOf(ctx.self.sid),enemyOrder=state.order.indexOf(target.sid);
                const orders=ownOrder>=0&&enemyOrder>=0?[enemyOrder<ownOrder]:[false,true];
                for(const enemyFirst of orders){
                    const before=enemyTrapped||enemyFirst?0:impulse,after=!enemyTrapped&&enemyFirst?impulse:0;
                    const self={x:p.x+sx*tick,y:p.y+sy*tick,vx:sx*decay,vy:sy*decay,scale:ctx.self.scale||35,sid:ctx.self.sid,team:ctx.self.team};
                    const enemy={x:e.x+(vx+Math.cos(dir)*before)*tick,y:e.y+(vy+Math.sin(dir)*before)*tick,vx:(vx+Math.cos(dir)*before)*decay+Math.cos(dir)*(after+turret),vy:(vy+Math.sin(dir)*before)*decay+Math.sin(dir)*(after+turret),scale:target.scale||35,sid:target.sid,team:target.team};
                    if(!needsSpike){
                        const targetStep=enemyFirst&&!enemyTrapped?tick:0,selfStep=selfTrapped?0:tick;
                        if(Math.hypot(enemy.x+enemy.vx*targetStep-self.x-self.vx*selfStep,enemy.y+enemy.vy*targetStep-self.y-self.vy*selfStep)>primary.range+enemy.scale*1.8-1)return false;
                        continue;
                    }
                    const plan=contactSpikePlan(ctx,item,target,ctx.self.weapons[0],dir,true,sync?false:'prefer-target',pairedSpike?'paired-spike':'received',{self,enemy},null,false,sync,replacingSid);
                    if(!plan||!sync&&!nativePlacementCheck(ctx,item.id,plan.angle))return false;
                }
                return true;
    }
    const hammerInstaSpikeReady=(ctx,sid,replacingSid=null)=>hammerFollowupReady(ctx,sid,true,replacingSid);
    function canSpikeAt(ctx,targetSid) {
        const item=findItem(ctx,'spikes'),target=api.player(targetSid);
        if(!item||!canUse(ctx,item)||!target?.alive||!target.visible)return false;
        const self=root.MooMooThreats?.position(ctx.self)||ctx.self,p=root.MooMooThreats?.position(target)||target;
        if(ctx.self.weapons?.[1]===10)return hammerInstaSpikeReady(ctx,targetSid);
        if([11,14].includes(ctx.self.weapons?.[1])){
            const plan=contactSpikePlan(ctx,item,target,ctx.self.weapons[0],Math.atan2(p.y-self.y,p.x-self.x),true,true,true);
            return !!plan&&!!root.MooMooPlacers?.defend(item.id,[plan.angle],1,false,null,{dryRun:true,interruptManual:true});
        }
        return freeSpikeAngle(ctx,item,Math.atan2(p.y-self.y,p.x-self.x),target)!==null;
    }
    function spikeSyncPlan(ctx,targetSid,ignoreReload=false,expectedTrap=null){
        const target=api.player(targetSid),primary=ctx.self.weapons?.[0],item=findItem(ctx,'spikes'),hammer=ctx.data.weapon(10),threat=root.MooMooThreats;
        if(!target?.alive||!target.visible||target.health<=0||(ctx.objects.isFriendly(target.sid))||ctx.self.weapons?.[1]!==10||![4,5].includes(primary)||!owns(ctx,40)||!owns(ctx,7)||!item||!canUse(ctx,item))return null;
        const ready=id=>root.MooMooAutoReload?.ready(id)??threat.ready(ctx.self.sid,id);
        if(!ignoreReload&&(!ready(10)||!ready(primary))||threat.distance(ctx.self,target)>hammer.range+(target.scale||35)*1.8)return null;
        const variant=threat.observedWeapons(ctx.self.sid).find(w=>w.id===10)?.variant??(ctx.self.weaponIndex===10?ctx.self.weaponVariant:0)??0;
        const damage=hammer.dmg*(hammer.sDmg||1)*ctx.combat.variantVal(variant)*(ctx.data.hat(40).bDmg||1);
        const p=threat.position(ctx.self),e=threat.position(target),a=Math.atan2(e.y-p.y,e.x-p.x),holding=trapped(ctx,target);
        const options=(expectedTrap!=null?[ctx.objects.get(expectedTrap)]:ctx.objects.all()).filter(o=>o?.active&&!o.fake&&!o.preplace&&o.trap&&o.health>0&&o.health<=damage&&
            threat.distance(ctx.self,o)<=hammer.range+o.scale&&threat.distance(target,o)<=(target.scale||35)+(o.getScale?.()??o.scale));
        options.sort((x,y)=>Number(y.sid===holding?.sid)-Number(x.sid===holding?.sid)||threat.distance(target,x)-threat.distance(target,y));
        for(const trap of options){
            const b=Math.atan2(trap.y-p.y,trap.x-p.x),delta=Math.atan2(Math.sin(b-a),Math.cos(b-a));
            if(Math.abs(delta)>2*(ctx.combat.K?.gatherAngle??Math.PI/2.6))continue;
            const contact=holding?contactSpikePlan(ctx,item,target,primary,a,true,false,'received',null,null,false,true,trap.sid):hammerInstaSpikeReady(ctx,targetSid,trap.sid);
            if(contact)return {trap:trap.sid,aim:a+delta/2};
        }
        return null;
    }
    function turretImpactReady(ctx,target,self,enemy,world,tick) {
        const gear=ctx.data.hat(53)?.turret,shot=ctx.data.projectiles[gear?.proj];
        if(!gear||!shot||ctx.data.hat(target.hat??target.skinIndex)?.antiTurret||root.MooMooThreats?.turretReady(ctx.self.sid)===false)return false;
        const dx=enemy.x-self.x,dy=enemy.y-self.y,d=Math.hypot(dx,dy);if(d<1||d>gear.range)return false;
        const facing=target.d2??target.dir,toward=Math.atan2(-dy,-dx);
        if(ctx.data.weapon(target.weaponIndex)?.shield&&Number.isFinite(facing)&&Math.abs(Math.atan2(Math.sin(toward-facing),Math.cos(toward-facing)))<=(ctx.combat.K?.shieldAngle??Math.PI/3))return false;
        const ux=dx/d,uy=dy/d,limit=shot.speed*tick;
        const entry=(p,r)=>{
            let low=0,high=limit;
            for(const [axis,u]of [['x',ux],['y',uy]]){
                const offset=p[axis]-self[axis];if(Math.abs(u)<1e-9){if(Math.abs(offset)>r)return Infinity;continue;}
                const a=(offset-r)/u,b=(offset+r)/u;low=Math.max(low,Math.min(a,b));high=Math.min(high,Math.max(a,b));if(low>high)return Infinity;
            }return low;
        };
        const arrival=entry(enemy,enemy.scale);if(!Number.isFinite(arrival))return false;
        const layer=world.reduce((z,o)=>Math.hypot(self.x-o.x,self.y-o.y)<=self.scale+(o.getScale?.()??o.scale)?Math.max(z,o.zIndex||0):z,0)||shot.layer;
        if(world.some(o=>!o.ignoreCollision&&(o.layer||0)>=layer&&entry(o,o.getScale?.()??o.scale)<=arrival))return false;
        return ![...api.players.values()].some(other=>other.sid!==ctx.self.sid&&other.sid!==target.sid&&other.alive&&other.visible&&!(ctx.objects.isFriendly(other.sid))&&!ctx.data.hat(other.hat??other.skinIndex)?.antiTurret&&root.MooMooThreats.distance(other,self)<=d+2);
    }
    function contactSpikePlan(ctx,item,target,use,dir,attack=true,forward=false,strict=false,predicted=null,timing=null,contactNextTick=false,trapSync=false,replacingSid=null) {
        if(!target)return null;
        const threat=root.MooMooThreats,tick=ctx.SERVER_TICK||1000/9,decay=Math.pow(ctx.combat?.K?.playerDecel??.993,tick),weaponData=ctx.data.weapon(use??ctx.self.weapons?.[0]);
        if(!weaponData||weaponData.projectile!=null)return null;
        const body=p=>{const position=threat.position(p),v=threat.velocity(p),fresh=Number.isFinite(v.at)&&now()-v.at<=tick*2;
            return {...position,scale:p.scale||35,vx:fresh?v.vx*decay:0,vy:fresh?v.vy*decay:0,sid:p.sid,team:p.team};};
        const self=predicted?.self||body(ctx.self),enemy=predicted?.enemy||body(target),opening=predicted?null:state.active?.waitingSwing;
        if(!predicted)for(const [p,actor]of [[self,ctx.self],[enemy,target]]){
            const v=threat.velocity(actor),age=now()-v.at;
            // An equipment acknowledgement can arrive near the next snapshot.
            // Do not plan contact from an entire stale movement step behind it.
            if(Number.isFinite(age)&&age>tick*.65&&age<=tick*2&&!trapped(ctx,actor)){
                p.x+=p.vx*tick;p.y+=p.vy*tick;p.vx*=decay;p.vy*=decay;
            }
        }
        if(forward)dir=Math.atan2(enemy.y-self.y,enemy.x-self.x);
        if(opening?.observed&&opening.before&&now()-opening.before.at<tick*2.5&&target.health<opening.before.health){
            const start=opening.before,turretKnock=opening.turretEnded&&start.health-target.health>ctx.data.weapon(opening.weapon).dmg+8 ? .3 : 0,knock=.3*(target.weightM||1)+(ctx.data.weapon(opening.weapon)?.knock||0)+turretKnock,dx=start.enemy.x-start.self.x,dy=start.enemy.y-start.self.y,d=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1;
            const consumed=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,((enemy.x-start.enemy.x-start.vx*tick)*dx/d+(enemy.y-start.enemy.y-start.vy*tick)*dy/d)/(knock*tick)));
            const remaining=knock*(1-consumed);
            enemy.vx+=dx/d*remaining;enemy.vy+=dy/d*remaining;
        }
        for(const [body,actor]of [[self,ctx.self],[enemy,target]]){
            const prison=trapped(ctx,actor);
            if(prison&&!(replacingSid===prison.sid&&state.active?.waitingSwing?.observed)){body.vx=0;body.vy=0;}
        }
        const world=(ctx.objects?.all()||[]).filter(o=>o.active&&o.sid!==replacingSid&&!o.fake&&!o.preplace&&Math.hypot(o.x-self.x,o.y-self.y)<700);
        const advance=(p,spike,obstacles)=>{
            if(timing&&trapped(ctx,p.sid===ctx.self.sid?ctx.self:target)){p.vx=0;p.vy=0;}
            const steps=Math.min(4,Math.max(1,Math.round(Math.hypot(p.vx,p.vy)*tick/40)));let contact=false;
            for(let step=0;step<steps;step++){
                p.x+=p.vx*tick/steps;p.y+=p.vy*tick/steps;
                for(const o of obstacles){
                    const r=p.scale+(o.getScale?.()??o.scale),dx=p.x-o.x,dy=p.y-o.y,d=Math.hypot(dx,dy);
                    if(d>r||o.ignoreCollision)continue;
                    const a=d>1e-6?Math.atan2(dy,dx):dir;
                    p.x=o.x+r*Math.cos(a);p.y=o.y+r*Math.sin(a);p.vx*=.75;p.vy*=.75;
                    if(o===spike&&p.sid===target.sid){spike.depth=Math.max(spike.depth||0,r-d);contact=true;p.vx+=1.5*Math.cos(a);p.vy+=1.5*Math.sin(a);}
                }
            }
            return contact;
        };
        const collide=(a,b)=>{const dx=b.x-a.x,dy=b.y-a.y,d=Math.hypot(dx,dy),overlap=a.scale+b.scale-d;
            if(overlap>0){const angle=d>1e-6?Math.atan2(dy,dx):dir,x=Math.cos(angle)*overlap/2,y=Math.sin(angle)*overlap/2;a.x-=x;a.y-=y;b.x+=x;b.y+=y;}};
        return freeSpikeAngle(ctx,item,dir,target,choices=>{
            let best=null;
            for(const point of choices){
                const angles=[],contactOrders=[];let contacts=0,margin=Infinity,contactDepth=Infinity,valid=true;
                const selfOrder=state.order.indexOf(ctx.self.sid),enemyOrder=state.order.indexOf(target.sid),received=strict==='received';
                const paired=strict==='paired-spike',knownOrder=(received||paired)&&selfOrder>=0&&enemyOrder>=0;
                const orders=knownOrder?[enemyOrder<selfOrder]:[false,true];
                for(const enemyFirst of orders){
                    const a={...self},b={...enemy};let contact=false;
                    if(timing==='after-primary'){
                        if(enemyFirst){advance(b,null,world);collide(a,b);advance(a,null,world);}else{advance(a,null,world);collide(a,b);}
                        const aim=Math.atan2(b.y-a.y,b.x-a.x),distance=Math.hypot(b.x-a.x,b.y-a.y);
                        if(distance>weaponData.range+b.scale*1.8-2){valid=false;break;}
                        const k=.3*(target.weightM||1)+(weaponData.knock||0);b.vx+=Math.cos(aim)*k;b.vy+=Math.sin(aim)*k;
                        if(!enemyFirst)advance(b,null,world);
                        a.vx*=decay;a.vy*=decay;if(!enemyFirst){b.vx*=decay;b.vy*=decay;}
                    }
                    const spike={...point,x:point.x+a.x-self.x,y:point.y+a.y-self.y,scale:item.scale},obstacles=[...world,spike];
                    if(timing&&world.some(o=>Math.hypot(o.x-spike.x,o.y-spike.y)<item.scale+2+(o.blocker||(o.getScale?.(.6,o.isItem)??o.scale)))){valid=false;break;}
                    if(enemyFirst){contact=advance(b,spike,obstacles);collide(a,b);advance(a,spike,obstacles);}else{advance(a,spike,obstacles);collide(a,b);}
                    const dx=b.x-a.x,dy=b.y-a.y,d=Math.hypot(dx,dy),reach=weaponData.range+b.scale*1.8;
                    if(attack&&d>reach-2){valid=false;break;}
                    const attackAngle=Math.atan2(dy,dx);angles.push(attackAngle);margin=Math.min(margin,reach-d);
                    if(!enemyFirst){const k=attack ? .3*(target.weightM||1)+(weaponData.knock||0) : 0;b.vx+=Math.cos(attackAngle)*k;b.vy+=Math.sin(attackAngle)*k;contact=advance(b,spike,obstacles);}
                    if(!contact&&contactNextTick){
                        if(enemyFirst){
                            b.vx*=decay;b.vy*=decay;
                            const knock=attack ? .3*(target.weightM||1)+(weaponData.knock||0) : 0;
                            b.vx+=Math.cos(attackAngle)*knock;b.vy+=Math.sin(attackAngle)*knock;
                        }else{b.vx*=decay;b.vy*=decay;}
                        contact=advance(b,spike,obstacles);
                    }
                    if(timing&&!turretImpactReady(ctx,target,a,b,world,tick))contact=false;
                    if(contact){contacts++;contactDepth=Math.min(contactDepth,spike.depth||0);}
                    contactOrders.push(contact);
                }
                if(!valid||contacts<((received||paired)?orders.length:strict?2:1))continue;
                const delta=angles.length>1?Math.atan2(Math.sin(angles[1]-angles[0]),Math.cos(angles[1]-angles[0])):0;
                if(attack&&Math.abs(delta)>(ctx.combat?.K?.gatherAngle??1.2083)*2-.15)continue;
                if(paired){
                    const aim=angles[0]+delta/2,current=Math.atan2(enemy.y-self.y,enemy.x-self.x);
                    if(Math.abs(Math.atan2(Math.sin(aim-current),Math.cos(aim-current)))>(ctx.combat?.K?.gatherAngle??1.2083)-.075)continue;
                }
                const overlap=Math.max(0,item.scale+enemy.scale-Math.hypot(point.x-enemy.x,point.y-enemy.y));
                const depthScore=strict==='paired-spike'?3*Math.min(50,contactDepth):0;
                const score=contacts*1000+depthScore+Math.min(50,margin)+Math.min(25,overlap)-Math.abs(Math.atan2(Math.sin(point.angle-dir),Math.cos(point.angle-dir)));
                if((!best||score>best.score)&&(!(trapSync||forward==='prefer-target')||root.AntimoocheatBasePlacement.combatSearch(item.id,point.angle,0,()=>true,[],replacingSid)))best={angle:point.angle,aim:angles[0]+delta/2,score,contacts};
            }
            return best;
        },forward===true,replacingSid,trapSync);
    }
    function nonSoldierSpikePlan(ctx,targetSid){

        const threat=root.MooMooThreats,target=api.player(targetSid),use=ctx.self.weapons?.[0],weapon=ctx.data.weapon(use),item=findItem(ctx,'spikes');
        if(!target?.alive||!target.visible||!(target.health>0)||ctx.objects.isFriendly(targetSid)||(target.hat??target.skinIndex)===6||trapped(ctx,target))return null;
        if(!weapon||!(weapon.dmg>0)||weapon.projectile!=null||!owns(ctx,7)||!item||!canUse(ctx,item)||!(root.MooMooAutoReload?.ready(use)??threat.ready(ctx.self.sid,use)))return null;
        if(!threat.evaluateAttack(target,use,{hat:7,requireCurrent:true}).feasible)return null;
        const variant=threat.observedWeapons(ctx.self.sid).find(w=>w.id===use)?.variant??(ctx.self.weaponIndex===use?ctx.self.weaponVariant:0)??0;
        const primaryDamage=threat.meleeDamage({...ctx.self,hat:7},target,use,variant);
        const spikeDamage=(item.dmg||0)*(ctx.data.hat(target.hat??target.skinIndex)?.dmgMult??1)*(ctx.data.accessory(target.accessory??target.tailIndex)?.dmgMult??1);
        if(primaryDamage+spikeDamage<target.health)return null;
        const self=threat.position(ctx.self),enemy=threat.position(target),dir=Math.atan2(enemy.y-self.y,enemy.x-self.x);
        const spikeReach=(ctx.self.scale||35)+item.scale+(item.placeOffset||0)+item.scale+(target.scale||35);
        if(Math.hypot(enemy.x-self.x,enemy.y-self.y)>spikeReach)return null;
        const plan=contactSpikePlan(ctx,item,target,use,dir,true,false,'received',null,null,true);
        if(!plan||!nativePlacementCheck(ctx,item.id,plan.angle))return null;
        return {...plan,primaryDamage,spikeDamage};
    }
    function knockbackHatWindow(ctx,target){
        const eq=root.AntimoocheatEquipment,tick=ctx.SERVER_TICK||1000/9;
        const rtt=Math.max(0,ctx.net.minPing?.()||ctx.net.ping||0);
        const lead=(eq.settled(7)?0:eq.hatWait()+rtt)+rtt/2+tick/2;
        const window=root.MooMooAutomation?.hatWindow(target?.sid,Math.max(0,lead-tick*.4),lead+tick*.4);
        const current=target?.hat??target?.skinIndex;
        return {allowed:!!target&&(window?.valid===true||Number.isInteger(current)&&current!==6),window,lead};
    }
    function knockbackContactPlan(ctx,target,mode='hammer',followup=false){
        const threat=root.MooMooThreats,primary=ctx.data.weapon(ctx.self.weapons?.[0]),tick=ctx.SERVER_TICK||1000/9,decay=Math.pow(ctx.combat?.K?.playerDecel??.993,tick);
        if(!target?.alive||!target.visible||(ctx.objects.isFriendly(target.sid))||!primary||primary.id===8||primary.projectile!=null||!(primary.dmg>0)||trapped(ctx,target)||!owns(ctx,7))return null;
        const hatPrediction=mode==='primary'?knockbackHatWindow(ctx,target):null;
        if(hatPrediction&&!hatPrediction.allowed)return null;
        const hammer=mode==='hammer',primaryOnly=mode==='primary',ready=id=>root.MooMooAutoReload?.ready(id)??threat.ready(ctx.self.sid,id),gear=ctx.data.hat(53)?.turret,projectile=ctx.data.projectiles[gear?.proj];
        if(hammer&&(![4,5].includes(primary.id)||ctx.self.weapons?.[1]!==10))return null;
        if(!ready(primary.id)||hammer&&!followup&&!ready(10)||!threat.evaluateAttack(target,hammer&&!followup?10:primary.id,{requireCurrent:true,horizon:followup?0:undefined}).feasible||instaBlocked(ctx,target.sid)==='shield-facing')return null;
        const self=threat.position(ctx.self),enemy=threat.position(target),distance=Math.hypot(enemy.x-self.x,enemy.y-self.y);
        // Hammer owns the close, cooling-Turret opportunity. The ready Turret
        // route opens only beyond Hammer's actual melee reach.
        const hammerReach=(ctx.data.weapon(10)?.range||0)+(target.scale||35)*1.8;
        if(!followup&&(hammer&&threat.turretReady(ctx.self.sid)!==false||mode==='turret'&&distance<=hammerReach))return null;
        const active=followup&&state.active,shot=active?.kbShot,turret=!primaryOnly&&(followup?!!shot:owns(ctx,53)&&threat.turretReady(ctx.self.sid)&&!ctx.data.hat(target.hat??target.skinIndex)?.antiTurret);
        if(!hammer&&!primaryOnly&&!turret)return null;
        const world=(ctx.objects?.all()||[]).filter(o=>o.active&&!o.fake&&!o.preplace&&Math.hypot(o.x-self.x,o.y-self.y)<900);
        const damaging=o=>ctx.data.item(o.id)?.group?.name==='spikes'&&ctx.objects.isFriendly(o.ownerSid);
        if(!world.some(damaging))return null;
        const others=[...api.players.values(),...(ctx.combat?.animals||[])].filter(p=>p.sid!==ctx.self.sid&&p.sid!==target.sid&&p.alive!==false&&p.visible!==false&&p.health>0&&!(ctx.objects.isFriendly(p.sid)));
        if(turret&&!followup&&others.some(p=>!ctx.data.hat(p.hat??p.skinIndex)?.antiTurret&&threat.distance(ctx.self,p)<=distance))return null;
        const body=p=>{const v=threat.velocity(p),fresh=Number.isFinite(v.at)&&now()-v.at<=tick*2;return {...threat.position(p),scale:p.scale||35,vx:fresh?v.vx*decay:0,vy:fresh?v.vy*decay:0};};
        const ownOrder=state.order.indexOf(ctx.self.sid),enemyOrder=state.order.indexOf(target.sid),orders=ownOrder<0||enemyOrder<0?[false,true]:[enemyOrder<ownOrder];
        let result=null,guaranteed=null;
        const compoundContacts=(x,y)=>{
            // The server resolves every overlapping structure in a movement substep.
            // Resolve collision projection before testing the next structure;
            // simply adding nearby spikes would invent contacts behind the first one.
            const simulate=list=>{
                const p={x,y},hits=new Set();
                for(const o of list){
                    const radius=(target.scale||35)+(o.getScale?.()??o.scale),dx=p.x-o.x,dy=p.y-o.y,d=Math.hypot(dx,dy);
                    if(d>radius+.00001)continue;
                    const catches=o.boostSpeed||o.teleport||o.trap&&o.ownerSid!==target.sid&&!(target.team!=null&&api.player(o.ownerSid)?.team===target.team);
                    if(o.ignoreCollision){if(catches)break;continue;}
                    if(!damaging(o))break;
                    hits.add(o.sid);const angle=d>1e-6?Math.atan2(dy,dx):Math.atan2(enemy.y-self.y,enemy.x-self.x);
                    p.x=o.x+Math.cos(angle)*radius;p.y=o.y+Math.sin(angle)*radius;
                }
                return hits;
            };
            const forward=simulate(world),reverse=simulate([...world].reverse());
            return [...forward].filter(sid=>reverse.has(sid));
        };
        for(const enemyFirst of orders){
            const a=body(ctx.self),b=body(target);let blockedPath=false,contact=null,contacts=[],primaryHit=false,turretHit=!!shot?.impact,flight=null;
            const impulse=(amount,dir)=>{b.vx+=Math.cos(dir)*amount;b.vy+=Math.sin(dir)*amount;};
            if(followup){
                const opening=active.waitingSwing;
                if(enemyFirst&&opening?.observed&&opening.weapon===10&&state.tick===opening.releaseTick+1)impulse(.3*(target.weightM||1),opening.dir);
                if(shot?.impact&&state.tick===shot.impact.tick+1)impulse(.3*(target.weightM||1),shot.dir);
                if(shot&&!shot.ended){const age=Math.max(0,state.tick-shot.tick-1),travel=age*shot.speed*tick;flight={x:shot.x+Math.cos(shot.dir)*travel,y:shot.y+Math.sin(shot.dir)*travel,dir:shot.dir,speed:shot.speed,layer:shot.layer,skip:false};}
            }
            const move=(p,isEnemy)=>{
                const steps=Math.min(4,Math.max(1,Math.round(Math.hypot(p.vx,p.vy)*tick/40)));
                for(let i=0;i<steps;i++){
                    const x=p.x,y=p.y,dx=p.vx*tick/steps,dy=p.vy*tick/steps,length=dx*dx+dy*dy;
                    let first=null;
                    for(const o of world){
                        const catches=isEnemy&&(o.boostSpeed||o.teleport||o.trap&&o.ownerSid!==target.sid&&!(target.team!=null&&api.player(o.ownerSid)?.team===target.team));
                        if(o.ignoreCollision&&!catches)continue;
                        const radius=p.scale+(o.getScale?.()??o.scale),ox=x-o.x,oy=y-o.y,c=ox*ox+oy*oy-radius*radius;
                        let time=0;
                        if(c>=-1e-5&&c<=0&&ox*dx+oy*dy>=0)continue;
                        if(c>0){
                            if(length<1e-9)continue;
                            const dot=ox*dx+oy*dy,discriminant=dot*dot-length*c;
                            if(dot>=0||discriminant<0)continue;
                            time=(-dot-Math.sqrt(discriminant))/length;if(time<0||time>1)continue;
                        }
                        const spike=isEnemy&&damaging(o)&&primaryHit;
                        if(!first||time<first.time-1e-6||Math.abs(time-first.time)<=1e-6&&!spike)first={o,time,spike};
                    }
                    p.x=x+dx*(first?.time??1);p.y=y+dy*(first?.time??1);
                    if(first){
                        if(first.spike){contact=first.o.sid;contacts=compoundContacts(x+dx,y+dy);if(!contacts.includes(contact))contacts=[contact];}
                        else blockedPath=true;
                        return;
                    }
                }
                p.vx*=decay;p.vy*=decay;
                if(Math.abs(p.vx)<=.01)p.vx=0;if(Math.abs(p.vy)<=.01)p.vy=0;
            };
            const collide=()=>{const dx=b.x-a.x,dy=b.y-a.y,d=Math.hypot(dx,dy),overlap=a.scale+b.scale-d;if(overlap>0){const angle=Math.atan2(dy,dx),x=Math.cos(angle)*overlap/2,y=Math.sin(angle)*overlap/2;a.x-=x;a.y-=y;b.x+=x;b.y+=y;}};
            const updateShot=()=>{
                if(!flight)return;
                const length=flight.speed*tick,ux=Math.cos(flight.dir),uy=Math.sin(flight.dir);
                if(!flight.skip){flight.x+=ux*length;flight.y+=uy*length;}flight.skip=false;
                const intersects=(p,r)=>{let low=0,high=length;for(const [axis,u]of [['x',ux],['y',uy]]){const offset=p[axis]-flight[axis];if(Math.abs(u)<1e-9){if(Math.abs(offset)>r)return false;continue;}const v=(offset-r)/u,w=(offset+r)/u;low=Math.max(low,Math.min(v,w));high=Math.min(high,Math.max(v,w));if(low>high)return false;}return true;};
                const candidates=[{p:b,target:true,r:b.scale},...others.map(p=>({p:threat.position(p),r:p.scale||35})),...world.filter(o=>!o.ignoreCollision&&(o.layer||0)>=flight.layer).map(p=>({p,r:p.getScale?.()??p.scale}))].filter(o=>intersects(o.p,o.r)).sort((u,v)=>Math.hypot(u.p.x-flight.x,u.p.y-flight.y)-Math.hypot(v.p.x-flight.x,v.p.y-flight.y));
                if(candidates.length){if(candidates[0].target){impulse(.3*(target.weightM||1),flight.dir);turretHit=true;}flight=null;}
            };
            const maxTicks=primaryOnly?12:followup?5:6;
            for(let step=0;step<maxTicks;step++){
                if(enemyFirst){move(b,true);collide();if(contact)break;move(a,false);}else{move(a,false);collide();}
                if(blockedPath)break;
                const weapon=followup||primaryOnly?(step===0?primary:null):(step===0?(hammer?ctx.data.weapon(10):null):step===1?primary:null);
                if(weapon){const d=Math.hypot(b.x-a.x,b.y-a.y),dir=Math.atan2(b.y-a.y,b.x-a.x);if(d>weapon.range+b.scale*1.8-2){blockedPath=true;break;}if(weapon===primary)primaryHit=true;impulse(.3*(target.weightM||1)+(weapon.knock||0),dir);}
                if(!enemyFirst)move(b,true);
                if(blockedPath||contact)break;
                if(!followup&&step===0&&turret)flight={x:a.x,y:a.y,dir:Math.atan2(b.y-a.y,b.x-a.x),speed:projectile.speed,layer:Math.max(ctx.self.zIndex||0,projectile.layer||1),skip:true};
                updateShot();
            }
            if(blockedPath||contact==null||!primaryHit||turret&&!turretHit)return null;
            guaranteed=guaranteed==null?contacts:guaranteed.filter(sid=>contacts.includes(sid));
            const spikeSids=guaranteed.length?guaranteed:[contact];
            const armor=(ctx.data.hat(target.hat??target.skinIndex)?.dmgMult??1)*(ctx.data.accessory(target.accessory??target.tailIndex)?.dmgMult??1);
            result={targetSid:target.sid,spikeSid:contact,spikeSids,spikeCount:spikeSids.length,spikeDamage:spikeSids.reduce((sum,sid)=>sum+(ctx.data.item(ctx.objects.get(sid)?.id)?.dmg||0)*armor,0),enemyFirst,distance,turret,turretHit,travel:Math.hypot(b.x-enemy.x,b.y-enemy.y),maxTicks};
        }
        return result;
    }
    const hammerContactPlan=(ctx,target,followup=false)=>knockbackContactPlan(ctx,target,'hammer',followup);
    function retainedKnockbackPath(ctx,active){
        const target=api.player(active.targetSid),threat=root.MooMooThreats,w=ctx.data.weapon(ctx.self.weapons?.[0]);
        if(active.kbShot?.ended&&!active.kbShot.impact||active.def.id==='knockbackTurret'&&!active.kbShot)return false;
        if(!w||!target?.alive||!target.visible||trapped(ctx,target)||ctx.objects.isFriendly(target.sid)||instaBlocked(ctx,target.sid)==='shield-facing'||!threat.evaluateAttack(target,w.id,{requireCurrent:true,horizon:0}).feasible)return false;
        const a=threat.position(ctx.self),b=threat.position(target),angle=Math.atan2(b.y-a.y,b.x-a.x),v=threat.velocity(target),tick=ctx.SERVER_TICK||1000/9;
        const decay=Math.pow(ctx.combat?.K?.playerDecel??.993,tick),fresh=Number.isFinite(v.at)&&now()-v.at<=2*tick;
        // The SDK position changes before the motion observer runs in this dispatch.
        const elapsed=now()-v.at,unsampled=fresh&&elapsed>5&&Math.hypot(b.x-v.x,b.y-v.y)>.01;
        const baseX=unsampled?(b.x-v.x)/elapsed:fresh?v.vx:0,baseY=unsampled?(b.y-v.y)/elapsed:fresh?v.vy:0;
        const impulse=.3*(target.weightM||1)+(w.knock||0),shot=active.kbShot;
        const pending=shot&&(!shot.ended&&!shot.impact||shot.impact&&state.tick===shot.impact.tick+1)? .3*(target.weightM||1):0;
        const vx=baseX*decay+Math.cos(angle)*impulse+Math.cos(shot?.dir??angle)*pending;
        const vy=baseY*decay+Math.sin(angle)*impulse+Math.sin(shot?.dir??angle)*pending;
        const speed=Math.hypot(vx,vy);if(!(speed>0))return false;
        const ux=vx/speed,uy=vy/speed,travel=speed*tick/(1-decay),body=target.scale||35;
        const world=ctx.objects.all();let first=null;
        for(const o of world){
            if(!o.active||o.fake||o.preplace||o.ignoreCollision&&!o.boostSpeed&&!o.teleport&&!(o.trap&&o.ownerSid!==target.sid&&!(target.team!=null&&api.player(o.ownerSid)?.team===target.team)))continue;
            const x=o.x-b.x,y=o.y-b.y,along=x*ux+y*uy,cross=x*uy-y*ux,r=body+(o.getScale?.()??o.scale);
            if(along<0||Math.abs(cross)>r)continue;
            const distance=Math.max(0,along-Math.sqrt(Math.max(0,r*r-cross*cross)));
            if(distance>travel+2)continue;
            const spike=ctx.data.item(o.id)?.group?.name==='spikes'&&ctx.objects.isFriendly(o.ownerSid);
            if(!first||distance<first.distance-1e-6||Math.abs(distance-first.distance)<=1e-6&&!spike)first={distance,spike};
        }
        return !!first?.spike;
    }
    function bestKnockbackTarget(ctx,mode,followup=false,sid=null){
        let best=null;
        for(const entry of root.MooMooThreats.snapshot().targets){
            const target=api.player(entry.sid);
            if(sid!=null&&target?.sid!==sid)continue;
            const plan=knockbackContactPlan(ctx,target,mode,followup);
            if(plan&&(!best||plan.spikeDamage>best.spikeDamage||plan.spikeDamage===best.spikeDamage&&plan.distance<best.distance))best=plan;
        }
        return best?.targetSid??null;
    }
    const turretKnockbackTarget=(ctx,followup=false,sid=null)=>bestKnockbackTarget(ctx,'turret',followup,sid);
    const knockbackTarget=(ctx,followup=false,sid=null,hammerMode=true)=>bestKnockbackTarget(ctx,hammerMode?'hammer':'primary',followup,sid);
    const dragonWindow=createDragonCapeWindow(now,()=>root.MooMooAutomation?.scheduleCapeExpiry());
    const stickBlocked=new Set(['instakill','oneTick','reverse','boostTick','age1Insta','katanaInsta','bowInsta','katanaHammer']);
    const stickUnavailable=(weapons,id)=>weapons?.[0]===8&&stickBlocked.has(id)&&!(id==='instakill'&&weapons[1]===10);
    const wearsSoldier=p=>(p?.hat??p?.skinIndex)===6;
    const removedKeybinds=new Set(['katanaHammer','trapSpikeSync','spikePrimary','spikeTick']);
    const optionalTurretIds=new Set(['spikeContact','trapSpikeSync','spikeSyncHammer','spikeTick','spikePrimary','doubleSpikeTick','spikeStrike','nonSoldierSpike','knockbackPrimary','knockbackTick']);
    const confirmPrimaryNotice=new Set(['spikeSyncHammer','knockbackTick','knockbackTurret','knockbackPrimary','spikeContact']);
    const noticeOnPrimary=def=>confirmPrimaryNotice.has(def.id)||def.id==='bullStrike'&&def.name==='SpikeSync';

    function finishingInsta(){
        const a=state.active;
        if(a?.def.id!=='instakill'||a.firstStrikeAt==null)return false;
        const waiting=a.waitingSwing;
        if(a.phase>=2&&waiting?.observed&&a.stages[a.phase]?.hat===6)return true;
        const secondPending=a.phase>=2&&waiting?.sent&&!waiting.observed;
        const start=secondPending?waiting.sentAt:a.firstStrikeAt;
        return (secondPending||a.stages[a.phase]?.attack)&&
            now()-start<=2*(comboContext.SERVER_TICK||1000/9)+Math.max(0,comboContext.net.ping||0);
    }
    function protectLethalSpikeCombo(){
        if(finishingInsta())return false;
        const path=root.MooMooThreats?.committedSpikePath().active,oneTick=root.AntimoocheatDefense?.antiOneTickThreat?.(),bow=root.AntimoocheatDefense?.antiBowThreat?.();
        if(!bow&&!oneTick&&!path&&!root.MooMooThreats?.lethalSpikeCombo().active)return false;
        if(state.active)cancel(bow?'anti-bow':oneTick?'anti-one-tick':path?'committed-spike-path':'lethal-spike-combo');
        if(!root.AntimoocheatEquipment.settled(6)&&soldierTimer==null)armSoldier(500);
        return true;
    }
    function request(ctx,def,options={}) {
        if(protectLethalSpikeCombo())return;

        if(stickUnavailable(ctx.self.weapons,def.id))return;
        if(state.active?.def===def){cancel('cancelled');return;}
        // A different shortcut must not replace an in-flight attack sequence.
        if(state.active&&(finishingInsta()||def.id!=='animalSteal'))return;
        if(def.id!=='animalSteal'&&root.MooMooRangedAutoSync?.status().active){state.last='waiting-for-ranged-sync';return;}
        if(def.id==='dash'&&dashWeapon(ctx)==null){reject('dash-unavailable','Dash: Boost Pad, owned Tank and a one-hit breaking weapon are required.');return;}
        if(def.id==='boostTick'&&![9,12,13].includes(ctx.self.weapons?.[1]))return;
        if(options.hammerSpike&&(ctx.self.weapons?.[1]!==10||!owns(ctx,53))){state.last='waiting-for-hammer-and-turret';return;}
        if(def.id==='instakill'&&!owns(ctx,7)){state.last='waiting-for-bull';return;}
        const targetSid=def.id==='knockbackTurret'?turretKnockbackTarget(ctx):['knockbackTick','knockbackPrimary'].includes(def.id)?knockbackTarget(ctx,false,null,def.id==='knockbackTick'):['bowInsta','dash'].includes(def.id)?null:options.targetSid??(root.MooMooAutomation?.status().autoAim?root.MooMooThreats?.snapshot().targets[0]?.sid:null);
        if(['age1Insta','katanaInsta'].includes(def.id)&&!upgradeInstaRange(ctx,api.player(targetSid))){state.last='waiting-for-spike-range';return;}
        if(['knockbackTick','knockbackPrimary','knockbackTurret'].includes(def.id)&&targetSid==null){
            if(!options.automatic)reject('no-knockback-path','Knockback: no clear path to a friendly spike.');
            return;
        }
        const secondary=ctx.self.weapons?.[1],contactOnly=[11,14].includes(secondary);
        const enemy=api.player(targetSid);
        if(['instakill','reverse'].includes(def.id)&&secondary===10){
            if(!root.MooMooThreats.evaluateAttack(enemy,ctx.self.weapons[0],{requireCurrent:true,ignoreReload:true,trapOpening:true,horizon:0}).feasible){state.last='waiting-for-primary-range';return;}
            if(!hammerFollowupReady(ctx,targetSid,!!options.hammerSpike,null,!!options.hammerSpike)){state.last=options.hammerSpike?'waiting-for-spike-contact':'waiting-for-primary-range';return;}
        }
        let stages=def.stages;
        if(['age1Insta','katanaInsta'].includes(def.id)&&!owns(ctx,53))stages=def.stages.filter(stage=>stage.hat!==53);
        if(def.id==='instakill'&&ctx.data.weapon(ctx.self.weapons?.[1])?.projectile==null){
            const finish=options.hammerSpike?{...attack(7,0,'spikes'),freeSpike:true,confirmedSpike:true}:attack(7,0);
            stages=secondary===10?[attack(53,1),finish]:[attack(7,0),{hat:53}];
        }
        let kbPlan=null;
        if(['knockbackTick','knockbackTurret','knockbackPrimary'].includes(def.id)){
            kbPlan=knockbackContactPlan(ctx,enemy,def.id==='knockbackTick'?'hammer':def.id==='knockbackPrimary'?'primary':'turret');
            if(!kbPlan)return;
            const spike=ctx.objects.get(kbPlan.spikeSid),position=root.MooMooThreats.position(enemy);
            kbPlan.initialGap=Math.hypot(spike.x-position.x,spike.y-position.y);
            if(def.id==='knockbackTick')stages=[attack(kbPlan.turret?53:null,1),attack(7,0)];
        }
        if(options.automatic&&def.id==='oneTick')stages=[{hat:53,slot:0},{...attack(7,0),waitForSwing:true}];
        if(def.bow) {
            const setup=[];
            if(state.offer.points>0&&state.offer.age===6)setup.push({upgrade:9});
            if(state.offer.points>0&&state.offer.age<=7)setup.push({itemUpgrade:18});
            stages=[...setup,attack(53,1),{...attack(53,1),upgrade:12},{...attack(53,1),upgrade:15}];
        }
        stages=stages.map(stage=>stage.attack?{...stage,waitForSwing:true}:stage);
        const heldHat=root.MooMooBaseClicks?.heldHat?.();
        if(def.id!=='animalSteal'&&heldHat!=null&&stages.some(stage=>stage.hat!=null&&stage.hat!==6&&stage.hat!==heldHat&&owns(ctx,stage.hat))){state.last='waiting-for-manual-release';return;}


        const lastStage=stages.at(-1);
        if(def.id!=='dragonPrime'&&lastStage?.hat!==6){
            const restoreOnly=def.id==='instakill'&&Object.keys(lastStage||{}).every(key=>key==='slot');
            stages=restoreOnly?[...stages.slice(0,-1),{...lastStage,hat:6}]:[...stages,{hat:6}];
        }
        if(options.automatic&&stages.at(-1)?.hat!==6)stages=[...stages,{hat:6}];
        if(!optionalTurretIds.has(def.id)&&owns(ctx,53)&&stages.some(stage=>stage.hat===53)&&root.MooMooThreats?.turretReady(ctx.self.sid)===false){state.last='waiting-for-combo-turret';return;}
        const trappedStart=!!root.MooMooThreats.selfTrap();
        const openingHat=stages.find(s=>s.hat!=null)?.hat;
        if(!['instakill','oneTick','animalSteal'].includes(def.id)&&openingHat!=null&&openingHat!==6&&owns(ctx,openingHat)&&owns(ctx,6)&&root.AntimoocheatEquipment.urgent(true)){state.last='defense-priority';return;}
        if(trappedStart&&['boostTick','dash'].includes(def.id)){state.last='waiting-for-trap-exit';return;}
        if(trappedStart&&options.automatic&&def.id!=='animalSteal'&&root.MooMooCombatDefense?.status().target!=null){
            const cooling=stages.some(s=>s.attack&&s.upgrade==null&&!(root.MooMooAutoReload?.ready(ctx.self.weapons?.[s.slot]??ctx.self.weapons?.[0])??root.MooMooThreats.ready(ctx.self.sid,ctx.self.weapons?.[s.slot]??ctx.self.weapons?.[0])));
            if(cooling){state.last='waiting-for-combo-reload';return;}
        }
        if(root.MooMooRangedAutoSync?.status().active){
            if(def.id!=='animalSteal'){state.last='waiting-for-ranged-sync';return;}
            root.MooMooRangedAutoSync.cancel('animal-steal');
            root.AntimoocheatBots?.sync.clear('animal-steal');
        }
        cancel('replaced',def.id!=='animalSteal');
        state.message='';showNotice('');
        root.MooMooAutoGrind?.release();
        const original=root.MooMooAutoReload?.status().original??weapon(ctx);
        root.MooMooAutoReload?.release(false);
        const openingAttack=stages.find(s=>s.attack),openingWeapon=ctx.self.weapons?.[openingAttack?.slot]??ctx.self.weapons?.[0];
        const breakHandoff=root.MooMooCombatDefense?.release?.({forCombo:true,openingWeapon,immediate:def.id==='animalSteal'});
        if(breakHandoff?.blocked){state.last='waiting-for-break-release';return;}
        const prepare=def.id==='instakill'&&(secondary===10||trappedStart)||trappedStart&&options.automatic&&['reverse','age1Insta','katanaInsta'].includes(def.id);
        const pushStrike=(def.id==='spikeContact'||def.id==='bullStrike'&&def.name==='SpikeSync')&&root.MooMooAutomation?.status().pushTarget===targetSid;
        state.active={hammerSpike:!!options.hammerSpike,dragonCape:!!options.dragonCape,entry:options.entry?{...options.entry,until:now()+Math.max(650,4*(ctx.SERVER_TICK||1000/9)+(ctx.net.ping||0))}:null,breakHandoff,trappedStart,openingWeapon,preparing:prepare,def,stages,phase:0,original,deadline:now()+6000,upgradeSent:false,sent:false,lastTick:-Infinity,targetSid,kbPlan,targetAnimal:!!options.animal,preserveMovement:def.id==='dragonPrime'||pushStrike||!!options.animal||['autoBullSpam','spikeSyncHammer','spikeContact','bullStrike','spikeStrike','nonSoldierSpike','turretSteal'].includes(def.id),automatic:!!options.automatic};
        {
            const active=state.active;
            active.timeout=(root.MooMooPrivateBackground?.timers||root).setTimeout(()=>{
                if(state.active!==active)return;
                const waiting=active.waitingSwing&&!active.waitingSwing.observed;
                cancel(waiting?'primary-unconfirmed':'stopped');
                reject(state.last,def.name+(waiting?': primary swing was not observed; spikes cancelled.':': timed out waiting for game updates.'));
            },6001);
        }
        state.last='armed';
        ctx.net[Symbol.for('moomoojs.comboPriority')]={until:state.active.deadline};
        if(def.id==='instakill'&&!options.hammerSpike)root.MooMooAutomation?.armInsta();
    }
    api.register({id:'combat-macros',name:'Instakill Modules',version:'0.1.0',defaultEnabled:true,liveSettings:true,
        description:'Press a bound key to arm its combo. Hammer Instakill supports every primary.',
        settings:definitions.filter(d=>!d.automaticOnly&&!removedKeybinds.has(d.id)).map(d=>({key:d.id,type:'key',default:d.key||'',label:d.name,category:'Instakill Modules',hint:d.hint||(['instakill','oneTick'].includes(d.id)?'Toggles automatic mode. Waits for a valid enemy and the required attack range; press again to cancel.':'Starts without gear/target requirements. Missing secondary falls back to primary; unavailable gear, items and upgrades are skipped.')}))
    },ctx=>{
        comboContext=ctx;
        const opportunityDefense=createOpportunityDefense(ctx,root);
        const opportunistic=new Set(['nonSoldierSpike','spikeStrike','spikeContact','bullStrike','turretSteal','spikeSyncHammer','knockbackTick','knockbackPrimary','knockbackTurret']);
        function protectOpportunity(){
            if(!opportunityDefense.danger())return false;
            if(state.active&&opportunistic.has(state.active.def.id)&&!(root.AntimoocheatEquipment.urgent()&&holdFollowup(state.active,'defense-priority')))cancel('defensive-priority');
            if(!state.active&&!rightHeld&&!root.MooMooBaseClicks?.ownsEquipment?.())armSoldier(500);
            return true;
        }
        ctx.onOutgoing('aim',payload=>state.active?.targetSid!=null||state.active?.dashDirection!=null?{...payload,dir:angle(ctx)}:payload);
        ctx.onOutgoing('mouse',(payload,info)=>{
            if(info?.source==='client'){clearWeaponRecovery();if(state.active)state.down=!!payload.down;return payload.down&&root.MooMooManualAutoaim?.status().enabled&&(state.active?.targetSid!=null||state.active?.dashDirection!=null)?{...payload,dir:angle(ctx)}:payload;}
            if(executing)return payload;
            return state.active?.targetSid!=null||state.active?.dashDirection!=null?{...payload,dir:angle(ctx)}:payload;
        });
        for(const action of ['move','stopMove','selectItem','store','toggle'])ctx.onOutgoing(action,(payload,info)=>{
            if(info?.source==='client'&&['selectItem','toggle'].includes(action))clearWeaponRecovery();
            // OneTick owns the planned lunge. Competing modules must not undo
            // it with a late stop/move; remember native input for release only.
            if(state.active?.def.id==='oneTick'&&!executing&&(action==='move'||action==='stopMove')){
                if(info?.source==='client')state.move=action==='move'&&Number.isFinite(payload.dir)?payload.dir:null;
                return null;
            }
            if(info?.source!=='client'||!state.active)return payload;
            if(action==='move'||action==='stopMove'){state.move=action==='move'&&Number.isFinite(payload.dir)?payload.dir:null;if(state.active.preserveMovement)return payload;}
            if(action==='toggle'&&payload.which===1)state.auto=!state.auto;
            return null;
        });
        const movementKeys=new Set(['w','a','s','d','arrowup','arrowdown','arrowleft','arrowright']);
        const trackMovement=(event,aliases)=>{if(!aliases.some(k=>movementKeys.has(k))||ctx.input.isTyping())return;state.keyboardMove=true;};
        const offMoveDown=ctx.input.onKeyDown(trackMovement),offMoveUp=ctx.input.onKeyUp(trackMovement);
        ctx.onCleanup(()=>{offMoveDown();offMoveUp();clearWeaponRecovery();});
        for(const event of ['reset','setup','died','disconnect'])ctx.on(event,()=>{state.message='';showNotice('');});
        const tick=Math.max(16,Number(ctx.SERVER_TICK)||1000/9);
        let tickSerial=0,lastUpdateAt=null,updatePeriod=tick;
        function wakeEquipment(active,delay){
            const timers=root.MooMooPrivateBackground?.timers||root,at=now()+Math.max(1,delay);
            if(active.equipmentWake!=null&&active.equipmentWakeAt<=at)return;
            if(active.equipmentWake!=null)timers.clearTimeout(active.equipmentWake);
            active.equipmentWakeAt=at;
            active.equipmentWake=timers.setTimeout(()=>{active.equipmentWake=null;active.equipmentWakeAt=Infinity;if(state.active===active)run();},Math.max(1,at-now()));
        }
        function recheckAt(active,at){
            const timers=root.MooMooPrivateBackground?.timers||root;
            if(active.progressWake!=null){
                if(active.progressDue<=at)return;
                timers.clearTimeout(active.progressWake);
            }
            active.progressDue=at;
            active.progressWake=timers.setTimeout(()=>{
                active.progressWake=null;if(state.active===active)run();
            },Math.max(1,Math.ceil(at-now())));
        }
        function targetLeftMeleeReach(active,weapon){
            // OneTick already checks its moving intercept at impact. Its
            // legitimate launch distance can exceed instantaneous melee reach.
            if(active.targetSid==null||active.def.id==='oneTick'||active.def.id==='spikeSyncHammer'&&
                (active.phase===0||active.waitingSwing?.weapon===weapon&&weapon===10))return false;
            const spec=ctx.data.weapon(weapon);if(!spec||spec.projectile!=null)return false;
            const target=targetOf(active);
            if(!target||target.visible===false||target.alive===false)return true;
            return root.MooMooThreats.distance(ctx.self,target)>spec.range+(target.scale||35)*1.8;
        }
        function armSwingReceipt(active,waiting,delay){
            const timers=root.MooMooPrivateBackground?.timers||root;
            if(active.swingWake!=null)timers.clearTimeout(active.swingWake);
            const remaining=Math.max(1,Math.min(delay,waiting.sentAt+1500-now()));
            active.swingWake=timers.setTimeout(()=>{
                if(state.active!==active||active.waitingSwing!==waiting||waiting.observed)return;
                active.swingWake=null;if(targetLeftMeleeReach(active,waiting.weapon)){cancel('target-lost');return;}
                cancel('primary-unconfirmed');
                reject('primary-unconfirmed',active.def.name+': swing not confirmed; returned to defense.');
            },remaining);
        }
        function instaVolleyTarget(target){
            const threat=root.MooMooThreats,p=threat.position(target),opening=state.active?.waitingSwing;
            if(!opening?.observed||!opening.before||threat.trapFor(target))return p;
            const velocity=threat.velocity(target),decay=Math.pow(ctx.combat?.K?.playerDecel??.993,tick);
            let vx=(velocity.vx||0)*decay,vy=(velocity.vy||0)*decay;
            const pendingPosition=tickSerial===opening.releaseTick;
            if(pendingPosition&&target.health<opening.before.health){
                const before=opening.before,dx=before.enemy.x-before.self.x,dy=before.enemy.y-before.self.y,d=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1;
                const knock=.3*(target.weightM||1)+(ctx.data.weapon(opening.weapon)?.knock||0);
                vx+=dx/d*knock;vy+=dy/d*knock;
            }
            // Gather confirmation precedes the same tick's position snapshot.
            // Include that pending movement and the launch tick when necessary.
            for(let i=0;i<(pendingPosition?2:1);i++){p.x+=vx*tick;p.y+=vy*tick;vx*=decay;vy*=decay;}
            return p;
        }
        const resumable=new Set(['instakill','reverse','knockbackTick','spikeSyncHammer']);
        function holdFollowup(active,reason){
            if(!active||!resumable.has(active.def.id)||active.lastAttackAt==null||!active.stages[active.phase]?.attack||blocked(ctx,true))return false;
            const target=targetOf(active);
            if(!target?.alive||!target.visible||ctx.objects?.isFriendly(target.sid))return false;
            const time=now();
            active.followupUntil??=Math.min(active.deadline,time+Math.max(650,tick*4+Math.min(250,ctx.net.ping||0)));
            if(time>=active.followupUntil)return false;
            active.followupReason=reason;
            state.last=reason;
            recheckAt(active,Math.min(active.followupUntil,time+tick));
            return true;
        }
        let armedWake=null;
        function tryArmed(){
            armedWake=null;
            if(state.active||rightHeld||blocked(ctx)||!Object.values(state.armed).some(Boolean))return;
            const threat=root.MooMooThreats,primary=ctx.self.weapons?.[0],secondary=ctx.self.weapons?.[1],weaponData=ctx.data.weapon(primary);
            if(!threat||!weaponData||primary===8||weaponData.projectile!=null)return;
            const ready=id=>root.MooMooAutoReload?.ready(id)??threat.ready(ctx.self.sid,id);
            const inTrap=!!threat.selfTrap();
            if(!inTrap&&!ready(primary))return;
            for(const id of Object.keys(state.armed)){
                if(!state.armed[id])continue;
                const def=definitions.find(d=>d.id===id),upgrading=['age1Insta','katanaInsta'].includes(id),boost=id==='boostTick';
                if(upgrading&&(!upgradeEligible(ctx,def.upgrade)||primary!==(id==='age1Insta'?0:3)))continue;
                if(upgrading&&owns(ctx,53)&&!threat.turretReady(ctx.self.sid))continue;
                if(!upgrading&&(![9,12,13,15].includes(secondary)||!inTrap&&!ready(secondary)||owns(ctx,53)&&!threat.turretReady(ctx.self.sid)))continue;
                if(boost&&inTrap)continue;
                if(boost&&![9,12,13].includes(secondary))continue;
                if(boost&&!canUse(ctx,findItem(ctx,'booster')))continue;
                for(const ranked of threat.rankTargets(id,primary,{scoreOnly:true,maxRange:400,requireCurrent:!boost,ignoreReload:inTrap})){
                    const entry={...ranked,distance:ranked.state.distance};
                    if(!boost&&!ranked.evaluation.feasible)continue;
                    const enemy=api.player(entry.sid);if(!enemy?.alive||!enemy.visible||(boost?entry.distance<300||entry.distance>350:entry.distance>Math.min(id==='reverse'?195:Infinity,weaponData.range+(enemy.scale||35)*1.8))||instaBlocked(ctx,entry.sid,upgrading))continue;
                    if(upgrading&&!upgradeInstaRange(ctx,enemy)){state.last='waiting-for-spike-range';continue;}
                    if(boost&&(!boostClear(ctx,enemy)||!root.MooMooPlacers?.defend(findItem(ctx,'booster').id,[boostDirection(ctx,enemy)],1,false,null,{dryRun:true,interruptManual:true})))continue;
                    request(ctx,def,{automatic:true,targetSid:entry.sid});run();return;
                }
            }
        }
        function scheduleArmed(){if(armedWake==null&&Object.values(state.armed).some(Boolean))armedWake=(root.MooMooPrivateBackground?.timers||root).setTimeout(tryArmed,0);}
        let running=false,rerunOwner=null,queuedRun=false;
        function run(){
            if(running){
                rerunOwner=state.active;
                if(!queuedRun){
                    queuedRun=true;root.queueMicrotask(()=>{queuedRun=false;if(state.active===rerunOwner)run();});
                }
                return;
            }
            running=true;
            try{advanceCombat();}finally{running=false;}
        }
        function advanceCombat(){
            if(protectLethalSpikeCombo())return;
            if(!finishingInsta()&&root.MooMooOpportunities?.tryNonSoldier?.())return;
            const active=state.active;if(!active)return;

            if(active.def.id==='autoBullSpam'&&root.MooMooThreats.selfTrap()){cancel('trapped');return;}
            if(!active.waitingSwing&&active.def.followupReady&&!active.def.followupReady()){cancel('sync-range-or-finish-lost');return;}
            if(active.followupUntil!=null&&now()>=active.followupUntil){cancel(active.followupReason);return;}
            if(active.def.id!=='animalSteal'&&(active.trappedStart||resumable.has(active.def.id)&&active.lastAttackAt!=null)&&!active.finishing&&active.stages[active.phase]?.hat!=null&&active.stages[active.phase].hat!==6&&owns(ctx,active.stages[active.phase].hat)&&owns(ctx,6)&&root.AntimoocheatEquipment.urgent()){
                if(!holdFollowup(active,'defense-priority'))cancel('defense-priority');
                return;
            }
            if(active.def.id==='perfectBoostTick'){root.MooMooPerfectBoostTick?.run();return;}
            if(opportunistic.has(active.def.id)&&protectOpportunity())return;
            if(stickUnavailable(ctx.self.weapons,active.def.id)){cancel('stick-unavailable');return;}
            if(active.boostMoveTick!=null&&tickSerial>=active.boostMoveTick+2){
                executing=true;
                try{if(ctx.send.stopMove()!==true)return;active.boostMoveTick=null;}finally{executing=false;}
                if(active.def.id==='dash'&&active.phase===1){cancel('dash-entry-timeout');return;}
            }
            if(active.def.id==='boostTick'&&![9,12,13].includes(ctx.self.weapons?.[1])){cancel('boost-weapon-unavailable');return;}
            if(active.def.id==='nonSoldierSpike'&&!active.sent&&!nonSoldierSpikePlan(ctx,active.targetSid)){cancel('spike-path-lost');return;}
            if(active.finishing){if(tickSerial>=active.finishing.after)cancel(active.finishing.reason,active.finishing.restore);return;}
            const dashUse=active.def.id==='dash'&&!active.waitingSwing?dashWeapon(ctx):null;
            if(active.def.id==='dash'&&!active.waitingSwing&&dashUse==null){cancel('dash-unavailable');return;}
            if(active.def.id==='dash'&&active.phase===1&&tickSerial<=active.boostMoveTick)return;
            if(!active.controls){
                if(!ctx.net.wouldAllowBatch([...(!active.preserveMovement?['e']:[]),...(state.wireAuto?['K']:[])]))return;
                executing=true;
                try{
                    if(active.def.id!=='oneTick'&&!active.preserveMovement&&ctx.send.stopMove()!==true)return;
                    if(state.wireAuto){if(ctx.send.toggle(1)!==true)return;active.autoPaused=true;}
                }finally{executing=false;}
                active.controls=true;
            }
            const stacking=active.automatic&&active.def.id==='oneTick';
            if(stacking&&active.phase<=1&&!active.dragonCape&&root.MooMooAutomation?.status().dragonOneTick){
                const target=targetOf(active);
                if((target?.accessory??target?.tail??target?.tailIndex)===15){
                    if(!root.MooMooAutomation.capeReady(target)){cancel('dragon-cape-buff-required');return;}
                    active.dragonCape=true;
                }
            }
            if(stacking&&active.phase===0&&active.entry){
                const enemy=targetOf(active),plan=root.MooMooAutomation.stackPlan(active.targetSid);
                if(!enemy?.alive||!enemy.visible||[6,60,61,22].includes(enemy.hat??enemy.skinIndex)&&!plan.hatWindow?.valid||root.MooMooThreats.distance(ctx.self,enemy)>400||now()>active.entry.until){cancel('entry-ended');return;}
                if(plan.reason==='movement-in-flight'){recheckAt(active,now()+tick/2);return;}
                if(plan.valid){
                    if(oneTickWindow().launchAt>now()+2){recheckAt(active,oneTickWindow().launchAt);return;}
                    active.entry=null;
                }else{
                    const next=root.MooMooAutomation.stackEntry(active.targetSid);
                    if(!next){cancel('entry-path-lost');return;}
                    if(ctx.self.weaponIndex!==ctx.self.weapons[0]){
                        if(!active.entry.weaponAt||now()-active.entry.weaponAt>250){
                            executing=true;try{if(ctx.send.selectItem(ctx.self.weapons[0],true)===true)active.entry.weaponAt=now();}finally{executing=false;}
                        }
                        recheckAt(active,now()+tick/2);return;
                    }
                    if(active.entry.lastDir==null||Math.abs(Math.atan2(Math.sin(next.entry.dir-active.entry.lastDir),Math.cos(next.entry.dir-active.entry.lastDir)))>.01){
                        executing=true;
                        try{if(ctx.send.move(next.entry.dir)!==true){recheckAt(active,now()+25);return;}active.entry.lastDir=next.entry.dir;}finally{executing=false;}
                    }
                    state.last='oneTick-approach';recheckAt(active,now()+tick/2);return;
                }
            }

            if(active.phase===0&&!active.sent&&(stacking||active.def.id==='instakill'&&ctx.self.weapons?.[1]===10)&&hammerInstaProtected(targetOf(active)?.hat??targetOf(active)?.skinIndex,active.hammerSpike)&&!(stacking&&root.MooMooAutomation?.stackPlan(active.targetSid).hatWindow?.valid)){
                cancel('waiting-for-unarmored-target');return;
            }
            if(stacking&&active.phase===0&&!active.stackWindow&&!root.MooMooAutomation?.stackPlan(active.targetSid).valid){cancel('stack-window-lost');return;}
            const kbTurretOpener=['knockbackTurret','knockbackTick'].includes(active.def.id)&&active.stages[0]?.hat===53;
            if(stacking&&active.phase===0&&!active.preparingTurret&&lastUpdateAt===null)return;
            if(stacking&&active.phase===0&&!active.preparingTurret&&!root.AntimoocheatEquipment.settled(53)&&lastUpdateAt!==null){
                const time=now(),gate=root.AntimoocheatEquipment.hatWait();
                const ping=Math.max(0,ctx.net.minPing?.()||ctx.net.ping||0),slack=Math.max(6,2*updatePeriod-206);
                const offset=Math.min(13,Math.max(6,(2*tick-200)/2));
                let start=lastUpdateAt+(ping<=slack?0:(updatePeriod-ping%updatePeriod)%updatePeriod)+offset;
                const late=time+gate-start-Math.min(stacking?8:20,slack);
                if(late>0)start+=Math.ceil(late/updatePeriod)*updatePeriod;
                active.launchAt=Math.max(time+gate,start);
                active.expectedFireAt=start+updatePeriod-offset;
                if(stacking){const window=oneTickWindow();active.stackWindow??={launchAt:window.launchAt,fireAt:window.fireAt};active.launchAt=window.launchAt;active.expectedFireAt=window.fireAt;}
                const wait=active.launchAt-time;
                if(wait>1){
                    recheckAt(active,active.launchAt);
                    return;
                }
            }
            if(blocked(ctx)){
                if(root.MooMooDefenses?.protectingBow?.()&&holdFollowup(active,'defense-priority'))return;
                cancel(root.MooMooDefenses?.protectingBow?.()?'defense-priority':'stopped');return;
            }
            if(active.targetSid!=null){
                const target=targetOf(active);if(!target||!(target.alive||active.targetAnimal&&target.active&&target.health>0)||!target.visible||!active.targetAnimal&&ctx.objects?.isFriendly(target.sid)){cancel('target-lost');return;}
                if(active.def.id==='spikeContact'&&!active.waitingSwing){const contact=root.MooMooOpportunities?.contactPlan(active.targetSid);if(!contact){cancel('spike-contact-lost');return;}active.contactDirection=contact.angle;}
                if(active.def.id==='knockbackPrimary'&&!active.waitingTurret&&active.stages[active.phase]?.attack&&(!active.waitingSwing||active.waitingSwing.observed)&&knockbackTarget(ctx,active.phase>0,active.targetSid,active.def.id==='knockbackTick')!==active.targetSid){cancel('knockback-path-lost');return;}
                if(active.def.id==='spikeStrike'&&!active.sent&&!root.MooMooOpportunities?.canSpikeStrike(active.targetSid)){cancel('spike-path-lost');return;}
                if(active.def.id==='turretSteal'){
                    if(!root.MooMooOpportunities?.canTurret(active.targetSid,true)){cancel('turret-target-lost');return;}
                    if(active.waitingTurret){state.last='waiting-for-turret';return;}
                }
                if(stacking&&active.phase===1){
                    // The impact-time hat forecast is checked by stackShot below.
                    const flight=active.turretShot,rtt=active.equipmentRtt??Math.max(0,ctx.net.ping||0);
                    if(flight){
                        if(tickSerial>flight.tick+1||now()>=flight.at+updatePeriod-rtt+5){cancel('stack-window-lost');return;}
                    }else{
                        const launch=active.stackLaunch;
                        if(!launch||rtt<updatePeriod*.5||!root.AntimoocheatEquipment.settled(53)){
                            state.last='waiting-for-turret';return;
                        }
                        // Express server tick boundaries on the client's send clock.
                        const shotAt=launch.fireAt;
                        const due=Math.max(shotAt+10,now()+root.AntimoocheatEquipment.hatWait());
                        if(due>=shotAt+updatePeriod-6){cancel('stack-window-lost');return;}
                        if(due>now()+1){recheckAt(active,due);state.last='waiting-for-stack-time';return;}
                        if(!root.MooMooAutomation.isTurretTarget(target.sid)){cancel('stack-target-changed');return;}
                    }
                    const predictionSteps=flight?Math.max(1,flight.tick+2-tickSerial):Math.max(1,Math.round((active.stackLaunch.fireAt+updatePeriod+rtt-lastUpdateAt)/updatePeriod));
                    active.stackFollow=root.MooMooAutomation.stackShot(active.targetSid,{...(flight||active.stackLaunch.path),impactLead:Math.max(0,(flight?flight.at+updatePeriod:active.stackLaunch.fireAt+updatePeriod+rtt)-now()),predictionSteps,predicted:!flight});
                    if(!Number.isFinite(active.stackFollow.angle))active.stackFollow.angle=angle(ctx,ctx.self.weapons[0]);
                }
            }
            if(active.breakHandoff){
                if(now()<active.breakHandoff.until){
                    state.last='waiting-for-break-swing';
                    if(active.breakWake==null)active.breakWake=(root.MooMooPrivateBackground?.timers||root).setTimeout(()=>{active.breakWake=null;if(state.active===active)run();},Math.max(1,active.breakHandoff.until-now()));
                    return;
                }
                active.breakHandoff=null;
            }
            if(active.preparing){
                const target=targetOf(active),threat=root.MooMooThreats;
                const reverse=active.def.id==='reverse',upgrading=['age1Insta','katanaInsta'].includes(active.def.id);

                const reachOptions={requireCurrent:true,ignoreReload:true};
                if(active.trappedStart&&active.def.id==='instakill'){reachOptions.trapOpening=true;reachOptions.horizon=0;}
                if(!target||!threat.evaluateAttack(target,reachWeapon,reachOptions).feasible||
                    reverse&&threat.distance(ctx.self,target)>195||upgrading&&!upgradeInstaRange(ctx,target)||instaBlocked(ctx,active.targetSid,upgrading,false,active.hammerSpike)){
                    cancel(active.trappedStart?'opening-unavailable':'target-lost');return;
                }
                const cooling=active.stages.filter(s=>s.attack&&s.upgrade==null).map(s=>ctx.self.weapons?.[s.slot]??ctx.self.weapons?.[0]).filter(id=>id!=null&&!(root.MooMooAutoReload?.ready(id)??threat.ready(ctx.self.sid,id)));
                const preferHammer=cooling.includes(10)&&reloadPriority(ctx.self.weapons,threat.selfTrap())===10;
                const pending=preferHammer?10:cooling[0];
                if(pending!=null){
                    state.last='waiting-for-combo-reload';
                    if(!(root.MooMooAutoReload?.isSelected(pending)??(state.weapon===pending))&&ctx.net.wouldAllowBatch(['F','z'])){
                        executing=true;
                        try{
                            if(ctx.send.mouse(false,angle(ctx))!==true||ctx.send.selectItem(pending,true)!==true){cancel('send-failed');return;}
                            state.weapon=pending;active.preparedSelection=true;
                        }finally{executing=false;}
                    }
                    return;
                }
                active.preparing=false;
            }
            if(active.waitingTurret){state.last='waiting-for-turret';return;}
            if(now()>active.deadline){cancel('stopped');reject('stopped',active.def.name+': timed out waiting for game updates, gear or an upgrade.');return;}

                const pendingWeapon=active.waitingSwing.weapon;
                if(targetLeftMeleeReach(active,pendingWeapon)){cancel('target-lost');return;}
                state.last='waiting-for-attack';
                return;
            }
            if(active.nextAfterUpdate!=null){
                if(tickSerial<=active.nextAfterUpdate&&now()<active.nextUpdateDeadline){recheckAt(active,active.nextUpdateDeadline);return;}
                active.nextAfterUpdate=null;
            }
            let stage=active.stages[active.phase];
            if(stage?.attack&&active.def.name==='SpikeSync'&&!root.MooMooOpportunities?.spikeWindow(active.targetSid,active.phaseEquipment?.request).allowed){cancel('spike-sync-window-ended');return;}
            if(optionalTurretIds.has(active.def.id)&&stage?.hat===53&&!active.preparingTurret&&root.MooMooThreats?.turretReady(ctx.self.sid)===false){
                stage={...stage};delete stage.hat;delete stage.waitForTurret;
            }
            if(active.def.id==='spikeSyncHammer'&&active.phase===0&&active.planTick!==tickSerial){

                if(!plan||plan.trap!==active.syncTrap){cancel('trap-sync-window-lost');return;}
                active.syncAim=plan.aim;active.planTick=tickSerial;
            }

                    active.kbPositionDeadline??=now()+tick*2+Math.min(250,ctx.net.ping||0);
                    if(now()>=active.kbPositionDeadline){cancel('stale-target-position');return;}
                    state.last='waiting-for-impact-position';recheckAt(active,active.kbPositionDeadline);return;
                }
                const valid=followup?retainedKnockbackPath(ctx,active):
                    (active.def.id==='knockbackTick'?knockbackTarget(ctx,false,active.targetSid):turretKnockbackTarget(ctx,false,active.targetSid))===active.targetSid;
                if(!valid){
                    if(followup&&(active.confirmedAtTick===tickSerial||active.kbShot&&!active.kbShot.ended&&tickSerial===active.confirmedAtTick+1)){state.last='waiting-for-impact-position';return;}
                    cancel('knockback-path-lost');return;
                }

            if(active.def.id==='spikeSyncHammer'&&active.phase===1){

                // A confirmed Hammer swing is not confirmation that this trap
                // disappeared. Keep the offensive hat and contact strike queued
                // until removal is observed; Preplacer has its own early queue.
                if(waitingForTrap){state.last='waiting-for-trap-removal';return;}
                if(equipment.urgent()&&owns(ctx,6)){cancel('defense-priority');return;}
                if(!equipment.settled(7)&&equipment.pending(false)?.id!==7){
                    executing=true;try{if(ctx.net.wouldAllowBatch(['c']))ctx.send.store(1,7,false);}finally{executing=false;}
                    if(equipment.pending(false)?.id===7)active.syncBullSent=equipment.pending(false);
                    if(equipment.pending(false)?.id!==7&&active.equipmentWake==null){
                        active.equipmentWake=(root.MooMooPrivateBackground?.timers||root).setTimeout(()=>{
                            active.equipmentWake=null;if(state.active===active)run();
                        },Math.max(5,equipment.waitMs(7)+1));
                    }
                }

            }
            // Only the final defensive return yields to an ongoing physical click.
            // Attack stages and forced one-tick defenses keep their own equipment.
            if(stage?.hat===6&&!stage.attack&&active.phase===active.stages.length-1&&root.MooMooBaseClicks?.status().active&&(root.MooMooBaseClicks.heldHat()!=null||!root.AntimoocheatDefense?.forcedArmor?.()&&!root.MooMooDefenses?.protectingBow?.())){
                stage={...stage};delete stage.hat;
            }

                !root.AntimoocheatEquipment.urgent(true)&&!root.MooMooBaseClicks?.status().active&&!state.down&&!state.auto){
                const sid=active.targetSid;active.transferToTurret=true;cancel('complete',false);
                if(!root.MooMooCombatMacros.turretStrike(sid))armSoldier();
                return;
            }
            if(soldierFinish&&active.turretForecast&&now()<active.turretForecast.until&&active.waitingSwing?.observed&&
                targetOf(active)?.health<active.turretForecast.before&&root.MooMooOpportunities?.canTurret(active.targetSid,false,active.turretForecast.remaining)&&
                !root.AntimoocheatEquipment.urgent(true)&&!root.MooMooBaseClicks?.status().active&&!state.down&&!state.auto){
                recheckAt(active,active.turretForecast.until);return;
            }
            if(soldierFinish&&active.phase===active.stages.length-1&&active.waitingSwing?.observed&&!state.down&&!state.auto&&root.MooMooCombatDefense?.readyToResume()){
