            }
            const stageInterval=stage?.place?amPlacementPacing.intervalMs:tick*.85;
            if(!stage?.attack&&!soldierFinish&&!(stacking&&active.phase===1)&&!(active.def.id==='dash'&&active.phase===1)&&now()-active.lastTick<stageInterval){recheckAt(active,active.lastTick+stageInterval);return;}
            if(!stage){cancel('complete',false);return;}
            if(active.automatic&&active.def.id==='instakill'&&stage.attack){
                const reason=instaBlocked(ctx,active.targetSid,false,active.lastAttackAt!=null,active.hammerSpike);
                if(reason){
                    if(!(['blocked-projectile','shield-facing'].includes(reason)&&holdFollowup(active,reason)))cancel(reason);
                    return;
                }
            }
            const hammerInsta=active.def.id==='instakill'&&active.openingWeapon===10&&stage.attack;
            if(hammerInsta){
                const target=targetOf(active),threat=root.MooMooThreats,primary=ctx.self.weapons[0];
                const reachable=id=>threat.evaluateAttack(target,id,{requireCurrent:true,ignoreReload:true,trapOpening:active.trappedStart,horizon:0}).feasible;
                if(!reachable(primary)||stage.slot===1&&!reachable(10)){cancel(stage.slot===1?'opening-unavailable':'primary-out-of-range');return;}
                if(stage.slot===1&&!hammerFollowupReady(ctx,active.targetSid,active.hammerSpike,null,active.hammerSpike)){cancel('opening-unavailable');return;}
            }
            const upgrade=stage.upgrade??stage.itemUpgrade;
            if(upgrade!=null) {
                const isItem=stage.itemUpgrade!=null,inventory=isItem?ctx.self.items:ctx.self.weapons;
                if(!inventory?.includes(upgrade)) {


                    if(active.upgradeSent&&now()<active.upgradeUntil)return;
                    const entry=isItem?ctx.data.item(upgrade):ctx.data.weapon(upgrade);
                    const available=state.offer.points>0&&state.offer.age===entry?.age&&(isItem||upgradeEligible(ctx,upgrade));
                    if(!active.upgradeSent&&available){
                        if(!ctx.net.wouldAllowBatch(['H']))return;
                        if(!ctx.send.upgrade(upgrade+(isItem?ctx.data.weapons.length:0))){cancel('send-failed');return;}
                        active.upgradeSent=true;active.upgradeUntil=now()+500;state.last='waiting-for-upgrade';return;
                    }
                    if(Object.hasOwn(state.armed,active.def.id)){cancel('upgrade-unavailable');return;}
                }
            }
            const selected=weapon(ctx);
            let slot=stage.slot;
            if(stage.dash){
                slot=ctx.self.weapons.indexOf(dashUse);
            }
            const use=slot==null?null:(ctx.self.weapons?.[slot]??ctx.self.weapons?.[0]??selected);
            if(stage.attack&&targetLeftMeleeReach(active,use)){cancel('target-lost');return;}
            if((active.followupUntil!=null||active.def.id==='reverse'&&active.lastAttackAt!=null)&&stage.attack&&ctx.data.weapon(use)?.projectile==null&&
                !root.MooMooThreats.evaluateAttack(targetOf(active),use,{requireCurrent:true,ignoreReload:true,trapOpening:active.trappedStart,horizon:0}).feasible){
                cancel('target-lost');return;
            }

            if(stage.requireContact&&!contactPlan){
                if(['instakill','age1Insta','katanaInsta','spikeSyncHammer'].includes(active.def.id)&&active.waitingSwing?.observed){
                    if(active.contactUntil==null)active.contactUntil=now()+(syncSpace?tick*1.25:tick*3);
                    if(now()<active.contactUntil){
                        state.last='waiting-for-spike-contact';recheckAt(active,Math.min(active.contactUntil,now()+amPlacementPacing.intervalMs));return;
                    }
                }
                cancel('no-stack-contact');return;
            }
            if(active.def.id==='nonSoldierSpike'&&(!contactPlan||!nativePlacementCheck(ctx,item.id,contactPlan.angle))){cancel('no-stack-contact');return;}
            active.contactUntil=null;
            const spikeAngle=contactPlan?.angle??(item&&stage.freeSpike?freeSpikeAngle(ctx,item,dir,targetOf(active)):null);
            if(item&&stage.freeSpike&&spikeAngle===null)item=null;
            if(stage.confirmedSpike&&targetOf(active)&&!contactPlan)item=null;
            if(!Number.isFinite(dir)||!Number.isInteger(selected)||slot!=null&&!Number.isInteger(use)){
                cancel('missing-item-or-resource');return;
            }
            const ready=id=>root.MooMooAutoReload?.ready(id)??root.MooMooThreats?.ready(ctx.self.sid,id)??true;
            const pending=active.def.id==='boostTick'&&active.phase===0?(ctx.self.weapons||[]).find(id=>!ready(id)):null;
            const reloadWeapon=pending??use;
            if(pending!=null||(stage.waitReload||stage.attack)&&!ready(use)){
                state.last=stage.dash?'waiting-for-dash-reload':'waiting-for-combo-reload';

                if(Number.isFinite(remaining)&&remaining>0)recheckAt(active,now()+Math.max(1,remaining));
                if((active.reloadWeapon!==reloadWeapon||selected!==reloadWeapon)&&ctx.net.wouldAllowBatch(['F','z'])){
                    executing=true;try{
                        if(ctx.send.mouse(false,dir)!==true||ctx.send.selectItem(reloadWeapon,true)!==true){cancel('send-failed');return;}
                        state.weapon=reloadWeapon;active.reloadWeapon=reloadWeapon;active.sent=true;
                    }finally{executing=false;}
                }
                return;
            }
            if(active.def.id!=='animalSteal'&&(stage.attack||stage.hat===53)&&root.AntimoocheatDefense?.prepareAttackAccessory()===false){state.last='waiting-for-accessory';return;}

            // A late placement after the primary confirmation cannot be a
            // same-tick strike. Preserve the primary, omit a speculative spike.
            if(item&&stage.freeSpike&&stage.attack&&active.def.id==='instakill'&&targetOf(active)&&!contactPlan)item=null;
            if(contactPlan&&stage.attack)dir=contactPlan.aim;
            const commands=[];
            const push=(name,args,wire)=>commands.push({name,args,wire});
            const aimAfterPlacement=active.hammerSpike&&item&&stage.attack;
            if(active.targetSid!=null&&!aimAfterPlacement)push('aim',[dir],'D');
            if(stage.dashMove){
                if((ctx.self.hat??ctx.self.skin)===40)push('store',[1,owns(ctx,6)?6:(ctx.self.hat??0),false],'c');
                push('move',[dir],'9');
            }
            if(stage.dash&&!stage.dashMove)push('aim',[dir],'D');
            if(active.automatic&&active.def.id==='boostTick'&&active.phase===0)push('move',[boostDirection(ctx,targetOf(active))],'9');
            if(stacking){
                const plan=active.phase===0?root.MooMooAutomation.stackPlan(active.targetSid):active.stackFollow;
                if(active.phase===0&&!active.turretUsed&&!plan.valid){cancel('stack-window-lost');return;}
                if(active.phase===0){active.stackPath=plan.shotPath;active.predictedHatOpening=plan.hatWindow?.valid===true;}
                if(active.phase===0&&plan.move==null)push('stopMove',[],'e');else push('move',[active.phase===0?plan.move:plan.angle],'9');
                if(active.dragonCape&&active.phase<=1)push('store',[1,2,true],'c');
                else if(active.phase<=1 && !root.AntimoocheatDefense?.settings.distanceAccessory){const current=ctx.self.accessory??ctx.self.tailIndex??0;const accessory=[current,21,19,0].find(id=>id!==11&&(id===0||owns(ctx,id,true)));if(accessory!==current)push('store',[1,accessory,true],'c');}
            }
            const place=()=>{
                const offsets=stage.placeOffsets||[0];
                const restore=stage.attack||stage.placeAfterAttack||stage.dash||stage.upgrade!=null?use:selected;
                for(let i=0;i<offsets.length&&canUse(ctx,item,i+1);i++){
                    const placementAngle=stage.freeSpike?spikeAngle:(stage.place==='booster'?(stage.dash?dir:active.automatic&&active.def.id==='boostTick'?boostDirection(ctx,targetOf(active)):pointer(ctx)):dir)+offsets[i];
                    commands.push({name:'nativePlace',args:[item.id,placementAngle,restore,replacingTrap],wires:active.hammerSpike?['z','F','F','z']:['z','F','z']});
                }
            };
            if(!active.sent)push('mouse',[false,dir],'F');
            if(item&&stage.placeFirst)place();
            const stageHat=stage.hat===6?defenseHat(ctx):stage.hat;
            if(stageHat!=null&&owns(ctx,stageHat))push('store',[1,stageHat,false],'c');
            if(stage.accessory!=null&&owns(ctx,stage.accessory,true))push('store',[1,stage.accessory,true],'c');
            if(item&&!stage.placeFirst&&!stage.placeAfterAttack)place();
            if(stacking&&active.phase===0&&selected!==ctx.self.weapons[0])push('selectItem',[ctx.self.weapons[0],true],'z');
            if(use!=null)push('selectItem',[use,true],'z');
            if(aimAfterPlacement)push('aim',[dir],'D');
            if(stage.attack){push('mouse',[true,dir],'F');push('mouse',[false,dir],'F');}
            if(item&&stage.placeAfterAttack)place();
            const planned=[];
            for(let i=0;i<commands.length;i++)if(commands[i].name==='nativePlace'){
                const placement=nativePlacementCheck(ctx,commands[i].args[0],commands[i].args[1],planned,replacingTrap);
                if(!placement){
                    if(hammerInsta){
                        if(stage.requireContact){cancel('no-stack-contact');return;}
                        commands.splice(i--,1);continue;
                    }
                    if(['age1Insta','katanaInsta'].includes(active.def.id)){commands.splice(i--,1);continue;}
                    cancel('no-placement-space');return;
                }
                planned.push(placement);
            }
            for(let i=commands.length-1;i>0;i--){
                if(commands[i].name==='selectItem'&&commands[i-1].name==='nativePlace'&&commands[i-1].args[2]===commands[i].args[0])commands.splice(i,1);
            }
            const final=active.phase===active.stages.length-1;
            // The previous pulse is already confirmed and released. Returning
            // its weapon need not wait for the final Soldier acknowledgement.

                !state.down&&!state.auto&&!root.MooMooBaseClicks?.status().active&&
                !(root.MooMooAutoReload?.isSelected(use)??selected===use)){
                if(!ctx.net.wouldAllowBatch(['z'])){state.last='budget';recheckAt(active,now()+25);return;}
                const prior=executing;executing=true;
                try{
                    if(ctx.send.selectItem(use,true)!==true){state.last='waiting-for-return-weapon';recheckAt(active,now()+25);return;}
                    state.weapon=use;
                }finally{executing=prior;}
            }

            if(final&&soldierFinish&&active.def.id==='instakill'&&active.waitingSwing?.observed&&
                !state.down&&!state.auto&&!root.MooMooBaseClicks?.status().active&&

                cancel('complete');return;

            if(final&&state.down&&active.def.id!=='dragonPrime')push('mouse',[true,dir],'F');

            // A deferred equip must not partially fire and cancel the combo.
            const stageEquipment=new Map();
            for(const c of commands)if(c.name==='store'&&c.args[0]===1)stageEquipment.set(!!c.args[2],c.args[1]);
            const wires=commands.filter(c=>c.name!=='store').flatMap(c=>c.wires||[c.wire]);
            const volley=active.def.id==='instakill'&&stage.attack&&stage.hat===53&&owns(ctx,53);
            const volleyTiming=volley&&targetOf(active)&&ctx.data.weapon(use)?.projectile!=null?(()=>{
                const target=targetOf(active),threat=root.MooMooThreats,gear=ctx.data.hat(53).turret;
                const self=threat.position(ctx.self),enemy=use===15?instaVolleyTarget(target):threat.position(target),dx=enemy.x-self.x,dy=enemy.y-self.y,d=Math.hypot(dx,dy);
                const hitDistance=d-(target.scale||35)*d/Math.max(Math.abs(dx),Math.abs(dy),1);
                const shot=ctx.data.projectiles[ctx.data.weapon(use).projectile];
                return {turret:Math.max(1,Math.ceil(hitDistance/(ctx.data.projectiles[gear.proj].speed*tick))),
                    secondary:Math.max(1,Math.ceil(Math.max(0,hitDistance-2*(ctx.self.scale||35))/(shot.speed*(ctx.data.hat(53)?.aMlt||1)*tick)))};
            })():null;
            const pairedVolley=!!volleyTiming&&volleyTiming.turret===volleyTiming.secondary;
            if(volley&&use===15&&state.weapon!==use){
                if(!ctx.net.wouldAllowBatch(['z'])){state.last='budget';recheckAt(active,now()+25);return;}

                try{if(ctx.send.selectItem(use,true)!==true){recheckAt(active,now()+25);return;}state.weapon=use;}finally{executing=prior;}

                const rtt=Math.max(0,ping,active.hatRtt??0);

                if(active.volleyAt==null||active.volleyAnchor!==lastUpdateAt&&time+6<active.volleyAt){
                    const phase=((readyAt-lastUpdateAt+rtt)%period+period)%period;
                    const tight=rtt>period*.6,center=tight?3:Math.min(period*.3,slack/2);
                    const early=tight?0:margin,late=tight?Math.min(8,slack/3+3):slack-margin;
                    active.volleyAt=phase<early?readyAt+center-phase:phase>late?readyAt+period-phase+center:readyAt;
                    active.volleyAnchor=lastUpdateAt;
                }
                if(active.volleyAt>time+1){state.last='waiting-for-volley-window';recheckAt(active,active.volleyAt);return;}

            // An extra acknowledgement round trip separates Turret from Hammer

            if((pairedHammer||pairedVolley)&&!ctx.net.wouldAllowBatch([...wires,'c','F','z','D'])){state.last='budget';recheckAt(active,now()+25);return;}

            for(const [tail,id]of stageEquipment){
                if(!root.AntimoocheatEquipment.settled(id,tail)){
                    const equipment=root.AntimoocheatEquipment;
                    const before=equipment.pending(tail);
                    const instaHat=active.def.id==='instakill'&&stage.attack&&!tail;

                    if(waitingHat&&now()>=active.requestedHat.deadline){

                        try{if(ctx.send.store(1,id,tail)&&!tail&&id===53){active.turretUsed=true;active.preparingTurret=true;}}finally{executing=prior;}

            if(active.automatic&&active.def.id==='oneTick'){
                clearPhaseTimer(active);ctx.send.stopMove();active.lastTick=now()-tick;run();return;
            }
            if(active.def.id==='instakill'&&active.stages[active.phase]?.hat===6){

                return;
            }
            if(['spikeSyncHammer','knockbackTick'].includes(active.def.id)&&active.stages[active.phase]?.attack){
                active.hammerObservedAt=now();active.confirmedAtTick=tickSerial;active.lastTick=now()-tick;
                run();return;
            }
            if(active.def.id==='boostTick'){active.lastTick=now()-tick;run();return;}

                // the new positions, rather than adding a second acknowledgement
                // round trip after those positions arrive. Placement is still
                // revalidated at execution and never precedes a confirmed Bull.

        function possibleOtherShooter(shot){
            for(const other of api.players.values()){
                if(other.sid===ctx.self.sid||!other.alive||!other.visible||ctx.data.weapon(other.weaponIndex)?.projectile!==shot.index)continue;

                if(Math.hypot(shot.x-pos.x-70*Math.cos(shot.dir),shot.y-pos.y-70*Math.sin(shot.dir))<45)return true;
            }
            return false;
        }

    (function installDefensiveCombat(api,root){
    'use strict';
    const background=()=>root.MooMooPrivateBackground?.allowed()===true;
    const id='defensive-combat';if(api.getMods().some(m=>m.id===id))return;
    return api.register({id,name:'Combat Defense',version:'0.1.0',defaultEnabled:true,liveSettings:true,settings:[
        {key:'antiOneTick',type:'boolean',default:false,label:'Anti OneTick',category:'Hat Keybinds',hint:'Soldier during a reachable Polearm + Turret threat. Blocks Tank until it passes.'},
        {key:'autobreak',type:'boolean',default:false,label:'Autobreaker',category:'Placers',hint:'Hammer breaks nearby hazards; Katana reaches farther spikes. Returns to Soldier after danger or exit.'}
    ]},ctx=>{
        const threat=root.MooMooThreats,now=()=>root.performance?.now()??Date.now();
        let timer=null,timerAt=Infinity,active=null,holding=null,executing=false,blurred=false,disposed=false,lastArmor=-Infinity,pendingHat=null,pauseUntil=0;
        let tickIndex=0,nextAttackTick=0,nextAttackAt=0,trapSid=null,soldierPending=false,tankOwned=false,soldierDeadline=0,reloadRetryAt=0,resumeBuilding=null;
        let spaceHeld=false,spaceOriginal=null,spaceTap=null;
        const manualBreak=()=>spaceHeld||!!spaceTap;
        const breakEnabled=()=>manualBreak()||ctx.settings.autobreak;
        const trapCycleActive=()=>breakEnabled()&&!!threat.selfTrap();
        const spaceBlocked=()=>ctx.input.isTyping()||root.AntimoocheatPlacementHost?.isOpen()||root.AntimoocheatPlacementHost?.capturingKey()||root.document.hidden&&!background();
        const intent={weapon:null,down:false,auto:false};
        let manualShotUntil=0;
        let wireAuto=false,wireWeapon=null,wireAim=null,wireItem=null,lastItemSelection=-Infinity;
        const status={target:null,targets:[],weapon:null,reason:'idle',antiOneTick:false};
        const effectiveHat=()=>root.AntimoocheatEquipment?.pending(false)?null:ctx.self.hat;
        const aim=()=>root.MooMooFacing?.direction(ctx.input)??ctx.input.aimAngle();
        const selected=()=>manualBreak()&&ctx.self.weapons?.includes(spaceOriginal)?spaceOriginal:ctx.self.weapons?.includes(intent.weapon)?intent.weapon:ctx.self.weapons?.includes(ctx.self.weaponIndex)?ctx.self.weaponIndex:ctx.self.weapons?.[0];
        const live=()=>!disposed&&(!blurred||background())&&api.isReady()&&ctx.self.alive&&(!root.document.hidden||background());
        function send(name,...args){
            if(root.MooMooCombatMacros?.status().active)return false;
            try{return ctx.send[name](...args)===true;}catch(_){return false;}
        }
        function startSwing(direction){
            if(!active||!send('mouse',true,direction))return false;
            active.observed=false;active.pulsed=true;active.sentAt=now();
            if(active.spaceAttack&&!spaceTap)spaceTap={target:active.target,sent:true,until:now()+Math.max(700,(ctx.net.ping||0)+4*(ctx.SERVER_TICK||1000/9))};
            active.stopPending=!send('mouse',false,direction);
            if(root.MooMooActionIntent?.owner===id)root.MooMooActionIntent.down=false;
            return true;
        }
        function finish(reason,restore=true){
            if(!['swing-observed','retarget','space-released'].includes(reason))spaceTap=null;
            if(active&&restore&&!manualBreak()&&!['swing-observed','manual-selection','yielded','space-released'].includes(reason))active.original=active.weapon;
            const prior=active||holding;active=null;holding=null;if(!['swing-observed','retarget'].includes(reason))breakAim=null;status.target=null;status.targets=[];status.weapon=null;status.reason=reason;
            if(root.MooMooActionIntent?.owner===id)delete root.MooMooActionIntent;
            if(!prior||!restore||!api.isReady()||!ctx.self.alive)return;
            executing=true;
            try{
                const continuing=breakEnabled()&&['swing-observed','retarget'].includes(reason);
                const dir=continuing?prior.direction:aim();const stopped=send('mouse',false,dir);
                if(continuing){
                    if(reason==='swing-observed'){
                        prior.releaseTick=tickIndex;prior.stoppedAt=now();prior.releaseUntil=now()+Math.max(500,(ctx.net.ping||0)+250);
                        if(prior.returnSoldier){requestSoldier(true);}
                    }
                    holding=prior;status.target=prior.target;status.weapon=prior.weapon;
                    root.MooMooActionIntent={owner:id,direction:prior.direction,weapon:prior.weapon,down:false};return;
                }
                const aimed=send('aim',dir);const restored=send('selectItem',prior.original,true);
                if(wireAuto!==intent.auto)send('toggle',1);
                if(stopped&&aimed&&restored&&intent.down&&root.MooMooBaseClicks?.status().active)send('mouse',true,dir);
                if(tankOwned){requestSoldier();}
            }finally{executing=false;}
        }
        function yieldToLeft(){
            spaceTap=null;spaceOriginal=ctx.self.weapons?.[0]??spaceOriginal;
            if(!active&&!holding)return;
            executing=true;try{send('mouse',false,aim());}finally{executing=false;}
            finish('manual-left',false);
            resumeBuilding=null;soldierPending=tankOwned=false;
            manualShotUntil=now()+(ctx.net.ping||0)+2*(ctx.SERVER_TICK||1000/9);
            if(wireAuto!==intent.auto){
                executing=true;
                try{send('toggle',1);}finally{executing=false;}
            }
            schedule();
        }
        function tankSafety(estimate=threat.snapshot()) {
            if(trapCycleActive())return {blocked:false,damage:0,spikeFollowup:0,replacementDamage:0,reason:'tank-hit-soldier-reload'};
            // A ready enemy primary is not by itself a reason to leave Tank.
            // Evaluate the incoming damage with Tank, independent of the hat
            // currently observed, so equipping Soldier cannot change this decision.
            const factor=(ctx.data.hat(40)?.dmgMult??1)*(ctx.data.accessory(ctx.self.accessory)?.dmgMult??1);
            let damage=estimate.unarmoredDamage*factor;const hp=ctx.self.health;
            // Collision separation can put the attacker just outside melee reach.
            // Until that confirmed spike contact clears, protect one body-width
            // around the hit boundary from an already ready lethal follow-up.
            let spikeFollowup=0;
            if(threat.recentSpikeContact())for(const candidate of estimate.targets){
                const enemy=api.player(candidate.sid);if(!enemy)continue;
                for(const observed of threat.observedWeapons(enemy.sid)){
                    const w=ctx.data.weapon(observed.id);
                    if(!w||w.projectile!=null||candidate.distance>(w.range||0)+(ctx.self.scale||35)*2.8||
                        (threat.reload(enemy.sid,w.id)?.remaining||0)>2*(ctx.SERVER_TICK||1000/9)+(ctx.net.ping||0))continue;
                    spikeFollowup=Math.max(spikeFollowup,threat.meleeDamage({...enemy,hat:7,skinIndex:7},{...ctx.self,hat:40,skinIndex:40},w.id,observed.variant));
                }
            }
            damage=Math.max(damage,spikeFollowup);
            const lethal=hp>0&&damage>=hp,high=damage>100;
            const currentFactor=(ctx.data.hat(ctx.self.hat)?.dmgMult??1)*(ctx.data.accessory(ctx.self.accessory)?.dmgMult??1);
            const replacementDamage=(root.AntimoocheatDefense?.trapSyncDamage(estimate)||0)/(currentFactor||1)*factor;
            const replacement=replacementDamage>93;
            return {blocked:lethal||high||replacement,damage,spikeFollowup,replacementDamage,reason:lethal?(spikeFollowup>=hp?'spike-followup-in-tank':'lethal-in-tank'):high?'high-potential-damage':replacement?'trap-replacement-damage':'low-potential-damage'};
        }

        function protection(){
            const estimate=threat.snapshot();const antiOneTick=!!(ctx.settings.antiOneTick&&(estimate.targets.some(t=>t.oneTick)||threat.pressure?.(estimate)?.airStack));
            const risk=threat.breakingPressure(estimate),tankFactor=(ctx.data.hat(40)?.dmgMult??1)*(ctx.data.accessory(ctx.self.accessory)?.dmgMult??1);
            const tankDamage=risk.unarmoredDamage*tankFactor,tankHigh=tankDamage>100||ctx.self.health>0&&tankDamage>=ctx.self.health;
            const tankWindow=tankSafety(estimate);
            const immediate=trapCycleActive()?tankWindow.blocked||antiOneTick||threat.committedSpikePath(estimate).active||threat.lethalSpikeCombo(estimate).active||risk.incomingDamage*tankFactor>=ctx.self.health:
                root.AntimoocheatDefense?.forcedArmor?.()||tankWindow.blocked||antiOneTick||root.MooMooDefenses?.protectingBow?.()||breakEnabled()&&tankHigh||(risk.incomingDamage+risk.spikeDamage)*tankFactor>=ctx.self.health;
            return {estimate,antiOneTick,risk,tankFactor,tankDamage,tankHigh,tankWindow,immediate};
        }
        function manualHat(preferred){
            if(ctx.store.ownsHat(6)&&(threat.committedSpikePath().active||threat.lethalSpikeCombo().active))return 6;
            const held=root.MooMooBaseClicks?.heldHat?.();if(held!=null)return held;
            const soldier=ctx.store.ownsHat(6)?6:(ctx.self.hat??0);
            if(preferred===40&&ctx.store.ownsHat(6)&&root.AntimoocheatEquipment.urgent())return 6;
            if(root.AntimoocheatDefense?.forcedArmor?.()||root.MooMooDefenses?.protectingBow?.())return soldier;
            if(preferred===40&&(breakEnabled()||ctx.settings.antiOneTick)&&
                (soldierPending||protection().immediate))return soldier;
            return preferred;
        }

        function gear(id){
            if(root.MooMooCombatMacros?.status().active)return false;
            if(id!==6&&id!==0&&root.MooMooDefenses?.protectingBow?.())return false;
            if(id===40&&breakEnabled()&&tankSafety().blocked){requestSoldier(true);schedule();return false;}
            if(id===40&&ctx.settings.antiOneTick){const risk=threat.pressure();if(risk.oneTick||risk.airStack){requestSoldier(true);schedule();return false;}}
            if(id!==0&&!ctx.store.ownsHat(id))return false;
            if(effectiveHat()===id)return true;
            if(ctx.net.wouldAllowBatch(['c'])&&send('store',1,id,false)){lastArmor=now();pendingHat=id;return true;}
            return false;
        }
        function requestSoldier(){
            if(!soldierPending)soldierDeadline=now()+Math.max(1500,2*(ctx.net.ping||0)+750);
            soldierPending=true;restoreSoldier();
        }
        function restoreSoldier(){
            if(!soldierPending)return;
            if(!active&&!holding&&root.MooMooBaseClicks?.ownsEquipment?.()){soldierPending=false;tankOwned=false;return;}
            if(now()>soldierDeadline){soldierPending=false;status.reason='soldier-unconfirmed';return;}
            const hat=ctx.store.ownsHat(6)?6:0;
            if(ctx.self.hat===hat&&effectiveHat()===hat){soldierPending=false;tankOwned=false;return;}
            gear(hat);schedule(33);
        }
        const breakObjectPadding=Math.max(0,...(ctx.data.items||[]).map(item=>item?.scale||0));
        function breakObjects(){
            if(manualBreak()){
                // The manual mode accepts placed structures of any owner,
                // like Revelation. Resources and speculative objects are excluded.
                return (ctx.objects?.all()||[]).filter(o=>o.active&&!o.fake&&!o.preplace&&o.ownerSid!=null&&(spaceHeld||o.sid===spaceTap?.target)&&chooseWeapon(o)!=null);
            }
            const prison=threat.selfTrap()?.sid;
            const me=threat.position(ctx.self);
            const reach=Math.max(0,...(ctx.self.weapons||[]).map(id=>ctx.data.weapon(id)?.range||0));
            const radius=reach+breakObjectPadding;
            const candidates=root.AntimoocheatWorld?.query({x:me.x-radius,y:me.y-radius},{x:me.x+radius,y:me.y+radius})??ctx.objects.all();
            const stoppedAt=root.AntimoocheatDefense?.blockedHazard?.();
            let pushedSpikes;
            return candidates.filter(object=>{
                if(!object.active||object.fake||object.preplace||object.ownerSid==null||ctx.objects.isFriendly(object.ownerSid))return false;
                if(object.trap)return object.sid===prison;
                const group=ctx.data.item(object.id)?.group?.name;
                if(prison!=null)return ['spikes','booster','teleporter'].includes(group);
                if(group!=='spikes'&&group!=='booster'||threat.distance(ctx.self,object)>reach+object.scale)return false;
                if(object.sid===stoppedAt)return true;
                const gap=threat.distance(ctx.self,object),contact=(ctx.self.scale||35)+(object.getScale?.()??object.scale);
                if(gap<=contact+2)return true;
                const prior=active||holding;
                if(prior?.target===object.sid&&!prior.spaceAttack&&
                    gap<=(prior.engagementDistance??0)+2&&gap<=range(prior.weapon,object))return true;
                if(group==='booster')return false;
                pushedSpikes??=threat.committedSpikePath(undefined,false).spikeSids||[];
                return pushedSpikes.includes(object.sid);
            });
        }
        function nextBreakTarget(objects){
            const preferred=trapPriority.choice(objects);if(preferred)return preferred.target;
            let target=null,bestPriority=Infinity,bestDistance=Infinity;
            for(const object of objects){
                if(chooseWeapon(object)==null)continue;
                const priority=manualBreak()?0:ctx.data.item(object.id)?.group?.name==='spikes'?0:object.trap?1:2;
                const distance=threat.distance(ctx.self,object);
                if(priority<bestPriority||priority===bestPriority&&distance<bestDistance){target=object;bestPriority=priority;bestDistance=distance;}
            }
            return target;
        }
        function continueBreak(objects=breakObjects()){
            const prior=active||holding,combo=root.MooMooCombatMacros?.status();
            if(!prior||!live()||!breakEnabled()||combo?.active||combo?.rightClickTankHeld)return false;
            const target=nextBreakTarget(objects);if(!target)return false;
            const weapon=chooseWeapon(target);
            // Changing weapons still drains the old held attack. A new target
            // for the same weapon only changes aim; no release or hat return.
            if(weapon!==prior.weapon){if(active)finish('retarget');schedule();return true;}
            const direction=swing(target,weapon,objects);if(!Number.isFinite(direction))return false;
            prior.target=target.sid;prior.engagementDistance=threat.distance(ctx.self,target);prior.direction=direction;
            if(active)active.until=now()+Math.max(1000,ctx.data.weapon(weapon).speed*2+(ctx.net.ping||0)*2);
            status.target=target.sid;status.weapon=weapon;status.reason='target-continuation';
            root.MooMooActionIntent={owner:id,direction,weapon,down:!!active};
            if((wireWeapon??ctx.self.weaponIndex)===weapon&&(!Number.isFinite(wireAim)||Math.abs(Math.atan2(Math.sin(direction-wireAim),Math.cos(direction-wireAim)))>.015)&&ctx.net.wouldAllowBatch(['D']))send('aim',direction);
            schedule();return true;
        }

        function observeTrap(){
            const next=threat.selfTrap()?.sid??null,previous=trapSid;trapSid=next;
            if(previous!=null&&next!==previous&&breakEnabled()){
                requestSoldier();finish('trap-exit');schedule(1);
                nextAttackTick=Math.max(nextAttackTick,tickIndex+2);nextAttackAt=Math.max(nextAttackAt,now()+2*(ctx.SERVER_TICK||1000/9));
            }
            trapSid=next;
        }
        let missedBreak=null;
        // Both endpoints arrive as rounded world coordinates. Reserve only
        // this narrow automatic boundary band; explicit Space and the prison
        // holding us retain their full measured reach.
        const range=(weapon,object)=>ctx.data.weapon(weapon)?.projectile==null?(ctx.data.weapon(weapon)?.range||0)+object.scale-(!manualBreak()&&object.sid!==trapSid?1.5:0):0;
        function chooseWeapon(object){
            if(missedBreak?.sid===object.sid){
                const p=threat.position(ctx.self);
                // A real K0 proved no object was hit. Reload completion alone
                // cannot make unchanged geometry reachable. Missing K never
                // enters this suppression path.
                if(!manualBreak()&&object.sid!==trapSid&&now()<missedBreak.until&&Math.hypot(p.x-missedBreak.x,p.y-missedBreak.y)<.5&&
                    Math.hypot(object.x-missedBreak.ox,object.y-missedBreak.oy)<.5&&object.health===missedBreak.health)return null;
                missedBreak=null;
            }
            const [primary,secondary]=ctx.self.weapons||[],dist=threat.distance(ctx.self,object),hammer=secondary===10;
            if(!manualBreak()&&hammer&&primary===4&&trapSid!=null&&ctx.data.item(object.id)?.group?.name==='spikes'&&dist<=range(4,object))return 4;
            if(hammer&&dist<=range(10,object))return 10;
            if(manualBreak())return primary===4&&dist<=range(4,object)?4:null;
            const spike=ctx.data.item(object.id)?.group?.name==='spikes';
            if(primary===8||!(ctx.data.weapon(primary)?.dmg>0)||dist>range(primary,object))return null;
            if(hammer)return (spike&&primary===4&&trapSid!=null||object.sid===root.AntimoocheatDefense?.blockedHazard?.())?primary:null;
            const prior=active||holding,retained=prior?.target===object.sid&&dist<=(prior.engagementDistance??0)+3;
            if(spike&&primary!==0&&primary!==4&&!retained&&!(root.MooMooSafewalk?.breakThreat(object.sid)??dist<=(ctx.self.scale||35)+(object.getScale?.()??object.scale)+38))return null;
            return primary;
        }
        let breakAim=null;
        function variedBreakAim(target,weapon,angle,hitAngles,halfWidth){
            let low=-.035,high=.035;
            for(const hit of hitAngles){const offset=Math.atan2(Math.sin(hit-angle),Math.cos(hit-angle));low=Math.max(low,offset-halfWidth);high=Math.min(high,offset+halfWidth);}
            if(low>high||!Number.isFinite(angle)){breakAim=null;return angle;}
            const time=now();
            if(!breakAim||breakAim.target!==target||breakAim.weapon!==weapon)breakAim={target,weapon,offset:0,next:time};
            breakAim.anchor=angle;breakAim.low=low;breakAim.high=high;
            if(time>=breakAim.next){
                breakAim.offset=Math.max(low,Math.min(high,breakAim.offset+(Math.random()-.5)*.045));
                breakAim.next=time+180+Math.random()*120;
            }
            breakAim.offset=Math.max(low,Math.min(high,breakAim.offset));
            return angle+breakAim.offset;
        }
        function breakAimAllows(angle){
            if(!breakAim)return true;
            const offset=Math.atan2(Math.sin(angle-breakAim.anchor),Math.cos(angle-breakAim.anchor));
            return offset>=breakAim.low-1e-9&&offset<=breakAim.high+1e-9;
        }

        function swing(target,weapon,objects){
            const p=threat.position(ctx.self),at=o=>Math.atan2(o.y-p.y,o.x-p.x),anchor=at(target),width=2*(ctx.combat.K?.gatherAngle??Math.PI/2.6)-.01;
            const directions=objects.filter(o=>threat.distance(ctx.self,o)<=range(weapon,o)).map(o=>({o,offset:Math.atan2(Math.sin(at(o)-anchor),Math.cos(at(o)-anchor))})).filter(e=>Math.abs(e.offset)<=width).sort((a,b)=>a.offset-b.offset);
            let best={spikes:-1,count:0,span:Infinity,angle:anchor};
            for(let start=0,end=0;start<directions.length&&directions[start].offset<=0;start++){
                while(end<directions.length&&directions[end].offset-directions[start].offset<=width)end++;
                if(!end||directions[end-1].offset<0)continue;
                const count=end-start,span=directions[end-1].offset-directions[start].offset;
                const spikes=manualBreak()?0:directions.slice(start,end).filter(e=>ctx.data.item(e.o.id)?.group?.name==='spikes').length;
                if(spikes>best.spikes||spikes===best.spikes&&(count>best.count||count===best.count&&span<best.span))best={spikes,count,span,angle:anchor+(directions[start].offset+directions[end-1].offset)/2};
            }
            const hits=directions.filter(e=>Math.abs(Math.atan2(Math.sin(at(e.o)-best.angle),Math.cos(at(e.o)-best.angle)))<=width/2+.005);
            status.targets=hits.map(e=>e.o.sid);
            return variedBreakAim(target.sid,weapon,best.angle,hits.map(e=>at(e.o)),width/2);
        }
        function createTrapBreakPriority({ctx,root,threat,now,manualBreak,breakObjects,canKatana}){
            let trapRef=null,committed=null,hammerSwing=null,trapHit=null,spikeCache=null;
            function invalidate(){spikeCache=null;}
            function reset(){trapRef=committed=hammerSwing=trapHit=null;invalidate();}
            function prison(){
                const sid=threat.selfTrap()?.sid,object=sid==null?null:ctx.objects.get(sid);
                const next=object?.active&&!object.fake&&!object.preplace?object:null;
                if(next!==trapRef){trapRef=next;committed=hammerSwing=trapHit=null;invalidate();}
                return next;
            }
            function match(){
                const trap=prison(),window=Math.max(50,(ctx.SERVER_TICK||1000/9)*1.25);
                if(!trap||!hammerSwing||!trapHit||hammerSwing.trap!==trap||trapHit.trap!==trap||
                    Math.abs(hammerSwing.at-trapHit.at)>window||now()-Math.max(hammerSwing.at,trapHit.at)>window)return;
                const dx=trap.x-hammerSwing.position.x,dy=trap.y-hammerSwing.position.y,d=Math.hypot(dx,dy);
                const angle=Math.atan2(dy,dx)-trapHit.angle;
                if(d<=(ctx.data.weapon(10)?.range||0)+trap.scale+.01&&(d<=5||Math.abs(Math.atan2(Math.sin(angle),Math.cos(angle)))<=.12)){
                    committed=trap;hammerSwing=trapHit=null;
                }
            }
            function observe(event,p){
                const trap=prison();if(!trap)return;
                if(event==='wiggle'){
                    const [angle,sid]=p.args||[];
                    if(sid===trap.sid&&Number.isFinite(angle)){trapHit={trap,angle,at:now()};match();}
                }else if(event==='gatherAnimation'){
                    const [sid,hit,weapon]=p.args||[];
                    if(sid===ctx.self.sid&&hit&&weapon===10){hammerSwing={trap,position:threat.position(ctx.self),at:now()};match();}
                }
            }
            function choice(objects){
                const trap=prison();
                if(!ctx.settings.autobreak||manualBreak()||!trap||ctx.self.weapons?.[1]!==10)return null;
                if(committed===trap)return {target:trap,weapon:10,committed:true};
                if(ctx.self.weapons[0]===4){
                    const me=threat.position(ctx.self);
                    if(spikeCache?.target&&!canKatana(spikeCache.target))spikeCache=null;
                    if(!spikeCache||spikeCache.x!==me.x||spikeCache.y!==me.y){
                        const candidates=[];
                        for(const object of objects||breakObjects()){
                            if(ctx.data.item(object.id)?.group?.name!=='spikes')continue;
                            const distance=threat.distance(ctx.self,object);
                            if(canKatana(object))candidates.push({object,distance,trapDistance:threat.distance(trap,object),angle:Math.atan2(object.y-me.y,object.x-me.x)});
                        }
                        candidates.sort((a,b)=>a.angle-b.angle);
                        const n=candidates.length,ring=candidates.concat(candidates.map(p=>({...p,angle:p.angle+2*Math.PI})));
                        const width=2*(ctx.combat?.K?.gatherAngle??Math.PI/2.6)-.01,queue=[];let head=0,end=0,best=null;
                        const closer=(a,b)=>a.trapDistance<b.trapDistance||a.trapDistance===b.trapDistance&&a.distance<b.distance;
                        // A sorted angular window reuses reachable break candidates;
                        // no full-circle placement search or per-target cone rescan.
                        for(let start=0;start<n;start++){
                            while(end<start+n&&ring[end].angle-ring[start].angle<=width){
                                while(queue.length>head&&closer(ring[end],ring[queue.at(-1)]))queue.pop();
                                queue.push(end++);
                            }
                            const candidate=ring[queue[head]],count=end-start;
                            if(candidate&&(!best||count>best.count||count===best.count&&closer(candidate,best)))best={...candidate,count};
                            if(queue[head]===start)head++;
                        }
                        spikeCache={x:me.x,y:me.y,target:best?.object??null,count:best?.count??0};
                    }
                    if(spikeCache.target)return {target:spikeCache.target,weapon:4,committed:false,spikeCount:spikeCache.count};
                }
                return {target:trap,weapon:10,committed:false};
            }
            function reload(objects){const value=choice(objects);return value&&(root.MooMooAutoReload?.remaining(value.weapon)??threat.reload(ctx.self.sid,value.weapon)?.remaining??0)>0?value:null;}
            return {choice,reload,observe,reset,invalidate,status:()=>({trap:prison()?.sid??null,committedTrap:committed?.sid??null})};
        }
        const trapPriority=createTrapBreakPriority({ctx,root,threat,now,manualBreak,breakObjects,canKatana:object=>chooseWeapon(object)===4});
        function trapReloadFirst(){return trapPriority.reload();}
        function tankEquipLead(){return (ctx.SERVER_TICK||1000/9)+Math.min(200,(ctx.net.ping||0)/2);}
        function preparingTankHit(){
            if(!holding)return false;
            if(holding.combatReload){
                const priority=trapPriority.choice();
                if(!priority||priority.target.sid!==holding.target||priority.weapon!==holding.weapon)return false;
            }
            const target=breakObjects().find(o=>o.sid===holding.target);
            if(!target||chooseWeapon(target)!==holding.weapon)return false;
            const remaining=root.MooMooAutoReload?.remaining(holding.weapon)??threat.reload(ctx.self.sid,holding.weapon)?.remaining??0;
            return remaining>=0&&remaining<=tankEquipLead();
        }
        function run(){
            timer=null;timerAt=Infinity;
            if(manualBreak()&&spaceBlocked())releaseSpace(true);
            if(spaceTap&&now()>spaceTap.until){spaceTap=null;if(!spaceHeld)finish('space-tap-expired');}if(!live()){finish('inactive');return;}
            if(root.MooMooCombatMacros?.status().active){finish('combo-owned',false);return;}
            if(active?.stopPending){active.stopPending=!send('mouse',false,active.direction);if(active.stopPending){schedule(16);return;}}
            const armed=root.MooMooCombatMacros?.status().armed,automatic=root.MooMooAutomation?.status();
            const reloadFirst=trapReloadFirst();
            if(root.MooMooOpportunities?.trySync?.()||root.MooMooOpportunities?.tryFinish?.(true)||root.MooMooOpportunities?.tryTrapPriority?.())return;
            if(!reloadFirst){
                if(root.MooMooCombatMacros?.tryArmed?.())return;
                if(root.MooMooAutomation?.tryInsta?.())return;
                if(root.MooMooOpportunities?.tryAids?.())return;
                if(root.MooMooOpportunities?.tryCombat?.())return;
            }
            observeTrap();restoreSoldier();
            const controlled=active||holding;
            if(controlled&&(wireWeapon??ctx.self.weaponIndex)===controlled.weapon){
                const direction=controlled.direction;
                if(Number.isFinite(direction)&&(!Number.isFinite(wireAim)||Math.abs(Math.atan2(Math.sin(direction-wireAim),Math.cos(direction-wireAim)))>.015)&&ctx.net.wouldAllowBatch(['D']))send('aim',direction);
            }
            const {estimate,antiOneTick,risk,tankFactor,tankDamage,tankHigh,tankWindow,immediate}=protection();
            status.antiOneTick=antiOneTick;status.tankSafety=tankWindow;
            const defendBetween=!!immediate||ctx.store.ownsHat(6)&&(trapSid!=null||estimate.targets.some(t=>t.distance<=350));
            status.tankCycle=tankHigh;status.breakingDamage=risk.unarmoredDamage;
            if(active)active.returnSoldier=defendBetween;
            // A valid reload lead already prepares the next Tank hit. Returning now
            // would cancel that preparation before the weapon can swing.
            if(!root.MooMooBaseClicks?.ownsEquipment?.()&&(immediate||breakEnabled()&&defendBetween&&!active&&!preparingTankHit()&&(tankOwned||effectiveHat()===40))){requestSoldier(immediate);}
            if(root.MooMooBaseClicks?.primaryHeld()||now()<manualShotUntil){
                yieldToLeft();return;
            }
            const combo=root.MooMooCombatMacros?.status();
            if(!breakEnabled()||combo?.active||combo?.rightClickTankHeld){finish('yielded');return;}
            if(now()<pauseUntil&&!reloadFirst)return;
            // Food/item transactions retain their selection; Soldier protection
            // above still runs while an owned Hammer is waiting to reload.
            if(reloadFirst&&(root.AntimoocheatDefense?.busy()||root.AntimoocheatPlacementHost?.placing()||
                wireItem!=null&&(root.AntimoocheatPlacementHost?.heldPlacement()||
                    now()-lastItemSelection<(ctx.SERVER_TICK||1000/9)+(ctx.net.ping||0)))){status.reason='item-before-trap-reload';schedule(16);return;}
            const objects=breakObjects();
            const reloadTarget=reloadFirst?.target||nextBreakTarget(objects),reload=root.MooMooAutoReload;
            if(!reloadTarget||reloadTarget.sid!==resumeBuilding)resumeBuilding=null;
            let combatReload=root.MooMooCombatMacros?.reloadWeapon?.();
            const breakWeapon=reloadTarget&&chooseWeapon(reloadTarget);
            const primary=ctx.self.weapons?.[0];
            const autoReloadPrimary=!manualBreak()&&trapSid==null&&reload?.status().enabled&&primary!==breakWeapon&&reload.remaining(primary)>0?primary:null;
            if(trapSid!=null&&combatReload===primary&&(breakWeapon===10||!root.MooMooOpportunities?.needsReload(primary)))combatReload=null;
            if(combatReload==null&&reloadTarget&&trapSid!=null&&breakWeapon!==10&&!active&&!root.MooMooBaseClicks?.status().active){
                combatReload=ctx.self.weapons?.find(id=>id!==breakWeapon&&reload?.remaining(id)>0&&root.MooMooOpportunities?.needsReload(id));
            }
            combatReload??=autoReloadPrimary;
            if(reloadFirst){
                // Keep the chosen trap/spike weapon selected until its observed
                // reload completes; a committed Hammer trap stays the target.
                if(active&&active.weapon!==reloadFirst.weapon)finish('retarget');
                combatReload=reloadFirst.weapon;resumeBuilding=null;
            }else if(combatReload!=null&&trapSid!=null&&reloadPriority(ctx.self.weapons,true)===10&&reload?.remaining(10)>0){
                combatReload=10;
            }

            if(holding?.combatReload&&holding.weapon===combatReload&&now()>=holding.reloadDeadline){
                holding.combatReload=false;reloadRetryAt=now()+Math.max(750,(ctx.data.weapon(combatReload)?.speed||0)+2*(ctx.SERVER_TICK||1000/9));
            }
            if(!active&&resumeBuilding==null&&combatReload!=null&&reloadTarget&&(reloadFirst||now()>=reloadRetryAt)){
                const direction=swing(reloadTarget,combatReload,objects),original=holding?.original??selected();
                if(!holding||holding.weapon!==combatReload||(wireWeapon??ctx.self.weaponIndex)!==combatReload){
                    if(!ctx.net.wouldAllowBatch(['F','z'])){schedule(33);return;}
                    executing=true;
                    try{if(!send('mouse',false,direction)||!send('selectItem',combatReload,true)){schedule(33);return;}}
                    finally{executing=false;}
                }
                const reloadDeadline=holding?.combatReload&&holding.weapon===combatReload?holding.reloadDeadline:now()+(reload?.remaining(combatReload)||0)+Math.max(650,2*(ctx.net.ping||0)+350);
                holding={...holding,original,target:reloadTarget.sid,weapon:combatReload,direction,combatReload:true,reloadDeadline};
                status.target=reloadTarget.sid;status.weapon=combatReload;status.reason=combatReload===ctx.self.weapons[0]?'combat-primary-reload':'combat-weapon-reload';
                root.MooMooActionIntent={owner:id,direction,weapon:combatReload,down:false};
                // The selected trap priority owns this reload. Prepare only its
                // final equipment lead, keeping Soldier through the earlier reload.
                if(reloadFirst&&!immediate&&ctx.store.ownsHat(40)&&
                    (reload?.remaining(combatReload)||0)<=tankEquipLead()&&gear(40))tankOwned=true;
                schedule(33);return;
            }
            if(active){
                if(now()>active.until){finish('expired');schedule(1);return;}
                const target=manualBreak()||trapPriority.choice(objects)?reloadTarget:objects.find(o=>o.sid===active.target);
                const nextWeapon=target&&chooseWeapon(target);
                if(!target||nextWeapon!==active.weapon){if(!continueBreak(objects))finish('target-changed');schedule();return;}
                active.target=target.sid;status.target=target.sid;status.weapon=active.weapon;
                const direction=swing(target,active.weapon,objects);
                if(Math.abs(Math.atan2(Math.sin(direction-active.direction),Math.cos(direction-active.direction)))>.015||!breakAimAllows(active.direction)){
                    active.direction=direction;if(root.MooMooActionIntent?.owner===id)root.MooMooActionIntent.direction=direction;send('aim',direction);
                }
                if(active.waitingEquipment){
                    const wanted=immediate?(ctx.store.ownsHat(6)?6:(ctx.self.hat??0)):ctx.store.ownsHat(40)?40:null;
                    if(wanted!==null&&!root.AntimoocheatEquipment.settled(wanted)){
                        gear(wanted);status.reason='waiting-for-equipment';schedule(33);return;
                    }
                    active.hat=wanted;active.waitingEquipment=false;active.itemInterrupted=true;
                }
                const cooling=(root.MooMooAutoReload?.remaining(active.weapon)||0)>0;
                status.reason=cooling?'reloading-held-attack':'waiting-for-swing';
                if(!immediate&&ctx.store.ownsHat(40)&&gear(40))tankOwned=true;
                if(!active.observed&&active.pulsed&&!active.itemInterrupted&&!cooling&&
                    now()-(active.sentAt??now())>=(ctx.SERVER_TICK||1000/9)+Math.max(0,ctx.net.ping||0)+20&&
                    (active.retries||0)<2&&!root.AntimoocheatDefense?.busy()&&
                    (active.hat==null||root.AntimoocheatEquipment.settled(active.hat))){

    (function installCombatAutomation(api,root){
    'use strict';
    const background=()=>root.MooMooPrivateBackground?.allowed()===true;
class PushPoint {constructor(x,y){this.x=x;this.y=y;}distance(p){return Math.hypot(this.x-p.x,this.y-p.y);}angle(p){return Math.atan2(p.y-this.y,p.x-this.x);}addDirection(a,d){return new PushPoint(this.x+Math.cos(a)*d,this.y+Math.sin(a)*d);}}
const pushFinder={blocksStep(from,to,obstacle){
            if(!this.intersects(from,to,obstacle))return false;
            const dx=from.x-obstacle.center.x,dy=from.y-obstacle.center.y,vx=to.x-from.x,vy=to.y-from.y;
            const escaping=dx*dx+dy*dy<obstacle.radius**2 && dx*vx+dy*vy>=0 && vx*vx+vy*vy>0;
            return !escaping;
        },intersects(from, to, obstacle) {
            const {center, radius} = obstacle;
            if (Math.max(from.x, to.x) < center.x - radius || Math.min(from.x, to.x) > center.x + radius
                || Math.max(from.y, to.y) < center.y - radius || Math.min(from.y, to.y) > center.y + radius) return false;
            const dx = to.x - from.x, dy = to.y - from.y;
            const length = dx * dx + dy * dy;
            const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, ((center.x - from.x) * dx + (center.y - from.y) * dy) / (length || 1)));
            const start = (from.x - center.x) ** 2 + (from.y - center.y) ** 2;

            if (t === 0 && start < radius * radius && (to.x - center.x) ** 2 + (to.y - center.y) ** 2 > start) return false;
            return (from.x + t * dx - center.x) ** 2 + (from.y + t * dy - center.y) ** 2 < (radius - 0.01) ** 2;
        },
index(obstacles) {
            const cells = new Map(), size = 160;
            const visit = (left, top, right, bottom, callback) => {
                for (let x = Math.floor(left / size); x <= Math.floor(right / size); x++) {
                    for (let y = Math.floor(top / size); y <= Math.floor(bottom / size); y++) callback(`${x},${y}`);
                }
            };
            for (const obstacle of obstacles) {
                const {center, radius} = obstacle;
                visit(center.x - radius, center.y - radius, center.x + radius, center.y + radius, key => {
                    if (!cells.has(key)) cells.set(key, []);
                    cells.get(key).push(obstacle);
                });
            }
            const query = (left, top, right = left, bottom = top) => {
                const found = new Set();
                visit(left, top, right, bottom, key => {
                    for (const obstacle of cells.get(key) || []) found.add(obstacle);
                });
                return found;
            };

            const visited = new Map();
            let visitID = 0;
            query.segment = (from, to, callback) => {
                const stamp = ++visitID;
                const check = (x, y) => {
                    for (const obstacle of cells.get(`${x},${y}`) || []) {
                        if (visited.get(obstacle) === stamp) continue;
                        visited.set(obstacle, stamp);
                        if (callback(obstacle)) return true;
                    }
                    return false;
                };
                let x = Math.floor(from.x / size), y = Math.floor(from.y / size);
                const endX = Math.floor(to.x / size), endY = Math.floor(to.y / size);
                const dx = to.x - from.x, dy = to.y - from.y;
                const stepX = Math.sign(dx), stepY = Math.sign(dy);
                const deltaX = dx ? size / Math.abs(dx) : Infinity, deltaY = dy ? size / Math.abs(dy) : Infinity;
                let nextX = dx ? ((x + (stepX > 0 ? 1 : 0)) * size - from.x) / dx : Infinity;
                let nextY = dy ? ((y + (stepY > 0 ? 1 : 0)) * size - from.y) / dy : Infinity;
                for (;;) {
                    if (check(x, y)) return true;
                    if (x === endX && y === endY) return false;
                    if (y === endY || x !== endX && nextX < nextY) { x += stepX; nextX += deltaX; }
                    else if (x === endX || nextY < nextX) { y += stepY; nextY += deltaY; }
                    else {
                        if (check(x + stepX, y) || check(x, y + stepY)) return true;
                        x += stepX; y += stepY; nextX += deltaX; nextY += deltaY;
                    }
                }
            };
            return query;
        },
search(origin, target, obstacles, arrivalRadius = 0, budget = 30) {
            const until=performance.now()+budget;

            const nodes = [origin, null], query = this.index(obstacles), nodeCells = new Map(), obstacleNodes = new Map();
            const visible = (from, to) => !query.segment(from, to, obstacle => this.blocksStep(from, to, obstacle));
            const add = (point, obstacle = null) => {
                if (point.x < 35 || point.y < 35 || point.x > 14365 || point.y > 14365) return;
                for (const o of query(point.x, point.y)) if ((point.x - o.center.x) ** 2 + (point.y - o.center.y) ** 2 < o.radius ** 2) return;
                const x = Math.floor(point.x / 2), y = Math.floor(point.y / 2);
                for (let dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) {
                    for (let dy = -1; dy <= 1; dy++) {
                        const match = (nodeCells.get(`${x + dx},${y + dy}`) || []).find(id => (nodes[id].x - point.x) ** 2 + (nodes[id].y - point.y) ** 2 < 0.25);
                        if (match !== undefined) {
                            if (obstacle) {
                                if (!obstacleNodes.has(obstacle)) obstacleNodes.set(obstacle, new Set());
                                obstacleNodes.get(obstacle).add(match);
                            }
                            return match;
                        }
                    }
                }
                const key = `${x},${y}`;
                if (!nodeCells.has(key)) nodeCells.set(key, []);
                const id = nodes.length;
                nodeCells.get(key).push(id);
                nodes.push(point);
                if (obstacle) {
                    if (!obstacleNodes.has(obstacle)) obstacleNodes.set(obstacle, new Set());
                    obstacleNodes.get(obstacle).add(id);
                }
                return id;
            };
            add(target);
            for (let i = 0; i < 16 && arrivalRadius > 0; i++) add(target.addDirection(i * Math.PI / 8, arrivalRadius));
            for (const obstacle of obstacles) {
                if(performance.now()>until)return null;

                const radius = (obstacle.radius + 1) / Math.cos(Math.PI / 16);
                const base = obstacle.center.angle(origin);
                for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) add(obstacle.center.addDirection(base + i * Math.PI / 8, radius), obstacle);
                for (const point of [origin, target]) {
                    const distance = point.distance(obstacle.center);
                    if (distance <= radius) continue;
                    const offset = Math.acos(radius / distance);
                    const angle = obstacle.center.angle(point);
                    add(obstacle.center.addDirection(angle + offset, radius), obstacle);
                    add(obstacle.center.addDirection(angle - offset, radius), obstacle);
                }
            }

            const order = new Map(obstacles.map((obstacle, i) => [obstacle, i]));
            for (const obstacle of obstacles) {
                const {center, radius} = obstacle, reach = radius + 96;
                for (const other of query(center.x - reach, center.y - reach, center.x + reach, center.y + reach)) {
                    if (order.get(other) <= order.get(obstacle)) continue;
                    const distance = center.distance(other.center), gap = distance - radius - other.radius;
                    if (gap < 0.5 || gap > 96) continue;
                    const angle = center.angle(other.center);
                    const middle = center.addDirection(angle, radius + gap / 2);
                    const entry = Math.min(radius, other.radius) + 16;
                    for (const offset of [-entry, -24, 0, 24, entry]) {
                        const id = add(middle.addDirection(angle + Math.PI / 2, offset), obstacle);
                        if (id !== undefined) {
                            if (!obstacleNodes.has(other)) obstacleNodes.set(other, new Set());
                            obstacleNodes.get(other).add(id);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            const nodeGrid = new Map(), nodeCellSize = 240;
            for (let id = 2; id < nodes.length; id++) {
                const key = `${Math.floor(nodes[id].x / nodeCellSize)},${Math.floor(nodes[id].y / nodeCellSize)}`;
                if (!nodeGrid.has(key)) nodeGrid.set(key, []);
                nodeGrid.get(key).push(id);
            }
            const nearby = (point, radius = 420) => {
                const ids = new Set(), left = Math.floor((point.x - radius) / nodeCellSize), right = Math.floor((point.x + radius) / nodeCellSize);
                const top = Math.floor((point.y - radius) / nodeCellSize), bottom = Math.floor((point.y + radius) / nodeCellSize);
                for (let x = left; x <= right; x++) for (let y = top; y <= bottom; y++) {
                    for (const id of nodeGrid.get(`${x},${y}`) || []) if ((point.x - nodes[id].x) ** 2 + (point.y - nodes[id].y) ** 2 <= radius * radius) ids.add(id);
                }
                return ids;
            };
            const costs = Array(nodes.length).fill(Infinity), previous = Array(nodes.length).fill(-1);
            const open = [], closed = new Uint8Array(nodes.length);
            let sequence = 0;
            const priority = (a, b) => a.score < b.score || a.score === b.score && a.order < b.order;
            const push = id => {
                const entry = {id, cost:costs[id], score:costs[id] + (id === 1 ? 0 : Math.max(0, nodes[id].distance(target) - arrivalRadius)), order:sequence++};
                let at = open.length;
                open.push(entry);
                while (at > 0) {
                    const parent = (at - 1) >> 1;
                    if (!priority(entry, open[parent])) break;
                    open[at] = open[parent]; at = parent;
                }
                open[at] = entry;
            };
            const pop = () => {
                const first = open[0], last = open.pop();
                if (open.length) {
                    let at = 0;
                    while (at * 2 + 1 < open.length) {
                        let child = at * 2 + 1;
                        if (child + 1 < open.length && priority(open[child + 1], open[child])) child++;
                        if (!priority(open[child], last)) break;
                        open[at] = open[child]; at = child;
                    }
                    open[at] = last;
                }
                return first;
            };
            costs[0] = 0;
            push(0);
            let expanded=0;
            while (open.length && expanded++ < 1200) {
                if(performance.now()>until)return null;
                const entry = pop(), current = entry.id;
                if (closed[current] || entry.cost !== costs[current]) continue;
                if (current === 1) {
                    const path = [];
                    for (let id = 1; id !== 0; id = previous[id]) path.unshift(nodes[id]);
                    return path;
                }
                closed[current] = 1;
                const point = nodes[current];
                const finish = point.distance(target) <= arrivalRadius ? point : target.addDirection(target.angle(point), arrivalRadius);
                const finalCost = costs[current] + point.distance(finish);
                if (finalCost < costs[1] && finish.x >= 35 && finish.y >= 35 && finish.x <= 14365 && finish.y <= 14365 && visible(point, finish)) {
                    nodes[1] = finish;
                    costs[1] = finalCost;
                    previous[1] = current;
                    push(1);
                }
                const candidates = nearby(point);
                const blockers = [];
                query.segment(point, target, obstacle => {
                    if (this.intersects(point, target, obstacle)) blockers.push(obstacle);
                    return false;
                });
                blockers.sort((a, b) => (point.x - a.center.x) ** 2 + (point.y - a.center.y) ** 2 - ((point.x - b.center.x) ** 2 + (point.y - b.center.y) ** 2));
                blockers.length = Math.min(blockers.length, 6);
                for (const obstacle of blockers) for (const id of obstacleNodes.get(obstacle) || []) candidates.add(id);
                for (const id of candidates) {
                    if (closed[id]) continue;
                    const cost = costs[current] + nodes[current].distance(nodes[id]);
                    if (cost >= costs[id] || !visible(nodes[current], nodes[id])) continue;
                    costs[id] = cost;
                    previous[id] = current;
                    push(id);
                }
            }
            return null;
        }};

        function clearPath(angle,travel,margin=2){

        function intersects(start,end,point,radius){
            let low=0,high=1;
            for(const axis of ['x','y']){
                const delta=end[axis]-start[axis],offset=point[axis]-start[axis];
                if(Math.abs(delta)<1e-9){if(Math.abs(offset)>radius)return false;continue;}
                const a=(offset-radius)/delta,b=(offset+radius)/delta;
                low=Math.max(low,Math.min(a,b));high=Math.min(high,Math.max(a,b));if(low>high)return false;
            }
            return true;
        }

        function observeStackMotion(player){

        function stackMotion(player){
            const point=threat.position(player),v=threat.velocity(player),age=now()-(v.at??-Infinity);
            const fresh=age<=tick*2,unsampled=fresh&&age>5&&Math.hypot(point.x-v.x,point.y-v.y)>.01;
            const previous=unsampled?v:v.previous;

            if(Math.hypot(x,y)>150||threat.trapFor(player))x=y=0;

            let ax=h?x-(unsampled?h.dx:h.previousX)*decay:0,ay=h?y-(unsampled?h.dy:h.previousY)*decay:0;
            const max=(ctx.combat?.K?.playerSpeed??.0016)*tick*tick*(ctx.data.weapon(player.weaponIndex)?.spdMult||1)*(ctx.data.hat(player.hat??player.skinIndex)?.spdMult||1)*(ctx.data.accessory(player.accessory??player.tailIndex)?.spdMult||1);
            const acceleration=Math.hypot(ax,ay);if(acceleration>max){ax*=max/acceleration;ay*=max/acceleration;}
            if(!fresh||threat.trapFor(player))ax=ay=0;
            return {x,y,ax,ay,decay,fresh,confidence:v.confidence??0};
        }

        function stackPlan(enemy,shot=null,entry=null){
            const result={valid:false,reason:'waiting-for-clay-window',sid:enemy?.sid,distance:enemy?threat.distance(ctx.self,enemy):Infinity,radius:(ctx.data.weapon(5)?.range||142)+(enemy?.scale||35)*1.8,ringMin:220,ringMax:245};
