            const timing=root.MooMooCombatMacros?.oneTickWindow();
            // Hat observations use the receipt clock. Predict at impact on that
            // same clock, not relative to the preceding position update.
            const impactLead=shot?Math.max(0,shot.impactLead??tick):Math.max(0,timing?timing.fireAt+(timing.period||tick)+(timing.rtt||0)-now():lead+tick*2);
            if(!capeReady(enemy,impactLead)){result.reason='dragon-cape-buff-required';return result;}
            const hatWindow=hatCycles.window(enemy.sid,impactLead-tick*.4,impactLead+tick*.4);
            result.hatWindow=hatWindow;
            if(!shot&&[6,60,61].includes(enemyHat)&&!hatWindow?.valid){result.reason='waiting-for-unarmored-target';return result;}
            if(!shot&&hatWindow&&!hatWindow.valid){result.reason='predicted-protected-target';return result;}
            if(ctx.data.hat(enemyHat)?.antiTurret||enemyHat===6&&!hatWindow?.valid){result.reason='enemy-soldier-or-emp';return result;}
            const steps=shot?(shot.predictionSteps||1):(root.MooMooCombatMacros?.oneTickWindow().steps||1);
            const sp=threat.position(ctx.self),ep=threat.position(enemy),ev=stackMotion(enemy);
            const coast=stackMotion(ctx.self),friction=Math.pow(ctx.combat?.K?.playerDecel??.993,tick);
            if(!shot&&!threat.selfTrap()){
                const config=ctx.combat?.K||{},gear=ctx.data.hat(ctx.self.hat??ctx.self.skinIndex),tail=ctx.data.accessory(ctx.self.accessory??ctx.self.tailIndex);
                let speed=(ctx.data.weapon(ctx.self.weaponIndex)?.spdMult||1)*(gear?.spdMult||1)*(tail?.spdMult||1)*Math.max(0,Math.min(1,ctx.self.slowMult??1));
                if(sp.y<=(config.snowBiomeTop??2400)&&!gear?.coldM)speed*=config.snowSpeed??.75;
                if(!ctx.self.zIndex&&Math.abs(sp.y-(config.mapScale??14400)/2)<=(config.riverWidth??724)/2)speed*=gear?.watrImm?.75:.33;
                const acceleration=(config.playerSpeed??.0016)*tick*tick*speed;
                for(let i=1;i<steps;i++){
                    // Position history can still show the old direction after a
                    // turn. Use the command that can reach this intervening tick.
                    const cutoff=timing.fireAt-(steps-i)*(timing.period||tick);
                    const uncertainty=Math.max(12,(timing.period||tick)-tick+8);
                    if(stackInputs.some(input=>Math.abs(input.at-cutoff)<uncertainty)){
                        result.reason='movement-in-flight';return result;
                    }
                    const command=stackInputs.findLast(input=>input.at<=cutoff);
                    const dir=command?command.dir:null;
                    coast.x=coast.x*friction+(Number.isFinite(dir)?Math.cos(dir)*acceleration:0);
                    coast.y=coast.y*friction+(Number.isFinite(dir)?Math.sin(dir)*acceleration:0);
                    sp.x+=coast.x;sp.y+=coast.y;
                }
            }
            // No wall-clock acceleration or extra launch lead in the position forecast.
            if(entry){
                const config=ctx.combat?.K||{},gear=ctx.data.hat(ctx.self.hat),tail=ctx.data.accessory(ctx.self.accessory);
                let speed=(ctx.data.weapon(5)?.spdMult||1)*(gear?.spdMult||1)*(tail?.spdMult||1)*Math.max(0,Math.min(1,ctx.self.slowMult??1));
                if(sp.y<=(config.snowBiomeTop??2400)&&!gear?.coldM)speed*=config.snowSpeed??.75;
                if(!ctx.self.zIndex&&Math.abs(sp.y-(config.mapScale??14400)/2)<=(config.riverWidth??724)/2)speed*=gear?.watrImm ? .75 : .33;
                const acceleration=(config.playerSpeed??.0016)*tick*tick*speed;
                for(let i=0;i<entry.steps;i++){
                    coast.x=coast.x*friction+Math.cos(entry.dir)*acceleration;coast.y=coast.y*friction+Math.sin(entry.dir)*acceleration;
                    sp.x+=coast.x;sp.y+=coast.y;
                }
            }
            const future=stackPosition(enemy,steps+(entry?.steps||0));
            result.lead=lead;
            result.predictedDistance=Math.hypot(future.x-sp.x,future.y-sp.y);result.angle=Math.atan2((shot?ep:future).y-sp.y,(shot?ep:future).x-sp.x);
            if(!ev.fresh){result.reason='stale-position';return result;}
            const facing=enemy.d2??enemy.dir,toward=Math.atan2(sp.y-ep.y,sp.x-ep.x);
            if(ctx.data.weapon(enemy.weaponIndex)?.shield&&Number.isFinite(facing)&&Math.abs(Math.atan2(Math.sin(toward-facing),Math.cos(toward-facing)))<=Math.PI/3){result.reason='shield-facing';return result;}
            const turretLayer=shot?.layer??Math.max(ctx.self.zIndex||0,ctx.data.projectiles[ctx.data.hat(53)?.turret?.proj]?.layer??1);
            for(const object of stackObjects(sp,ep)){
                if(!object.active||object.fake||object.preplace||object.ignoreCollision||(object.layer||0)<turretLayer)continue;
                if(intersects(sp,ep,object,object.getScale?.()??object.scale)){result.reason='blocked-turret';return result;}
            }
            if(shot){
                const fireTarget=shot.predicted?stackPosition(enemy,Math.max(0,steps-1)):null;
                const shotDir=fireTarget?Math.atan2(fireTarget.y-shot.y,fireTarget.x-shot.x):shot.dir;
                const step=shot.speed*tick,dx=Math.cos(shotDir)*step,dy=Math.sin(shotDir)*step;
                const mid={x:shot.x+dx,y:shot.y+dy},end={x:mid.x+dx,y:mid.y+dy};
                if(!intersects(mid,end,future,(enemy.scale||35)+1)){result.reason='turret-path-lost';return result;}
                const config=ctx.combat?.K||{},sv=stackMotion(ctx.self),gear=ctx.data.hat(7),tail=ctx.data.accessory(root.AntimoocheatDefense?.attackAccessory()??ctx.self.accessory??ctx.self.tailIndex);
                let speed=(ctx.data.weapon(5)?.spdMult||1)*(gear?.spdMult||1)*(tail?.spdMult||1)*Math.max(0,Math.min(1,ctx.self.slowMult??1));
                if(sp.y<=(config.snowBiomeTop??2400)&&!gear?.coldM)speed*=config.snowSpeed??.75;
                if(!ctx.self.zIndex&&Math.abs(sp.y-(config.mapScale??14400)/2)<=(config.riverWidth??724)/2)speed*=gear?.watrImm ? .75 : .33;
                const acceleration=(config.playerSpeed??.0016)*tick*tick*speed,decay=Math.pow(config.playerDecel??.993,tick),locked=!!threat.selfTrap();
                const from={x:shot.x+(locked?0:sv.x*decay+Math.cos(result.angle)*acceleration),y:shot.y+(locked?0:sv.y*decay+Math.sin(result.angle)*acceleration)};
                const sampleAge=Math.min(tick,Math.max(0,now()-(threat.velocity(enemy).at??now()))),after=stackPosition(enemy,steps);
                if(Math.min(Math.hypot(future.x-from.x,future.y-from.y),Math.hypot(after.x-from.x,after.y-from.y))>(ctx.data.weapon(5)?.range||142)+(enemy.scale||35)*1.8+2){result.reason='primary-path-lost';return result;}
            }else{
                const variant=threat.observedWeapons(ctx.self.sid).find(w=>w.id===5)?.variant??(ctx.self.weaponIndex===5?ctx.self.weaponVariant:0)??0;
                if(variant<2){result.reason='diamond-polearm-required';return result;}
                const reload=threat.reload(enemy.sid,enemy.weaponIndex),melee=ctx.data.weapon(enemy.weaponIndex)?.projectile==null;
                const almostReloaded=melee&&reload?.observed&&reload.remaining>0&&reload.remaining<=tick+1;
                const predicted=hatWindow?.hat??predictedHat(enemy),validHat=hatWindow?.valid===true;
                result.predictedHat=predicted;result.almostReloaded=almostReloaded;
                if(enemyHat===6&&!almostReloaded&&!validHat){result.reason='waiting-for-hat-or-reload';return result;}
                const config=ctx.combat?.K||{},sv=coast,decay=Math.pow(config.playerDecel??.993,tick),unit={x:Math.cos(result.angle),y:Math.sin(result.angle)};
                const tail=ctx.data.accessory(root.AntimoocheatDefense?.attackAccessory()??ctx.self.accessory??ctx.self.tailIndex);
                const acceleration=hat=>{
                    const gear=ctx.data.hat(hat);let speed=(ctx.data.weapon(5)?.spdMult||1)*(gear?.spdMult||1)*(tail?.spdMult||1)*Math.max(0,Math.min(1,ctx.self.slowMult??1));
                    if(sp.y<=(config.snowBiomeTop??2400)&&!gear?.coldM)speed*=config.snowSpeed??.75;
                    if(!ctx.self.zIndex&&Math.abs(sp.y-(config.mapScale??14400)/2)<=(config.riverWidth??724)/2)speed*=gear?.watrImm ? .75 : .33;
                    return (config.playerSpeed??.0016)*tick*tick*speed;
                };
                const start=threat.position(ctx.self);
                const selfRadius=ctx.self.scale||35;
                const obstacles=stackObjects(start,start,400).filter(o=>o.active&&!o.fake&&!o.preplace&&!o.ignoreCollision&&ctx.data.item(o.id)?.group?.name!=='spikes'&&threat.distance(ctx.self,o)<400)
                    .map(o=>({x:o.x,y:o.y,radius:selfRadius+(o.getScale?.()??o.scale)}));
                const advance=(start,dx,dy)=>{
                    const p={...start},steps=Math.min(4,Math.max(1,Math.round(Math.hypot(dx,dy)/40)));
                    for(let i=0;i<steps;i++){
                        p.x+=dx/steps;p.y+=dy/steps;
                        for(const o of obstacles){const radius=o.radius,x=p.x-o.x,y=p.y-o.y;
                            if(x*x+y*y<radius*radius){const angle=Math.atan2(y,x);p.x=o.x+Math.cos(angle)*radius;p.y=o.y+Math.sin(angle)*radius;dx*=.75;dy*=.75;}}
                    }
                    return {...p,dx,dy};
                };
                const selfOrder=stackOrder.indexOf(ctx.self.sid),enemyOrder=stackOrder.indexOf(enemy.sid);
                const locked=!!threat.selfTrap(),enemyEnd=stackPosition(enemy,steps+1+(entry?.steps||0)),meleeTarget=selfOrder>=0&&enemyOrder>=0?(selfOrder<enemyOrder?future:enemyEnd):null,primaryReach=(ctx.data.weapon(5)?.range||142)+(enemy.scale||35)*1.8;
                let first,second,chosen=false,bestMargin=-Infinity,bestHeading=null,headingMargin=-Infinity;
                const moves=locked?[null]:[result.angle,null,result.angle+Math.PI,...[.25,.5,.75,0,-.25,-.5,-.75].flatMap(radial=>[result.angle+Math.acos(radial),result.angle-Math.acos(radial)])];
                const turretAcceleration=locked?0:acceleration(53),bullAcceleration=locked?0:acceleration(7);
                const consider=heading=>{
                    if(!locked&&!entry&&result.distance>260&&Number.isFinite(heading)&&
                        Math.cos(heading)*(future.x-sp.x)+Math.sin(heading)*(future.y-sp.y)>.001)return;
                    const a=advance(sp,locked?0:sv.x*decay+(heading==null?0:Math.cos(heading)*turretAcceleration),locked?0:sv.y*decay+(heading==null?0:Math.sin(heading)*turretAcceleration));
                    const b=advance(a,locked?0:a.dx*decay+unit.x*bullAcceleration,locked?0:a.dy*decay+unit.y*bullAcceleration);
                    const dir=Math.atan2(future.y-a.y,future.x-a.x),ux=Math.cos(dir),uy=Math.sin(dir),step=1.5*tick;
                    const mid={x:a.x+ux*step,y:a.y+uy*step},end={x:mid.x+ux*step,y:mid.y+uy*step};
                    const meleeMargin=primaryReach-(meleeTarget?Math.hypot(b.x-meleeTarget.x,b.y-meleeTarget.y):Math.max(Math.hypot(b.x-future.x,b.y-future.y),Math.hypot(b.x-enemyEnd.x,b.y-enemyEnd.y)))-(locked?0:3);
                    const flightMargin=Math.hypot(future.x-a.x,future.y-a.y)-((enemy.scale||35)+(locked?1:4))/Math.max(Math.abs(ux),Math.abs(uy))-step;
                    const margin=Math.min(meleeMargin,flightMargin);
                    if(!intersects(mid,end,enemyEnd,(enemy.scale||35)+1))return;
                    if(heading!=null&&margin>headingMargin){bestHeading=heading;headingMargin=margin;}
                    if(margin<=bestMargin)return;
                    // Prefer room on both sides of the timing window, rather
                    // than the first heading that passes by a fraction of a unit.
                    first=a;second=b;result.move=heading;bestMargin=margin;
                };
                for(const heading of moves)consider(heading);
                // Refine only the strongest heading: at most 12 extra trials,
                // independent of frame rate, rather than a full angle sweep.
                if(!locked&&bestHeading!=null){
                    let step=Math.PI/8;
                    for(let i=0;i<6;i++){const center=bestHeading;consider(center-step);consider(center+step);step/=2;}
                }
                chosen=bestMargin>=0;
                if(!chosen){result.reason='no-motion-window';return result;}
                if(!locked&&stackObjects(sp,second,ctx.self.scale||35).some(o=>o.active&&!o.fake&&!o.preplace&&!ctx.objects.isFriendly(o.ownerSid)&&(o.trap||o.teleport||o.boostSpeed)&&pushFinder.intersects(sp,second,{center:o,radius:(ctx.self.scale||35)+(o.getScale?.()??o.scale)}))){result.reason='blocked-movement';return result;}
                const enemySecond=stackPosition(enemy,steps+1+(entry?.steps||0)),reach=(ctx.data.weapon(5)?.range||142)+(enemy.scale||35)*1.8;
                result.radius=Math.min(400,reach+Math.hypot(second.x-sp.x,second.y-sp.y));
                // Glotus v6.2 uses the midpoint and width of its 220..245 window.
                // Adapt that small marker to this core's actual movement/trap geometry.
                result.ringMin=Math.hypot(first.x-sp.x,first.y-sp.y)+1.5*tick+(enemy.scale||35)+1;
                result.ringMax=reach+Math.hypot(second.x-sp.x,second.y-sp.y);
                if((meleeTarget?Math.hypot(second.x-meleeTarget.x,second.y-meleeTarget.y):Math.max(Math.hypot(second.x-future.x,second.y-future.y),Math.hypot(second.x-enemySecond.x,second.y-enemySecond.y)))>reach){result.reason='primary-out-of-reach-next-tick';return result;}
                const shotAngle=Math.atan2(future.y-first.y,future.x-first.x),shotStep=1.5*tick,mid={x:first.x+Math.cos(shotAngle)*shotStep,y:first.y+Math.sin(shotAngle)*shotStep};
                if(intersects(first,mid,future,(enemy.scale||35)+1)){result.reason='turret-too-early';return result;}
                const end={x:mid.x+Math.cos(shotAngle)*shotStep,y:mid.y+Math.sin(shotAngle)*shotStep};
                if(!intersects(mid,end,enemySecond,(enemy.scale||35)+1)){result.reason='turret-path-lost';return result;}
                result.shotPath={x:first.x,y:first.y,dir:shotAngle,speed:1.5,layer:turretLayer};
            }
            if(entry){
                const origin=threat.position(ctx.self);
                if(stackObjects(origin,sp,(ctx.self.scale||35)+1).some(o=>o.active&&!o.fake&&!o.preplace&&!o.ignoreCollision&&pushFinder.intersects(origin,sp,{center:o,radius:(ctx.self.scale||35)+(o.getScale?.()??o.scale)+1}))){result.reason='entry-blocked';return result;}
                result.entry={...entry};
            }
            result.valid=true;result.reason='clay-velocity-window';return result;
        }
        function stackApproachAllowed(enemy,plan){
            if(threat.selfTrap()||threat.distance(ctx.self,enemy)<=260)return true;
            const dir=plan.entry?.dir??plan.move;
            if(!Number.isFinite(dir))return true;
            const me=threat.position(ctx.self),target=stackPosition(enemy,1);
            return Math.cos(dir)*(target.x-me.x)+Math.sin(dir)*(target.y-me.y)<=.001;
        }
        function stationaryIncoming(enemy){
            if(!threat.selfTrap())return false;
            const me=threat.position(ctx.self),future=stackPosition(enemy,1);
            return Math.hypot(future.x-me.x,future.y-me.y)<threat.distance(ctx.self,enemy)-1;
        }
        let entryCache=null;
        function stackEntry(enemy){
            if(!validEnemy(enemy)||threat.selfTrap())return null;
            const stamp=threat.velocity(enemy).at,me=threat.position(ctx.self);
            const key=[enemy.sid,stamp,me.x,me.y,ctx.self.hat,ctx.self.accessory,ctx.self.weaponIndex,ctx.self.weaponVariant,ctx.self.slowMult,enemy.hat,enemy.weaponIndex,root.MooMooCombatMacros?.oneTickWindow().steps].join(':');
            if(entryCache?.key===key)return entryCache.plan;
            const direct=stackPlan(enemy);let found=null;
            if(!direct.valid&&direct.reason==='no-motion-window'&&direct.distance<=400){
                for(const steps of [1,2,3]){
                    const future=stackPosition(enemy,steps+1),toward=Math.atan2(future.y-me.y,future.x-me.x);
                    for(const dir of [toward,toward+Math.PI/2,toward-Math.PI/2,toward+Math.PI]){
                        const candidate=stackPlan(enemy,null,{steps,dir});
                        if(candidate.valid&&stackApproachAllowed(enemy,candidate)){found=candidate;break;}
                    }
                    if(found)break;
                }
            }
            entryCache={key,plan:found};return found;
        }
        function chooseAutomatic(){
            
            if(!instaEnabled()&&!oneTickEnabled()||now()-lastStart<tick)return;
            if(root.MooMooOpportunities?.trySync?.()||root.MooMooOpportunities?.tryFinish?.(true))return;
            if(root.MooMooCombatDefense?.needsTrapReload?.()){state.instaWait=state.reason='trap-weapon-reload';return;}
            const [primary,secondary]=ctx.self.weapons||[],weapon=ctx.data.weapon(primary),ranged=ctx.data.weapon(secondary);
            const trappedInsta=instaEnabled()&&!!threat.selfTrap();
            const openingOptions={scoreOnly:true,maxRange:instaEnabled()?1500:400,requireCurrent:true,ignoreReload:secondary===10||trappedInsta};
            if(instaEnabled())openingOptions.horizon=0;
            if(trappedInsta)openingOptions.trapOpening=true;
            const targets=threat.rankTargets('automatic',secondary===10?10:primary,openingOptions).map(e=>({...e,distance:e.state.distance}));
            const ready=id=>root.MooMooAutoReload?.ready(id)??threat.ready(ctx.self.sid,id);
            spikeCandidate=ctx.settings.spikeInsta&&secondary===10
                ?targets.find(entry=>!root.MooMooCombatMacros.instaBlocked(entry.sid,true))?.sid??null:null;
            if(instaEnabled())state.instaWait=targets[0]?.evaluation.reason??'no-current-target';
            if(!weapon||primary===8&&secondary!==10){state.instaWait=state.reason=primary===8?'stick-unavailable':'no-primary';return;}
            for(const entry of targets){
                const enemy=api.player(entry.sid);if(!validEnemy(enemy))continue;
                const distance=threat.distance(ctx.self,enemy),opening=secondary===10?ranged:weapon,range=opening.range+(enemy.scale||35)*1.8;
                if(oneTickEnabled()&&capeReady(enemy)&&primary===5&&distance<=400&&ctx.self.weaponIndex!==5&&ctx.store.ownsHat(7)&&ctx.store.ownsHat(53)&&stackPlan(enemy).reason==='diamond-polearm-required'&&root.MooMooCombatDefense?.status().target==null&&!root.MooMooBaseClicks?.status().active){
                    if(now()-(state.primaryObserveAt??-Infinity)>250&&send('selectItem',5,true))state.primaryObserveAt=now();
                    continue;
                }
                if(oneTickEnabled()&&capeReady(enemy)&&primary===5&&distance<=400&&ctx.store.ownsHat(7)&&ctx.store.ownsHat(53)&&ready(primary)&&threat.turretReady(ctx.self.sid)&&nearestTurretTarget(enemy)){
                    const entry=stackEntry(enemy);
                    if(entry&&root.MooMooCombatMacros.start('oneTick',{automatic:true,targetSid:enemy.sid,dragonCape:capeNeeded(enemy),entry:entry.entry})){
                        lastStart=now();state.target=enemy.sid;state.reason='oneTick-approach';return;
                    }
                }
                if(oneTickEnabled()&&capeReady(enemy)&&primary===5&&distance<=400&&ctx.store.ownsHat(7)&&ctx.store.ownsHat(53)&&ready(primary)&&threat.turretReady(ctx.self.sid)&&nearestTurretTarget(enemy)&&(root.MooMooCombatMacros.oneTickWindow().launchAt<=now()+2||stationaryIncoming(enemy))&&stackPlan(enemy).valid&&stackApproachAllowed(enemy,stackPlan(enemy))){
                    if(root.MooMooCombatMacros.start('oneTick',{automatic:true,targetSid:enemy.sid,dragonCape:capeNeeded(enemy)})){
                        lastStart=now();state.target=enemy.sid;state.reason='stack-window';return;
                    }
                }
                if(instaEnabled()&&entry.evaluation.feasible&&distance<=range&&(secondary===10||trappedInsta||ready(opening.id))){
                    if(ctx.store.ownsHat(53)&&!threat.turretReady(ctx.self.sid)){state.instaWait='waiting-for-combo-turret';continue;}
                    if(ctx.store.ownsHat(6)&&root.AntimoocheatEquipment.urgent(true)){state.instaWait=state.reason='defense-priority';continue;}
                    if(secondary!==10&&!trappedInsta&&(!ready(primary)||ranged&&ranged.id!==11&&ranged.id!==14&&!ready(ranged.id))){state.instaWait=state.reason='waiting-for-combo-reload';continue;}
                    const blocked=root.MooMooCombatMacros.instaBlocked(enemy.sid,!!ctx.settings.spikeInsta);if(blocked){state.instaWait=state.reason=blocked;continue;}
                    if(root.MooMooCombatMacros.start('instakill',{automatic:true,targetSid:enemy.sid,hammerSpike:!!ctx.settings.spikeInsta})){
                        lastStart=now();state.target=enemy.sid;state.instaWait=null;state.reason='instakill';return;
                    }
                    state.instaWait=root.MooMooDefenses?.protectingBow?.()?'defense-priority':root.MooMooCombatMacros.status().status;
                }
            }
            if(ctx.settings.dragonOneTick&&primary===5&&ready(5)&&ctx.store.ownsTail(2)&&root.MooMooCombatMacros.dragonBuffMs()===0){
                let nearest=null,best=Infinity;
                for(const entry of targets){
                    const enemy=api.player(entry.sid);
                    if(validEnemy(enemy)&&entry.distance<=weapon.range+(enemy.scale||35)*1.8&&entry.distance<best){nearest=enemy;best=entry.distance;}
                }
                if(nearest&&root.MooMooCombatMacros.primeDragonCape(nearest.sid)){lastStart=now();state.target=nearest.sid;state.reason='dragon-cape-prime';}
            }
        }
        let swapRouter=null;
        let pushRoute=null,pathWorker=null,pathDeadline=null,pathSerial=0,pathNextAt=0,pushBendPlan=null;
        const failedPaths=new Map(),stuckPlans=new Map();let pushProgress=null;
        function planKey(sid,plan){return sid+':'+plan.spike.sid+':'+Math.round(plan.angle*8);}
        function trackProgress(enemy,plan,sp,destination,align){
            const key=planKey(enemy.sid,plan),time=now(),distance=Math.hypot(sp.x-destination.x,sp.y-destination.y);
            for(const [id,entry]of stuckPlans)if(entry.until<=time)stuckPlans.delete(id);
            if(!pushProgress||pushProgress.key!==key||pushProgress.align!==align){pushProgress={key,align,at:time,distance,x:sp.x,y:sp.y};return true;}
            if(distance<pushProgress.distance-3||Math.hypot(sp.x-pushProgress.x,sp.y-pushProgress.y)>25){pushProgress={key,align,at:time,distance,x:sp.x,y:sp.y};return true;}
            if(time-pushProgress.at<tick*6)return true;
            stuckPlans.set(key,{until:time+900});if(stuckPlans.size>64)stuckPlans.delete(stuckPlans.keys().next().value);
            ctx.net.actions?.record('path','stuck',{sid:enemy.sid,spike:plan.spike.sid,position:sp});
            pushProgress=null;resetPath(true);releaseMove(false);state.reason='push-replanning';return false;
        }
        function resetPath(close=false){
            swapRouter?.clear(close);
            const pending=pushRoute?.pending;pushRoute=null;pathSerial++;
            if(pathDeadline!==null)(root.MooMooPrivateBackground?.timers||root).clearTimeout(pathDeadline);pathDeadline=null;
            if(close||pending){pathWorker?.terminate();pathWorker=null;}if(close)pushBendPlan=null;
        }
        function routePoint(origin,goal,obstacles,key){
            if(!swapRouter)swapRouter=createSwapRouter('revelation',root,now,schedule);
            const next=swapRouter.point(origin,goal,obstacles,key);
            pushRoute=swapRouter.status();return next;
        }
        function sidePlans(ep,sp,enemy,trap,spike,world,deadline){
            const body=enemy.scale||35,capture=body+(trap.getScale?.()??trap.scale)-.1,radius=body+(spike.getScale?.()??spike.scale);
            const obstacles=world.filter(o=>o!==spike&&o.active&&!o.fake&&!o.preplace&&!o.ignoreCollision&&Math.hypot(o.x-trap.x,o.y-trap.y)<=capture+body+(o.getScale?.()??o.scale)+2)
                .map(o=>({center:o,radius:body+(o.getScale?.()??o.scale)+.5}));
            const clear=(a,b)=>!obstacles.some(o=>pushFinder.intersects(a,b,o));
            const points=[];
            const approachAngle=Math.atan2(ep.y-sp.y,ep.x-sp.x);
            for(const offset of [0,-Math.PI/12,Math.PI/12])for(const step of [24,45,70])points.push({x:ep.x+Math.cos(approachAngle+offset)*step,y:ep.y+Math.sin(approachAngle+offset)*step});
            for(const radius of [capture*.55,capture])for(let n=0;n<12;n++){const angle=n*Math.PI/6;points.push({x:trap.x+Math.cos(angle)*radius,y:trap.y+Math.sin(angle)*radius});}
            for(const o of obstacles.slice(0,3))for(let n=0;n<8;n++){const angle=n*Math.PI/4;points.push({x:o.center.x+Math.cos(angle)*(o.radius+2),y:o.center.y+Math.sin(angle)*(o.radius+2)});}
            const result=[],behind=(ctx.self.scale||35)+body+12;
            if(pushBendPlan?.sid===enemy.sid&&pushBendPlan.spike===spike.sid){
                if(Math.hypot(pushBendPlan.via.x-ep.x,pushBendPlan.via.y-ep.y)<=15)pushBendPlan=null;
                else points.unshift(pushBendPlan.via);
            }
            for(const via of points){
                if((root.performance?.now()??Date.now())>deadline)break;
                const first=Math.hypot(via.x-ep.x,via.y-ep.y);
                if(first<12||Math.hypot(via.x-trap.x,via.y-trap.y)>capture+.01||!clear(ep,via))continue;
                const dx=spike.x-via.x,dy=spike.y-via.y,d=Math.hypot(dx,dy),last=Math.max(0,d-radius),contact={x:via.x+dx*last/(d||1),y:via.y+dy*last/(d||1)};
                if(last<1||Math.hypot(contact.x-trap.x,contact.y-trap.y)>capture||!clear(via,contact))continue;
                const follow={x:via.x-dx*behind/(d||1),y:via.y-dy*behind/(d||1)};
                if(world.some(o=>o.active&&!o.fake&&!o.preplace&&!o.ignoreCollision&&Math.hypot(follow.x-o.x,follow.y-o.y)<(ctx.self.scale||35)+(o.getScale?.()??o.scale)+.5))continue;
                const ux=(via.x-ep.x)/first,uy=(via.y-ep.y)/first,spot={x:ep.x-ux*behind,y:ep.y-uy*behind};
                const forward=(ep.x-sp.x)*ux+(ep.y-sp.y)*uy,lateral=Math.abs((ep.x-sp.x)*uy-(ep.y-sp.y)*ux),aligned=forward>=0&&forward<=behind+12&&lateral<=14;
                if(!aligned&&world.some(o=>o.active&&!o.fake&&!o.preplace&&!o.ignoreCollision&&Math.hypot(spot.x-o.x,spot.y-o.y)<(ctx.self.scale||35)+(o.getScale?.()??o.scale)+.5))continue;
                const approach=aligned?0:Math.hypot(sp.x-spot.x,sp.y-spot.y);
                const retained=pushBendPlan?.sid===enemy.sid&&pushBendPlan.spike===spike.sid&&via===pushBendPlan.via;
                result.push({spike,gap:first+last,leg:first,contact,rim:0,ux,uy,angle:Math.atan2(uy,ux),path:[via,contact],cost:approach+(first+last)*2+35-(retained?35:0)});
            }
            return result.sort((a,b)=>a.cost-b.cost).slice(0,6);
        }
        function push(){
    if(!ctx.settings.autoPush||threat.selfTrap()||root.MooMooPlacers?.status().held.length||root.MooMooCombatDefense?.status().target!=null){resetPath(true);if(mode==='push')releaseMove();return;}
    const world=(ctx.objects?.all()||[]).filter(o=>o.active&&!o.fake&&!o.preplace),self=ctx.self;
    for(const entry of threat.snapshot().targets.filter(t=>t.distance<400)){
        const enemy=api.player(entry.sid);if(!enemy||enemy.alive===false||ctx.data.hat(enemy.hat)?.noTrap)continue;
        const trap=world.find(o=>o.trap&&o.ownerSid!=null&&o.ownerSid!==enemy.sid&&!(enemy.team!=null&&api.player(o.ownerSid)?.team===enemy.team)&&threat.distance(enemy,o)<=(enemy.scale||35)+(o.getScale?.()??o.scale));
        if(!trap){cancelledPushes.delete(enemy.sid);continue;}
        if(cancelledPushes.get(enemy.sid)===trap.sid)continue;
        cancelledPushes.delete(enemy.sid);
        const spikes=world.filter(o=>amPushCactus(o)||ctx.data.item(o.id)?.group?.name==='spikes'&&ctx.objects.isFriendly(o.ownerSid));
        const preferred=pushLane?.sid===enemy.sid&&pushLane.trap===trap.sid?pushLane.spike:null;
        const plan=revelationPushPlan(self,enemy,trap,spikes,world,preferred);if(!plan)continue;
        const ep=threat.position(enemy),sp=threat.position(self),origin=new PushPoint(sp.x,sp.y),goal=new PushPoint(plan.goal.x,plan.goal.y);
        const obstacles=world.filter(o=>!o.ignoreCollision||!ctx.objects.isFriendly(o.ownerSid)&&(o.trap||ctx.data.item(o.id)?.dmg>0)).map(o=>({id:o.sid,center:new PushPoint(o.x,o.y),radius:(self.scale||35)+(o.getScale?.()??o.scale)+.5}));
        const lane={sid:enemy.sid,trap:trap.sid,spike:plan.spike.sid,points:[goal,ep],route:plan.aligned?[ep]:[goal,ep],until:now()+tick*3};
        let angle=plan.angle;
        if(!plan.aligned){
            for(const p of ctx.players.values())if(p.sid!==self.sid&&p.alive!==false&&p.visible!==false&&threat.distance(self,p)<500){const q=threat.position(p);obstacles.push({id:'player'+p.sid,center:new PushPoint(q.x,q.y),radius:(self.scale||35)+(p.scale||35)+3});}
            const next=routePoint(origin,goal,obstacles,enemy.sid+':'+plan.spike.sid);
            if(!next){
                if(mode==='push')move(null);
                state.reason=pushRoute?.pending?'push-path-pending':'push-path-blocked';
                if(pushRoute?.pending){pushLane={...lane,pending:true};return;}
                continue;
            }
            const index=pushRoute?.path?.indexOf(next)??-1;
            lane.route=index<0?[next,goal,ep]:[...pushRoute.path.slice(index),goal,ep];
            angle=Math.atan2(next.y-sp.y,next.x-sp.x);
        }else resetPath(true);
        // Keep the Revelation contact steering until actual collision.
        // Its contact margin is a steering threshold, not proof of spike damage.
        const safe=root.MooMooSafewalk;
        if(angle!==null&&(!clearPath(angle,Math.min(35,threat.distance(self,enemy)),.45)||safe?.status().enabled&&safe.hazard(angle)!=null))continue;
        if(Number.isFinite(angle))lane.route.unshift({x:sp.x+Math.cos(angle)*Math.min(35,threat.distance(self,enemy)),y:sp.y+Math.sin(angle)*Math.min(35,threat.distance(self,enemy))});
        if(move(angle)){
            pushTailContact.begin(enemy.sid,trap.sid);
            mode='push';target=enemy.sid;pushSpike=plan.spike.sid;pushTrap=trap.sid;pushHealth=enemy.health;state.pushTarget=target;
            pushLane=lane;
            state.reason=angle===null?'holding-contact':plan.aligned?'pushing':'push-positioning';return;
        }
    }
    if(!pushRoute?.pending)resetPath(true);
    pushLane=null;if(mode==='push')releaseMove();
}

        function run(){
            timer=null;if(!live()){releaseMove(false);state.reason='inactive';return;}
            const combo=root.MooMooCombatMacros?.status();
            if(combo?.active){
                if(mode==='push'&&combo.preservesMovement){push();return;}
                if(mode==='push'){
                    // OneTick has taken movement. Drop the old push lease
                    // without a stop/retry that could overwrite its lunge.
                    if(combo.active==='oneTick')cancel('oneTick-handoff',false);
                    else releaseMove(false);
                }
                return;
            }
            chooseAutomatic();if(!root.MooMooCombatMacros?.status().active&&now()>=pauseUntil)push();
            if(oneTickEnabled()&&!root.MooMooCombatMacros?.status().active&&[...ctx.players.values()].some(p=>validEnemy(p)&&threat.distance(ctx.self,p)<=400)){
                const at=root.MooMooCombatMacros.oneTickWindow().checkAt;
                if(Number.isFinite(at)&&timer===null)timer=(root.MooMooPrivateBackground?.timers||root).setTimeout(run,Math.max(5,at-now()+1));
            }
        }
        function schedule(){if(timer===null&&!disposed&&(instaEnabled()||oneTickEnabled()||ctx.settings.autoPush||ownedMove))timer=(root.MooMooPrivateBackground?.timers||root).setTimeout(run,1);}
        for(const action of ['move','stopMove'])ctx.onOutgoing(action,(payload,info)=>{
            if(executing)return payload;
            if(info?.source==='client')nativeMove=action==='move'&&Number.isFinite(payload.dir)?payload.dir:null;
            const combo=root.MooMooCombatMacros?.status();
            if(ownedMove&&mode==='push'&&ctx.settings.autoPush&&live()&&now()>=pauseUntil&&(!combo?.active||combo.preservesMovement))return null;
            return payload;
        });
        const offSent=api.onSent((action,p,source)=>{
            if(action==='move'||action==='stopMove'){stackInputs.push({at:now(),dir:action==='move'?p.dir:null});if(stackInputs.length>16)stackInputs.shift();}
            if(executing)return;
            if(action==='move'||action==='stopMove')lastPushDirection=action==='move'?p.dir:null;
            if(source==='mod'){
                if((releasePending||mode==='push'&&root.MooMooCombatMacros?.status().active)&&(action==='move'||action==='stopMove')){
                    pushTailContact.clear();clearRelease();ownedMove=false;mode=null;target=null;state.pushTarget=null;pushLane=null;
                    if(movementTimer!==null)(root.MooMooPrivateBackground?.timers||root).clearTimeout(movementTimer);movementTimer=null;
                }
                return;
            }
            if(action==='move'||action==='stopMove'){nativeMove=action==='move'&&Number.isFinite(p.dir)?p.dir:null;schedule();}
        });
        const offKey=ctx.input.onKeyDown((event,aliases)=>{
            const direction=movementKeys().find(([key,arrow])=>aliases.includes('#'+key)||aliases.includes('#'+arrow));
            if(direction&&live()&&!ctx.input.isTyping()){
                keyboardMove=true;heldDirections.set(event.code||event.keyCode,direction);
            }
            if(!live()||event.repeat||event.defaultPrevented||event.isComposing||event.ctrlKey||event.altKey||event.metaKey)return;
            const spikeKey=ctx.input.normKey(ctx.settings.spikeInstaKey);
            if(spikeKey&&aliases.includes(spikeKey)&&!ctx.input.isTyping()&&!root.AntimoocheatBots?.isRemoteKey(event)){
                event.preventDefault();event.stopImmediatePropagation();ctx.setSetting('spikeInsta',!ctx.settings.spikeInsta);return;
            }
            const capeKey=ctx.input.normKey(ctx.settings.dragonOneTickKey);
            if(capeKey&&aliases.includes(capeKey)&&!ctx.input.isTyping()&&!root.AntimoocheatBots?.isRemoteKey(event)){
                event.preventDefault();event.stopImmediatePropagation();ctx.setSetting('dragonOneTick',!ctx.settings.dragonOneTick);return;
            }
            const pauseKey=ctx.input.normKey(ctx.settings.executePushKey);
            if(pauseKey&&aliases.includes(pauseKey)){
                event.preventDefault();event.stopImmediatePropagation();if(mode==='push'&&target!=null)cancelledPushes.set(target,pushTrap);pauseUntil=0;resetPath();releaseMove();state.reason='push-cancelled';schedule();return;
            }
        });
        const offKeyUp=ctx.input.onKeyUp(event=>{
            if(!heldDirections.delete(event.code||event.keyCode)||heldDirections.size)return;
            nativeMove=null;
            schedule();
        });
        ctx.on('health',p=>{
            if(mode!=='push'||p.sid!==target)return;
            const enemy=api.player(target),spike=ctx.objects?.get(pushSpike);
            if(enemy&&spike?.active&&p.value<pushHealth&&amPushSpikeDamage(ctx,enemy,spike,pushHealth-p.value)){
                pushDamage={sid:target,spike:pushSpike,trap:pushTrap,at:now(),point:threat.position(enemy)};
                if(!amPushCactus(spike)){
                    pushTailContact.defer(pushDamage);
                    if(threat.distance(enemy,spike)<=(enemy.scale||35)+(spike.getScale?.()??spike.scale)+2)
                        pushTailContact.confirm(target,pushTrap,pushSpike,pushDamage.at);
                }
                if(threat.distance(enemy,spike)<=(enemy.scale||35)+(spike.getScale?.()??spike.scale)+24){
                    const hit=target;finishedPushes.set(hit,{spike:pushSpike,trap:pushTrap});state.reason=amPushCactus(spike)?'cactus-contact':'spike-contact';pushDamage=null;if(!amPushCactus(spike))root.MooMooOpportunities?.pushContact?.(hit);schedule();
                }
            }
            pushHealth=p.value;
        });
        ctx.on('playersUpdate',payload=>{
            const tailSample=pushTailContact.takePending();
            if(tailSample){

                if(mode==='push'&&target===tailSample.sid&&pushTrap===tailSample.trap&&now()-tailSample.at<=tick*2&&enemy&&spike?.active&&
                    pushFinder.intersects(tailSample.point,threat.position(enemy),{center:spike,radius:(enemy.scale||35)+(spike.getScale?.()??spike.scale)+2}))
                    pushTailContact.confirm(tailSample.sid,tailSample.trap,tailSample.spike,tailSample.at);
            }
            if(pushDamage){
                const sample=pushDamage,enemy=api.player(sample.sid),spike=ctx.objects?.get(sample.spike);
                if(now()-sample.at<=tick*2&&enemy&&spike?.active&&pushFinder.intersects(sample.point,threat.position(enemy),{center:spike,radius:(enemy.scale||35)+(spike.getScale?.()??spike.scale)+2})){
                    finishedPushes.set(sample.sid,{spike:sample.spike,trap:sample.trap});state.reason=amPushCactus(spike)?'cactus-contact':'spike-contact';if(!amPushCactus(spike))root.MooMooOpportunities?.pushContact?.(sample.sid);
                }

            }
            stackOrder=(payload.positions||[]).map(p=>p.sid);
            const points=new Map((payload.positions||[]).map(p=>[p.sid,p])),hidden=new Set(payload.hidden||[]);
            for(const p of ctx.players.values()){
                if(!p.alive||!p.visible||hidden.has(p.sid)){observedMotion.delete(p.sid);stackHistory.delete(p.sid);hatHistory.delete(p.sid);usesTurret.delete(p.sid);hatCycles.remove(p.sid);finishedPushes.delete(p.sid);continue;}

                const history=hatHistory.get(p.sid)||[],hat=p.hat??p.skinIndex;if(history.at(-1)===7&&hat===53)usesTurret.add(p.sid);history.push(hat);if(history.length>4)history.shift();hatHistory.set(p.sid,history);

            }

        });
        for(const event of ['objectsLoad','objectKilled','objectsKilled'])ctx.on(event,()=>{entryCache=null;schedule();});
        for(const event of ['health','inventory','storeUpdate'])ctx.on(event,schedule);
        for(const event of ['reset','setup','died','disconnect'])ctx.on(event,()=>{clearToast();resetPath(true);failedPaths.clear();stuckPlans.clear();pushProgress=null;pathNextAt=0;cancel(event,false);nativeMove=null;keyboardMove=false;pauseUntil=0;lastStart=-Infinity;observedMotion.clear();stackHistory.clear();hatHistory.clear();usesTurret.clear();hatCycles.clear();finishedPushes.clear();pushSpike=pushTrap=pushHealth=pushDamage=null;if(timer!==null)(root.MooMooPrivateBackground?.timers||root).clearTimeout(timer);timer=null;});
        const capeClock=root.MooMooPrivateBackground?.timers||root;
        let capeTimer=null;
        function clearCapeExpiry(){if(capeTimer!==null)capeClock.clearTimeout(capeTimer);capeTimer=null;}
        function scheduleCapeExpiry(){
            clearCapeExpiry();
            const remaining=root.MooMooCombatMacros?.dragonBuffMs()||0;
            if(!ctx.settings.dragonOneTick||disposed||remaining<=0)return;

            },Math.ceil(remaining));
        }
        function clearDirections(){heldDirections.clear();cancelledPushes.clear();nativeMove=null;lastPushDirection=null;stackInputs.length=0;}
        for(const event of ['reset','setup','died','disconnect'])ctx.on(event,()=>{clearDirections();clearCapeExpiry();});
        const blur=()=>{blurred=true;resetPath(true);clearDirections();releaseMove(false);state.reason='blur';},focus=()=>{blurred=false;schedule();};
        const hidden=()=>{if(root.document.hidden){resetPath(true);clearDirections();releaseMove(false);state.reason='hidden';}};
        root.addEventListener('blur',blur);root.addEventListener('focus',focus);
        root.document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',hidden);
        ctx.onSettingChange(key=>{
            if((key==='instakill'||key==='spikeInsta')&&ctx.settings[key]){

                if(ctx.settings[other])ctx.setSetting(other,false);
            }
            if(key==='oneTick'||key==='dragonOneTick'){
                const other=key==='oneTick'?'dragonOneTick':'oneTick';
                if(ctx.settings[key]&&ctx.settings[other])ctx.setSetting(other,false);
                const running=root.MooMooCombatMacros?.status().active;
                if(running==='dragonPrime'&&!ctx.settings.dragonOneTick||running==='oneTick')root.MooMooCombatMacros.cancel('mode-changed');
            }

                if(!completingSpike)toast('spikeInsta');
            }

            if(key==='oneTick'||key==='instakill')toast(key);const active=root.MooMooCombatMacros?.status();if(active?.automatic&&['instakill','oneTick'].includes(active.active)&&!(active.active==='oneTick'?oneTickEnabled():ctx.settings[active.hammerSpike?'spikeInsta':'instakill']))root.MooMooCombatMacros.cancel('disabled');if(key==='autoPush')cancelledPushes.clear();if(!ctx.settings.autoPush){resetPath(true);if(mode==='push')releaseMove();}schedule();});
        let lineCache=[],lineAt=-Infinity;
        const hasPushLane=sid=>ctx.settings.autoPush&&now()>=pauseUntil&&pushLane&&now()<=pushLane.until&&
            (sid==null||pushLane.sid===sid)&&validEnemy(api.player(pushLane.sid))&&ctx.objects.get(pushLane.spike)?.active&&
            (ctx.objects.get(pushLane.trap)?.active||target===pushLane.sid&&finishedPushes.get(target)?.spike===pushLane.spike);
        root.MooMooAutomation={toggle:key=>{if(key==='instakill'||key==='oneTick')ctx.setSetting(key,!ctx.settings[key]);},
            capeReady,scheduleCapeExpiry,
            oneTickPreparing:()=>!!(oneTickEnabled()&&ctx.self.alive&&ctx.self.weapons?.[0]===5&&ctx.store.ownsHat(7)&&ctx.store.ownsHat(53)&&(root.MooMooAutoReload?.ready(5)??threat.ready(ctx.self.sid,5))&&threat.turretReady(ctx.self.sid)&&[...ctx.players.values()].some(p=>validEnemy(p)&&![6,60,61,22].includes(p.hat??p.skinIndex)&&threat.distance(ctx.self,p)<=400&&threat.distance(ctx.self,p)>190)),
            hatForecast:(sid,lead)=>hatCycles.forecast(sid,lead),
            hatWindow:(sid,from,to)=>hatCycles.window(sid,from,to),
            isTurretTarget:sid=>validEnemy(api.player(sid))&&nearestTurretTarget(api.player(sid)),
            pressInsta:()=>{
                if(ctx.settings.instakill){ctx.setSetting('instakill',false);return;}
                lastStart=-Infinity;
                ctx.setSetting('instakill',true);
                if(live()&&!root.MooMooCombatMacros?.status().active)chooseAutomatic();
            },
            placementDirection:()=>{
                if(!live())return null;
                const direction=ownedMove?lastPushDirection:(manualDirection()??lastPushDirection);
                return Number.isFinite(direction)?direction:null;
            },
            navigationPath:()=>{
                if(!ctx.settings.autoPush||mode!=='push'||!ownedMove||!live()||!hasPushLane())return [];
                const me=threat.position(ctx.self),route=pushRoute?.path||[];
                let start=0,nearest=Infinity;
                // Skip already travelled segments when displaying a worker route.
                for(let i=0;i+1<route.length;i++){
                    const a=route[i],b=route[i+1],dx=b.x-a.x,dy=b.y-a.y,l=dx*dx+dy*dy;
                    const t=l?Math.max(0,Math.min(1,((me.x-a.x)*dx+(me.y-a.y)*dy)/l)):1;
                    const d=Math.hypot(me.x-a.x-t*dx,me.y-a.y-t*dy);
                    if(d<nearest){nearest=d;start=i+1;}
                }
                const points=[],lane=pushLane.points;
                for(const p of [...route.slice(start),...lane].slice(0,64)){
                    if(!Number.isFinite(p.x)||!Number.isFinite(p.y))continue;
                    const previous=points.at(-1)||me;if(Math.hypot(p.x-previous.x,p.y-previous.y)>1)points.push({x:p.x,y:p.y});
                }
                return points;
            },
            reservedPushSpike:sid=>hasPushLane(sid)?pushLane.spike:null,
            hasPushLane:sid=>!!hasPushLane(sid),
            debug:()=>({lane:hasPushLane()?pushLane.points.map(p=>({x:p.x,y:p.y})):[],progress:pushProgress?{...pushProgress}:null,failedRoutes:failedPaths.size,stuckPlans:stuckPlans.size}),
            placementAllowed:(item,point)=>{
                if(item.ignoreCollision||!hasPushLane())return true;

                    if(pushFinder.intersects(from,to,obstacle))return false;
                    from=to;
                }

                if(!enemy||!spike)return true;

                const body=enemy.scale||35,travel=d?Math.max(0,d-body-(spike.getScale?.()??spike.scale))/d:0;
                return !Number.isFinite(amCircleEntry(ep.x,ep.y,dx*travel,dy*travel,point.x,point.y,body+item.scale+2));
            },
            tryInsta:()=>{if((instaEnabled()||oneTickEnabled())&&live()&&!root.MooMooCombatMacros?.status().active)chooseAutomatic();return ['instakill','oneTick'].includes(root.MooMooCombatMacros?.status().active);},
            armInsta:()=>{if(!ctx.settings.instakill)ctx.setSetting('instakill',true);},completeInsta:(reason,hammerSpike)=>{
                const key=hammerSpike?'spikeInsta':'instakill';
                if(!ctx.settings[key])return;
                completingSpike=hammerSpike&&reason==='complete';

            instaTarget:()=>{
                if(!instaEnabled()||!api.isReady()||!ctx.self.alive)return null;
                const active=root.MooMooCombatMacros?.status(),locked=active?.active==='instakill'?api.player(active.targetSid):null;

                }

            },
            canShowRing:plan=>{
                const enemy=api.player(plan.sid);
