            },
            lines:()=>{if(!oneTickEnabled())return [];if(now()-lineAt>=50){lineAt=now();lineCache=threat.snapshot().targets.map(entry=>api.player(entry.sid)).filter(enemy=>validEnemy(enemy)&&threat.distance(ctx.self,enemy)<=400).map(enemy=>stackPlan(enemy));}return lineCache;},
            pushSpikeContact:()=>mode==='push'&&ownedMove&&live()?pushTailContact.status():null,
            ownsPushMovement:()=>mode==='push'&&ownedMove&&live()&&now()>=pauseUntil,
            ownsMovement:()=>ownedMove,status:()=>({...state,insta:!!instaEnabled(),spikeInsta:!!ctx.settings.spikeInsta,oneTick:!!ctx.settings.oneTick,dragonOneTick:!!ctx.settings.dragonOneTick,autoAim:true,autoPush:!!ctx.settings.autoPush,pushSpike:mode==='push'?pushSpike:null,pushPausedMs:Math.max(0,pauseUntil-now()),ownsMovement:ownedMove,pushPath:pushRoute?.path?.map(p=>({x:p.x,y:p.y}))||[],pathPending:!!pushRoute?.pending,lineRange:400})};
        ctx.onCleanup(()=>{disposed=true;clearCapeExpiry();clearToast();resetPath(true);failedPaths.clear();stuckPlans.clear();pushProgress=null;if(timer!==null)(root.MooMooPrivateBackground?.timers||root).clearTimeout(timer);cancel('disabled');offSent();offKey();offKeyUp();root.removeEventListener('blur',blur);root.removeEventListener('focus',focus);root.document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange',hidden);text?.remove();delete root.MooMooAutomation;});
    });
})(miscApi,root);
    (function installCombatOpportunities(api,root){
    'use strict';
    const background=()=>root.MooMooPrivateBackground?.allowed()===true;
    const id='combat-opportunities';if(api.getMods().some(m=>m.id===id))return;
    return api.register({id,name:'Combat Opportunities',version:'0.1.0',defaultEnabled:true,liveSettings:true,settings:[
        {key:'autoBullSpam',type:'boolean',default:false,label:'Auto Bull Spam'},
        {key:'autoSync',type:'boolean',default:false,label:'AutoSync',hint:'When both you and your bot are in melee range, the bot hits first. You follow as soon as possible on a later tick so the two hits do not stack.'},
{key:'autoFinisher',type:'boolean',default:true,label:'AutoFinisher'},
        {key:'spikeTickNonSoldier',type:'boolean',default:false,label:'SpikeTick Non-Soldier',hint:'Prioritizes ready Bull Primary + damaging Spike, including during placers and combos. Searches contact angles within spike reach and the next tick. Requires an untrapped non-Soldier target.'},
        {key:'spikeSyncHammer',type:'boolean',default:false,label:'Trap Sync',category:'Instakill Modules',hint:'Katana/Polearm only. Tank Hammer → spike + Bull Primary.'},
        {key:'animalSteal',type:'boolean',default:false,label:'AutoSteal',category:'Instakill Modules'},
        {key:'turretSteal',type:'boolean',default:false,label:'Turret Steal',category:'Instakill Modules',hint:'Equips ready owned Turret for a clear shot at the nearest enemy at lethal actual damage (25 HP, or 18.75 with Soldier). Returns to Soldier after the observed shot. Soldier takes 18.75 actual damage; the displayed 19 is rounded.'},
        {key:'knockbackTick',type:'boolean',default:false,label:'KB Tick Hammer',category:'Instakill Modules',hint:'Ready Turret + Hammer, then Bull Primary. Tracks the same enemy and spike through the swing. Uses any feasible Hammer-to-spike path within real weapon reach.'},
        {key:'knockbackTurret',type:'boolean',default:false,label:'KB Tick Turret',category:'Instakill Modules',hint:'Turret then Bull Primary against an untrapped enemy within real weapon reach. Requires a quick path to an existing friendly spike; new spike placement is irrelevant.'},
        {key:'knockbackPrimary',type:'boolean',default:false,label:'KB Tick',category:'Instakill Modules',hint:'Bull Primary pushes non-Soldier enemies into your spikes. No Stick.'}
    ]},ctx=>{
        const threat=root.MooMooThreats,now=()=>root.performance?.now()??Date.now(),pushed=new Set(),animalAttempts=new Map(),finishCandidates=new Map();
        const healthSamples=new Map([...ctx.players.values()].map(p=>[p.sid,p.health])),spikeDamage=new Map();
        let timer=null,spikeWindowWake=null,disposed=false,blurred=false,lastStrike=-Infinity;
        const pos=threat.position,distance=threat.distance;
        const primary=()=>ctx.data.weapon(ctx.self.weapons?.[0]);
        const reach=p=>(primary()?.range||0)+(p.scale||35)*1.8;
        const hostile=p=>p?.alive&&p.health>0&&p.visible&&p.sid!==ctx.self.sid&&!(ctx.objects.isFriendly(p.sid));
        const sessionLive=()=>!disposed&&(!blurred||background())&&api.isReady()&&ctx.self.alive&&(!root.document.hidden||background())&&!automationTyping();
        const live=()=>sessionLive()&&!root.MooMooCombatDefense?.needsTrapReload?.();
        const available=(finish=false,immediate=false,trapException=false)=>(trapException?sessionLive():live())&&!root.MooMooCombatMacros?.protectOpportunity?.()&&(finish||!root.MooMooAutomation?.status().insta)&&!root.MooMooCombatMacros?.status().active&&!root.AntimoocheatCombat?.sending()&&!root.AntimoocheatDefense?.busy()&&(!root.MooMooActionIntent||root.MooMooActionIntent.owner==='defensive-combat')&&(immediate||now()-lastStrike>=(ctx.SERVER_TICK||1000/9));
        const ready=(animal=false,finish=false,trapException=false)=>available(finish,false,trapException)&&(animal||ctx.store.ownsHat(7))&&primary()?.dmg>0&&(root.MooMooAutoReload?.ready(primary().id)??threat.ready(ctx.self.sid,primary().id));
        function priorityReady(){
            if(!root.MooMooCombatMacros?.finisherMayInterrupt())return ready(false,true);
            const w=primary();
            return live()&&w?.dmg>0&&w.projectile==null&&ctx.store.ownsHat(7)&&
                !root.AntimoocheatDefense?.busy()&&!root.AntimoocheatCombat?.sending()&&
                (root.MooMooAutoReload?.ready(w.id)??threat.ready(ctx.self.sid,w.id));
        }
        function canTurret(sid,ignoreReload=false,expectedHP=null){
            const target=api.player(sid),gear=ctx.data.hat(53)?.turret;
            if(!ctx.settings.turretSteal||!hostile(target)||!gear||!ctx.store.ownsHat(53)||!ignoreReload&&!threat.turretReady(ctx.self.sid))return false;
            const armor=ctx.data.hat(target.hat??target.skinIndex),damage=threat.projectileDamage(target,ctx.self,ctx.data.projectiles[gear.proj]?.dmg||25);
            if(armor?.antiTurret||(expectedHP??target.health)>damage+1e-6||distance(ctx.self,target)>gear.range)return false;
            const candidates=[...ctx.players.values(),...(ctx.combat?.animals||[])].filter(p=>p.sid!==ctx.self.sid&&p.visible!==false&&p.alive!==false&&p.health>0&&!(ctx.objects.isFriendly(p.sid))&&!ctx.data.hat(p.hat??p.skinIndex)?.antiTurret);
            candidates.sort((a,b)=>distance(ctx.self,a)-distance(ctx.self,b));if(candidates[0]?.sid!==target.sid)return false;
            const start=pos(ctx.self),end=pos(target),toward=Math.atan2(start.y-end.y,start.x-end.x),facing=target.d2??target.dir;
            if(ctx.data.weapon(target.weaponIndex)?.shield&&Number.isFinite(facing)&&Math.abs(Math.atan2(Math.sin(toward-facing),Math.cos(toward-facing)))<=Math.PI/3)return false;
            const entry=(point,radius)=>{
                let low=0,high=1;
                for(const axis of ['x','y']){const delta=end[axis]-start[axis],offset=point[axis]-start[axis];if(Math.abs(delta)<1e-9){if(Math.abs(offset)>radius)return Infinity;continue;}const a=(offset-radius)/delta,b=(offset+radius)/delta;low=Math.max(low,Math.min(a,b));high=Math.min(high,Math.max(a,b));if(low>high)return Infinity;}
                return low;
            };
            const hit=entry(end,target.scale||35);
            const layer=Math.max(ctx.self.zIndex||0,ctx.data.projectiles[gear.proj]?.layer??1);
            return !(root.AntimoocheatWorld?.query({x:Math.min(start.x,end.x)-2,y:Math.min(start.y,end.y)-2},{x:Math.max(start.x,end.x)+2,y:Math.max(start.y,end.y)+2})||ctx.objects.all()).some(o=>o.active&&!o.fake&&!o.preplace&&!o.ignoreCollision&&(o.layer||0)>=layer&&entry(o,(o.getScale?.()??o.scale)+2)<=hit);
        }
        function pushable(enemy){
            if(!hostile(enemy)||!threat.evaluateAttack(enemy,primary()?.id,{requireCurrent:true}).feasible||distance(ctx.self,enemy)>reach(enemy)||root.MooMooCombatMacros?.trapped(enemy.sid))return false;
            const a=pos(ctx.self),b=pos(enemy),d=Math.hypot(b.x-a.x,b.y-a.y);if(d<1)return false;
            const dx=(b.x-a.x)/d,dy=(b.y-a.y)/d;
            const world=ctx.objects.all();
            const contact=o=>{
                const x=o.x-b.x,y=o.y-b.y,along=x*dx+y*dy,cross=Math.abs(x*dy-y*dx),radius=(enemy.scale||35)+(o.getScale?.()??o.scale);
                return along<0||cross>radius?Infinity:Math.max(0,along-Math.sqrt(Math.max(0,radius*radius-cross*cross)));
            };
            return world.some(o=>{
                if(!o.active||o.fake||o.preplace||!ctx.objects.isFriendly(o.ownerSid)||ctx.data.item(o.id)?.group?.name!=='spikes')return false;
                const hit=contact(o);
                return hit<=60&&!world.some(block=>block!==o&&block.active&&!block.fake&&!block.preplace&&(!block.ignoreCollision||block.boostSpeed||block.teleport||block.trap&&block.ownerSid!==enemy.sid&&!(enemy.team!=null&&api.player(block.ownerSid)?.team===enemy.team))&&contact(block)<=hit);
            });
        }
        function spikeWindow(sid,acceptedBull=null){
            const enemy=api.player(sid),eq=root.AntimoocheatEquipment,tick=ctx.SERVER_TICK||1000/9;
            if(!root.AntimoocheatCombat?.settings?.spikeSync||!hostile(enemy))return {allowed:false,reason:'disabled-or-target'};
            const hat=enemy.hat??enemy.skinIndex,hammer=enemy.weaponIndex===10||threat.observedWeapons(sid).some(w=>w.id===10);
            if(!root.MooMooCombatMacros?.trapped(sid)||!hammer&&hat!==40)return {allowed:true,reason:'no-trapped-tank-cycle'};
            // Melee already pairs an accepted Bull request and F in order.
            // Do not add an acknowledgement RTT or acquire while the shared
            // hat deadline is closed. Re-check the arrival window at send.
            const paired=acceptedBull?.id===7&&eq?.pending(false)===acceptedBull;
            const gate=paired||eq?.settled(7)?0:Math.max(0,eq?.hatWait()||0),rtt=Math.max(0,ctx.net.minPing?.()||ctx.net.ping||0);
            const lead=rtt/2+tick/2,from=Math.max(0,lead-tick*.4),to=lead+tick*.4;
            const forecast=delay=>root.MooMooAutomation?.hatWindow(sid,from+delay,to+delay);
            const window=forecast(0),tank=w=>w?.valid===true&&w.hat===40;
            const center=root.MooMooAutomation?.hatForecast(sid,lead);
            const observed=hat===40&&(!center||center.hat===40);
            if(gate<=1&&(tank(window)||observed))return {allowed:true,reason:tank(window)?'predicted-tank':'observed-tank',lead,window};
            // Only an already evidenced cycle can schedule a future opening.
            // The wait owns no action and is bounded to two server updates.
            let wait=null;
            if(observed&&gate>1&&gate<=tick*2)wait=gate+1;
            else for(let delay=Math.max(0,gate);delay<=tick*2;delay+=tick/8)if(tank(forecast(delay))){wait=Math.max(1,delay);break;}
            return {allowed:false,reason:gate>1?'bull-deadline':'waiting-for-tank',lead,window,wait};
        }
        function allowSpikeSync(sid){
            const plan=spikeWindow(sid);
            if(!plan.allowed&&plan.wait!=null&&spikeWindowWake==null&&sessionLive())spikeWindowWake=(root.MooMooPrivateBackground?.timers||root).setTimeout(()=>{
                spikeWindowWake=null;if(sessionLive()){if(!tryTrapPriority())schedule();}
            },Math.max(1,Math.ceil(plan.wait)));
            return plan.allowed;
        }
        function contactPlan(sid){
            const enemy=api.player(sid),w=primary(),tick=ctx.SERVER_TICK||1000/9;
            if(!hostile(enemy)||w?.id===8||!(w?.dmg>0)||w.projectile!=null||distance(ctx.self,enemy)>reach(enemy))return null;
            const self=pos(ctx.self),start=pos(enemy),locked=root.MooMooCombatMacros?.trapped(sid);
            // A captured player cannot continue an old incoming velocity into
            // a spike. Only actual overlap can predict contact while trapped.
            const next=locked?start:threat.predict(enemy,tick,{collisions:false});
            const dx=next.x-start.x,dy=next.y-start.y,selfNext=threat.predict(ctx.self,tick);
            const world=ctx.objects.all().filter(o=>o.active&&!o.fake&&!o.preplace);
            const entry=(o,radius)=>{
                const x=start.x-o.x,y=start.y-o.y,c=x*x+y*y-radius*radius,a=dx*dx+dy*dy,b=x*dx+y*dy;
                if(c<=0)return b>0&&Math.hypot(x+dx,y+dy)>radius?Infinity:0;
                if(a<=0||b>=0)return Infinity;const disc=b*b-a*c;if(disc<0)return Infinity;
                const t=(-b-Math.sqrt(disc))/a;return t>=0&&t<=1?t:Infinity;
            };
            let best=null;
            for(const spike of world){
                if(!(ctx.data.item(spike.id)?.dmg>0)||ctx.data.item(spike.id)?.group?.name!=='spikes'||spike.ownerSid==null||spike.ownerSid===sid||enemy.team!=null&&api.player(spike.ownerSid)?.team===enemy.team)continue;
                const radius=(enemy.scale||35)+(spike.getScale?.()??spike.scale);if(locked&&distance(enemy,spike)>=radius)continue;const t=entry(spike,radius);if(!Number.isFinite(t))continue;
                if(world.some(o=>o!==spike&&(!o.ignoreCollision||o.trap&&o.ownerSid!==sid&&!(enemy.team!=null&&api.player(o.ownerSid)?.team===enemy.team))&&entry(o,(enemy.scale||35)+(o.getScale?.()??o.scale))<t-.0001))continue;
                const x=start.x+dx*t-spike.x,y=start.y+dy*t-spike.y,length=Math.hypot(x,y)||1,hit={x:spike.x+x/length*radius,y:spike.y+y/length*radius};
                if(Math.hypot(hit.x-selfNext.x,hit.y-selfNext.y)>reach(enemy))continue;
                const a=Math.atan2(start.y-self.y,start.x-self.x),b=Math.atan2(hit.y-selfNext.y,hit.x-selfNext.x),delta=Math.atan2(Math.sin(b-a),Math.cos(b-a));
                if(Math.abs(delta)>(ctx.combat.K?.gatherAngle??Math.PI/2.6))continue;
                if(!best||t<best.time)best={spike:spike.sid,time:t,angle:a+delta/2};
            }
            return best;
        }
        function prune(){
            for(const sid of pushed){const enemy=api.player(sid);if(!hostile(enemy)||distance(ctx.self,enemy)>reach(enemy)+60)pushed.delete(sid);}
            for(const sid of animalAttempts.keys())if(!(ctx.combat.animals||[]).some(a=>a.sid===sid&&a.active&&a.visible&&a.health>0))animalAttempts.delete(sid);
        }
        const wantsSpike=sid=>ready()&&!pushed.has(sid)&&pushable(api.player(sid));
        function strike(sid,animal=false,hat=7,finish=false,notice=null){const target=animal?(ctx.combat.animals||[]).find(a=>a.sid===sid):api.player(sid);if(!ready(animal||hat!==7,finish)||!threat.evaluateAttack(target,primary().id,{animal,hat,requireCurrent:true}).feasible||!root.MooMooCombatMacros.strike(sid,animal,hat,false,notice))return false;lastStrike=now();return true;}
        function finishingHat(target,animal){
            const weapon=primary(),variant=threat.observedWeapons(ctx.self.sid).find(w=>w.id===weapon.id)?.variant??(ctx.self.weaponIndex===weapon.id?ctx.self.weaponVariant:0)??0;
            const current=ctx.self.hat??ctx.self.skinIndex??0,selfPos=pos(ctx.self),targetPos=pos(target);
            const toward=Math.atan2(selfPos.y-targetPos.y,selfPos.x-targetPos.x),shield=ctx.data.weapon(target.weaponIndex)?.shield;
            const targetDir=target.d2??target.dir;
            const facing=!animal&&shield&&Number.isFinite(targetDir)&&Math.abs(Math.atan2(Math.sin(toward-targetDir),Math.cos(toward-targetDir)))<=(ctx.combat.K?.shieldAngle??Math.PI/3);
            const multiplier=facing?shield:([1,1.1,1.18,1.18,1.18][variant]||1);
            const defense=animal?1:(ctx.data.hat(target.hat??target.skinIndex)?.dmgMult||1);
            for(const gear of animal?[...new Set([current,...ctx.store.ownsHat(7)?[7]:[]])]:ctx.store.ownsHat(7)?[7]:[]){
                const accessory=root.AntimoocheatDefense?.attackAccessory(false,animal?'animal':'enemy')??ctx.self.accessory;
                const damage=weapon.dmg*multiplier*(ctx.data.hat(gear)?.dmgMultO??1)*(ctx.data.accessory(accessory)?.dmgMultO??1)*defense;
                if(target.health<=damage)return gear;
            }
            return null;
        }
        // Check the received animal state directly, before unrelated opportunities.
        // No polling: animal packets, reload readiness and ordinary game updates wake it.
        let checkingAnimal=false;
        function animalPlan(animal){
            const w=primary();
            if(!ctx.settings.animalSteal||!live()||!animal?.active||!animal.visible||!(animal.health>0)||
                animal.state&&ctx.data.animal(animal.index)?.diver||!(w?.dmg>0)||w.projectile!=null||
                distance(ctx.self,animal)>reach(animal))return null;
            const variant=threat.observedWeapons(ctx.self.sid).find(v=>v.id===w.id)?.variant??ctx.self.weaponVariant??0;
            const base=w.dmg*([1,1.1,1.18,1.18,1.18][variant]||1);
            const current=ctx.self.hat??ctx.self.skinIndex??0,tail=ctx.self.accessory??ctx.self.tailIndex??0;
            const hats=[...new Set([current,...ctx.store.ownsHat(7)?[7]:[]])];
            const desired=root.AntimoocheatDefense?.attackAccessory(false,'animal')??tail;
            const tails=[...new Set([...(desired===0||ctx.store.ownsTail(desired)?[desired]:[]),tail])];
            for(const accessory of tails)for(const hat of hats){
                const damage=base*(ctx.data.hat(hat)?.dmgMultO??1)*(ctx.data.accessory(accessory)?.dmgMultO??1);
                if(animal.health<=damage)return {hat,accessory,damage};
            }
            return null;
        }
        function tryAnimalSteal(){
            if(checkingAnimal||!ctx.settings.animalSteal||!live())return false;
            if(root.MooMooCombatMacros?.animalStealing())return true;
            const w=primary();
            if(!(w?.dmg>0)||w.projectile!=null||!(root.MooMooAutoReload?.ready(w.id)??threat.ready(ctx.self.sid,w.id)))return false;
            checkingAnimal=true;
            try{
                let best=null;
                for(const animal of ctx.combat.animals||[]){
                    const plan=animalPlan(animal);if(!plan)continue;
                    const previous=animalAttempts.get(animal.sid);
                    if(previous?.health===animal.health&&now()-previous.at<(ctx.SERVER_TICK||1000/9))continue;
                    if(!threat.evaluateAttack(animal,w.id,{animal:true,hat:plan.hat,requireCurrent:true}).feasible)continue;
                    if(!best||animal.health<best.animal.health)best={animal,plan};
                }
                if(!best)return false;
                const {animal,plan}=best;
                const valid=()=>{
                    const current=(ctx.combat.animals||[]).find(a=>a.sid===animal.sid),next=animalPlan(current);
                    return !!next&&current.health<=plan.damage&&
                        threat.evaluateAttack(current,w.id,{animal:true,hat:plan.hat,requireCurrent:true,ignoreReload:true}).feasible;
                };
                if(!root.MooMooCombatMacros?.stealAnimal(animal.sid,plan,valid))return false;
                animalAttempts.set(animal.sid,{health:animal.health,at:now()});lastStrike=now();return true;
            }finally{checkingAnimal=false;}
        }

        function tryAids(){
            if(!ctx.settings.spikeSyncHammer||!ready(false,true)||root.MooMooCombatMacros?.opportunityDanger?.())return false;
            // An already ready, observed spike hit keeps its trapped target.
            // Do not destroy that trap first merely because Trap Sync is enabled.
            if(tryTrapPriority(true))return true;
            for(const enemy of [...ctx.players.values()].filter(hostile).sort((a,b)=>distance(ctx.self,a)-distance(ctx.self,b))){
                if(root.MooMooCombatMacros.spikeSyncHammer(enemy.sid)){lastStrike=now();return true;}
            }
            return false;
        }
        let finisherForecast=null;
        const finisherPreparing=()=>!!(ctx.settings.autoFinisher&&finisherForecast&&now()<finisherForecast.until&&hostile(api.player(finisherForecast.target))&&!root.MooMooCombatMacros?.status().active);
        function forecastFinisher(attacker,id){
            if(!ctx.settings.autoFinisher||!attacker||attacker.sid===ctx.self.sid||!available(true,true)||!ctx.store.ownsHat(7)||root.MooMooBaseClicks?.status().active)return;
            const w=ctx.data.weapon(id),own=primary();if(!w||w.projectile!=null||!own||own.projectile!=null||!(root.MooMooAutoReload?.ready(own.id)??threat.ready(ctx.self.sid,own.id)))return;
            const from=pos(attacker),dir=attacker.d2??attacker.dir,variant=threat.observedWeapons(attacker.sid).find(w=>w.id===id)?.variant??attacker.weaponVariant??0;
            for(const target of ctx.players.values()){
                if(!hostile(target)||target.sid===attacker.sid||attacker.team!=null&&attacker.team===target.team||distance(ctx.self,target)>reach(target)||distance(attacker,target)>w.range+(target.scale||35)*1.8)continue;
                const p=pos(target),angle=Math.atan2(p.y-from.y,p.x-from.x);
                if(!Number.isFinite(dir)||Math.abs(Math.atan2(Math.sin(angle-dir),Math.cos(angle-dir)))>(ctx.combat.K?.gatherAngle??Math.PI/2.6))continue;
                const ownDamage=threat.meleeDamage({...ctx.self,hat:7,skinIndex:7},target,own.id,ctx.self.weaponVariant??0),after=target.health-threat.meleeDamage(attacker,target,id,variant);
                if(target.health<=ownDamage||after<=0||after>ownDamage)continue;
                finisherForecast={target:target.sid,health:after,until:now()+Math.max(250,(ctx.net.ping||0)+2*(ctx.SERVER_TICK||1000/9))};
                // Gear can be prepared from a plausible hit; the attack below
                // still requires server-confirmed health, so a miss cannot fire it.
                if(ctx.net.wouldAllowBatch(['c']))ctx.send.store(1,7,false);
                root.AntimoocheatDefense?.prepareAttackAccessory();return;
            }
        }
        const syncBot=()=>root.AntimoocheatBots?.sync.controlled()===true;
        let syncStrike=null;
        function cancelSyncStrike(){
            if(syncStrike&&root.MooMooCombatMacros?.status().active==='bullStrike')root.MooMooCombatMacros.cancel('autosync-cancelled');
            syncStrike=null;
        }
        function trySync(){
            if(!live()||!ctx.settings.autoSync)return false;
            const bots=root.AntimoocheatBots,job=bots?.sync.current();
            if(job?.kind==='ranged')return true;
            if(job?.kind==='melee'){
                if(job.sent)return !!root.MooMooCombatMacros?.status().active;
                const target=api.player(job.target);
                const valid=()=>ctx.settings.autoSync&&live()&&hostile(api.player(job.target))&&now()<=job.until&&distance(ctx.self,api.player(job.target))<=reach(api.player(job.target));
                if(!valid()){bots.sync.finish(job.token,'unavailable');return false;}
                if(!priorityReady()||root.MooMooCombatMacros?.protectOpportunity?.())return false;
                if(!threat.evaluateAttack(target,primary().id,{hat:7,requireCurrent:true}).feasible)return false;
                // The bot opens only an accepted owner job. The owner still
                // finishes through the current observed-damage finisher.
                if(root.MooMooCombatMacros.finisherMayInterrupt())root.MooMooCombatMacros.cancel('finisher-priority');
                if(!root.MooMooCombatMacros.strike(target.sid,false,7,true,'AutoSync',true,valid))return false;
                syncStrike={token:job.token,target:target.sid};bots.sync.markSent(job.token);lastStrike=now();return true;
            }
            if(syncBot())return false;
            if(tryFinisherFollowup())return true;
            if(bots?.sync.status().chain?.kind==='melee')return true;
            if(ready(false,true)&&!root.MooMooBaseClicks?.status().active){
                for(const target of [...ctx.players.values()].filter(hostile).sort((a,b)=>distance(ctx.self,a)-distance(ctx.self,b))){
                    if(distance(ctx.self,target)<=reach(target)&&threat.evaluateAttack(target,primary().id,{hat:7,requireCurrent:true}).feasible&&bots?.sync.beginMelee(target.sid))return true;
                }
            }
            return false;
        }
        let offSync=null;
        const bindSync=()=>{if(!offSync&&root.AntimoocheatBots)offSync=root.AntimoocheatBots.sync.onChange(()=>{
            if(syncStrike?.token!=null&&root.AntimoocheatBots.sync.current()?.token!==syncStrike.token)cancelSyncStrike();
            if(!disposed)trySync();
        });};
        bindSync();root.addEventListener('antimoocheat-bots-ready',bindSync);
        ctx.onCleanup(()=>{offSync?.();root.removeEventListener('antimoocheat-bots-ready',bindSync);cancelSyncStrike();});

        const finisherTargets=new Map();
        let finisherStrike=null;
        function cancelFinisherFollowup(){
            const active=root.MooMooCombatMacros?.status();
            if(finisherStrike&&active?.active==='bullStrike'&&active.targetSid===finisherStrike.target)root.MooMooCombatMacros.cancel('finisher-disabled');
            finisherStrike=null;
        }
        const followupEnabled=()=>ctx.settings.autoFinisher||ctx.settings.autoSync;
        const meleeFollowups=createMeleeFollowups({
            self:()=>ctx.self,players:()=>ctx.players.values(),player:sid=>api.player(sid),weapon:id=>ctx.data.weapon(id),
            position:pos,now,tick:()=>ctx.SERVER_TICK||1000/9,enabled:followupEnabled,
            damage:(a,b,id)=>threat.meleeDamage(a.sid===ctx.self.sid?ctx.self:a,b,id,threat.observedWeapons(a.sid).find(w=>w.id===id)?.variant??a.weaponVariant??a.variant??0),
            onHit:sample=>{
                if(sample.actor===ctx.self.sid){finisherStrike=null;const job=root.AntimoocheatBots?.sync.current();if(job?.kind==='melee'&&job.target===sample.target){syncStrike=null;root.AntimoocheatBots.sync.finish(job.token,'confirmed');}return;}
                if(syncBot())return;
                if(!hostile(api.player(sample.target)))return;
                finisherTargets.set(sample.target,{...sample,until:now()+Math.max(250,2*(ctx.SERVER_TICK||1000/9)+(ctx.net.ping||0))});
                tryFinisherFollowup();
            }
        });
        function finisherInRange(sample,target){
            const attacker=api.player(sample.actor),weapon=ctx.data.weapon(sample.weapon),own=primary();
            return hostile(target)&&attacker?.alive&&attacker.visible&&attacker.health>0&&
                weapon?.dmg>0&&weapon.projectile==null&&own?.dmg>0&&own.projectile==null&&
                distance(attacker,target)<=weapon.range+(target.scale||35)*1.8&&distance(ctx.self,target)<=reach(target);
        }
        function startFinisher(target,sample=null,trapException=false){
            const sid=target.sid;
            const valid=()=>{
                const current=api.player(sid),w=primary();
                return followupEnabled()&&(trapException?sessionLive():live())&&hostile(current)&&w?.dmg>0&&w.projectile==null&&
                    distance(ctx.self,current)<=reach(current)&&finishingHat(current,false)===7&&
                    (!sample||now()<=sample.until&&finisherInRange(sample,current)&&current.health<=sample.hp);
            };
            if(!valid()||!threat.evaluateAttack(target,primary().id,{hat:7,requireCurrent:true}).feasible)return false;
            if(root.MooMooCombatMacros?.finisherMayInterrupt())root.MooMooCombatMacros.cancel('finisher-priority');
            // Ordered gear + attack packets use the existing equipment limiter.
            // A confirmed remote hit already occurred; no extra tick timer is needed.
            if(!root.MooMooCombatMacros.strike(sid,false,7,true,ctx.settings.autoFinisher?'AutoFinisher':'AutoSync',true,valid))return false;
            finisherForecast=null;
            lastStrike=now();finisherTargets.delete(sid);finisherStrike={target:sid};return true;
        }
        function tryFinisherFollowup(){
            if(!live()||!followupEnabled()||syncBot())return false;
            for(const [sid,sample]of finisherTargets){
                const target=api.player(sid);
                if(now()>sample.until||!finisherInRange(sample,target)||target.health>sample.hp){finisherTargets.delete(sid);continue;}
                if(finishingHat(target,false)!==7||!priorityReady()||root.MooMooCombatMacros?.protectOpportunity?.())continue;
                if(startFinisher(target,sample))return true;
            }
            return false;
        }
        ctx.on('health',p=>meleeFollowups.health(p.sid,p.value));
        ctx.on('gatherAnimation',p=>{const [sid,,id]=p.args||[];forecastFinisher(api.player(sid),id);meleeFollowups.swing(sid,id);});
        ctx.on('playersUpdate',()=>meleeFollowups.tick());
        ctx.on('playerAdd',()=>meleeFollowups.clear());
        for(const event of ['setup','reset','died','disconnect'])ctx.on(event,()=>{finisherForecast=null;finisherStrike=null;finisherTargets.clear();meleeFollowups.clear();});

        function tryBullSpam(){
            if(!ctx.settings.autoBullSpam||!ready()||threat.selfTrap()||!ctx.store.ownsHat(6)||primary()?.projectile!=null||root.MooMooBaseClicks?.status().active||root.MooMooCombatMacros?.status().recovering||root.MooMooPlacers?.status().held.length||stage.config?.isOpen())return false;
            for(const enemy of [...ctx.players.values()].filter(hostile).sort((a,b)=>distance(ctx.self,a)-distance(ctx.self,b))){
                const valid=()=>ctx.settings.autoBullSpam&&live()&&!stage.config?.isOpen()&&!threat.selfTrap()&&!root.MooMooBaseClicks?.status().active&&hostile(api.player(enemy.sid))&&primary()?.dmg>0&&primary().projectile==null&&distance(ctx.self,api.player(enemy.sid))<=reach(api.player(enemy.sid));
                if(!valid()||!threat.evaluateAttack(enemy,primary().id,{hat:7,requireCurrent:true}).feasible)continue;
                if(root.MooMooCombatMacros.autoBullStrike(enemy.sid,valid)){lastStrike=now();return true;}
            }
            return false;
        }
        function tryTrapPriority(spikeOnly=false){
            // Only a ready, immediate opportunity may preempt the trap reload.
            // Keep the ordinary session, food, action-owner and Soldier guards.
            const weapon=primary();
            const selfTrapped=!!threat.selfTrap();
            if(!selfTrapped&&!spikeOnly||!ready(false,true,selfTrapped)||weapon?.id===8||weapon?.projectile!=null)return false;
            const enemies=[...ctx.players.values()].filter(hostile).sort((a,b)=>distance(ctx.self,a)-distance(ctx.self,b));
            for(const enemy of enemies){
                if(distance(ctx.self,enemy)>reach(enemy)||!threat.evaluateAttack(enemy,weapon.id,{hat:7,requireCurrent:true}).feasible)continue;
                if(!spikeOnly&&ctx.settings.autoFinisher&&!meleeFollowups.pending(enemy.sid)&&finishingHat(enemy,false)===7&&startFinisher(enemy,null,true))return true;
                if(!root.AntimoocheatCombat?.settings?.spikeSync)continue;
                const sample=spikeDamage.get(enemy.sid),spike=sample&&ctx.objects.get(sample.spike);
                if(!sample||now()-sample.at>(ctx.SERVER_TICK||1000/9)*2||!spike?.active||spike.fake||spike.preplace||
                    !root.MooMooCombatMacros?.trapped(enemy.sid))continue;
                const contact=contactPlan(enemy.sid);
                // A real collision separates the player to the spike boundary.
                // Keep the fresh, same-spike wound proof through that separation;
                // two units match the existing rounded-position damage matcher.
                if(contact?(contact.time!==0||contact.spike!==sample.spike):
                    distance(enemy,spike)>(enemy.scale||35)+(spike.getScale?.()??spike.scale)+2)continue;
                // The damage was already observed. A later collision separation
                // may end overlap, while the ready primary remains in real reach.
                if(allowSpikeSync(enemy.sid)&&root.MooMooCombatMacros.strike(enemy.sid,false,7,true,'SpikeSync')){spikeDamage.delete(enemy.sid);lastStrike=now();return true;}
            }
            return false;
        }
        function tryFinish(immediate=false){
            if(tryFinisherFollowup())return true;
            if(syncBot()||!ctx.settings.autoFinisher)return false;
            if(root.MooMooCombatMacros?.protectOpportunity?.())return false;
            if(!live()||root.MooMooCombatMacros?.status().active&&!root.MooMooCombatMacros.finisherMayInterrupt()||!immediate&&now()-lastStrike<(ctx.SERVER_TICK||1000/9))return false;
            const weapon=primary();
            if(!(weapon?.dmg>0)||weapon.projectile!=null||!ctx.store.ownsHat(7)||!(root.MooMooAutoReload?.ready(weapon.id)??threat.ready(ctx.self.sid,weapon.id)))return false;

            for(const enemy of [...ctx.players.values()].filter(hostile).sort((a,b)=>distance(ctx.self,a)-distance(ctx.self,b))){
                if(meleeFollowups.pending(enemy.sid)||finishingHat(enemy,false)!==7)continue;
                const gap=distance(ctx.self,enemy),range=reach(enemy);
                if(gap>range){
                    if(!finisherPreparing()&&!root.MooMooBaseClicks?.status().active&&gap<range+75){
                        const lead=Math.min(2*(ctx.SERVER_TICK||1000/9),(ctx.SERVER_TICK||1000/9)+(ctx.net.ping||0)/2);
                        const a=threat.predict(ctx.self,lead),b=threat.predict(enemy,lead);
                        if(Math.hypot(a.x-b.x,a.y-b.y)<=range&&(a.confidence>=.35||b.confidence>=.35)){
                            finisherForecast={target:enemy.sid,health:enemy.health,until:now()+lead};
                            if(ctx.net.wouldAllowBatch(['c']))ctx.send.store(1,7,false);
                            root.AntimoocheatDefense?.prepareAttackAccessory();
                        }
                    }
                    continue;
                }
                if(!threat.evaluateAttack(enemy,weapon.id,{hat:7,requireCurrent:true}).feasible)continue;
                if(startFinisher(enemy))return true;
            }
            return false;
        }
        function tryTurret(){
            if(!ctx.settings.turretSteal||!available(true,true))return false;
            for(const enemy of [...ctx.players.values()].filter(hostile).sort((a,b)=>distance(ctx.self,a)-distance(ctx.self,b))){
                if(canTurret(enemy.sid)&&root.MooMooCombatMacros?.turretStrike(enemy.sid)){lastStrike=now();return true;}
            }
            return false;
        }
        let priorityChecking=false,lastPriorityCheck=-Infinity;
        function tryNonSoldier(){
            if(priorityChecking||!ctx.settings.spikeTickNonSoldier||!live()||root.MooMooCombatMacros?.status().active||now()-lastPriorityCheck<8)return false;
            lastPriorityCheck=now();
            if(root.MooMooAutomation?.status().insta&&root.MooMooAutomation.tryInsta())return true;
            if(!(primary()?.dmg>0)||!ctx.store.ownsHat(7)||!(root.MooMooAutoReload?.ready(primary().id)??threat.ready(ctx.self.sid,primary().id))||root.MooMooCombatMacros?.opportunityDanger?.())return false;
            priorityChecking=true;
            try{
                for(const enemy of [...ctx.players.values()].filter(hostile).sort((a,b)=>distance(ctx.self,a)-distance(ctx.self,b))){
                    if(root.MooMooCombatMacros?.nonSoldierSpikeStrike(enemy.sid)){lastStrike=now();return true;}
                }
                return false;
            }finally{priorityChecking=false;}
        }
        function run(){
            timer=null;prune();
            if(trySync()||syncBot()||tryFinish(true)||tryTurret()||tryAnimalSteal())return;
            if(root.MooMooAutomation?.status().insta&&root.MooMooAutomation.tryInsta())return;
            if(tryNonSoldier()||!available(true))return;
            if(tryAids())return;
            if(root.AntimoocheatCombat?.settings?.spikeSync&&ready(false,true)&&primary().id!==8)for(const [sid,sample]of spikeDamage){
                const enemy=api.player(sid),spike=ctx.objects.get(sample.spike);
                if(!hostile(enemy)||now()-sample.at>(ctx.SERVER_TICK||1000/9)*2||!spike?.active||distance(enemy,spike)>(enemy.scale||35)+(spike.getScale?.()??spike.scale)+24){spikeDamage.delete(sid);continue;}
                if(distance(ctx.self,enemy)<=reach(enemy)&&allowSpikeSync(sid)&&strike(sid,false,7,true,'SpikeSync')){spikeDamage.delete(sid);return;}
            }
            if(root.AntimoocheatCombat?.settings?.spikeSync&&ready(false,true)&&primary().id!==8)for(const enemy of [...ctx.players.values()].filter(hostile).sort((a,b)=>distance(ctx.self,a)-distance(ctx.self,b))){
                if(contactPlan(enemy.sid)&&allowSpikeSync(enemy.sid)&&root.MooMooCombatMacros?.contactStrike(enemy.sid)){lastStrike=now();return;}
            }
            for(const enemy of ctx.players.values())if(hostile(enemy)&&!finishCandidates.has(enemy.sid))finishCandidates.set(enemy.sid,{health:enemy.health,at:now(),attempted:false});
            if(ctx.settings.autoFinisher&&ready(true,true))for(const [sid,sample]of finishCandidates){
                const enemy=api.player(sid);
                if(!hostile(enemy)||enemy.health!==sample.health){finishCandidates.delete(sid);continue;}
                if(meleeFollowups.pending(sid))continue;
                if(now()<(sample.nextAttempt||0)||distance(ctx.self,enemy)>reach(enemy))continue;
                const gear=finishingHat(enemy,false);
                if(gear===7&&startFinisher(enemy)){sample.nextAttempt=now()+Math.max(500,primary().speed+(ctx.SERVER_TICK||1000/9));return;}
            }

            if(ready())for(const enemy of [...ctx.players.values()].filter(hostile).sort((a,b)=>distance(ctx.self,a)-distance(ctx.self,b))){
                if(wantsSpike(enemy.sid)&&root.MooMooCombatMacros?.spikeStrike(enemy.sid)){pushed.add(enemy.sid);lastStrike=now();return;}
            }
            if(ctx.settings.knockbackTick&&ready(true,true)&&root.MooMooCombatMacros?.start('knockbackTick',{automatic:true})){lastStrike=now();return;}
            if(ctx.settings.knockbackTurret&&ready(false,true)&&root.MooMooCombatMacros?.start('knockbackTurret',{automatic:true})){lastStrike=now();return;}
            if(ctx.settings.knockbackPrimary&&ready(false,true)&&root.MooMooCombatMacros?.start('knockbackPrimary',{automatic:true})){lastStrike=now();return;}
            tryBullSpam();

        }
        function schedule(){if(timer===null&&live())timer=(root.MooMooPrivateBackground?.timers||root).setTimeout(run,1);}
        const clear=()=>{if(spikeWindowWake!==null)(root.MooMooPrivateBackground?.timers||root).clearTimeout(spikeWindowWake);spikeWindowWake=null;if(timer!==null)(root.MooMooPrivateBackground?.timers||root).clearTimeout(timer);timer=null;pushed.clear();animalAttempts.clear();finishCandidates.clear();spikeDamage.clear();healthSamples.clear();for(const p of ctx.players.values())healthSamples.set(p.sid,p.health);lastStrike=-Infinity;};
        ctx.on('playerAdd',()=>{for(const p of ctx.players.values())healthSamples.set(p.sid,p.health);});
        ctx.on('playersUpdate',()=>{
            for(const p of ctx.players.values())healthSamples.set(p.sid,p.health);
            schedule();
            const pending=timer;
            if(pending!==null)root.queueMicrotask(()=>{
                if(timer!==pending)return;
                (root.MooMooPrivateBackground?.timers||root).clearTimeout(pending);
                if(live())run();else timer=null;
            });
        });
        ctx.on('health',payload=>{
            const enemy=api.player(payload.sid),before=healthSamples.get(payload.sid)??enemy?.maxHealth??100;
            healthSamples.set(payload.sid,payload.value);
            if(payload.sid===ctx.self.sid)return;
            const active=root.MooMooCombatMacros?.status();
            if(active?.active==='turretSteal'&&active.targetSid===payload.sid&&!canTurret(payload.sid,true))root.MooMooCombatMacros.cancel('turret-target-changed');
            if(payload.value<before&&hostile(enemy)){
                if(trySync()||syncBot()||tryFinish(true)||tryTurret()||tryTrapPriority()||tryAnimalSteal())return;
            }
            if(!hostile(enemy)||payload.value>before){finishCandidates.delete(payload.sid);return;}
            const old=finishCandidates.get(payload.sid);
            if(old?.health===payload.value||payload.value>=before)return;
            {
                const spike=ctx.objects.all().find(o=>o.active&&!o.fake&&!o.preplace&&ctx.data.item(o.id)?.dmg>0&&ctx.data.item(o.id)?.group?.name==='spikes'&&o.ownerSid!=null&&o.ownerSid!==enemy.sid&&!(enemy.team!=null&&api.player(o.ownerSid)?.team===enemy.team)&&distance(enemy,o)<=(enemy.scale||35)+(o.getScale?.()??o.scale)+2);
                if(spike){
                    const loss=before-payload.value,expected=ctx.data.item(spike.id).dmg*(ctx.data.hat(enemy.hat??enemy.skinIndex)?.dmgMult??1)*(ctx.data.accessory(enemy.accessory??enemy.tailIndex)?.dmgMult??1);
                    // Proximity alone cannot label Bull bleed, melee or a shot
                    // as a spike hit. The health loss must match spike damage.
                    if(Math.abs(loss-expected)<=1.1){spikeDamage.set(payload.sid,{spike:spike.sid,at:now()});if(tryTrapPriority())return;}
                }
            }
            finishCandidates.set(payload.sid,{health:payload.value,at:now(),attempted:false});
            schedule();
        });
        ctx.on('animalsUpdate',()=>{if(!trySync()&&!tryFinish(true))tryAnimalSteal();schedule();});
        for(const event of ['gatherAnimation','inventory','storeUpdate','objectsLoad','objectKilled','objectsKilled'])ctx.on(event,schedule);
        for(const event of ['reset','setup','died','disconnect'])ctx.on(event,clear);
        const cancelKnockback=(key=null)=>{const active=root.MooMooCombatMacros?.status().active;if(['knockbackTick','knockbackPrimary','knockbackTurret'].includes(active)&&(!key||key===active))root.MooMooCombatMacros.cancel('disabled');};
        ctx.onSettingChange(()=>{if(!ctx.settings.autoBullSpam&&root.MooMooCombatMacros?.status().active==='autoBullSpam')root.MooMooCombatMacros.cancel('disabled');clear();finisherTargets.clear();meleeFollowups.clear();if(!ctx.settings.animalSteal&&root.MooMooCombatMacros?.animalStealing())root.MooMooCombatMacros.cancel('disabled');if(!followupEnabled())cancelFinisherFollowup();if(!ctx.settings.autoSync){cancelSyncStrike();root.AntimoocheatBots?.sync.clear();}for(const key of ['knockbackTick','knockbackPrimary','knockbackTurret'])if(!ctx.settings[key])cancelKnockback(key);if(!ctx.settings.spikeSyncHammer&&root.MooMooCombatMacros?.status().active==='spikeSyncHammer')root.MooMooCombatMacros.cancel('disabled');schedule();});
        const blur=()=>{blurred=true;clear();finisherTargets.clear();},focus=()=>{blurred=false;schedule();};
        root.addEventListener('blur',blur);root.addEventListener('focus',focus);
        const offThreat=root.MooMooThreats.onChange(schedule);
        const offReady=root.MooMooAutoReload?.onReady(()=>{tryAnimalSteal();schedule();});
        if(offReady)ctx.onCleanup(offReady);
        function needsReload(id){
            const weapon=primary();if(!weapon||!live())return false;
            const isPrimary=id===weapon.id,hammer=id===10&&ctx.self.weapons?.[1]===10;
            if(!isPrimary&&!hammer)return false;
            for(const enemy of ctx.players.values()){
                if(!hostile(enemy)||distance(ctx.self,enemy)>reach(enemy))continue;
                if(isPrimary&&ctx.settings.autoSync)return true;
                if(isPrimary&&ctx.settings.autoBullSpam&&!threat.selfTrap())return true;
                if(isPrimary&&(ctx.settings.autoFinisher&&finishingHat(enemy,false)!==null||root.AntimoocheatCombat?.settings?.spikeSync&&(spikeDamage.has(enemy.sid)||contactPlan(enemy.sid))))return true;
                if(ctx.settings.spikeSyncHammer&&root.MooMooCombatMacros?.spikeSyncWaiting(enemy.sid)!=null)return true;
                if((ctx.settings.knockbackTick||isPrimary&&(ctx.settings.spikeTickNonSoldier||ctx.settings.knockbackPrimary||ctx.settings.knockbackTurret))&&ctx.store.ownsHat(7))return true;
                if(isPrimary&&ctx.store.ownsHat(7)&&ctx.objects.all().some(o=>o.active&&ctx.objects.isFriendly(o.ownerSid)&&ctx.data.item(o.id)?.group?.name==='spikes'&&distance(enemy,o)<(enemy.scale||35)+(o.scale||0)+60))return true;
            }
            return isPrimary&&ctx.settings.animalSteal&&(ctx.combat.animals||[]).some(a=>a.active&&a.visible&&a.health>0&&!(a.state&&ctx.data.animal(a.index)?.diver)&&distance(ctx.self,a)<=reach(a)&&finishingHat(a,true)!==null);
        }
        function forecastTurret(sid,use,placedSpike){
            if(!ctx.settings.turretSteal||!ctx.store.ownsHat(53)||!threat.turretReady(ctx.self.sid))return null;
            const target=api.player(sid);if(!hostile(target))return null;
            const variant=threat.observedWeapons(ctx.self.sid).find(w=>w.id===use)?.variant??ctx.self.weaponVariant??0;
            const melee=threat.meleeDamage({...ctx.self,hat:7},target,use,variant);
            if(target.health<=melee)return null;
            let spike=placedSpike;
            if(!spike){
                const spikeSid=contactPlan(sid)?.spike??root.MooMooCombatMacros?.primaryKnockbackPlan(sid)?.spikeSid;
                if(spikeSid!=null)spike=ctx.data.item(ctx.objects.get(spikeSid)?.id);
            }
            if(!spike?.dmg)return null;
            const spikeDamage=spike.dmg*(ctx.data.hat(target.hat??target.skinIndex)?.dmgMult||1)*(ctx.data.accessory(target.accessory??target.tailIndex)?.dmgMult||1);
            const remaining=target.health-melee-spikeDamage;
            return remaining>0&&canTurret(sid,false,remaining)?{before:target.health,remaining,until:now()+(ctx.SERVER_TICK||1000/9)+Math.max(0,ctx.net.ping||0)}:null;
        }
        root.MooMooOpportunities={forecastTurret,spikeWindow,allowSpikeSync,tryTrapPriority,trySync,syncStatus:()=>({targets:[...finisherTargets.keys()],observer:meleeFollowups.status()}),finisherPreparing,finisherForecast:()=>finisherPreparing()?{...finisherForecast}:null,finisherStatus:()=>({targets:[...finisherTargets.keys()],observer:meleeFollowups.status()}),tryFinisherFollowup,needsReload,tryAnimalSteal,tryAids,tryNonSoldier,tryFinish,tryCombat:()=>{if(root.MooMooCombatMacros?.opportunityDanger?.())return false;if(timer!==null)(root.MooMooPrivateBackground?.timers||root).clearTimeout(timer);run();return !!root.MooMooCombatMacros?.status().active;},pushContact:sid=>{const enemy=api.player(sid);return !!root.AntimoocheatCombat?.settings?.spikeSync&&primary()?.id!==8&&hostile(enemy)&&distance(ctx.self,enemy)<=reach(enemy)&&allowSpikeSync(sid)&&strike(sid,false,7,true,'SpikeSync');},wantsSpike,canSpikeStrike:sid=>pushable(api.player(sid)),contactPlan,canTurret,status:()=>({pending:0,pushed:[...pushed],animalAttempts:animalAttempts.size,autoFinish:!!ctx.settings.autoFinisher,spikeStrike:true,spikeContact:!!root.AntimoocheatCombat?.settings?.spikeSync,turretSteal:!!ctx.settings.turretSteal,knockbackTick:!!ctx.settings.knockbackTick})};
        ctx.onCleanup(()=>{cancelFinisherFollowup();disposed=true;clear();offThreat();cancelKnockback();if(['autoBullSpam','animalSteal','spikeStrike','spikeContact','spikeSyncHammer','nonSoldierSpike'].includes(root.MooMooCombatMacros?.status().active))root.MooMooCombatMacros.cancel('disabled');root.removeEventListener('blur',blur);root.removeEventListener('focus',focus);delete root.MooMooOpportunities;});
    });
})(miscApi,root);

    

(function installRangedAutoSync(api,root){
        const id='ranged-autosync';
        api.register({id,name:'Ranged AutoSync',defaultEnabled:true,liveSettings:true,settings:[
            {key:'key',type:'key',default:'',label:'Ranged AutoSync (works only with bot)'}
        ]},ctx=>{
            const now=()=>root.performance.now(),timers=root.MooMooPrivateBackground?.timers||root,threat=root.MooMooThreats;
            const tick=ctx.SERVER_TICK||1000/9,bots=()=>root.AntimoocheatBots?.sync,pos=threat.position;
            let active=null,pendingStart=null,timer=null,restoreTimer=null,lastUpdate=null,updatePeriod=tick,epoch=0,last='idle',completed=0,disposed=false;
            let moveDirection=null,moveChangedAt=-Infinity;
            const rtt=()=>Math.max(0,ctx.net.minPing?.()||ctx.net.ping||0);
            const hostile=p=>p?.alive&&p.visible&&p.health>0&&p.sid!==ctx.self.sid&&!ctx.objects.isFriendly(p.sid)&&!root.AntimoocheatBots?.isPeer(p.sid)&&!(p.team!=null&&p.team===ctx.self.team);
            const live=()=>!disposed&&api.isReady()&&ctx.self.alive&&!automationTyping();
            // A newly sent movement change has not yet reached the observed
            // motion predictor. Wait for its server sample before booking slots.
            const motionReady=at=>lastUpdate!=null&&(at==null||lastUpdate>=at+rtt());
            const motionBarrier=()=>motionReady(moveChangedAt)?null:moveChangedAt;
            ctx.onSent((action,p)=>{
                if(action!=='move'&&action!=='stopMove')return;
                const direction=action==='move'&&Number.isFinite(p.dir)?p.dir:null;
                const changed=(direction==null)!==(moveDirection==null)||direction!=null&&moveDirection!=null&&Math.abs(Math.atan2(Math.sin(direction-moveDirection),Math.cos(direction-moveDirection)))>=Math.PI/6;
                if(changed){
                    moveDirection=direction;moveChangedAt=now();
                    // Freeze the first relevant barrier for this preparation.
                    // Repeated Follow Me turns must not slide it indefinitely.
                    if(pendingStart&&pendingStart.motionAt==null)pendingStart.motionAt=moveChangedAt;
                    if(active&&!active.equipped&&(active.preparing||active.motionAt==null))active.motionAt=moveChangedAt;
                }
            });
            const priorOwner=()=>!!(root.MooMooCombatMacros?.status().active||root.MooMooActionIntent||root.MooMooBaseClicks?.status().active);
            function entry(a,b,c,r){let lo=0,hi=1;for(const key of ['x','y']){const d=b[key]-a[key],o=c[key]-a[key];if(Math.abs(d)<1e-9){if(Math.abs(o)>r)return Infinity;continue;}const x=(o-r)/d,y=(o+r)/d;lo=Math.max(lo,Math.min(x,y));hi=Math.min(hi,Math.max(x,y));if(lo>hi)return Infinity;}return lo;}
            function plan(target,origin=null){
                if(!hostile(target)||ctx.data.hat(target.hat)?.antiTurret)return null;
                const a=origin||pos(ctx.self),p=pos(target),distance=Math.hypot(p.x-a.x,p.y-a.y);
                if(distance>700||distance<1||!root.MooMooAutomation?.isTurretTarget(target.sid))return null;
                const speed=ctx.data.projectiles[ctx.data.weapon(15)?.projectile]?.speed||3.6;
                const dir=Math.atan2(p.y-a.y,p.x-a.x),ux=Math.cos(dir),uy=Math.sin(dir),radius=target.scale||35;
                const end={x:a.x+ux*1400,y:a.y+uy*1400},hit=entry(a,end,p,radius)*1400;
                const shield=ctx.data.weapon(target.weaponIndex)?.shield,face=target.d2??target.dir;
                if(shield&&Number.isFinite(face)&&Math.abs(Math.atan2(Math.sin(dir+Math.PI-face),Math.cos(dir+Math.PI-face)))<=Math.PI/3)return null;
                for(const o of ctx.objects.all())if(o.active&&!o.fake&&!o.preplace&&!o.ignoreCollision&&(o.layer||0)>=Math.max(ctx.self.zIndex||0,1)&&entry(a,end,o,o.getScale?.()??o.scale)*1400<=hit)return null;
                const turretTicks=Math.max(0,Math.ceil(hit/(1.5*tick))-1),musketTicks=Math.max(0,Math.ceil(Math.max(0,hit-70)/(speed*tick))-1);
                return {dir,hit,turretTicks,musketTicks,delayTicks:turretTicks-musketTicks};
            }
            function windowPlan(target,impactAt,kind,period=updatePeriod){
                let p=plan(target);if(!p)return null;
                for(let i=0;i<4;i++){
                    const launchAt=impactAt-p[kind]*period;
                    const predicted=threat.predict(ctx.self,Math.max(0,launchAt-(lastUpdate??now())+rtt()/2));
                    const next=plan(target,predicted);if(!next)return null;
                    if(next[kind]===p[kind])return {plan:next,due:launchAt-rtt()/2-period/2};
                    p=next;
                }
                return {plan:p,due:impactAt-p[kind]*period-rtt()/2-period/2};
            }
            function wake(delay=1){if(timer!==null)timers.clearTimeout(timer);timer=timers.setTimeout(()=>{timer=null;run();},Math.max(1,delay));}
            function restore(previous){
                if(!live())return;
                if(previous.original!=null)ctx.send.selectItem(previous.original,true);
                const gear=ctx.store.ownsHat(6)?6:previous.hat;
                const equip=()=>{restoreTimer=null;if(!live()||active||root.MooMooCombatMacros?.status().active||root.MooMooActionIntent)return;ctx.send.store(1,gear,false);};
                restoreTimer=timers.setTimeout(equip,root.AntimoocheatEquipment.hatWait()+1);
            }
            function finish(reason){
                const waiting=pendingStart;pendingStart=null;
                const previous=active;if(!previous){const job=bots()?.current();if(waiting||job?.kind==='ranged'){last=reason;if(timer!==null)timers.clearTimeout(timer);timer=null;if(job?.kind==='ranged')bots().finish(job.token,reason);}return;}
                active=null;last=reason;if(timer!==null)timers.clearTimeout(timer);timer=null;
                if(root.MooMooActionIntent?.owner===id)delete root.MooMooActionIntent;
                if(reason==='confirmed')completed++;
                if(live()&&!previous.preparing){ctx.send.mouse(false,previous.angle);restore(previous);}
                bots()?.finish(previous.token,reason);
            }
            function fire(){
                const a=active,p=plan(api.player(a.target));if(!p){finish('path-lost');return;}
                if(!ctx.net.wouldAllowBatch(['z','F','F'])){wake(3);return;}
                if(!ctx.send.selectItem(15,true)||!ctx.send.mouse(true,p.dir)){wake(3);return;}
                ctx.send.mouse(false,p.dir);a.fired=true;a.fireAt=now();a.angle=p.dir;root.MooMooActionIntent.direction=p.dir;
                last='waiting-for-paired-impact';wake(Math.min(250,a.until-now()));
            }
            function run(){
                if(!active){if(pendingStart)dispatchStart();else if(bots()?.current()?.kind==='ranged')take();return;}
                const a=active;if(!live()||bots()?.current()?.token!==a.token){finish('cancelled');return;}
                const target=api.player(a.target);if(!hostile(target)){finish(!a.preparing&&target?.health<=0?'confirmed':'target-lost');return;}
                if(now()>=a.until){finish(a.preparing?'preparation-expired':'expired');return;}
                if(root.AntimoocheatEquipment.urgent(true)){finish('defense-priority');return;}
                if(a.preparing&&(root.MooMooActionIntent?.owner!==id||root.MooMooCombatMacros?.status().active||root.MooMooBaseClicks?.status().active)){finish('preparation-interrupted');return;}
                if(a.preparing&&root.AntimoocheatBots?.prepareRangedMovement?.()===false){
                    if(a.ready){finish('preparation-readiness-lost');return;}
                    last='waiting-for-bot-motion';wake(10);return;
                }
                if(root.AntimoocheatDefense?.prepareAttackAccessory()===false){
                    if(a.preparing&&a.ready){finish('preparation-readiness-lost');return;}
                    last='waiting-for-accessory';wake(20);return;
                }
                if(a.preparing){
                    if(!startReady(target)){finish('preparation-invalid');return;}
                    if(!motionReady(a.motionAt)){
                        if(a.ready){finish('preparation-readiness-lost');return;}
                        last='waiting-for-motion-sample';wake(10);return;
                    }
                    const gearWait=root.AntimoocheatEquipment.hatWait();
                    if(gearWait>0){
                        if(a.ready){finish('preparation-readiness-lost');return;}
                        last='waiting-for-hat-pacing';wake(Math.min(gearWait+1,a.until-now()));return;
                    }
                    last='waiting-for-peers';wake(Math.min(25,a.until-now()));
                    if(!a.ready){a.ready=true;bots().ready(a.token);}
                    return;
                }
                if(!a.equipped){
                    if(!motionReady(a.motionAt)){last='waiting-for-motion-sample';wake(10);return;}
                    const window=windowPlan(target,a.impactAt,'turretTicks',a.period);if(!window){finish('unavailable');return;}
                    const p=window.plan,equipDue=window.due;
                    if(equipDue>now()+1){last='waiting-for-turret-window';wake(equipDue-now());return;}
                    if(now()>equipDue+a.period/2){finish('missed-window');return;}
                    if(!ctx.send.store(1,53,false)){last='waiting-for-turret-equip';wake(Math.max(4,root.AntimoocheatEquipment.hatWait()+1));return;}
                    a.equipped=true;a.plan=p;a.angle=p.dir;a.equipAt=now();
                    root.MooMooActionIntent.direction=p.dir;
                    a.due=a.impactAt-p.musketTicks*a.period-rtt()/2-a.period/2;
                    if(p.delayTicks<0){finish('unavailable');return;}
                    last='waiting-for-musket-window';
                }
                if(!a.fired){
                    const window=windowPlan(target,a.impactAt,'musketTicks',a.period);if(!window){finish('path-lost');return;}a.due=window.due;
                    if(a.due>now()+1){wake(a.due-now());return;}fire();}
                else wake(Math.min(150,a.until-now()));
            }
            function take(){
                const job=bots()?.current();
                if(active){
                    if(job?.token!==active.token){finish('cancelled');return;}
                    if(active.preparing&&job.phase==='committed'){
                        // Readiness may change between its acknowledgment and
                        // this commit delivery; reject before releasing the
                        // preparation guard or scheduling any combat equipment.
                        if(!live()||!startReady(api.player(job.target))||root.MooMooActionIntent?.owner!==id||root.MooMooCombatMacros?.status().active||root.MooMooBaseClicks?.status().active||root.AntimoocheatEquipment.urgent(true)||root.AntimoocheatBots?.prepareRangedMovement?.()===false||!motionReady(active.motionAt)||root.AntimoocheatEquipment.hatWait()>0||root.AntimoocheatDefense?.prepareAttackAccessory()===false){finish('commit-readiness-lost');return;}
                        active.preparing=false;active.until=job.until;active.impactAt=job.impactAt-root.performance.timeOrigin;active.period=job.period;
                        bots().markSent(job.token);run();
                    }
                    return;
                }
                if(job?.kind!=='ranged'||job.sent)return;
                if(now()>=job.until){finish('preparation-expired');return;}
                if(!live()){last='waiting-for-live';wake(Math.min(10,job.until-now()));return;}
                const target=api.player(job.target);
                if(!startReady(target)){finish('unavailable');return;}
                if(root.AntimoocheatEquipment.urgent(true)){finish('defense-priority');return;}
                if(priorOwner()){last='waiting-for-owner';wake(Math.min(10,job.until-now()));return;}
                root.MooMooAutoReload.release(false);
                active={token:job.token,target:job.target,until:job.until,preparing:job.phase==='prepare',ready:false,period:job.period||updatePeriod,motionAt:pendingStart?.motionAt??motionBarrier(),impactAt:Number.isFinite(job.impactAt)?job.impactAt-root.performance.timeOrigin:null,original:ctx.self.weaponIndex,hat:ctx.self.hat,angle:0,hp:target.health,losses:[],turret:null,musket:null};
                root.MooMooActionIntent={owner:id,direction:Math.atan2(pos(target).y-pos(ctx.self).y,pos(target).x-pos(ctx.self).x),weapon:15,down:false};
                if(!active.preparing)bots().markSent(job.token);run();
            }
            function startReady(target){
                return !!target&&!!plan(target)&&ctx.self.weapons?.includes(15)&&ctx.store.ownsHat(53)&&root.MooMooAutoReload?.ready(15)&&threat.turretReady(ctx.self.sid);
            }
            function dispatchStart(){
                const request=pendingStart;if(!request)return false;
                if(!live()){finish('inactive');return false;}
                const target=api.player(request.target);
                if(!startReady(target)){finish('unavailable');return false;}
                if(root.AntimoocheatEquipment.urgent(true)){finish('defense-priority');return false;}
                if(now()>=request.until){finish('preparation-expired');return false;}
                // Both participants prepare concurrently under the coordinator's
                // one bounded deadline; take/run own all readiness waits.
                last='preparing';
                const accepted=bots()?.startRanged(target.sid,root.performance.timeOrigin+lastUpdate-rtt()/2,updatePeriod)===true;
                pendingStart=null;
                if(!accepted)last='bot-required';
                return accepted&&!!bots()?.current();
            }
            function start(){
                if(root.AntimoocheatBots?.child||!live()||active||pendingStart)return false;
                const target=[...ctx.players.values()].filter(hostile).sort((a,b)=>threat.distance(ctx.self,a)-threat.distance(ctx.self,b))[0];
                if(!startReady(target)){last='unavailable';return false;}
                pendingStart={target:target.sid,motionAt:motionBarrier(),until:now()+Math.min(1000,Math.max(500,3*updatePeriod+rtt()))};
                return dispatchStart();
            }
            let offSync=null;const bindSync=()=>{if(!offSync&&bots())offSync=bots().onChange(take);};
            bindSync();root.addEventListener('antimoocheat-bots-ready',bindSync);
            ctx.onCleanup(()=>{offSync?.();root.removeEventListener('antimoocheat-bots-ready',bindSync);});
            ctx.on('playersUpdate',()=>{
                const time=now(),elapsed=lastUpdate==null?0:time-lastUpdate;
                // Physics uses SERVER_TICK; dispatch follows observed update spacing.
                // A delayed local/server frame must not move Musket a tick earlier.
                if(elapsed>=tick*.65&&elapsed<=tick*1.75)updatePeriod=Math.max(tick,Math.min(tick*1.5,updatePeriod+(elapsed-updatePeriod)*.2));
                epoch++;lastUpdate=time;if(active||pendingStart||bots()?.current()?.kind==='ranged')run();
            });
            ctx.on('projectileAdd',payload=>{
                if(!active)return;const [x,y,dir,range,speed,index,layer,sid]=payload.args||[],me=pos(ctx.self);
                const turret=index===1&&speed===1.5,musket=index===ctx.data.weapon(15)?.projectile&&Math.abs(speed-3.6)<.01;
                if(!turret&&!musket)return;
                const sx=x-(musket?70*Math.cos(dir):0),sy=y-(musket?70*Math.sin(dir):0);
                const predicted=threat.predict(ctx.self,Math.max(0,now()-(lastUpdate??now())+rtt()/2+tick));
                const dx=predicted.x-me.x,dy=predicted.y-me.y,len=dx*dx+dy*dy;
                const t=len?Math.max(0,Math.min(1,((sx-me.x)*dx+(sy-me.y)*dy)/len)):0;
                if(Math.hypot(sx-me.x-dx*t,sy-me.y-dy*t)>25)return;
                if([...ctx.players.values()].some(p=>p.sid!==ctx.self.sid&&p.alive&&p.visible&&Math.hypot(pos(p).x-sx,pos(p).y-sy)<25))return;
                if(active.preparing){finish('preparation-projectile-launched');return;}
                const key=turret?'turret':'musket';if(active[key])return;
                active[key]={sid,epoch,at:now(),ended:null};
                if(turret&&!active.fired){const p=plan(api.player(active.target),{x:sx,y:sy});if(!p){finish('path-lost');return;}
                    // Preserve the shared booked slot through packet-delivery jitter.
                    // Only an actual launch-path travel-bin change corrects this pair;
                    // never retime other participants after a projectile has launched.
                    if(active.equipped&&active.plan){
                        active.launchTravelCorrection=(p.turretTicks-active.plan.turretTicks)*active.period;
                        active.impactAt+=active.launchTravelCorrection;active.plan=p;
                    }
                    else{finish('unexpected-turret-launch');return;}
                    run();}
            });
            ctx.on('health',payload=>{
                if(!active||payload.sid!==active.target)return;
                if(payload.value<=0){finish(active.preparing?'target-lost':'confirmed');return;}
                const loss=active.hp-payload.value;active.hp=payload.value;if(loss>0)active.losses.push({epoch,loss});
            });
            ctx.on('projectileRemove',payload=>{
                if(!active)return;const sid=payload.args?.[0];for(const key of ['turret','musket'])if(active[key]?.sid===sid)active[key].ended=epoch;
                const {turret,musket}=active;if(turret?.ended==null||musket?.ended==null)return;
                const target=api.player(active.target),factor=(ctx.data.hat(target?.hat)?.dmgMult??1)*(ctx.data.accessory(target?.accessory)?.dmgMult??1)*(target?.accessory===15?.75:1);
                const loss=active.losses.filter(s=>s.epoch===turret.ended).reduce((sum,s)=>sum+s.loss,0);
                finish(turret.ended===musket.ended&&loss>=75*factor-.1?'confirmed':'pair-not-confirmed');
            });
            const offKey=ctx.input.onKeyDown((event,keys)=>{const key=ctx.input.normKey(ctx.settings.key);if(root.AntimoocheatBots?.child||!key||!keys.includes(key)||event.repeat||event.defaultPrevented||event.ctrlKey||event.altKey||event.metaKey||ctx.input.isTyping())return;event.preventDefault();event.stopImmediatePropagation();start();});
            ctx.onCleanup(offKey);
            for(const event of ['setup','died','reset','disconnect'])ctx.on(event,()=>{moveDirection=null;moveChangedAt=-Infinity;finish('inactive');});
            const service={start,cancel:finish,status:()=>({active:!!active,pending:pendingStart?{...pendingStart}:null,last,completed,job:active?{...active}:null})};root.MooMooRangedAutoSync=service;
            ctx.onCleanup(()=>{disposed=true;finish('disabled');if(timer!==null)timers.clearTimeout(timer);if(restoreTimer!==null)timers.clearTimeout(restoreTimer);if(root.MooMooRangedAutoSync===service)delete root.MooMooRangedAutoSync;});
        });
    })(miscApi,root);

        function autoplay(){

            else if(distance<=110){stopPlay();playTarget=target.sid;playPhase='in-range';return;}else playPhase='approaching';
            const world=ctx.objects.all().filter(o=>o.active&&!o.fake&&!o.preplace&&dist(ctx.self,o)<400&&(!o.ignoreCollision||o.trap&&!ctx.objects.isFriendly(o.ownerSid)||ctx.data.item(o.id)?.group.name==='spikes'&&!ctx.objects.isFriendly(o.ownerSid)));

            const angle=angles.find(safe);if(angle==null){stopPlay();return;}if(now()-lastMove<150)return;

        function recoverHat(){
            if(root.MooMooOpportunities?.finisherPreparing())return;

        const clearDeferred=()=>{deferredMouse=null;deferredAuto=false;accessoryHoldUntil=0;};
        function releaseUnownedAttack(){
            if(!(wireDown||itemPressUnreleased)||wireAuto||physical().held||attackOwned()||deferredMouse||!weaponSelected()||!available()||now()<accessoryHoldUntil)return;

        function flushAccessoryInput(){
            if(!deferredMouse && !deferredAuto)return;
            if(!available() || win.document.hidden&&!win.AntimoocheatBots?.background() || automationTyping() || attackOwned() || !weaponSelected()){clearDeferred();return;}
            if(deferredMouse && now()>deferredMouse.until && !deferredMouse.sent)deferredMouse=null;
            if(!deferredMouse && !deferredAuto || !prepareAccessory())return;
            if(deferredAuto && net.wouldAllowBatch(['K']) && sdk.send.toggle(1)===true)deferredAuto=false;
            const click=deferredMouse;
            if(click?.press&&!click.sent){
                if(now()>=click.press.until){deferredMouse=null;return;}
                if(!win.MooMooBaseClicks.preparePress(click.press))return;
            }
            if(!click || !net.wouldAllowBatch(click.released && !click.sent?['F','F']:['F']))return;
            if(!click.sent){
                click.dir=win.MooMooBaseClicks?.rangedDirection?.()??click.dir;
                if(sdk.send.mouse(true,click.dir)!==true)return;
                click.sent=true;win.MooMooBaseClicks?.confirmPress(click.press);
            }
            if(!click.released || sdk.send.mouse(false,click.dir)===true)deferredMouse=null;
        }
        function prepareMouseInput(p){
            if(!p.down){if(deferredMouse){deferredMouse.released=true;if(!deferredMouse.sent)return null;}return p;}
            if(!available() || !weaponSelected() || attackOwned())return p;
            const dir=win.MooMooBaseClicks?.rangedDirection?.()??win.MooMooManualAutoaim?.prepareClick(p.dir??input.aimAngle())??p.dir??input.aimAngle(),clicks=win.MooMooBaseClicks,press=clicks?.armPress(dir);

            deferredMouse={dir,press,released:false,sent:false,until:now()+Math.max(1200,(net.ping||0)*3+600)};
            return null;
        }
        ctx.onOutgoing('mouse',(p,meta)=>meta?.source==='client'?prepareMouseInput(p):p);

        });

        ctx.onCleanup(()=>{clearDeferred();win.removeEventListener('blur',clearDeferred);});
        service={syncBotInput(value){

    });

            const delta = (a,b) => Math.atan2(Math.sin(a-b),Math.cos(a-b));
            const physical = o => o.active && !o.fake && !o.preplace;
            const itemFor = group => ctx.self.items?.map(i=>ctx.data.item(i)).find(i=>i?.group?.name===group);
            const boostLoadout=()=>!!ctx.self.items?.includes(16)&&!ctx.self.items.includes(15);
            const friendly = p => (ctx.objects.isFriendly(p.sid)) || (p.team != null && p.team === ctx.self.team);
            const known = new Map(), motion = new Map(), prepared = new Map(), resources = new Map(), hudResources = new Map(), resourceFrame = new Map(), captures = new Map(), rimAttempts = new Map();
            let pending = [], failedSearches = [], replacements = [], formation = null, leavePending = null, blurred = false, disposed = false, geometry = null;
            let last = 'idle', lastTarget = null, sent = 0, move = null, mouseDown = false, wireItem = null, autoHit = false, roundAfter = 0, formationStop = null;
            const live = () => !disposed && base.live();
            let boostSpikeKey=null,boostHeading=null,boostSpikeDir=null,boostSpikeTurnAt=0,boostRelease=null,nextBoostSlot=0;
            const active = () => !!(boostSpikeKey || boostRelease || root.AntimoocheatDefense?.placementActive() || root.AntimoocheatCombat?.settings.autoplay || settings.enabled || settings.preplacer || settings.animal || settings.boost4 || settings.mill3 || settings.spawn4 || settings.troll || leavePending);
            let playerCache=null;
            const players = () => {
                if(playerCache)return playerCache;
                const current=root.AntimoocheatVisuals?.observedApi.players??ctx.players;
                playerCache=[...current.values()].filter(p=>p.sid!==ctx.self.sid&&p.visible&&p.alive!==false&&(p.health==null||p.health>0)).map(p=>({
                    __proto__:p,sid:p.sid,team:p.team,x:p.x,y:p.y,x2:p.x2,y2:p.y2,scale:p.scale,
