            };
            const enemies = range => players().filter(p=>!friendly(p) && distance(ctx.self,p)<=range).sort((a,b)=>distance(ctx.self,a)-distance(ctx.self,b));
            const world = () => root.AntimoocheatWorld?.all() || geometry || (geometry = ctx.objects.all().filter(physical));
            for(const event of ['objectsLoad','objectKilled','objectsKilled','setup','reset'])ctx.on(event,()=>{geometry=null;});
            const trapFor = (p,objects) => objects.find(o=>o.trap && o.ownerSid!==p.sid && !(p.team!=null && api.player(o.ownerSid)?.team===p.team) && distance(p,o)<=(p.scale||35)+(o.getScale?.()??o.scale));
            const hudText=key=>root.document.getElementById(key+'Display')?.textContent.trim().replace(/[\s,]/g,'')||'';
            function resourceAmount(key) {
                if(resources.has(key))return resources.get(key);
                if(resourceFrame.has(key))return resourceFrame.get(key);
                const text=hudText(key);
                const match=/^(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)([kmb])?$/i.exec(text);
                if(!match){resourceFrame.set(key,0);return 0;}
                const amount=Number(match[1])*({k:1000,m:1000000,b:1000000000}[match[2]?.toLowerCase()]||1);
                const old=hudResources.get(key);
                if(!old || old.text!==text)hudResources.set(key,{text,amount});
                const available=hudResources.get(key).amount;resourceFrame.set(key,available);return available;
            }
            ctx.on('playerValue',p=>{
                if(['wood','stone','food','points'].includes(p.key) && Number.isFinite(p.value)){resources.set(p.key,Math.max(0,p.value));hudResources.delete(p.key);}
            });
            const confirmedObjects = new Map();
            let confirmedPlacements = 0, probeAttempts = 0, expiredPlacements = 0;
            let pendingTimer=null,pendingDue=Infinity;
            const placingKinds=new Map();
            function placementActivity(){
                const time=clock();for(const [kind,until]of placingKinds)if(until<=time)placingKinds.delete(kind);
                return {count:placingKinds.size,kinds:[...placingKinds.keys()]};
            }
            function armPending(){
                const due=pending.length?Math.min(...pending.map(p=>p.until)):Infinity;
                if(due===pendingDue)return;
                if(pendingTimer!==null)burstTimers().clearTimeout(pendingTimer);
                pendingTimer=null;pendingDue=due;
                if(Number.isFinite(due)&&!disposed)pendingTimer=burstTimers().setTimeout(()=>{
                    pendingTimer=null;pendingDue=Infinity;pruneAt=-Infinity;prune();
                },Math.max(1,due-clock()+1));
            }
            ctx.on('objectsLoad',()=>{if(pending.length){pruneAt=-Infinity;prune();}});
            function reconcilePlacements(objects, time) {
                for (const [sid, until] of confirmedObjects) if (until <= time) confirmedObjects.delete(sid);
                const matches = [];
                for (const p of pending) {
                    if (p.until <= time) continue;
                    // Position packets lag behind the server's moving player. Allow
                    // a bounded movement envelope, not only a five-unit exact match.
                    const travelled = p.origin ? distance(p.origin, ctx.self) : 0;
                    const latencyTravel = .6 * (Math.max(0, ctx.net.ping || 0) / 2 + (ctx.SERVER_TICK || 1000 / 9));
                    const tolerance = Math.max(35, Math.min(240, travelled + latencyTravel));
                    // The world query preserves all() insertion order, including equal-error ties.
                    // Replacement receipts retain their alternate x2/y2-position full-list check.
                    const index = root.AntimoocheatWorld;
                    const candidates = p.replacementSid == null && index?.query && index.all() === objects
                        ? index.query({x:p.x-tolerance,y:p.y-tolerance},{x:p.x+tolerance,y:p.y+tolerance}) : objects;
                    for (const o of candidates) {
                        if (o.ownerSid !== ctx.self.sid || o.id !== p.item.id || p.seen.has(o.sid) || confirmedObjects.has(o.sid)) continue;
                        const error = Math.hypot(o.x - p.x, o.y - p.y);
                        const replacementMatch = p.replacementSid != null && distance(o, p.replacementPosition) <= 35;
                        if (error <= tolerance || replacementMatch) matches.push({p, o, error});
                    }
                }
                // Each new owned building confirms exactly one request, including
                // when several requests precede the same objectsLoad packet.
                matches.sort((a, b) => a.error - b.error);
                const confirmed = new Set();
                for (const {p, o} of matches) {
                    if (confirmed.has(p) || confirmedObjects.has(o.sid)) continue;
                    confirmed.add(p);
                    confirmedObjects.set(o.sid, time + 1600);
                    confirmedPlacements++;
                    for (let i = 0; i < p.item.req.length; i += 2) {
                        const key = p.item.req[i];
                        if (!resources.has(key) && p.hudAt[key] === hudText(key)) {
                            resourceAmount(key);
                            const balance = hudResources.get(key);
                            if (balance) {
                                balance.amount = Math.max(0, balance.amount - p.item.req[i + 1]);
                                resourceFrame.set(key, balance.amount);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                pending = pending.filter(p => {
                    if (confirmed.has(p)) return false;
                    if (p.until <= time) {
                        expiredPlacements++;
                        if(p.searchMode!=='manual'&&!p.probe)rememberFailure(p,time);
                        if(['anti-trap','trapped-surround','approach-trap','recapture','contact-spike','trap-rim-spike'].includes(p.searchMode)){
                            failedSearches.push({x:p.x,y:p.y,id:p.item.id,until:time+retryWindow()});
                            if(failedSearches.length>48)failedSearches.shift();
                        }
                        return false;
                    }
                    return true;
                });
            }

            const failedCells=new Map(),nearbySets=new Map();
            let pruneAt=-Infinity,pruneWorld=null,failureWorld=null;
            const failureKey=(id,x,y)=>id+':'+x+':'+y;
            const retryWindow=()=>Math.max(120,Math.min(450,(ctx.net.ping||0)+(ctx.SERVER_TICK||1000/9)));
            function rememberFailure(p,time){
                const key=failureKey(p.item.id,Math.floor(p.x/32),Math.floor(p.y/32)),old=failedCells.get(key);
                const count=(old?.count||0)+1;
                // A rejected combat spike must survive the Hammer/primary reload window;
                // otherwise the next Trap Sync selects the same unseen obstruction.
                const hold=p.searchMode==='combat'&&p.item.group.name==='spikes'?Math.max(1800,retryWindow()*6):retryWindow()*Math.min(2,count);
                failedCells.delete(key);failedCells.set(key,{x:p.x,y:p.y,id:p.item.id,count,until:time+hold});
                if(failedCells.size>96)failedCells.delete(failedCells.keys().next().value);
            }
            function failedPoint(p){
                const x=Math.floor(p.x/32),y=Math.floor(p.y/32),time=clock();
                for(let dx=-1;dx<=1;dx++)for(let dy=-1;dy<=1;dy++){
                    const cell=failedCells.get(failureKey(p.item.id,x+dx,y+dy));
                    if(cell?.until>time&&Math.hypot(cell.x-p.x,cell.y-p.y)<24)return true;
                }
                return false;
            }
            function nearbyFor(item){
                const objects=world(),me=position(ctx.self),old=nearbySets.get(item.id);
                if(old?.objects===objects&&old.x===me.x&&old.y===me.y&&old.scale===ctx.self.scale)return old.list;
                const reach=(ctx.self.scale||35)+item.scale+(item.placeOffset||0)+item.scale;
                const source=root.AntimoocheatWorld?.query({x:me.x-reach,y:me.y-reach},{x:me.x+reach,y:me.y+reach})||objects;
                const list=source.filter(o=>distance(o,me)<=reach+(o.blocker||(o.getScale?.(.6,o.isItem)??o.scale)));
                nearbySets.set(item.id,{objects,x:me.x,y:me.y,scale:ctx.self.scale,list});
                if(nearbySets.size>32)nearbySets.delete(nearbySets.keys().next().value);
                return list;
            }
            ctx.on('objectKilled',p=>{
                const o=pruneWorld?.find(o=>o.sid===p.args?.[0]);
                if(o)for(const [key,f]of failedCells)if(distance(o,f)<(o.scale||50)+100)failedCells.delete(key);
            });
            function prune() {
                const objects = world(), time = clock();
                if(objects===pruneWorld&&time-pruneAt<16)return;
                pruneAt=time;pruneWorld=objects;resourceFrame.clear();
                for(const [key,f]of failedCells)if(f.until<=time){failedCells.delete(key);planRevision++;}
                if(failureWorld!==objects){
                    failureWorld=objects;
                    const owned=objects.filter(o=>o.ownerSid===ctx.self.sid);
                    for(const [key,f]of failedCells)if(owned.some(o=>o.id===f.id&&distance(o,f)<24))failedCells.delete(key);
                }
                const pendingBefore=pending.length,failedBefore=failedSearches.length;
                reconcilePlacements(objects, time);
                failedSearches=failedSearches.filter(p=>p.until>time);
                if(pending.length!==pendingBefore||failedSearches.length!==failedBefore)planRevision++;
                replacements = replacements.filter(p=>p.until>time && !objects.some(o=>o.ownerSid===ctx.self.sid && o.id===p.item && (p.retrap?(p.removed||o.sid!==p.sid)&&players().some(t=>t.sid===p.target&&distance(t,o)<=(t.scale||35)+(o.getScale?.()??o.scale)):distance(o,p)<=35)));
                pending = pending.filter(p=>p.replacementSid==null || replacements.some(r=>r.sid===p.replacementSid));
                armPending();
                for(const [sid,p] of captures)if(time-p.at>2000)captures.delete(sid);
                for(const [sid,until] of rimAttempts)if(until<=time)rimAttempts.delete(sid);
            }
            // One synchronous search shares inventory, resource and collision inputs.
            // Nothing is retained across calls: follow-up placements see new pending costs.
            function freeAngles(item,angles){
                if(!angles.length||!item?.group?.place||!ctx.self.items?.includes(item.id))return [];
                const sandbox=amSandbox(ctx,root),limit=base.structureLimit(item.group,sandbox),all=pending;
                if(limit&&ctx.objects.itemCount(item.group.id)+all.filter(e=>e.item.group.id===item.group.id).length>=limit)return [];
                if(!sandbox)for(let i=0;i<(item.req?.length||0);i+=2){
                    const resource=item.req[i],cost=all.reduce((sum,e)=>{const j=e.item.req.indexOf(resource);return sum+(j<0?0:e.item.req[j+1]);},0);
                    if(resourceAmount(resource)<item.req[i+1]+cost)return [];
                }
                const me=position(ctx.self),radius=(ctx.self.scale||35)+item.scale+(item.placeOffset||0),time=clock();
                const failures=[];for(const f of failedCells.values())if(f.id===item.id&&f.until>time)failures.push(f);
                const blockers=nearbyFor(item).map(o=>{const p=position(o);return {x:p.x,y:p.y,r:item.scale+(o.blocker||(o.getScale?.(.6,o.isItem)??o.scale))};});
                for(const p of all){const at=position(p);blockers.push({x:at.x,y:at.y,r:item.scale+p.item.scale});}
                const result=[];
                for(const angle of angles){
                    if(!Number.isFinite(angle))continue;
                    const x=me.x+Math.cos(angle)*radius,y=me.y+Math.sin(angle)*radius;
                    if(!Number.isFinite(x)||!Number.isFinite(y)||x<0||y<0||x>14400||y>14400||!sandbox&&Math.abs(y-7200)<=362)continue;
                    if(failures.some(f=>Math.hypot(f.x-x,f.y-y)<24)||blockers.some(o=>Math.hypot(o.x-x,o.y-y)<o.r))continue;
                    result.push({x,y,item,angle});
                }
                return result;
            }

            function free(item, angle, reserved = [], replacement = null, attemptBlocked = false, nearby = null) {
                if (!item?.group?.place || !ctx.self.items?.includes(item.id) || !Number.isFinite(angle)) return null;
                const me = position(ctx.self), radius = (ctx.self.scale||35)+item.scale+(item.placeOffset||0);
                const p = {x:me.x+Math.cos(angle)*radius,y:me.y+Math.sin(angle)*radius,item,angle};
                if (![p.x,p.y].every(Number.isFinite) || p.x<0 || p.y<0 || p.x>14400 || p.y>14400 || !amSandbox(ctx,root) && Math.abs(p.y-7200)<=362) return null;
                const retry=attemptBlocked ? pending.find(e=>e.item.id===item.id && Math.hypot(e.x-p.x,e.y-p.y)<1) : null;
                const all = [...pending.filter(e=>e!==retry && (!replacement || e.replacementSid!==replacement.sid)),...reserved], limit = base.structureLimit(item.group,amSandbox(ctx,root));
                if (limit && ctx.objects.itemCount(item.group.id)+all.filter(e=>e.item.group.id===item.group.id).length>=limit) return null;
                if (!amSandbox(ctx,root)) for (let i=0;i<(item.req?.length||0);i+=2) {
                    const resource=item.req[i], cost=all.reduce((sum,e)=>{const j=e.item.req.indexOf(resource);return sum+(j<0?0:e.item.req[j+1]);},0);
                    if (resourceAmount(resource)<item.req[i+1]+cost) return null;
                }
                if(!attemptBlocked&&failedPoint(p))return null;
                const blockedWorld = (nearby||nearbyFor(item)).some(o=>!(replacement?.speculativeUntil>clock() && replacement.sid===o.sid) && distance(o,p)<item.scale+(o.blocker||(o.getScale?.(.6,o.isItem)??o.scale)));
                const blockedPending = all.some(o=>distance(o,p)<item.scale+o.item.scale);
                if (!attemptBlocked && (blockedWorld || blockedPending)) return null;
                // Blind manual retries remain possible, but a known blocked
                // location is not another predicted successful purchase.
                const probe = attemptBlocked && !retry && (blockedWorld || blockedPending);
                return retry ? {...p,retry} : probe ? {...p,probe:true} : p;
            }

            function search(item, preferred, spread, accept = () => true, reserved = [], replacement = null) {
                if (!item) return null;
                const angles=[preferred], steps=Math.max(8,Math.min(10,Number(settings.placementAccuracy)||4)*6);
                for (let i=1;i<=steps && spread>0;i++) angles.push(preferred+spread*i/steps,preferred-spread*i/steps);
                if(replacement?.lastAngle!=null)angles.sort((a,b)=>Number(Math.abs(delta(a,replacement.lastAngle))<.02)-Number(Math.abs(delta(b,replacement.lastAngle))<.02));
                for (const angle of angles) {const p=free(item,angle,reserved,replacement);if(p && accept(p))return p;}
                return null;
            }
            const spikeContexts=new Map(),captureAttempts=new Map();let spikeContextRevision=-1;
            function spikePolicy(target,item){
                if(spikeContextRevision!==planRevision){spikeContexts.clear();spikeContextRevision=planRevision;}
                const now=clock(),me=position(ctx.self),at=position(target);
                let entry=spikeContexts.get(target.sid);
                if(!entry||entry.item!==item.id||entry.x!==me.x||entry.y!==me.y||entry.ex!==at.x||entry.ey!==at.y||now>=entry.until){
                    const policy=root.AntimoocheatSwapPlanners.amTrapSpikeContext({root,ctx,api,world,position,clock},target,item);
                    entry={policy,item:item.id,x:me.x,y:me.y,ex:at.x,ey:at.y,until:now+(ctx.SERVER_TICK||1000/9)};
                    spikeContexts.set(target.sid,entry);
                }
                return entry.policy;
            }
            const spikeRank=(p,target)=>p.item.group.name!=='spikes'?0:target?spikePolicy(target,p.item)?.rank(p)??0:-1;
            function protectsRetrap(p){
                if(p.item.group.name!=='spikes'&&p.item.group.name!=='trap')return true;
                const overlaps=r=>r.retrap&&distance(r,p)<p.item.scale+(ctx.data.item(r.item)?.scale||0);
                for(const r of prepared.values())if(overlaps(r))return false;
                return !replacements.some(r=>r.until>clock()&&overlaps(r));
            }
            function allowAutoPlacement(p){
                if(p.manual||p.defense)return true;
                if(boostLoadout()&&['contact-spike','trap-rim-spike','close-spike-surround'].includes(p.mode))return false;
                if(p.item?.group?.name==='trap'&&['approach-trap','close-trap-surround'].includes(p.mode)){
                    if(!protectsRetrap(p))return false;
                    if(replacements.some(r=>r.retrap)&&!hasPlacementRoom(p.item,2))return false;
                }
                if(p.item?.group?.name!=='spikes'||!['contact-spike','trap-rim-spike','close-spike-surround','preplacer'].includes(p.mode))return true;
                if(replacements.some(r=>r.retrap&&r.target===p.target&&r.until>clock()&&(r.removed||!ctx.objects.get(r.sid)?.active)))return false;
                const target=players().find(t=>t.sid===p.target);
                if(!target||friendly(target)||!protectsRetrap(p)||root.MooMooAutomation?.placementAllowed?.(p.item,p)===false)return false;
                const rank=spikeRank(p,target);
                if(rank<0||rank>=3&&(captureAttempts.get(p.target)??0)>clock())return false;
                p.capturePush=rank>=3;
                for(const other of enemies(400))if(other.sid!==p.target&&distance(p,other)<=(other.scale||35)+p.item.scale&&spikeRank(p,other)<0)return false;
                return true;
            }
            const placementPath=root.AntimoocheatSwapPlanners.createPlacementPathGuard({ctx,root,position});
            const automaticPathAllows=(p,path)=>root.MooMooAutomation?.placementAllowed?.(p.item,p)!==false&&placementPath.allows(p.item,p,path);
            function closeSurround(item,targetRange=75,preparation=false,automatic=false){
                if(!hasPlacementRoom(item))return null;
                const trap=item?.group.name==='trap';
                if(!trap&&item?.group.name!=='spikes')return null;
                const target=enemies(targetRange).find(p=>preparation||!trap||!trapFor(p,world()));if(!target)return null;
                const me=position(ctx.self),at=position(target),heading=Math.atan2(at.y-me.y,at.x-me.x),batch=[],nearby=nearbyFor(item);
                const path=automatic?placementPath.snapshot([target]):null;
                // Four sectors cover the full circle with at most seven candidates each. Reuse
                // the obstacle index and reserve accepted positions for this batch.
                for(let sector=0;sector<4;sector++){
                    const baseAngle=heading+sector*Math.PI/2;
                    let best=null,rank=-1;
                    for(const offset of [0,Math.PI/12,-Math.PI/12,Math.PI/6,-Math.PI/6,Math.PI/4,-Math.PI/4]){
                        const p=free(item,baseAngle+offset,batch,null,false,nearby);
                        if(!p||automatic&&(!automaticPathAllows(p,path)||!protectsRetrap(p)))continue;
                        const value=automatic&&!trap?spikeRank(p,target):0;
                        if(value>rank){best=p;rank=value;}
                        if(best&&(value===0||value===4||!automatic||trap))break;
                    }
                    if(best)batch.push({...best,mode:trap?'close-trap-surround':'close-spike-surround',target:target.sid,spikeRank:rank});
                }
                if(automatic&&!trap)batch.sort((a,b)=>b.spikeRank-a.spikeRank);
                return batch.length?{...batch[0],batch}:null;
            }
            let nextManualProbe=0;
            function manual(itemId, angle) {
                if(burst||root.document.hidden||base.isOpen()||base.isTyping())return null;
                prune(); const item=ctx.data.item(itemId);
                const surround=closeSurround(item);if(surround)return surround;
                const spread=item?.group.name==='booster' || !enemies(350).length ? 0 : Math.PI/2;
                const open=search(item,angle,spread);if(open)return {...open,mode:'manual'};
                const p=free(item,angle,[],null,true);if(!p)return null;
                if((p.probe||p.retry)&&(ctx.net.tokens('z')<6||ctx.net.tokens('F')<3||clock()<nextManualProbe))return null;
                return {...p,mode:'manual'};
            }
            function predict(p) {
                const old=motion.get(p.sid),at=position(p);
                if(!old || old.dt<=0 || old.dt>400 || clock()-old.at>350)return at;
                const amount=Math.min(80,Math.hypot(old.dx,old.dy)/old.dt*Math.min(180,(ctx.net.ping||0)/2+111)),dir=Math.atan2(old.dy,old.dx);
                return {x:at.x+Math.cos(dir)*amount,y:at.y+Math.sin(dir)*amount};
            }
            let planRevision=0;
            for(const event of ['playersUpdate','objectsLoad','objectKilled','objectsKilled','inventory','itemCount','playerValue','health','tribeSet','tribeMembers','playerAdd','playerRemove'])ctx.on(event,p=>{
                if(event==='playerValue'&&!(ctx.self.items||[]).some(id=>ctx.data.item(id)?.req?.includes(p.key)))return;
                playerCache=null;planRevision++;if(active())base.wake();
            });
            const autoRules=(function createAutoplacerRules(env){return env.root.AntimoocheatSwapPlanners.createRevelationRules(env);}

)({ctx,api,root,settings,clock,position,distance,delta,world,enemies,itemFor:group=>{const item=itemFor(group);return hasPlacementRoom(item)?item:null;},predict,free,freeAngles,spikePolicy,spikeRank,protectsRetrap,nearby:nearbyFor,planRevision:()=>planRevision,pending:()=>pending,failedSearches:()=>failedSearches});
            function hasPlacementRoom(item,needed=1){
                if(!item)return false;
                const group=item.group;
                let remaining=base.structureLimit(group,amSandbox(ctx,root))-ctx.objects.itemCount(group.id);
                if(remaining<needed)return false;
                for(const entry of pending)if(entry.item.group.id===group.id&&--remaining<needed)return false;
                return true;
            }
            function ordinary(){return autoRules.plan();}
            function followup(first){
                if(!settings.enabled||boostLoadout()||!['approach-trap','recapture','contact-spike','trap-rim-spike'].includes(first.mode))return null;
                prune();
                return autoRules.followup?.()||ordinary();
            }
            function animal() {
                const me=position(ctx.self),objects=world();
                const targets=(ctx.combat.animals||[]).filter(a=>a.active && a.visible && a.health>0 && distance(ctx.self,a)<=350).sort((a,b)=>distance(ctx.self,a)-distance(ctx.self,b));
                for(const target of targets) {
                    const d=ctx.data.animal(target.index);
                    // Hostility is a species property: no charge, movement or attack-state gate.
                    if(!d?.hostile || !d.speed || d.noTrap || d.boss || target.noTrap || [6,8,10].includes(target.index) || target.state && d.diver)continue;
                    const holding=objects.some(o=>o.trap && distance(o,target)<=(target.scale||d.scale||35)+(o.getScale?.()??o.scale));
                    const item=itemFor(holding?'spikes':'trap');if(!item)continue;
                    const at=position(target),p=search(item,Math.atan2(at.y-me.y,at.x-me.x),Math.PI,q=>distance(q,target)<=item.scale+(target.scale||d.scale||35)-1);
                    if(p)return {...p,mode:holding?'animal-spike':'animal-trap',target:target.sid};
                }
                return null;
            }
            let patternDiagnostics={};
        function legacyRingAngles(item, radius, x, y, world, pending, preferred, contact = null, pair = false, edge = null, exact = false) {
            if (![radius,x,y,preferred].every(Number.isFinite) || radius<=0) return [];
            const pi=Math.PI,tau=2*pi,epsilon=Math.max(1e-12,Number.EPSILON*Math.max(1,Math.abs(x),Math.abs(y))/radius*64);
            const accuracy=Math.min(10,Math.max(1,Math.round(Number(ctx.settings.placementAccuracy)||4)));
            world=world.filter(o=>o.active&&!o.fake&&!o.preplace&&Math.hypot(o.x-x,o.y-y)<=radius+item.scale+1+
                (o.blocker||(typeof o.getScale==='function'?o.getScale(.6,o.isItem):o.scale)));
            const relative=a=>Math.atan2(Math.sin(a-preferred),Math.cos(a-preferred));
            const valid=a=>{
                const px=x+Math.cos(a)*radius,py=y+Math.sin(a)*radius;
                return px>=0&&px<=14400&&py>=0&&py<=14400 && (amSandbox(ctx,root)||Math.abs(py-7200)>362) &&
                    (!contact||Math.hypot(px-contact.x,py-contact.y)<=contact.radius+1e-7) &&
                    !world.some(o=>o.active&&!o.fake&&!o.preplace&&Math.hypot(px-o.x,py-o.y)<item.scale+
                        (o.blocker||(typeof o.getScale==='function'?o.getScale(.6,o.isItem):o.scale))) &&
                    !pending.some(o=>Math.hypot(px-o.position.x,py-o.position.y)<item.scale+o.item.scale);
            };
            if(exact)return valid(preferred)?[preferred]:[];
            const cuts=[-pi,pi];
            if(contact) {
                if(![contact.x,contact.y,contact.radius].every(Number.isFinite)||contact.radius<=0)return [];
                const d=Math.hypot(contact.x-x,contact.y-y);
                if(Math.abs(d-radius)>contact.radius+1e-7)return [];


                if(d>1e-9&&Math.abs(d-radius)>=contact.radius-1e-7){
                    const a=Math.atan2(contact.y-y,contact.x-x);return valid(a)?[a]:[];
                }
                if(d>1e-9&&d+radius>contact.radius) {
                    const half=Math.acos(Math.max(-1,Math.min(1,(radius*radius+d*d-contact.radius*contact.radius)/(2*radius*d))));
                    const a=Math.atan2(contact.y-y,contact.x-x);
                    cuts.push(relative(a-half),relative(a+half));
                }
            }
            for(const bound of [0,14400]) {
                const v=(bound-x)/radius;
                if(Math.abs(v)<1){const a=Math.acos(v);cuts.push(relative(a),relative(-a));}
            }
            for(const bound of amSandbox(ctx,root)?[0,14400]:[0,6838,7562,14400]) {
                const v=(bound-y)/radius;
                if(Math.abs(v)<1){const a=Math.asin(v);cuts.push(relative(a),relative(pi-a));}
            }
            cuts.sort((a,b)=>a-b);
            let free=[];
            for(let i=1;i<cuts.length;i++) {
                const a=preferred+(cuts[i-1]+cuts[i])/2,px=x+Math.cos(a)*radius,py=y+Math.sin(a)*radius;
                if(cuts[i]-cuts[i-1]>epsilon && px>=0&&px<=14400&&py>=0&&py<=14400 &&
                    (amSandbox(ctx,root)||Math.abs(py-7200)>362) &&
                    (!contact||Math.hypot(px-contact.x,py-contact.y)<=contact.radius+1e-7))free.push([cuts[i-1],cuts[i]]);
            }
            const subtract=(lo,hi)=>{
                const next=[];
                for(const [a,b] of free) {
                    if(hi<=a||lo>=b){next.push([a,b]);continue;}
                    if(lo>a)next.push([a,lo]);if(hi<b)next.push([hi,b]);
                }
                free=next;
            };
            const block=(ox,oy,scale)=>{
                const d=Math.hypot(ox-x,oy-y),reach=item.scale+scale;
                if(!Number.isFinite(d)||!Number.isFinite(reach)||Math.abs(d-radius)>=reach)return;
                if(d+radius<=reach||d<1e-9){free=[];return;}
                const half=Math.acos(Math.max(-1,Math.min(1,(radius*radius+d*d-reach*reach)/(2*radius*d))));
                const a=relative(Math.atan2(oy-y,ox-x));
                for(const shift of [-tau,0,tau])subtract(a-half+shift,a+half+shift);
            };
            for(const o of world) {
                if(o.active&&!o.fake&&!o.preplace)block(o.x,o.y,o.blocker||(typeof o.getScale==='function'?o.getScale(.6,o.isItem):o.scale));
                if(!free.length)return [];
            }
            for(const o of pending){block(o.position.x,o.position.y,o.item.scale);if(!free.length)return [];}
            const candidates=[];
            for(const [a,b] of free.filter(([a,b])=>b-a>epsilon)){
                const edgeInset=Math.min(Math.max(epsilon*8,1e-8/radius),(b-a)/4);
                candidates.push(Math.max(a+edgeInset,Math.min(b-edgeInset,0)),(a+b)/2);
                if(!pair){
                    for(let level=1;level<=Math.ceil(accuracy/2);level++){
                        const fraction=Math.pow(.5,level+1);
                        candidates.push(a+(b-a)*fraction,b-(b-a)*fraction);
                    }
                }
                if(edge){



                    const toward=relative(Math.atan2(edge.y-y,edge.x-x));
                    for(const shift of [-tau,0,tau])candidates.push(Math.max(a+edgeInset,Math.min(b-edgeInset,toward+shift)));
                }
                {



                    const inset=Math.max(edgeInset,Math.min(1/radius,(b-a)/4));
                    candidates.push(a+inset,b-inset,a+edgeInset,b-edgeInset);
                }
            }
            const ordered=candidates.sort((a,b)=>a-b),unique=ordered.filter((a,i)=>!i||Math.abs(a-ordered[i-1])>epsilon);
            const clearance=a=>{
                const px=x+Math.cos(preferred+a)*radius,py=y+Math.sin(preferred+a)*radius;
                let minimum=Math.min(px,py,14400-px,14400-py);
                for(const o of world)minimum=Math.min(minimum,Math.hypot(px-o.x,py-o.y)-item.scale-(o.blocker||(o.getScale?.(.6,o.isItem)??o.scale)));
                for(const o of pending)minimum=Math.min(minimum,Math.hypot(px-o.position.x,py-o.position.y)-item.scale-o.item.scale);
                return minimum;
            };
            const score=a=>Math.abs(a)+.002/(Math.max(0,clearance(a))+.01);
            patternDiagnostics={...patternDiagnostics,intervals:free.length,narrowest:free.length?Math.min(...free.map(([a,b])=>b-a)):0,evaluated:unique.length};
            if(edge){
                return unique.map(a=>{
                    const angle=preferred+a,px=x+Math.cos(angle)*radius,py=y+Math.sin(angle)*radius;
                    return {angle,turn:Math.abs(a),gap:Math.round(Math.max(0,Math.hypot(px-edge.x,py-edge.y)-edge.radius)*100),
                        body:contact?Math.hypot(px-contact.x,py-contact.y):0};
                }).sort((a,b)=>a.gap-b.gap||a.body-b.body||a.turn-b.turn).map(e=>e.angle).filter(valid);
            }
            return unique.map(a=>({a,score:score(a)})).sort((a,b)=>a.score-b.score).map(e=>preferred+e.a).filter(valid);
        }

            // Four-place patterns share one rotation and one native placement batch.
            // Troll is atomic; Boost retains its target-facing slots and retries blocked sides.
            let burst=null,burstTimer=null,burstResumeTimer=null,burstBackoff=0,boostRound=null;
            const burstTimers=()=>root.MooMooPrivateBackground?.timers||root;
            function pattern(item,angles,offsets=null,accept=()=>true) {
                if(!item)return null;
                const me=position(ctx.self),radius=(ctx.self.scale||35)+item.scale+(item.placeOffset||0);
                const prior=pending.map(p=>({...p,position:{x:p.x,y:p.y}}));
                function* candidates(){
                    if(offsets){yield* offsets;return;}
                    yield 0;
                    for(const a of angles)for(const b of legacyRingAngles(item,radius,me.x,me.y,world(),prior,a,null,true))yield delta(b,a);
                }
                const visited=new Set();
                for(const offset of candidates()) {
                    if(!Number.isFinite(offset)||visited.has(offset))continue;visited.add(offset);
                    const plans=[];
                    for(const a of angles){const p=free(item,a+offset,plans);if(!p)break;plans.push(p);}
                    if(plans.length===angles.length&&accept(plans))return plans;
                }
                return null;
            }
            function burstBudget(count,troll=false) {
                const kinds=['e','F',...Array.from({length:count},()=>['z','F','z','F']).flat(),'z','F','9',...(root.AntimoocheatCombat?.status().auto?['K','K']:[]),...(troll?['N']:[])];
                const counts={};for(const kind of kinds)counts[kind]=(counts[kind]||0)+1;
                return ctx.net.perSecond()+kinds.length<=120&&Object.entries(counts).every(([kind,n])=>ctx.net.tokens(kind)>=n&&ctx.net.wouldAllow(kind));
            }
            function releaseBurst(resume=true) {
                const old=burst;if(!old)return;
                burst=null;
                if(burstTimer!=null)burstTimers().clearTimeout(burstTimer);burstTimer=null;
                if(burstResumeTimer!=null)burstTimers().clearTimeout(burstResumeTimer);burstResumeTimer=null;
                if(root.MooMooActionIntent?.owner==='placement-burst')delete root.MooMooActionIntent;
                burstBackoff=clock()+(boostRound?0:(ctx.SERVER_TICK||1000/9));
                if(!resume||!live())return;
                if(!root.document.hidden&&root.AntimoocheatCombat?.manualInput().held)root.MooMooBaseClicks?.resumeHeld?.();
                if(old.auto)ctx.send.toggle(1);
                // Resolve physical movement now; a key released during the burst stays up.
                const moveDir=heldWalkDirection();
                if(!root.document.hidden&&Number.isFinite(moveDir)&&root.AntimoocheatDefense?.hazard(moveDir)==null)ctx.send.move(moveDir);
                base.wake();
            }
            function heldWalkDirection(){
                let binds={};try{binds=JSON.parse(root.localStorage?.getItem('moo_keybinds')||'{}')||{};}catch(_){}
                let x=0,y=0;
                for(const [key,arrow,dx,dy]of [[binds.moveLeft||65,37,-1,0],[binds.moveRight||68,39,1,0],[binds.moveUp||87,38,0,-1],[binds.moveDown||83,40,0,1]])
                    if(ctx.input.isDown('#'+key)||ctx.input.isDown('#'+arrow)){x+=dx;y+=dy;}
                return x||y?Math.atan2(y,x):null;
            }
            function releaseBoostSpike(resume=true){
                if(!boostSpikeKey)return;
                boostSpikeKey=null;boostHeading=null;
                const owned=boostSpikeDir!==null&&Number.isFinite(move)&&Math.abs(delta(move,boostSpikeDir))<.01;
                if(owned)boostRelease={from:move,resume};
                boostSpikeDir=null;flushBoostRelease();
            }
            function flushBoostRelease(){
                if(!boostRelease)return;
                if(!live()||move!==boostRelease.from){boostRelease=null;return;}
                const dir=boostRelease.resume&&!root.document.hidden?heldWalkDirection():null;
                const sent=dir!=null&&root.AntimoocheatDefense?.hazard(dir)==null?ctx.send.move(dir):ctx.send.stopMove();
                if(sent===true)boostRelease=null;
            }
            function initialBoostHeading(){
                const me=position(ctx.self);
                let nearest=null,best=Infinity;
                for(const p of players()){
                    if(friendly(p))continue;
                    const at=position(p),d=(at.x-me.x)**2+(at.y-me.y)**2;
                    if(d<best){nearest=at;best=d;}
                }
                return nearest?Math.atan2(nearest.y-me.y,nearest.x-me.x):ctx.input.aimAngle();
            }
            function steerBoostSpike(){
                flushBoostRelease();
                if(!boostSpikeKey)return;
                if(!live()||root.document.hidden||base.isTyping()||base.capturingKey()||!ctx.self.items?.includes(16)||!itemFor('spikes')){
                    releaseBoostSpike();return;
                }
                if(burst||root.AntimoocheatCombat?.active()){
                    if(boostSpikeDir!=null&&move===boostSpikeDir)ctx.send.stopMove();
                    boostSpikeDir=null;return;
                }
                if(clock()<boostSpikeTurnAt)return;
                const angle=boostHeading;
                if(!Number.isFinite(angle))return;
                if(move==null||Math.abs(delta(angle,move))>.015){
                    if(ctx.send.move(angle)!==true)return;
                    boostSpikeTurnAt=clock()+33;
                }
                boostSpikeDir=move??angle;
            }
            function boostSpikeFormation(){
                if(!boostSpikeKey||boostSpikeDir==null)return null;
                prune();
                const angle=boostHeading,pad=ctx.data.item(16),spike=itemFor('spikes'),batch=[];
                const capacity=Math.min(3,Math.floor(ctx.net.tokens('z')/2),Math.floor(ctx.net.tokens('F')/2),Math.floor((120-ctx.net.perSecond())/4));
                if(!spike||capacity<1)return null;
                for(const [slot,offset] of [0,Math.PI/2,-Math.PI/2].entries()){
                    const item=slot?spike:pad,preferred=angle+offset;
                    let candidate=free(item,preferred,batch);
                    if(!candidate&&slot)candidate=autoRules.ringSearch(item,preferred,Math.PI/6,null,{mode:'boost-spike',reserved:batch});
                    if(candidate)batch.push({...candidate,mode:'boost-spike',boostSide:slot});
                }
                if(batch.length>capacity)batch.sort((a,b)=>(a.boostSide-nextBoostSlot+3)%3-(b.boostSide-nextBoostSlot+3)%3);
                const selected=batch.slice(0,capacity);
                return selected.length?{...selected[0],batch:selected}:null;
            }
            function beginBurst(plan) {
                if(burst||!live()||root.AntimoocheatCombat?.active()||root.AntimoocheatCombat?.status().moveOwned||root.AntimoocheatDefense?.placementUrgent())return false;
                if(!burstBudget(plan.batch.length,plan.mode==='4-spike-troll'))return false;
                burst={mode:plan.mode,auto:!!root.AntimoocheatCombat?.status().auto,sent:0,expected:plan.batch.length,until:clock()+500};
                root.MooMooActionIntent={owner:'placement-burst',down:false};
                burstTimer=burstTimers().setTimeout(()=>releaseBurst(),500);
                if(ctx.send.stopMove()!==true||ctx.send.mouse(false,ctx.input.aimAngle())!==true||burst.auto&&ctx.send.toggle(1)!==true){releaseBurst();return false;}
                return true;
            }
            function finishBurst(plan,count) {
                if(!burst)return;
                burst.sent=count;
                if(count!==burst.expected){formationStop={reason:'burst-incomplete',sent:count,expected:burst.expected};releaseBurst();return;}
                if(plan.mode==='4-spike-troll') {
                    burst.leaveUntil=clock()+400;
                    const leave=()=>{
                        burstResumeTimer=null;if(!burst)return;
                        if(ctx.self.team==null||ctx.send.leaveTribe()===true){releaseBurst();api.setSetting(id,'troll',false);}
                        else if(clock()>=burst.leaveUntil){releaseBurst();api.setSetting(id,'troll',false);}
                        else burstResumeTimer=burstTimers().setTimeout(leave,16);
                    };
                    leave();
                }
            }
            function ringPriority() {
                prune();
                if(burst||clock()<burstBackoff||!live()||root.AntimoocheatCombat?.active()||root.AntimoocheatCombat?.status().moveOwned)return null;
                const mate=settings.troll&&players().find(p=>ctx.self.team!=null&&p.team===ctx.self.team&&distance(ctx.self,p)<=75);
                if(mate){
                    const me=position(ctx.self),at=position(mate),a=Math.atan2(at.y-me.y,at.x-me.x);
                    const plans=pattern(itemFor('spikes'),[a,a+Math.PI/2,a+Math.PI,a+3*Math.PI/2],[0]);
                    if(plans&&burstBudget(4,true)){
                        formationStop=null;const batch=plans.map(p=>({...p,mode:'4-spike-troll',target:mate.sid}));
                        return {...batch[0],batch,burst:true};
                    }
                    formationStop={reason:plans?'burst-budget':'four-slots-unavailable',mode:'4-spike-troll',target:mate.sid};
                }
                const spike=itemFor('spikes'),target=boostRound&&players().find(p=>p.sid===boostRound.target);
                if(boostRound&&(!settings.boost4||!itemFor('booster')||!spike||spike.id!==boostRound.item.id||
                    clock()>=boostRound.until||distance(ctx.self,boostRound.origin)>25||!target||friendly(target)||distance(ctx.self,target)>350)){
                    formationStop={reason:'boost-round-ended',remaining:boostRound.slots.filter(s=>!s.sent).length};boostRound=null;
                }
                if(!boostRound&&settings.boost4&&itemFor('booster')&&spike){
                    const enemy=enemies(75)[0];if(!enemy)return null;
                    const origin=position(ctx.self),at=position(enemy),a=Math.atan2(at.y-origin.y,at.x-origin.x);
                    // Keep the first slot facing the target. A blocked side must not
                    // rotate the entire formation or delay the available front slot.
                    boostRound={target:enemy.sid,origin,item:spike,until:clock()+Math.min(1500,800+Math.max(0,ctx.net.ping||0)),
                        slots:[a,a+Math.PI/2,a+Math.PI,a+3*Math.PI/2].map(angle=>({angle,sent:false}))};
                }
                if(!boostRound)return null;
                const round=boostRound,batch=[];
                for(let slot=0;slot<round.slots.length;slot++){
                    if(round.slots[slot].sent)continue;
                    const p=free(round.item,round.slots[slot].angle,batch);
                    if(p)batch.push({...p,mode:'boost-4-spikes',target:round.target,boostRound:round,boostSlot:slot});
                }
                if(!batch.length){formationStop={reason:'boost-slots-blocked',remaining:round.slots.filter(s=>!s.sent).length,target:round.target};return null;}
                if(!burstBudget(batch.length)){formationStop={reason:'burst-budget',mode:'boost-4-spikes',target:round.target};return null;}
                formationStop=null;return {...batch[0],batch,burst:true};
            }
            for(const action of ['move','stopMove','mouse','selectItem','toggle'])ctx.onOutgoing(action,(p,info)=>{
                if(!burst||info?.source!=='client')return p;
                if(action==='toggle'&&p.which===1)burst.auto=!burst.auto;
                return null;
            });
            ctx.on('playersUpdate',()=>{if(burst?.mode==='boost-4-spikes'&&burst.sent===burst.expected)releaseBurst();});
            for(const event of ['reset','setup','died','disconnect'])ctx.on(event,()=>releaseBurst(false));


            function makeFormation(mode, item, angles, target = null, requireAll = false) {
                if(!hasPlacementRoom(item,requireAll?angles.length:1))return;
                const slots=[];
                for(const angle of angles) {const p=free(item,angle,slots);if(p)slots.push(p);else if(requireAll)return;}
                if(!slots.length)return;
                formationStop=null;formation={mode,item,slots,origin:position(ctx.self),target:target?.sid,until:clock()+5000,placed:[]};
            }

            function formationStep(manualHeld) {
                if(!formation)return null;
                const f=formation,flag={'boost-4-spikes':'boost4','4-spike-troll':'troll','3x-mill':'mill3','4x-spawn-pad':'spawn4'}[f.mode];
                const target=f.target==null?null:players().find(p=>p.sid===f.target);
                const moving=['3x-mill','4x-spawn-pad'].includes(f.mode);
                if(!settings[flag] || clock()>f.until || (!moving && distance(ctx.self,f.origin)>100) || f.target!=null && (!target || distance(ctx.self,target)>350 || (f.mode==='4-spike-troll' ? !friendly(target) : friendly(target)))) {
                    formationStop={reason:'conditions-changed',enabled:!!settings[flag],expired:clock()>f.until,displacement:distance(ctx.self,f.origin),target:target?{distance:distance(ctx.self,target),friendly:friendly(target)}:null};formation=null;return null;
                }
                if(moving && (manualHeld || mouseDown || autoHit || !Number.isFinite(move)))return null;
                if(moving){
                    const batch=[];
                    for(const slot of f.slots){
                        const next=free(f.item,slot.angle,batch);
                        if(next)batch.push({...next,mode:f.mode,target:f.target,formation:f,slot});
                    }
                    if(f.mode==='3x-mill' && !f.placed.length && batch.length<3){formation=null;return null;}
                    return batch.length?{...batch[0],batch}:null;
                }
                while(f.slots.length) {
                    const slot=f.slots[0],angle=slot.angle,p=free(f.item,angle);
                    if(!p) {formationStop={reason:'slot-unavailable',angle,origin:position(ctx.self),remaining:f.slots.length};formation=null;return null;}
                    return {...p,mode:f.mode,target:f.target,formation:f};
                }
                formation=null;return null;
            }
            function prepare() {
                // Keep a confirmed push intent across a brief movement handoff. A new
                // world update may precede the removal callback for the outgoing trap.
                const previous=[...prepared.values()].filter(r=>r.retrap&&clock()<r.until);
                prepared.clear();
                if(settings.enabled)for(const r of previous){
                    const spike=ctx.objects.get(r.spike),target=players().find(p=>p.sid===r.target);
                    if(target&&!friendly(target)&&spike?.active&&distance(target,r)<=(target.scale||35)+r.capture)prepared.set(r.sid,r);
                }
                if(settings.enabled){
                    const push=root.MooMooAutomation?.status(),item=itemFor('trap');
                    if(item){
                        const objects=world(),me=position(ctx.self);
                        for(const target of enemies(400).slice(0,8)){
                            const at=position(target),dx=at.x-me.x,dy=at.y-me.y,d=Math.hypot(dx,dy),ux=dx/(d||1),uy=dy/(d||1);
                            const pushSid=root.MooMooAutomation?.reservedPushSpike?.(target.sid)??(push?.pushTarget===target.sid?push.pushSpike:null);
                            const automatic=pushSid!=null;
                            const contact=d<=(ctx.self.scale||35)+(target.scale||35)+20;
                            const toward=Number.isFinite(move)&&Math.cos(move)*ux+Math.sin(move)*uy>.65;
                            if(!automatic&&(!contact||!toward))continue;
                            const spike=automatic?ctx.objects.get(pushSid):objects.find(o=>{
                                if(ctx.data.item(o.id)?.group?.name!=='spikes'||!ctx.objects.isFriendly(o.ownerSid))return false;
                                const x=o.x-at.x,y=o.y-at.y,dist=Math.hypot(x,y);
                                return dist<=(target.scale||35)+(o.getScale?.()??o.scale)+160&&x*ux+y*uy>dist*.65;
                            });
                            if(!spike)continue;
                            const trap=objects.find(o=>o.trap&&o.ownerSid!==target.sid&&!(target.team!=null&&api.player(o.ownerSid)?.team===target.team)&&distance(o,target)<(target.scale||35)+(o.getScale?.()??o.scale));
                            if(trap)prepared.set(trap.sid,{sid:trap.sid,x:trap.x,y:trap.y,item:item.id,target:target.sid,retrap:true,spike:spike.sid,capture:trap.getScale?.()??trap.scale,until:clock()+3*(ctx.SERVER_TICK||1000/9)});
                        }
                    }
                }
                if(!settings.preplacer)return;
                const spike=itemFor('spikes');if(!spike)return;
                const objects=world(),radius=(ctx.self.scale||35)+spike.scale+(spike.placeOffset||0);
                for(const target of enemies(350).slice(0,16)) {
                    for(const o of objects) {
                        if(prepared.size>=32)return;
                        const capturesEnemy=!boostLoadout()&&o.trap&&o.ownerSid!=null&&o.ownerSid!==target.sid&&
                            !(target.team!=null&&api.player(o.ownerSid)?.team===target.team)&&
                            distance(o,target)<=(target.scale||35)+(o.getScale?.()??o.scale);
                        if(ctx.data.item(o.id)?.group.name!=='spikes'&&!capturesEnemy || distance(o,target)>o.scale+(target.scale||35)+30 || Math.abs(distance(ctx.self,o)-radius)>35)continue;
                        if(!prepared.has(o.sid))prepared.set(o.sid,{sid:o.sid,x:o.x,y:o.y,item:spike.id,target:target.sid});
                    }
                }
            }
            function replacement() {
                const me=position(ctx.self);
                for(const retrap of [true,false])for(const plan of replacements) {
                    if(!!plan.retrap!==retrap)continue;
                    if(plan.sid===root.MooMooCombatMacros?.reservedTrap?.())continue;
                    if(plan.retrap?!settings.enabled:!settings.preplacer)continue;
                    const target=players().find(p=>p.sid===plan.target);
                    if(!target || friendly(target) || distance(ctx.self,target)>400 || ctx.objects.get(plan.sid)?.active && !(plan.speculativeUntil>clock()))continue;
                    if(plan.retrap&&(!ctx.objects.get(plan.spike)?.active||world().some(o=>o.trap&&o.sid!==plan.sid&&o.ownerSid!==target.sid&&!(target.team!=null&&api.player(o.ownerSid)?.team===target.team)&&distance(o,target)<(target.scale||35)+(o.getScale?.()??o.scale))))continue;
                    const path=placementPath.snapshot([target]);
                    const item=ctx.data.item(plan.item),p=search(item,Math.atan2(plan.y-me.y,plan.x-me.x),Math.PI,q=>distance(q,plan)<=(plan.retrap?90:35) && distance(q,target)<=(plan.retrap?item.scale*(item.colDiv||1)+(target.scale||35)-1:item.scale+(target.scale||35)+20) && automaticPathAllows(q,path)&&(plan.retrap||protectsRetrap(q)&&spikeRank(q,target)>=0),[],plan);
                    if(p)return {...p,mode:plan.retrap?'push-retrap':'preplacer',target:plan.target,replacement:plan};
                }
                return null;
            }
            function defensive(){
                prune();
                return root.AntimoocheatDefense?.placement(search,itemFor,autoRules.ringSearch,()=>settings.enabled&&autoRules.plan(true))||null;
            }
            function automatic(manualHeld) {
                prune();const defensePlan=defensive();if(defensePlan)return defensePlan;

                const preparedPlan=(settings.preplacer||settings.enabled) && replacement();if(preparedPlan)return preparedPlan;
                const ongoing=formationStep(manualHeld);if(ongoing)return ongoing;

                if(burst)return null;
                const preparationRange=Math.min(Math.min(400,Math.max(150,Number(settings.range)||250)),Math.min(400,Math.max(75,Number(settings.closeRange)||150)));
                // Near contact uses spikes first. Traps prepare the player's full
                // ring at the configured distance, without requiring a capture.
                // Blocked sectors are re-evaluated by the next normal planner pass.
                const autoEnabled=(settings.enabled||root.AntimoocheatCombat?.settings.autoplay)&&!boostLoadout();
                const surround=autoEnabled&&closeSurround(itemFor('spikes'),75,false,true);if(surround)return surround;
                const normal=autoEnabled&&ordinary();
                const spike=normal&&(normal.item.group.name==='spikes'?normal:normal.spikeAlternative);if(spike)return spike;
                const traps=autoEnabled&&![...prepared.values()].some(p=>p.retrap)&&!replacements.some(p=>p.retrap)&&closeSurround(itemFor('trap'),preparationRange,true,true);if(traps)return traps;
                if(normal)return normal;
                const animalPlan=settings.animal && animal();if(animalPlan)return animalPlan;
                if(!manualHeld && !mouseDown && !autoHit && Number.isFinite(move)) {
                    if(settings.mill3 && !formation){
                        const mill=itemFor('mill');
                        if(mill){
                            const radius=(ctx.self.scale||35)+mill.scale+(mill.placeOffset||0);
                            const spacing=2*Math.asin(Math.min(1,(mill.scale+2)/radius));
                            for(const turn of [0,-.12,.12,-.24,.24]){
                                const back=move+Math.PI+turn;
                                makeFormation('3x-mill',mill,[back,back-spacing,back+spacing],null,true);
                                if(formation)break;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    if(!formation && settings.spawn4)makeFormation('4x-spawn-pad',itemFor('spawn'),[move+Math.PI,move+Math.PI/2,move+3*Math.PI/2,move]);
                    return formationStep(manualHeld);
                }
                return null;
            }
            const adaptiveModes=new Set(['approach-trap','recapture','trap-rim-spike','contact-spike','close-trap-surround','close-spike-surround']);
            function attempted(p) {
                if(p.capturePush){
                    for(const [sid,end]of captureAttempts)if(end<=clock())captureAttempts.delete(sid);
                    captureAttempts.set(p.target,clock()+2*(ctx.SERVER_TICK||1000/9)+(ctx.net.ping||0));
                }
                if(!p.manual&&!p.defense&&adaptiveModes.has(p.mode))autoRules.sentAttempt();
                planRevision++;pruneAt=-Infinity;
                if(p.manual&&(p.probe||p.retry))nextManualProbe=clock()+1000/settings.speed;
                if(p.mode==='boost-spike')nextBoostSlot=(p.boostSide+1)%3;
                if(p.boostRound===boostRound&&boostRound){boostRound.slots[p.boostSlot].sent=true;if(boostRound.slots.every(s=>s.sent))boostRound=null;}
                sent++;last=p.mode;lastTarget=p.target??null;if(p.defense)root.AntimoocheatDefense?.placed(p);
                const retry=p.retry || p.replacement && pending.find(e=>e.replacementSid===p.replacement.sid);
                const hudAt={};
                for(let i=0;i<(p.item.req?.length||0);i+=2) {
                    const key=p.item.req[i];hudAt[key]=retry?.hudAt[key]??hudText(key);
                }
                const seen=retry?.seen || new Set(world().filter(o=>o.ownerSid===ctx.self.sid && o.id===p.item.id).map(o=>o.sid));
                const observation={x:p.x,y:p.y,item:p.item,searchMode:p.mode,hudAt,seen,origin:retry?.origin||position(ctx.self),replacementSid:p.replacement?.sid,replacementPosition:p.replacement&&{x:p.replacement.x,y:p.replacement.y},until:retry?.until??clock()+Math.max(250,Math.min(1400,(ctx.net.ping||0)+2*(ctx.SERVER_TICK||1000/9)))};
                if(retry)Object.assign(retry,observation);else if(p.probe)probeAttempts++;else pending.push(observation);
                armPending();
                placingKinds.set(p.manual||p.mode==='manual'?'manual':p.item.group?.name||String(p.item.id),clock()+300);
                if(p.replacement)p.replacement.lastAngle=p.angle;
                if(p.rimSid!=null)rimAttempts.set(p.rimSid,clock()+350);
                if(p.formation===formation && formation) {
                    const index=p.slot?formation.slots.indexOf(p.slot):0;
                    if(index<0)return;formation.slots.splice(index,1);formation.placed.push({x:p.x,y:p.y,item:p.item});
                    if(!formation.slots.length) {
                        roundAfter=clock()+700;
                        if(p.mode==='4-spike-troll')leavePending={placed:formation.placed,until:clock()+1600};
                        formation=null;
                    }
                }
            }
            function leave() {
                if(!leavePending)return;
                ctx.send.leaveTribe();leavePending=null;api.setSetting(id,'troll',false);
            }
            function clear() {if(pendingTimer!==null)burstTimers().clearTimeout(pendingTimer);pendingTimer=null;pendingDue=Infinity;placingKinds.clear();nextManualProbe=0;failedCells.clear();nearbySets.clear();pruneAt=-Infinity;pruneWorld=failureWorld=null;boostRound=null;releaseBurst(false);if(burstResumeTimer!=null)burstTimers().clearTimeout(burstResumeTimer);burstResumeTimer=null;burstBackoff=0;base.clear();autoRules.clear();pending=[];failedSearches=[];confirmedObjects.clear();confirmedPlacements=probeAttempts=expiredPlacements=0;replacements=[];prepared.clear();spikeContexts.clear();captureAttempts.clear();motion.clear();captures.clear();rimAttempts.clear();formation=null;leavePending=null;move=null;wireItem=null;mouseDown=false;autoHit=false;last='idle';roundAfter=0;}
            const service={settings,live,active,manual,automatic,followup,defensive,allowAutoPlacement,attempted,leave,pattern,priority:ringPriority,beginBurst,finishBurst,burstPaused:()=>!!burst,nearby:id=>nearbyFor(ctx.data.item(id)),
                combatAngles:(item,angle,ignore,contact)=>{
                    prune();const me=position(ctx.self),radius=(ctx.self.scale||35)+item.scale+(item.placeOffset||0);
                    // Object positions arrive rounded. Plan just inside each open arc.
                    const obstacles=nearbyFor(item).filter(o=>o.sid!==ignore).map(o=>({x:o.x,y:o.y,active:true,blocker:1+(o.blocker||(o.getScale?.(.6,o.isItem)??o.scale))}));
                    const angles=legacyRingAngles(item,radius,me.x,me.y,obstacles,
                        pending.map(p=>({item:p.item,position:p})),angle,contact);
                    // Failed positions are temporary exclusions, not invented
                    // trap coordinates. Include their arc edges in the next plan.
                    for(const f of failedCells.values())if(f.id===item.id&&f.until>clock()){
                        const dx=f.x-me.x,dy=f.y-me.y,d=Math.hypot(dx,dy);if(d<1e-6)continue;
                        const cosine=(radius*radius+d*d-24*24)/(2*radius*d);
                        if(cosine<=-1||cosine>=1)continue;
                        const center=Math.atan2(dy,dx),edge=Math.acos(cosine)+.015;
                        angles.push(center-edge,center+edge);
                    }
                    return angles.filter(a=>!failedPoint({item,x:me.x+Math.cos(a)*radius,y:me.y+Math.sin(a)*radius}));
                },
                combatSearch:(id,angle,spread=0,accept=()=>true,reserved=[],ignore=null)=>{prune();return search(ctx.data.item(id),angle,spread,accept,reserved,ignore==null?null:{sid:ignore,speculativeUntil:clock()+1});},
                combatValidate:p=>{prune();return free(p.item,p.angle);},searchPreview:()=>(settings.enabled||root.AntimoocheatCombat?.settings.autoplay||autoRules.preview()?.mode==='anti-trap'&&root.AntimoocheatDefense?.placementActive())&&live()?autoRules.preview():null,status:()=>({autoplacer:autoRules.status(),activity:placementActivity(),last,target:lastTarget,sent,pending:pending.length,failedPositions:failedCells.size,collisionCaches:nearbySets.size,confirmed:confirmedPlacements,probes:probeAttempts,expired:expiredPlacements,prepared:prepared.size,replacements:replacements.length,formation:formation?.slots.length||0,formationStop,boostRound:boostRound&&{target:boostRound.target,remaining:boostRound.slots.filter(s=>!s.sent).length,expiresIn:Math.max(0,boostRound.until-clock())},burst:burst&&{mode:burst.mode,sent:burst.sent,expected:burst.expected,remaining:Math.max(0,burst.until-clock())},pattern:patternDiagnostics})};
            Object.assign(service,{steerBoostSpike,boostSpikeFormation,boostSpikeHeld:()=>!!boostSpikeKey});
            const offBoostDown=ctx.input.onKeyDown((event,keys)=>{
                const binding=ctx.input.normKey(root.AntimoocheatCombat?.settings.boostSpikeKey||'');
                if(boostSpikeKey||!binding||!keys.includes(binding)||event.defaultPrevented||event.repeat||event.isComposing||event.ctrlKey||event.altKey||event.metaKey||base.isTyping()||base.capturingKey()||!live()||root.document.hidden||!ctx.self.items?.includes(16)||!itemFor('spikes'))return;
                event.preventDefault();event.stopImmediatePropagation();boostRelease=null;boostSpikeKey=binding;boostHeading=initialBoostHeading();boostSpikeTurnAt=0;nextBoostSlot=0;steerBoostSpike();base.wake();
            });
            const offBoostUp=ctx.input.onKeyUp((_event,keys)=>{if(boostSpikeKey&&keys.includes(boostSpikeKey))releaseBoostSpike();});
            ctx.onCleanup(()=>{releaseBoostSpike(false);offBoostDown();offBoostUp();});
            for(const event of ['setup','reset','died','disconnect'])ctx.on(event,()=>{boostSpikeKey=boostHeading=boostSpikeDir=boostRelease=null;});
            root.AntimoocheatBasePlacement=service;root.AntimoocheatIndicators?.register(id,settings,{mill3:'3x Mill',spawn4:'4x Pad',troll:'4x Spike Troll'});
            ctx.on('playerAdd',p=>{const d=p.data;if(Array.isArray(d))known.set(d[1],{id:d[0],health:d[6],scale:d[8],alive:d[6]>0});});
            ctx.on('health',p=>{const old=known.get(p.sid);if(old)Object.assign(old,{health:p.value,alive:p.value>0});});
            ctx.on('playerRemove',p=>{for(const [sid,entry]of known)if(sid===p.sid || entry.id===p.sid){known.delete(sid);motion.delete(sid);}});
            ctx.onSent((action,p)=>{
                if(action==='move')move=p.dir;
                if(action==='stopMove')move=null;
                if(action==='selectItem')wireItem=p.isWeapon?null:p.index;
                if(action==='mouse'&&!base.placing()&&(!p.down||wireItem==null))mouseDown=!!p.down;
                if(action==='toggle' && p.which===1)autoHit=!autoHit;
            });
            ctx.on('playersUpdate',()=>{
                if(!settings.enabled)return;
                for(const p of ctx.players.values()) {const old=motion.get(p.sid),at=position(p),time=clock();motion.set(p.sid,{...at,at:time,dx:old?at.x-old.x:0,dy:old?at.y-old.y:0,dt:old?time-old.at:0});}
                for(const [sid,p]of motion)if(clock()-p.at>1000)motion.delete(sid);
            });
            for(const event of ['playersUpdate','objectsLoad','inventory'])ctx.on(event,()=>{if(settings.preplacer||settings.enabled)prepare();});
            for(const event of ['objectKilled','objectsKilled'])ctx.on(event,()=>{
                for(const plan of prepared.values())if(!ctx.objects.get(plan.sid)?.active){
                    const existing=replacements.find(p=>p.sid===plan.sid),until=clock()+(plan.retrap?1800:Math.min(1200,600+(ctx.net.ping||0)));
                    if(existing){Object.assign(existing,plan,{until,removed:true});}
                    else if(plan.retrap)replacements.unshift({...plan,until,removed:true});else replacements.push({...plan,until,removed:true});
                }
                prepare();base.wake();
            });
            if(ctx.combat.onBuildingDamage)ctx.onCleanup(ctx.combat.onBuildingDamage((building,damage,attacker)=>{
                if(!settings.preplacer||!Number.isInteger(attacker?.sid)||!Number.isFinite(building?.health)||!(building.health>0)||!Number.isFinite(damage)||damage<building.health)return;
                const known=ctx.objects.get(building.sid),player=attacker.sid===ctx.self.sid?ctx.self:api.player(attacker.sid),weapon=ctx.data.weapon(attacker.weaponIndex);
                if(!known?.active||known.fake||known.preplace||known.ownerSid==null||known.id!==building.id||known.x!==building.x||known.y!==building.y||
                    !player?.alive||player.visible===false||!weapon||weapon.projectile!=null||!(weapon.dmg>0))return;
                const from=position(attacker),to=position(known),facing=attacker.d2??attacker.dir;
                if(!Number.isFinite(facing)||distance(attacker,known)>(weapon.range||0)+(known.scale||0)||
                    Math.abs(delta(Math.atan2(to.y-from.y,to.x-from.x),facing))>(ctx.combat?.K?.gatherAngle??Math.PI/2.6))return;
                prepare();const plan=prepared.get(building.sid);if(!plan)return;
                const speculativeUntil=clock()+Math.min(450,Math.max(150,(ctx.net.ping||0)+111));
                const existing=replacements.find(p=>p.sid===plan.sid);
                const replacement={...plan,speculativeUntil,until:clock()+800};
                if(existing)Object.assign(existing,replacement);else if(plan.retrap)replacements.unshift(replacement);else replacements.push(replacement);
                base.wake();
            }));
            for(const event of ['playersUpdate','animalsUpdate','objectsLoad','inventory','health'])ctx.on(event,()=>{if(active())base.pulse();});
            for(const event of ['setup','reset','died','disconnect'])ctx.on(event,()=>{clear();known.clear();resources.clear();hudResources.clear();resourceFrame.clear();});
            ctx.on('playerAdd',p=>{if(p.isYou){resources.clear();hudResources.clear();resourceFrame.clear();}});
            ctx.onSettingChange(key=>{if(key==='boost4'||!settings.boost4)boostRound=null;if(burst&&(key==='troll'||key==='boost4'))releaseBurst();root.AntimoocheatIndicators?.record(id,key,!!settings[key]);if(key==='troll')root.AntimoocheatCombat?.notice('Troll: '+!!settings.troll,!!settings.troll);autoRules.clear();formation=null;leavePending=null;replacements=[];prepare();if(!active())base.stopIfIdle();else base.wake();});
            const blur=()=>{releaseBoostSpike(false);releaseBurst();base.clear();move=null;mouseDown=false;base.wake();},focus=()=>base.wake(),visibility=()=>{if(root.document.hidden)blur();else focus();};
            root.addEventListener('blur',blur);root.addEventListener('focus',focus);root.document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',visibility);
            ctx.onCleanup(()=>{disposed=true;clear();root.removeEventListener('blur',blur);root.removeEventListener('focus',focus);root.document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange',visibility);if(root.AntimoocheatBasePlacement===service)delete root.AntimoocheatBasePlacement;});

            base.wake();
        });
    }
    if(root.AntimoocheatPlacementHost)start();else root.addEventListener('antimoocheat:placement-host',start,{once:true});
})(window);

(function(root) {
    'use strict';
    function start() {
        let api;
        root.dispatchEvent(new root.CustomEvent('moomoo.js:api',{detail:{resolve:sdk=>{api=root.AntimoocheatCore?.api || sdk;}}}));
        if(!api || api.getMods().some(m=>m.id==='ws-upgrades'))return;
        const mod=api.register({id:'ws-upgrades',name:'WS Upgrades',version:'1.1',menu:false,defaultEnabled:true,settings:[]},ctx=>{
            const doc=root.document,owned=new Set(),ids=new Set([5,8,9,12,20]);
            let offer={points:0,age:0},pendingUntil=0,queued=false,disposed=false;
            const now=()=>root.performance.now();
            const available=item=>!disposed && api.isReady() && ctx.self.alive && offer.points>0 && item.age===offer.age && !ctx.self.items?.includes(item.id);
            function clear() {
                const hadExtras=owned.size>0;
                for(const node of owned)node.remove();owned.clear();
                const holder=doc.getElementById('upgradeHolder');
                if(hadExtras && holder && !holder.children.length){holder.style.display='none';const counter=doc.getElementById('upgradeCounter');if(counter)counter.style.display='none';}
            }
            function render() {
                queued=false;clear();
                if(disposed || !api.isReady() || !ctx.self.alive || offer.points<=0)return;
                const holder=doc.getElementById('upgradeHolder');if(!holder)return;
                for(const item of ctx.data.items) {
                    const index=ctx.data.weapons.length+item.id;
                    if(!ids.has(item.id) || !available(item) || doc.getElementById('upgradeItem'+index))continue;
                    const button=doc.createElement('div');button.id='mmj-upgrade-'+index;button.className='actionBarItem';button.title=item.name;
                    button.setAttribute('role','button');button.setAttribute('aria-label',item.name);button.tabIndex=0;
                    button.style.backgroundImage=doc.getElementById('actionBarItem'+index)?.style.backgroundImage||'';
                    const choose=event=>{
                        event.preventDefault();event.stopPropagation();
                        if(!owned.has(button) || !available(item) || now()<pendingUntil)return;
                        if(ctx.send.upgrade(index)===true)pendingUntil=now()+1000;
                    };
                    button.addEventListener('click',choose);
                    button.addEventListener('keydown',event=>{if(!event.repeat && (event.key==='Enter' || event.key===' '))choose(event);});
                    owned.add(button);holder.appendChild(button);
                }
                if(owned.size){holder.style.display='block';const counter=doc.getElementById('upgradeCounter');if(counter){counter.style.display='block';counter.textContent='SELECT ITEMS ('+offer.points+')';}}
            }
            function schedule(){if(!queued && !disposed){queued=true;ctx.after(0,render);}}
            ctx.on('upgrades',p=>{if(p.points!==offer.points || p.age!==offer.age)pendingUntil=0;offer={points:p.points,age:p.age};schedule();});
            ctx.on('inventory',schedule);
            for(const event of ['reset','setup','died','disconnect'])ctx.on(event,()=>{offer={points:0,age:0};pendingUntil=0;clear();});
            ctx.onCleanup(()=>{disposed=true;clear();});
        });
        if(!mod.enabled)api.enable('ws-upgrades');
    }
    if(root.AntimoocheatPlacementHost)start();else root.addEventListener('antimoocheat:placement-host',start,{once:true});
})(window);
